pmid-8388556.summary_en: This study compared blood group, Lewis, and HLA antigen frequencies in patients with testicular germ cell tumors with those in controls. Blood group frequencies did not differ, but the Lewis Le(a-b-) phenotype was more frequent in patients, and HLA-Bw41 was strongly associated with seminoma. No HLA associations with metastatic disease were found. The authors conclude that genetic factors likely contribute to the etiology and pathogenesis of GCT, and that HLA-Bw41 might serve as a risk marker for seminoma.

pmid-8389273.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患86例の絨毛組織を対象に、フローサイトメトリーでDNA量とRNA量を解析し、早期妊娠の絨毛組織と比較した。良性胞状奇胎の診断精度はRNA測定の方が高く、予後指標としてもRNAがより鋭敏だった。異数性DNA量は悪性傾向と関連し、侵入奇胎や絨毛癌の鑑別と予後判定に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-8389273.summary_en: This study used flow cytometry to measure DNA and RNA contents in trophoblastic tissue from 86 patients with trophoblastic disease and compared them with chorionic tissue from early pregnancy. RNA content gave higher diagnostic accuracy for benign moles and better prognostic sensitivity than DNA content. Aneuploid DNA content was linked to malignant tendency, suggesting that cytometric parameters can help distinguish benign from invasive mole and choriocarcinoma and inform prognosis during follow-up.

pmid-8389575.summary_ja: 胎仔摘出後に卵黄嚢を体外へ露出させ、げっ歯類に胎児外腫瘍を誘発したモデルを概説する。良性奇形腫は脱分化した内胚葉由来の多分化能細胞から生じ、その悪性転化により卵黄嚢癌や胎児性癌、まれに絨毛癌が発生する。癌胎児性抗原の検出や単クローン抗体の作製にも利用されてきた。
pmid-8389575.summary_en: This review describes extra-embryonal fetal tumors induced in rodents by externalizing the visceral yolk sac after fetectomy. Benign teratomas arise from dedifferentiated endodermal multipotential cells, while malignant yolk sac carcinomas, embryonal carcinoma, and rarely choriocarcinoma develop from malignant transformation of these cells. The tumors are transplantable, metastasize, and produce oncofetal antigens, which were used to generate monoclonal antibodies. The model offers insight into germ cell tumor histogenesis and antigen discovery.

pmid-8389653.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に合併した白血病6例を対象に、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分内の造血細胞を検討した。4例で形態学的に血液細胞が認められ、CD34陽性で骨髄系などの分化マーカーを示した。2例にi(12p)が見られ、白血病は卵黄嚢腫瘍由来の前駆細胞から生じて骨髄に移動したと考えられる。
pmid-8389653.summary_en: This study examined mediastinal germ cell tumors associated with leukemia in six patients, looking for hematopoietic cells within the yolk sac tumor component. Hematologic cells were found morphologically in four cases, with CD34 expression and variable myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocytic markers. Some expressed p53, and two showed i(12p), a GCT marker. The findings support that secondary leukemias arise from yolk sac tumor-derived progenitor cells that differentiate and home to the marrow.

pmid-8389657.summary_ja: 精巣がんからの巨大な左腎転移により症状を呈した患者の経過を報告する。精巣がんの症候性腎転移は稀であり、高い腫瘍量や治療抵抗性を反映する可能性がある。シスプラチン併用化学療法により著明な奏効が得られ、進行例では腎転移の存在も念頭に置く必要があることが示唆される。
pmid-8389657.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a massive left renal metastasis from testicular carcinoma. Symptomatic renal metastases from testicular cancer are rare and may reflect high tumor burden or refractory disease. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy produced a dramatic response in this patient. The report highlights that renal involvement, although uncommon, should be considered in advanced testicular germ cell disease, and that such patients may still respond well to standard systemic therapy.

pmid-8390229.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎と絨毛癌の患者各1例を報告し、血清中の早期妊娠因子(EPF)をロゼット阻止試験で測定した。両例ともEPFは手術中にすでに消失していた。検出技術が改善されれば、EPFは感度の高い腫瘍マーカーとなりうると著者らは述べている。本報告は2例のみに基づく予備的な知見である。
pmid-8390229.summary_en: This brief report describes two patients with trophoblastic tumours, one invasive mole and one choriocarcinoma, in whom serum early pregnancy factor (EPF), measured by the rosette inhibition test, was detected before surgery. In both patients EPF had already disappeared by the end of surgery. The authors propose that EPF may serve as a sensitive tumour marker for trophoblastic disease, provided that detection methods are improved.

pmid-8390367.summary_ja: 精巣の初期がんにおける細胞構成を、半薄切片、免疫細胞化学、電子顕微鏡で検討した。精細管内、間質、充実性セミノーマに複数の腫瘍細胞型が認められ、奇形腫細胞もグリコーゲンに富む腫瘍細胞と同じ領域に存在した。これはセミノーマと奇形腫が共通の起源細胞に由来することを支持する。マクロファージは精細管に侵入して腫瘍細胞を処理し、初期の精巣腫瘍の形成に重要な役割を果たす可能性が示された。
pmid-8390367.summary_en: This article examines the cellular composition of early testicular cancer using semithin sections, immunocytochemistry and electron microscopy. Several tumour cell types were identified within seminiferous tubules, the interstitium and solid seminoma, including teratoma cells alongside glycogen-rich tumour cells. These findings support a common cell of origin for seminomas and teratomas. The authors also describe macrophages invading tubules and lysing tumour cells, suggesting they play an essential role in the early organisation of testicular tumours.

pmid-8390744.summary_ja: 通常は正中部の体幹構造に生じる性腺外胚細胞腫瘍について、非正中部位である右腸骨窩に発生した初例を報告している。本症例と文献レビューに基づき、後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の診断基準であるAbellの基準の修正を提案する。非典型的な部位にも発生しうることを示し、これらの腫瘍の解剖学的発生範囲を広げる症例である。
pmid-8390744.summary_en: The authors describe the first reported case of an extragonadal germ cell tumour arising in the right iliac fossa, a non-midline pelvic site, rather than the usual midline structures. Based on this case and a literature review, they propose modifying Abell's criteria for diagnosing retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumours. The report highlights that such tumours can present at atypical locations, widening the recognised anatomic range of these tumours.

pmid-8391067.summary_ja: インディアナ大学で、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清標本で生存性の非奇形腫性胚細胞腫瘍が認められた133例を後方視的に解析した。不完全切除は極めて予後不良であった。初回化学療法後の完全切除例では、追加のシスプラチン併用化学療法2コースが安全かつ再発リスクの低減に有効と考えられた。救援化学療法後には、標準用量の追加化学療法による利益は認められなかった。
pmid-8391067.summary_en: This retrospective review from Indiana University analysed 133 patients with viable nonteratomatous germ cell tumour found in postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimens. Incomplete resection carried a very poor prognosis. After complete resection following primary chemotherapy, two additional cisplatin-based courses appeared safe and reduced relapse risk. Additional standard-dose chemotherapy offered no benefit after salvage chemotherapy.

pmid-8392116.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と対側精巣セミノーマに対し、手術、化学療法、放射線治療を受けた既往をもつ男性が、15年後に脳梗塞で発症した。精査で心臓内腫瘍が判明し、切除標本は成熟奇形腫であった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のまれな転移形式について、診断と管理を検討している。長期経過後も晩期再発への注意が必要であることを示す症例である。
pmid-8392116.summary_en: A 15-year history of nonseminomatous germ cell tumour and contralateral seminoma, treated surgically, medically and with radiotherapy, presented with cerebral infarction. Investigation revealed an intracardiac tumour, which was resected and proved to be a mature teratoma. The authors discuss the diagnosis and management of this rare metastatic presentation of nonseminomatous germ cell cancer. The case highlights the need for vigilance for late recurrence.

pmid-8392234.summary_ja: 1988年から1990年にウィスコンシン大学で胚細胞腫瘍に対し再後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた9例を報告する。適応は初回手術と化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は正常、転移検索は陰性、腫瘤は切除可能であった。平均32か月の追跡で9例中6例が無病生存していた。術前評価、病理組織学、合併症、手術手技を検討している。
pmid-8392234.summary_en: This review reports nine patients who underwent redo retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for germ cell tumours at the University of Wisconsin between 1988 and 1990. Indications included residual retroperitoneal mass after initial RPLND and chemotherapy, normal AFP and hCG levels, negative metastatic work-up, and a resectable mass. Six of nine patients were alive without evidence of disease at a mean follow-up of 32 months. Preoperative evaluation, histopathology, morbidity and technique are discussed.

pmid-8392454.summary_ja: hCG産生性の胚細胞腫瘍、Leydig細胞腫瘍、正常男性を比較し、GnRH刺激に対する性腺刺激ホルモンの反応を検討した。胚細胞腫瘍の男性はLHおよびFSHが抑制され、テストステロンとエストラジオールが上昇していたが、片側精巣摘除後に正常化した。Leydig細胞腫瘍ではエストラジオールが上昇しても性腺刺激ホルモンは正常であった。hCG産生腫瘍では完全な抑制が生じると結論づけている。
pmid-8392454.summary_en: This study compared gonadotrophin responses to GnRH in men with hCG-secreting germ cell tumours, men with Leydig cell tumours and normal controls. Men with germ cell tumours had suppressed LH and FSH with raised testosterone and oestradiol, which normalised after successful unilateral orchidectomy. Leydig cell tumour patients had normal gonadotrophins despite raised oestradiol. The authors conclude that hCG-secreting tumours cause complete gonadotrophin suppression, while Leydig tumours show only a weak oestradiol feedback effect.

pmid-8393373.summary_ja: 33歳男性で右精巣に奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍からなる精巣胚細胞腫瘍を認めた症例。後腹膜リンパ節転移に対し術後放射線療法を受け、その後肺再発に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を施行された。40歳時に対側のライディッヒ細胞腫瘍を発症し、精巣温存切除を受けた。胚細胞腫瘍と対側ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍の併発の初報告であり、共通の病因の可能性を示唆している。
pmid-8393373.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with a right testicular tumor composed of teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and yolk sac tumor. He developed retroperitoneal lymph node metastases, received adjuvant abdominal radiation therapy, and later received cisplatin-based chemotherapy for pulmonary relapse. At age 40, a contralateral Leydig cell tumor was treated by testis-sparing excision. The authors report the first observation of testicular germ cell tumor with contralateral Leydig cell tumor and suggest shared etiologic factors as a possible explanation.

pmid-8393380.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍の30例に対し、大量カルボプラチン、エトポシド、シクロホスファミドと自家骨髄移植を行った第I相試験。G-CSFにより好中球減少期間が短縮し、継続的完全寛解は23%であった。薬物動態を解析し、許容可能な毒性で50mg/kg×3日の用量を決定した。
pmid-8393380.summary_en: This phase I trial treated 30 patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumor using high-dose carboplatin, etoposide, cyclophosphamide, and autologous bone marrow transplantation. G-CSF shortened neutropenia, and cyclophosphamide was escalated to 150 mg/kg without prohibitive toxicity. Thirteen patients (43%) achieved complete response, and 23% remained in continuous complete response. Pharmacokinetic analyses were performed, and 50 mg/kg daily for 3 days was selected as the dose with acceptable toxicity.

pmid-8393729.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者87例を対象に、外部施設の病理報告書を専門施設で再検討した研究。32%で診断が異なり、11%では治療方針または予後の変更につながった。専門施設での病理再検討は精巣がん治療の不可欠な第一歩であると結論している。
pmid-8393729.summary_en: This study assessed how histological review of outside pathology reports affects the management of testicular cancer in 87 referred patients. In 32% of patients, the reviewed diagnosis differed from the outside report. In 11% of patients, this review changed treatment or prognosis. The authors conclude that pathology review at a specialist cancer center is an essential first step in managing testicular cancer.

pmid-8393944.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における潜在性転移の予測因子を検討した研究。36例中、フローサイトメトリーの指標は有用ではなかった。一方、原発巣における胎児性癌の割合は潜在性病期II例で有意に高く、多変量解析でも有意であった。この割合が再発リスクの評価に役立つ可能性を示唆している。
pmid-8393944.summary_en: This study tested whether DNA flow cytometry and quantitative histology can predict occult metastases in clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Among 36 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, flow cytometric parameters were not useful. The percentage of embryonal carcinoma in the primary tumor was significantly higher in patients with occult stage II disease and remained significant on multivariate analysis. The authors suggest this percentage may help identify stage I patients at risk.

pmid-8394368.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者7例で、化学療法前後の血清中の非ras型21kDaタンパク(p21)濃度を測定した研究。奏効例の多くで低下し、非セミノーマ性腫瘍では腫瘍マーカーの推移と一致した。セミノーマや腫瘍マーカー陰性例の効果判定に有用な可能性を示唆している。
pmid-8394368.summary_en: This study measured serum levels of a non-ras 21-kDa protein (p21) in patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors before and after chemotherapy. Levels fell in most patients who responded, paralleling changes in alpha-fetoprotein, hCG, and LDH in non-seminomatous tumors and LDH in seminomas. Elevated p21 occurred in both seminomatous and non-seminomatous tumors. The authors suggest p21 may help monitor response in seminoma and marker-negative patients, and its biological role remains to be investigated.

pmid-8394879.summary_ja: 1970年から1990年にハノーバー医科大学で治療された精巣がん1025例における続発性悪性腫瘍の頻度を検討した研究。14例(累積発生率1.38%)に続発性腫瘍を認め、放射線療法後に最も高いリスクを示した(相対危険度7.53)。化学療法や監視療法では有意な上昇は認められず、治療の利益が上回ると結論している。
pmid-8394879.summary_en: This study evaluated secondary malignancies in 1,025 patients treated for testicular cancer at Hannover Medical School between 1970 and 1990. Fourteen patients (cumulative incidence 1.38%) developed a second neoplasm. The risk was highest after radiotherapy, with a relative risk of 7.53 compared with the male German population. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy and surveillance did not significantly increase risk. The authors conclude that the benefits of curative treatment far outweigh the risk of secondary cancer.

pmid-8394948.summary_ja: 精巣原発の純粋型セミノーマ由来の新規ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株TCam-2を樹立した。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGは産生せず、5G9、4B3、胎盤型ALPが陽性であった。染色体はモード数92でY染色体の欠失を認めた。scidマウスへの移植で古典的セミノーマ組織を形成し、由来が支持された。
pmid-8394948.summary_en: The authors established TCam-2, a new human testicular germ cell tumor cell line derived from a primary left testicular pure seminoma in a 35-year-old man. TCam-2 produced neither AFP nor beta-hCG but expressed 5G9, 4B3 and placental alkaline phosphatase. Karyotyping showed a modal number of 92 with loss of the Y chromosome. Histochemical and morphological features supported classical seminoma, and the line formed seminomatous tissue when transplanted into scid mice.

pmid-8394949.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍におけるGb3発現を抗Gb3モノクローナル抗体1A4で免疫組織化学的に検討した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍のすべての成分で陽性となり、セミノーマと胎児性癌では100%であった。精巣悪性リンパ腫は陰性であった。固定法により染色性が変化し、ホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋標本も利用可能であった。Gb3は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織マーカーとなり得ると考えられた。
pmid-8394949.summary_en: The study examined globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) expression by immunohistochemistry with the anti-Gb3 monoclonal antibody 1A4 in testicular tumors. Gb3 was detected in all components of testicular germ cell tumors, including 100% of seminomas and embryonal carcinomas, but not in testicular lymphomas. Staining varied with fixation and processing methods, and formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded specimens were also usable. The authors suggest Gb3 may serve as a histological marker for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-8395487.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の2例を報告した。1例は子宮原発、もう1例は卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分であり、いずれも初診時に明らかな甲状腺中毒症を呈した。腫瘍が産生するヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン（hCG）の甲状腺刺激作用が原因と考えられている。甲状腺機能異常の患者では、この希少な合併を念頭に置くべきである。
pmid-8395487.summary_en: The authors describe two patients with choriocarcinoma who presented with clinically overt thyrotoxicosis at initial diagnosis. One was a uterine choriocarcinoma and the other was a choriocarcinoma component of an ovarian germ cell tumor. The thyrotoxicosis is attributed to the thyrotropic action of human chorionic gonadotropin produced by the tumors. The report highlights this rare clinical association, which clinicians should recognize in patients presenting with thyroid dysfunction.

pmid-8395497.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の診断と局所病期分類における磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の役割を後方視的研究で検討した。MRIは超音波検査より視野が広く、組織コントラストに優れる。ほぼ全例でセミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍を鑑別できた。一方、Leydig細胞腫瘍はセミノーマと区別できず、精巣内血腫は非セミノーマ性腫瘍と誤認され得る。白膜を越える微小進展は評価できなかった。
pmid-8395497.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluates the role of magnetic resonance imaging in diagnosing and locally staging testicular tumors, compared with sonography. MRI offers a wider field of view and greater tissue contrast. It differentiates seminomatous from non-seminomatous tumors in nearly all cases. However, Leydig cell tumors cannot be distinguished from seminomas, and intratesticular hematomas can mimic non-seminomatous tumors. Microscopic extension beyond the tunica albuginea cannot be assessed by MR.

pmid-8395499.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する放射線療法と化学療法を概説した。精巣腫瘍は成人における治癒可能な固形腫瘍の典型例であり、化学療法は最も成功した応用の一つである。セミノーマは放射線感受性が高く、早期例では補助療法として放射線療法が用いられる。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）については、早期例に対する待機方針と進行例での化学療法の役割が論じられている。
pmid-8395499.summary_en: This review covers radiotherapy and chemotherapy for testis tumors. It notes that testis tumors are a model of curable solid tumors in adults, with chemotherapy among their most successful applications. Seminomas are highly radiosensitive, and radiotherapy remains adjuvant treatment for early-stage disease. For dysgerminoma, the authors discuss a wait-and-see policy for early tumors and the role of chemotherapy in advanced disease.

pmid-8396596.summary_ja: 超音波検査で精巣実質全体に散在する点状の高エコー像（精巣微小石灰化）を示した4例を報告する。4例中3例は同時性に精巣がんを合併していた。文献的考察から、精巣微小石灰化は精巣腫瘍と関連する可能性があるとした。この所見を認めた場合は、精巣を慎重に評価しフォローアップすることを推奨している。
pmid-8396596.summary_en: This report describes four patients in whom sonography detected testicular microlithiasis, defined as diffuse, punctate hyperechoic foci throughout the testicular parenchyma. Three of the four had concurrent testicular carcinoma. After reviewing previous reports, the authors conclude that microlithiasis may be associated with testicular neoplasia. They recommend careful evaluation and follow-up of the testes when this finding is detected.

pmid-8397061.summary_ja: インドの地域がんセンターにおける後方視的研究である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍123例のうち3例が寛解中に孤立性脳転移を生じた。セミノーマの2例は放射線療法後に無症状で生存し、胎児性癌が主体の混合型の1例は脳転移の再発で死亡した。文献上、脳転移は通常は全身転移に先行し、単独の再発部位となることは極めてまれである。
pmid-8397061.summary_en: This retrospective study from a regional cancer center in northern India identified three of 123 patients with testicular germ cell tumor who developed isolated cerebral metastasis during remission. Two patients with pure seminoma were treated with radiotherapy and remained symptom-free, while the third, with a mixed tumor dominated by embryonal carcinoma, died of recurrent brain metastases. The literature review notes that brain metastasis is almost always preceded by systemic spread and is rarely the sole site of relapse.

pmid-8397089.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍100例で神経特異的エノラーゼ(NSE)を測定し、腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した。進行セミノーマでは18例中5例、進行非セミノーマでは25例中7例で上昇していた。全病期でも陽性率は20%未満で、フォローアップ中に偽陽性・偽陰性を示す例もあり、NSEは有用な腫瘍マーカーではないと結論された。
pmid-8397089.summary_en: This study measured neuron-specific enolase (NSE) in 100 patients with germ cell tumors to assess its value as a serum tumor marker. NSE was elevated in 5 of 18 patients with advanced seminoma and 7 of 25 with advanced nonseminoma. Overall, fewer than 20% of patients with any stage of seminoma or nonseminoma were NSE-positive, and some results were false-positive or false-negative during follow-up. The authors concluded that NSE is not a valuable tumor marker for germ cell tumors.

pmid-8397155.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺形成不全を伴う19歳のXY女性で、性腺に複数の胚細胞腫瘍組織型が認められた症例報告。両側付属器を切除し子宮は温存された。両側性腺に性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）分化、左側に成熟奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍が認められた。補助療法は行われず、診断後30か月時点で良好な経過であった。
pmid-8397155.summary_en: This report describes a 19-year-old with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis who had five histologic subtypes of germ cell malignancy in the gonads. Both adnexa were removed while the uterus was preserved. Pathology showed gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma differentiation in both gonads, and mature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and endodermal sinus tumor in the left gonad. She received no adjuvant treatment and remained well 30 months after diagnosis.

pmid-8397165.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC4をレチノイン酸で分化誘導すると、EC細胞マーカーが低下し体細胞分化を示した。その後のシスプラチンおよびエトポシドに対する感受性は、いずれも増強した。白金の細胞内蓄積やPt-DNA結合の変化は認められず、分化誘導と化学療法の併用の意義を示す基礎研究である。
pmid-8397165.summary_en: Murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, PCC4, were pretreated with all-trans retinoic acid (RA) to induce differentiation and then exposed to cisplatin or etoposide. RA reduced EC markers and increased cytokeratin and neurofilament expression, indicating early somatic differentiation. RA pretreatment increased sensitivity to both drugs, with cisplatin IC50 reduced 1.9- to 2.6-fold and etoposide sensitivity increased 2.5- to 3-fold, without changes in platinum accumulation or Pt-DNA binding.

pmid-8397359.summary_ja: 絨毛癌3例由来の細胞株について、PCR法で縦列反復配列を増幅し原因となった妊娠を特定した。2例は完全胞状奇胎、1例は正期産の死産に由来した。胞状奇胎9例と侵入奇胎3例はすべて雄性発生（androgenetic）であった。少量の検体で済み、放射性同位元素を用いない手法である。
pmid-8397359.summary_en: Using PCR amplification of tandem repeat loci, this study identified the pregnancy responsible for choriocarcinoma in three patients, using DNA from three established cell lines and from patient and husband lymphocytes. Two tumors arose from complete hydatidiform moles and one from a full-term fetal death. All nine hydatidiform moles and three invasive moles examined were androgenetic. The method requires only small specimens and avoids isotopes.

pmid-8398923.summary_ja: 20歳で左側の悪性奇形腫と同側の傍大動脈リンパ節転移を発症した症例。左精巣摘除術、骨盤・腹部への放射線療法、化学療法を受けた後に無精子症となったが、治療後14年以上を経て妊孕性が回復した。精巣腫瘍の思春期後の男性では、遷延する精子形成抑制の報告は少ないと述べている。
pmid-8398923.summary_en: A man who developed a left-sided malignant teratoma with ipsilateral para-aortic node involvement at age 20 was treated with orchidectomy, abdominal and pelvic radiotherapy, and chemotherapy. He was azoospermic afterward but regained fertility more than 14 years after treatment. The authors note that prolonged iatrogenic suppression of spermatogenesis has been reported in younger lymphoma patients but is less often described in postpubertal men with testicular tumours.

pmid-8400045.summary_ja: 妊娠性および非妊娠性トロホブラスト腫瘍の最近の進歩をまとめた総説。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の起源をDNA解析で明らかにし、胞状奇胎と正常妊娠の併存を診断可能にした。分類の洗練と腫瘍マーカーの拡充により、妊娠性腫瘍の救済治療の改善が期待される。
pmid-8400045.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in gestational and non-gestational trophoblastic neoplasms. Topics include DNA analysis that clarified the origin of placental site trophoblastic tumors, a choriocarcinoma variant; diagnostic definition of coexistent hydatidiform mole and normal gestation carried to viability; and refined classification and expanded tumor markers that may improve salvage therapy for gestational neoplasms and emerging non-gestational neoplasms.

pmid-8402461.summary_ja: 低分化卵巣癌の2例で絨毛癌成分が認められた。両腫瘍ともβ-hCG陽性の合胞体栄養膜細胞を伴う壊死性結節を有し、1例では粘液性嚢胞腺腫からの移行帯が見られた。両例とも早期に腹腔外転移を生じ、多剤化学療法にもかかわらず術後間もなく死亡した。上皮性卵巣腫瘍の脱分化により絨毛癌が生じうることを示し、攻撃的な経過の指標として重要とする。
pmid-8402461.summary_en: Two cases of poorly differentiated ovarian carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous components are described. Both tumors contained necrotic nodules with cytotrophoblast and beta-HCG-positive syncytiotrophoblast, and one showed a transition zone from a mucinous cystadenoma. Both developed early extra-abdominal metastases and died shortly after surgery despite multiagent chemotherapy. The authors suggest choriocarcinoma can arise from dedifferentiation of epithelial ovarian tumors, and its recognition matters because it signals aggressive behavior.

pmid-8403882.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍42例を後方視的に検討した。古典的セミノーマ27例、胎児性癌9例に加え、セミノーマの増殖様式と胎児性癌の細胞学的特徴を併せ持つ非定型例6例を解析した。生存率は古典的セミノーマ90%、非定型セミノーマ80%、胎児性癌63%で、統計学的有意差はなかった。著者らは、非定型セミノーマがセミノーマと胎児性癌の中間病変であると考察している。
pmid-8403882.summary_en: This study examined 42 patients treated for primary testicular germ cell tumors between 1975 and 1985. Of these, 27 were classical seminomas and nine were embryonal carcinomas. The remaining six were difficult to classify, showing seminoma growth patterns with embryonal carcinoma cytologic features. Immunostaining suggested progression toward embryonal carcinoma in four of these atypical cases. Survival rates were 90% for classical seminoma, 80% for atypical seminoma, and 63% for embryonal carcinoma, though the differences were not statistically significant. The authors suggest atypical seminoma is an intermediate lesion between the two.

pmid-8405478.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍41例を前向きに検討し、シスプラチン併用化学療法の前後および治療中の後腹膜リンパ節転移を磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で評価した。MRIは開腹術と同等に転移の局在と大きさを評価でき、化学療法後の残存腫瘤の評価にも有用であった。一方、残存腫瘤の生存腫瘍の有無や治療効果は判定できなかった。
pmid-8405478.summary_en: This prospective study of 41 consecutive patients with non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors evaluated magnetic resonance imaging of retroperitoneal lymph node metastases before, during, and after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. MRI localized and sized metastases with accuracy comparable to laparotomy, and it also measured residual masses after treatment. Signal intensity and homogeneity on T1- and T2-weighted images varied among components of the metastases. However, MRI could not determine tumor viability or other chemotherapy effects within residual masses.

pmid-8407043.summary_ja: 臀筋部に発生した良性嚢胞性奇形腫の1例を報告。非典型的な性腺外部位の奇形腫の診断に磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を用いた。著者らの知る限り、この腫瘍の型がMRIで検討された症例は過去になく、画像所見の初めての報告である。MRIは軟部腫瘤の性状評価に有用であることを示唆する。
pmid-8407043.summary_en: The report describes a benign cystic teratoma arising in the gluteus maximus region, an unusual extragonadal site. Magnetic resonance imaging was used to aid diagnosis, supporting its value in characterizing soft-tissue masses. The authors state that, to their knowledge, no previous case of this tumor type had been investigated with MRI, making this a notable first imaging description. The paper is a brief case report.

pmid-8411400.summary_ja: 神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清の際に、経膀胱超音波検査と尿道内視鏡検査を用いて射精(emission)機能を術中にモニタリングする方法を報告する。非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の患者に対し、両側7例、片側4例に神経温存手術を行った。腰部神経L1からL3を電気刺激することで、射精に重要な神経を同定できた。モニタリングには超音波検査のみで十分であった。2例では、化学療法後の後腹膜残存線維化病変の中で関連神経を特定することができた。
pmid-8411400.summary_en: This study presents an intraoperative method using transvesical sonography and urethral endoscopy to monitor ejaculatory (emission) function during nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Seven patients had bilateral and four had unilateral nerve-sparing procedures for nonseminomatous testicular tumors. Electrostimulation of lumbar nerves L1 to L3 allowed identification of nerves important for emission. Sonography alone was sufficient for monitoring, and in two patients the method helped identify relevant nerves within residual fibrotic mass after chemotherapy.

pmid-8411415.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に生じる乳糜腹水の18例を検討した。穿刺や腹囲増大などから診断された。下大静脈切除を伴った6例がハイリスク群と考えられた。治療は脂肪制限食と中鎖脂肪酸の投与、利尿薬が中心で、多くは食事療法のみで改善した。腹腔静脈シャント術や手術が選択された症例もある。
pmid-8411415.summary_en: This report describes chylous ascites, an uncommon complication after retroperitoneal dissection for testicular cancer. Eighteen patients developed the condition, diagnosed by paracentesis or clinical signs such as increasing abdominal girth. Six patients had undergone resection of the inferior vena cava, a group the authors identify as high risk. Management included dietary fat restriction with medium chain triglycerides and diuretics, hyperalimentation, peritoneovenous shunting, or surgery, and most patients responded successfully to dietary treatment alone.

pmid-8411821.summary_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍の核DNA倍数性をフローサイトメトリーで解析した研究。卵黄嚢腫瘍9例と奇形腫8例はすべて倍数性を示し、異数体性は認めなかった。成人例の大半は異数体を示すことが知られており、小児と成人では発生機序が異なると考察された。小児では上皮内癌(CIS)が見られないことも根拠とされている。
pmid-8411821.summary_en: This study used DNA flow cytometry to analyze nuclear ploidy in testicular tumors from nine boys with yolk sac tumor and eight with prepubertal teratoma. All childhood tumors were DNA euploid, with diploid or tetraploid patterns and no aneuploidy or heterogeneity. In contrast, most adult testicular tumors previously reported contain aneuploid stemlines. Because carcinoma in situ is not observed in children and is the precursor of adult disease, the authors conclude that prepubertal testicular tumors arise through a pathogenesis different from adult tumors.

pmid-8412157.summary_ja: Tata Memorial Hospitalにおける病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍156例の経験を報告する。内訳はセミノーマ81例、非セミノーマ性腫瘍75例で、5年間に治療された。セミノーマ患者の多くは予防的放射線療法を受け、生存率は高かった。非セミノーマ性腫瘍では、血清マーカーの状態および後腹膜リンパ節郭清、化学療法、経過観察の治療法によって結果を比較した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の全生存率は96%、無病生存率は88%であった。マーカー陽性の疾患では、RPLNDと化学療法により高い治癒率が得られた。
pmid-8412157.summary_en: This Tata Memorial Hospital series reviews 156 patients with stage I testicular germ cell tumors, 81 seminomas and 75 nonseminomas, treated over five years. Seminoma patients mostly received prophylactic radiation, with high survival. Among nonseminomas, outcomes were compared by serum marker status and by management, including retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, chemotherapy, or surveillance. Overall survival was 96% for nonseminomas and disease-free survival 88%, with RPLND and chemotherapy yielding high rates in marker-positive disease.

pmid-8413005.summary_ja: 生後20か月の女児に発生した頭頸部(左側頭部)の正中線外卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。5cm大の腫瘤で、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で骨破壊を認めた。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とLDHが上昇していた。BEP療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)6サイクルで完全寛解し、5か月間寛解を維持している。
pmid-8413005.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-month-old girl with a non-midline endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor in the left temporal region of the head and neck. The 5 cm mass showed bone destruction on CT, and histopathological examination confirmed the diagnosis. Serum AFP and LDH were elevated. Treatment with BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) for six cycles produced a partial response after the first cycle and complete response after the fourth. The patient remained in remission for five months.

pmid-8413886.summary_ja: 妊娠26週の28歳女性が、3年前に卵巣腫瘍を切除した後に前頭部頭蓋骨の腫瘤を発症した症例報告である。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で頭蓋を貫通する硬膜外腫瘍を認め、胎児モニタリング下に全摘出を行い、健常な児を正期産で得た。病理は濾胞状腺癌で、甲状腺に異常はなく、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫からの転移と判断された。妊娠中の脳腫瘍の管理も考察されている。
pmid-8413886.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman in the 26th week of pregnancy developed an enlarging frontal cranial vault mass three years after resection of an ovarian tumor. MRI showed an extradural tumor invading the skull. Under fetal monitoring she underwent total resection including adjacent bone and dura, and delivered a healthy infant at term. Pathology showed follicular adenocarcinoma, and a normal thyroid indicated metastasis from a malignant struma ovarii. The authors also discuss brain tumor management during pregnancy.

pmid-8417194.summary_ja: 成熟型精巣奇形腫が下大静脈への浸潤と血栓を来し、再発性肺塞栓症として発症した症例報告である。根治的精巣摘除術と化学療法による減量の後、体外循環と深部低体温循環停止下に下大静脈を含む巨大後腹膜腫瘍を一塊として切除した。治療方針を考察し、文献的な検討も行われている。
pmid-8417194.summary_en: The authors report a case of mature testicular teratoma with invasion and thrombosis of the inferior vena cava, which first presented as recurrent pulmonary embolism. Management included radical orchiectomy and chemotherapeutic cytoreduction, followed by resection of a massive retroperitoneal tumor with en bloc removal of the inferior vena cava under cardiopulmonary bypass and deep hypothermic circulatory arrest. The paper discusses management strategies and reviews the relevant literature on this rare presentation.

pmid-8418082.summary_ja: 早産兆候で入院し36週で出産した女性の正期産胎盤に、臨床的に予想されなかった絨毛癌が見つかった。胎盤病理では多巣性の絨毛癌を認め、産後6日の血清β-hCGは著増し肺転移を伴っていた。多剤併用化学療法9クールにより、1年後も腫瘍は認められていない。異常妊娠における胎盤検査の有用性を示す症例である。
pmid-8418082.summary_en: A clinically unsuspected choriocarcinoma arose in a term placenta from a woman who was hospitalized antepartum for preterm labor and delivered a normal infant at 36 weeks. Placental examination revealed multifocal choriocarcinoma without villous stromal invasion. Six days postpartum, serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated and lung metastases were found. She received nine courses of multiagent chemotherapy and was tumor-free at one year. The case shows the value of placental examination in abnormal gestations.

pmid-8420674.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍の組織型を年齢層ごとに比較した総説である。小児期・若年では奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍などの胚細胞腫瘍が主体となる。成人では上皮性腫瘍が大半を占め、50歳以上では進行した予後不良の卵巣癌が多い。境界悪性腫瘍は30〜40歳の女性に多く、予後は良好である。
pmid-8420674.summary_en: This review contrasts ovarian pathology across age groups. In infancy and childhood, germ cell neoplasms such as teratomas, dysgerminomas, and endodermal sinus tumors predominate. In adults, epithelial tumors account for most cases, with benign epithelial tumors peaking at ages 20 to 40 and borderline tumors affecting women aged 30 to 40 with excellent prognosis. Older women more often present with advanced, aggressive ovarian cancer and poor survival.

pmid-8421106.summary_ja: 甲状腺機能亢進症を伴う胞状奇胎3例で、奇胎組織と血清由来のhCGの甲状腺刺激活性を比較した研究である。陰イオン交換で保持されない画分は部分的に脱シアル化されたhCG前駆体を含み、約2倍の活性を示した。奇胎由来hCGの糖鎖修飾の変化が、妊娠性絨毛性疾患に伴う甲状腺機能亢進に関与する可能性が示唆される。
pmid-8421106.summary_en: This study examined the thyrotropic activity of hCG from hydatidiform moles and serum of three hyperthyroid patients with molar pregnancy. Anion exchange chromatography separated a fraction not retained on the column, which contains a partially desialylated hCG precursor and showed about twice the thyrotropic activity of the retained fraction. Altered sialylation of molar hCG may contribute to the hyperthyroidism associated with gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-8421755.summary_ja: 38例48病変の付属器腫瘤について、脂肪抑制MRIによる奇形腫と嚢胞性出血性病変の鑑別能を検討した研究である。標準的なT1・T2強調像は信号強度による正診率が低かったが、脂肪抑制T1強調像により奇形腫の感度は92%に向上した。脂肪抑制MRIは奇形腫の特徴付けにおいて従来法より統計学的に優れていた。
pmid-8421755.summary_en: This study assessed proton-selective fat-saturation MRI for distinguishing teratomas from cystic hemorrhagic adnexal masses in 38 patients with 48 lesions. Standard T1- and T2-weighted sequences characterized only about half of lesions correctly by signal intensity, and chemical-shift criteria improved teratoma detection. Fat-saturation T1-weighted imaging alone raised teratoma sensitivity to 92% and cystic hemorrhagic mass sensitivity to 100%. The authors conclude that fat-saturation MRI is statistically superior for characterizing teratomas.

pmid-8428423.summary_ja: 両側精巣セミノーマの患者に精巣微小石灰化を合併し、「雪嵐」様の所見を示した症例を報告している。超音波検査の所見と病理所見を提示し、胚細胞腫瘍と石灰化の併存に注意すべきことを示した。
pmid-8428423.summary_en: This 1993 Clinical Radiology case report describes a patient with bilateral testicular seminomas who also had testicular microlithiasis, producing a snowstorm appearance on imaging. The authors present both the ultrasound features and the pathological findings. The case highlights that microlithiasis can coexist with germ cell tumors and that its sonographic appearance should prompt careful evaluation of the testis. It is a single-patient report that illustrates the imaging and histological correlation in seminoma-associated microlithiasis.

pmid-8428686.summary_ja: 愛知県の登録制度で1981年から1990年に追跡された部分奇胎妊娠349例中、10例が侵入奇胎を発症した。完全奇胎より発生率は低く、化学療法を平均5.5クール要し、絨毛癌や再発は認められなかった。
pmid-8428686.summary_en: This 1993 Gynecologic Oncology study followed 349 patients with partial molar pregnancy registered in Aichi Prefecture from 1981 to 1990. Ten (2.87%) developed invasive partial mole, a rate significantly lower than the 12.34% seen after complete mole. They were diagnosed earlier and achieved hCG normalization with a mean of 5.5 chemotherapy courses, comparable to invasive complete mole. None developed choriocarcinoma or recurrence. The authors recommend that partial mole patients undergo the same follow-up as complete mole patients.

pmid-8432519.summary_ja: 新生児女児から外科的切除された仙尾部奇形腫の中に、未熟な神経網膜に囲まれたレンズ様細胞（レントイド）が認められた。実験的な胚由来奇形腫との比較から、神経網膜または色素上皮からの転分化により生じた可能性が示唆された。仙尾部奇形腫の胚起源と、胚後端の複雑な形態形成との関連も論じられている。
pmid-8432519.summary_en: This histopathologic study describes lens-like cells (lentoids) surrounded by immature neural retina within a sacrococcygeal teratoma removed surgically from a female newborn. Comparison with experimental embryo-derived teratomas suggests that the lentoids arose by transdifferentiation, a cell-type conversion, from immature neural retina or pigmented retinal epithelium. The authors discuss the embryonic origin of sacrococcygeal teratomas in relation to complex morphogenetic features at the posterior end of the early embryo. The finding highlights the developmental complexity underlying these extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-8434423.summary_ja: モノクローナル抗体を用いて、セミノーマの腫瘍細胞におけるALPアイソザイムを免疫組織学的に検討した。純粋セミノーマ11例などで胎盤型ALP様物質が検出され、肝型ALPも全例で認められた。両者は酵素活性を示し、組織標本で検出可能な腫瘍マーカーとなりうる。
pmid-8434423.summary_en: This immunohistopathological study uses monoclonal antibodies to examine alkaline phosphatase isozymes in seminoma. Placental alkaline phosphatase-like substance was detected in tumor cells of 11 pure seminomas, a seminoma with embryonal carcinoma, and a seminoma metastasis. Liver alkaline phosphatase was present in all seminomas, while intestinal alkaline phosphatase was not detected. Both the placental-like substance and liver alkaline phosphatase showed considerable enzyme activity. The authors conclude that these two markers can be detected in histopathologic specimens.

pmid-8434433.summary_ja: 思春期前の奇形腫は一般に良性だが、思春期以降では悪性として振る舞う。転移のない成人は精巣摘除術後にサーベイランスを行いうる。奇形腫成分は化学療法に反応しないため、少量の後腹膜転移は外科的切除が選択されることが多い。
pmid-8434433.summary_en: This review addresses the management of teratoma in children, adolescents, and adults. Prepubertal teratoma is generally benign, whereas it behaves malignantly in older patients. Adults without metastases may be followed with surveillance after orchiectomy. Low-volume retroperitoneal metastases are often treated surgically because teratomatous deposits do not respond to chemotherapy, while larger masses may receive chemotherapy first. Residual teratomatous masses are usually excised, and in childhood, inguinal orchiectomy or enucleation may suffice if the lesion is purely teratoma.

pmid-8434434.summary_ja: 小児の性腺間質腫瘍、性腺芽腫、精巣の続発性腫瘍を概説している。性腺間質腫瘍は一般に良性でホルモン非産生性だが、活性がある場合は男性化や女性化を来し、思春期前の男児では内分泌上の問題となる。精巣の続発性腫瘍では白血病浸潤が最も多い。
pmid-8434434.summary_en: This article reviews gonadal stromal tumors, gonadoblastomas, epidermoid cysts, and secondary testicular tumors in children. Gonadal stromal tumors are usually benign and hormonally silent, but when active they can cause virilization or feminization, posing an endocrine risk in prepubertal boys. Accurate diagnosis is needed to distinguish tumors requiring medical management from those best treated by surgical resection, and benign from malignant lesions. Leukemic infiltration is the most common secondary testicular tumor, followed by neuroblastoma, Wilms' tumor, and gonadoblastoma.

pmid-8434437.summary_ja: 小児の精巣腫瘍は成人より良性が多く、転移の頻度も低い。そのため小児では侵襲の少ない外科的アプローチが発展してきた。適切な症例では精巣温存手術が、成長期の子どもの心理面・整容面の利点をもたらし、成人後の妊孕性にも寄与する可能性がある。本論文は思春期前の精巣病変に対するこの方針の根拠を論じている。
pmid-8434437.summary_en: This review describes pediatric testicular tumors, which are more often benign and less often metastatic than adult tumors. Because of this, a less aggressive surgical approach has evolved for children. In appropriate cases, testis-sparing surgery offers psychological and cosmetic benefits for the developing child and may preserve fertility potential when the child reaches adulthood. The authors discuss the rationale for this approach in prepubertal testicular lesions.

pmid-8434439.summary_ja: 精巣の病期Iセミノーマに対する治療戦略を扱う。十分な人員と資源を備えた医療体制であれば、前向き試験のガイドラインに従って厳密に行う監視が、補助放射線療法の適切な代替法になると述べている。治癒可能な胚細胞腫瘍における監視戦略を支持する内容であり、フォローアップの確実性と資源の確保が前提となる。
pmid-8434439.summary_en: This paper addresses management of stage I seminoma of the testis. It states that, in a health care system with adequate personnel and resources, careful surveillance rigorously performed according to guidelines from prospective trials is an appropriate alternative to adjuvant irradiation. The conclusion supports surveillance as a treatment strategy for patients with this curable germ cell tumor, provided that follow-up is reliable and resources are sufficient.

pmid-8436248.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対して根治的腹部放射線療法を受けた23年後に、遅発性の膵機能不全による脂肪便症を発症した症例を報告する。照射後の膵障害はまれである。腹部照射が治療から長年後に消化管合併症を引き起こしうることを示し、胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者で吸収不良症状がみられた場合に留意すべき点を強調している。
pmid-8436248.summary_en: This case report describes delayed pancreatic insufficiency with steatorrhoea occurring 23 years after radical abdominal radiotherapy given for testicular seminoma. Such post-irradiation pancreatic injury is rare. The report highlights that abdominal radiation can cause late gastrointestinal complications many years after treatment, and clinicians caring for long-term survivors of germ cell tumors should consider this possibility when patients present with malabsorption symptoms.

pmid-8436463.summary_ja: 生後8か月の乳児に発症した、中耳・耳管・上咽頭に生じた稀な良性奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍の正体が判明する前に部分的に切除されたが、術後3日目に腫瘍が耳管から脱出して喉頭を閉塞し、生命を脅かす気道閉塞を生じた。中耳病変が耳管を変位させている場合には、上咽頭の診察が重要であることを強調している。
pmid-8436463.summary_en: This case report describes a rare benign teratoma arising in the middle ear, eustachian tube and nasopharynx of an 8-month-old infant. Partial surgical resection was performed before the true nature of the tumor was recognized. Three days after surgery, the tumor displaced from the eustachian tube, causing life-threatening airway obstruction. The authors discuss the unusual presentation and pathology and emphasize the importance of nasopharyngeal examination when middle ear lesions distort the eustachian tube.

pmid-8437268.summary_ja: 1978年から1991年に仙尾部奇形腫と診断された29例を後方視的に検討した。尿閉、水腎症、陰嚢水腫、停留精巣などの泌尿器症状がみられた。尿閉例では超音波検査と排尿時膀胱尿道造影で嚢胞性の直腸後部病変と膀胱の偏位が確認された。水腎症は排尿不良と高い膀胱内圧に起因し、腫瘍切除後に自然に軽快した。原発性の上部尿路奇形は認められなかった。
pmid-8437268.summary_en: This retrospective review examined 29 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma treated between 1978 and 1991. Urological disorders included urinary retention, hydronephrosis, hydrocele and undescended testis. Ultrasonography and voiding cystourethrography in patients with urinary retention showed cystic retrorectal lesions and bladder displacement. Hydronephrosis was attributed to poor bladder emptying and high intravesical pressure and resolved after tumor resection, with no primary upper tract anomalies.

pmid-8439506.summary_ja: インドの一施設で6年間に診察された精巣の原発性胚細胞腫瘍108例を後方視的に解析した。セミノーマ45例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍63例で、約半数が進行期で受診し、停留精巣由来は14%だった。治療完遂は68.5%にとどまり、主な理由は化学療法の費用負担だった。完遂例の4年生存率は0.77で、早期発見とフォローアップの強化が求められている。
pmid-8439506.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 108 patients with primary testicular germ cell tumours at a tertiary cancer hospital in New Delhi over six years reports 45 seminomas and 63 non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. Nearly half presented with advanced disease, and 14% arose in undescended testes. Only 68.5% completed prescribed treatment, mainly because chemotherapy was unaffordable. Four-year survival among completers was 0.77, prompting calls for better detection, follow-up and screening.

pmid-8442676.summary_ja: 55歳男性の大型精巣腫瘤例で、骨盤・後腹膜リンパ節および骨転移を伴っていた。CTでは精巣とリンパ節に石灰化を認めた。精巣摘除標本では広範な骨化を伴うセミノーマが確認された。骨形成は変性現象と考えられ、セミノーマにおけるこれほど広範な骨形成の報告は著者らの知る限り文献上ない。
pmid-8442676.summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old man with a large testicular mass and metastases to pelvic and retroperitoneal lymph nodes and bones. CT showed calcifications in the testis and nodes. The orchiectomy specimen revealed seminoma with extensive ossification, which the authors attribute to degeneration. Such extensive bone formation within a seminoma has not, to their knowledge, been reported previously, making it an unusual morphologic variant of seminoma.

pmid-8442807.summary_ja: 口咽頭奇形腫は頻度の低い先天性腫瘍で、高い罹患率と死亡率を伴う。本研究では死産1例、生産2例、治療的中絶1例の計4例を検討した。最適な管理には出生前診断が必要であると著者らは強調する。既報例と比較しながら、診断、管理、臨床経過、自然史を論じている。
pmid-8442807.summary_en: This clinicopathologic study reviews four cases of oropharyngeal teratoma, an uncommon congenital tumor with substantial morbidity and mortality. The cases comprised one stillbirth, two live births, and one therapeutic abortion. The authors emphasize that optimal management requires prenatal diagnosis. Findings are compared with previously published cases, and diagnosis, management, clinical outcome, and natural history are discussed. The series provides a clinical framework for recognizing this rare entity in perinatal practice.

pmid-8448745.summary_ja: 80歳男性の腎盂高異型度移行上皮癌に絨毛癌成分を認めた症例である。免疫染色で移行上皮癌内の限局的なhCG陽性を示し、絨毛癌への分化に伴い強くなった。膀胱の浸潤性高異型度移行上皮癌25例中7例（28%）でhCG反応性を認めた。免疫金標識でもhCGの細胞質内局在が確認された。尿路上皮由来の絨毛癌は化生起源と結論された。
pmid-8448745.summary_en: An 80-year-old man had choriocarcinoma arising with high-grade transitional cell carcinoma of the renal pelvis. Immunoperoxidase showed focal hCG positivity in the TCC, which intensified as tumor cells differentiated into choriocarcinoma. In 25 invasive high-grade bladder TCCs, 28% showed hCG reactivity, and syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells were seen in one more case. Immunogold labeling confirmed cytoplasmic hCG. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma arising in the urothelial tract has a metaplastic origin.

pmid-8453580.summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ7例について、腫瘍内浸潤リンパ網内系細胞と腫瘍細胞の免疫表現型を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。腫瘍は肉芽腫を伴う強い間質反応を示し、浸潤細胞はCD8陽性T細胞を主体とするT細胞とマクロファージであった。腫瘍細胞は胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼとパンサイトケラチンに陽性であったが、MHCクラスII抗原はほとんど発現していなかった。精巣セミノーマとの密接な関連を裏付ける所見である。
pmid-8453580.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study characterizes tumor-infiltrating lymphoreticular cells and tumor cells in seven ovarian dysgerminomas. Tumors showed marked stromal reaction with disseminated granulomas, with infiltrating cells predominantly T cells, including CD8+ cytotoxic subsets, and macrophages. Tumor cells stained for placental alkaline phosphatase and pancytokeratin but rarely expressed MHC class II. The findings support a close relationship between ovarian dysgerminoma and testicular seminoma.

pmid-8458286.summary_ja: 53歳女性の膵体部から発生した類皮嚢腫に対する穿刺吸引細胞診（FNA）の症例報告である。吸引液には良性の成熟扁平上皮、角化物質、炎症細胞が含まれており、切除標本の病理で診断が確定した。細胞学的・組織学的所見を提示し、膵類皮嚢腫の術前診断においてFNAが有用であると論じている。性腺外の成熟嚢胞性病変の一例である。
pmid-8458286.summary_en: A case report describing fine-needle aspiration of a dermoid cyst arising from the body of the pancreas in a 53-year-old woman. Aspirated fluid contained benign mature squamous cells, keratin debris and inflammatory cells, leading to a diagnosis later confirmed on resection. The authors present the cytologic and histologic features and argue that FNA is a valuable preoperative diagnostic adjunct for pancreatic dermoid cysts. The case illustrates an extragonadal mature cystic lesion.

pmid-8460444.summary_ja: 父と息子に精巣がんが発生した家族性の症例報告である。父は奇形癌、息子は純粋セミノーマを発症していた。近親者に精巣腫瘍が生じることは稀であるため、精巣悪性腫瘍の病因における遺伝的要因の可能性を考察している。家族集積性と、精巣胚細胞腫瘍への遺伝的寄与に焦点を当てた短い報告である。
pmid-8460444.summary_en: A case report describing testicular cancer in a father and son. The father had teratocarcinoma, while the son developed pure seminoma. Because testicular tumors in closely related family members are rare, the authors discuss a possible genetic factor in the etiology of testicular malignancy. The report is brief and focuses on familial clustering and the potential genetic contribution to testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-8460595.summary_ja: 20か月の女児が排尿困難で受診し、膀胱後部の腫瘤による尿閉を呈した。手術で右卵巣の卵巣類皮嚢腫(6.2cm)と判明した。腫瘍マーカーと内分泌検査は正常であった。尿閉を呈した卵巣類皮嚢腫として日本で最年少の症例であり、乳児期の婦人科疾患による尿閉の機序を考察している。
pmid-8460595.summary_en: A 20-month-old girl presented with voiding difficulty and a large retrovesical abdominal mass causing urinary retention. Imaging and cystoscopy delineated the mass compressing the bladder, and tumor markers and endocrine tests were normal. Surgery revealed a 6.2 cm right ovarian dermoid cyst containing fat and hair. The authors report this as the youngest Japanese case of an ovarian dermoid cyst presenting as urinary retention and discuss the mechanism of urinary retention in infantile gynecological disease.

pmid-8462906.summary_ja: 20歳女性の卵巣に、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した原発性悪性黒色腫が見つかり、広範な腹膜転移を伴っていた。積極的な外科的切除と白金系化学療法により、診断から5年後も無病生存を維持している。胚細胞腫瘍成分からの悪性転化という稀な症例であり、集学的治療により長期寛解が得られた。
pmid-8462906.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman had a primary ovarian melanoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma, presenting with bulky peritoneal metastases. Treatment with aggressive surgical resection followed by platinum-based chemotherapy achieved long-term disease-free survival. At five years after diagnosis she remains free of disease. The case highlights a rare malignant transformation of an ovarian germ cell tumor component and shows that aggressive multimodal therapy can yield durable remission.

pmid-8469595.summary_ja: 生後6か月の女児で、膣から子宮頸部に進展した卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。おむつへの間欠的な出血で受診し、骨盤部CTで不均一に造影される腫瘤を認めた。組織所見は卵黄嚢腫瘍に一致した。乳児期の肢外性胚細胞腫瘍の一例であり、画像検査と組織診断の必要性を示す。
pmid-8469595.summary_en: This case report describes a 6-month-old female infant with an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor arising in the vagina and extending to the cervix. The child presented with intermittent bloody discharge on diapers. Pelvic CT showed an irregular soft tissue mass with heterogeneous enhancement. Histopathology was identical to that of endodermal sinus tumors. The report illustrates an extragonadal pediatric germ cell tumor and emphasizes that intermittent bloody vaginal discharge in infancy warrants imaging and tissue diagnosis.

pmid-8469596.summary_ja: 5歳男児の総胆管に発生した良性嚢胞性奇形腫に卵黄嚢腫瘍を合併した症例。超音波およびCTで、遠位胆管を閉塞する分葉状ポリープ状腫瘤を認め、ぶどう状横紋筋肉腫に類似した。極めてまれな肢外性胚細胞腫瘍の小児例であり、画像所見だけでは肉腫との鑑別が困難であることを示す。
pmid-8469596.summary_en: This pediatric report describes a 5-year-old boy with an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor associated with a benign cystic teratoma of the common bile duct. The lesion presented as a lobulated polypoid mass obstructing the distal bile duct, resembling botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma on sonography and computed tomography. The authors note that a prior English-literature case of bile duct teratoma lacked morphological or radiological description. The report highlights an unusual extragonadal germ cell tumor in a child, where imaging mimicked a sarcoma and histology was needed for diagnosis.

pmid-8471322.summary_ja: デンマークの1943～1987年の精巣がん患者6187例で、肉腫の相対危険度が約4倍に上昇した。大半はセミノーマ患者で、発症は診断後5～34年に及んだ。7例は放射線照射野内に発生しており、精巣がん患者のフォローアップでは二次性肉腫に留意すべきと結論した。
pmid-8471322.summary_en: A nationwide Danish cancer registry analysis of 6187 men with testicular cancer (1943 to 1987) identified 13 sarcomas, a fourfold increase in relative risk. Most occurred in men with seminoma, and the excess persisted regardless of time since diagnosis, with latency of 5 to 34 years. After record review and histology re-examination, three cases were excluded, yet the relative risk remained at least threefold. Seven of ten sarcomas lay within radiation fields and three at the periphery. The authors conclude that secondary sarcoma risk should be considered during follow-up of testicular cancer patients, despite its low absolute numbers.

pmid-8471324.summary_ja: 1943～1987年に精巣がんと診断された男性6187例を対象としたデンマークのコホート研究。二次原発がんは459例発生し、白血病・胃・膵臓・膀胱などで有意に増加した。白血病は診断後10年以内に増加し、消化器がんや肺がんは10～19年後にピークを示した。放射線療法の影響が主因と考察している。
pmid-8471324.summary_en: This Danish cohort study followed 6187 men diagnosed with testicular cancer between 1943 and 1987, totaling 59,000 person-years, during which 459 second primary cancers occurred. Relative risks were significantly increased for leukemia, gastric, pancreatic, bladder, non-melanoma skin, and kidney cancers, with suggestive increases for rectal, prostate, and lung cancers. Leukemia risk peaked within the first decade, while gastrointestinal and lung excess appeared 10 to 19 years later. The authors attribute the pattern largely to radiotherapy and propose that differing latency reflects tumor growth rates in various tissues.

pmid-8474949.summary_ja: 新生児の転移性頸部奇形腫の1例を報告した症例報告である。広範な頸部腫瘤と多発性肺転移による呼吸不全で患児は死亡した。先天性頸部奇形腫は通常良性だが、極めて稀に悪性の経過をたどることを示した。そのため、出生前診断は今後の治療方針の検討に重要となりうると述べている。
pmid-8474949.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a metastasizing cervical teratoma who died of respiratory failure caused by extensive cervical masses and multiple pulmonary metastases. Although congenital cervical teratomas are usually benign, the authors show that malignant behavior can very rarely occur. They suggest that prenatal diagnosis of such tumors may be important for planning further therapeutic management.

pmid-8477777.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の治療前後の精子数とホルモン値を14年間追跡。片側精巣摘除後の精子数低下は、多くの例で2〜3年かけて回復した。放射線療法やシスプラチン併用化学療法は回復を約1年遅らせ、後腹膜リンパ節郭清では射精量がわずかに減少した。
pmid-8477777.summary_en: This 14-year study followed sperm counts and serum hormone levels in testicular cancer patients before and after treatment. Sperm counts were severely reduced in 60-70% of patients one to four weeks after unilateral orchidectomy, but usually recovered over the next 2-3 years if pretreatment FSH was normal or only slightly elevated. Radiotherapy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy delayed recovery by about a year, and higher chemotherapy doses or combined treatment impaired it further. Unilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection slightly reduced ejaculatory volume.

pmid-8477780.summary_ja: 奇形腫細胞の増殖におけるbFGFの役割を検討。低濃度では増殖を促進し、高濃度では遊走を誘導した。両作用はプロタミン硫酸塩で抑制された。bFGF遺伝子はヒト精巣胎児性癌で活発に転写されていた。
pmid-8477780.summary_en: This study examines the role of basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) in controlling the proliferation of teratoma cells. Low concentrations of bFGF stimulated proliferation, while higher doses induced cell migration. Both effects were efficiently blocked by protamine sulphate. The bFGF gene is actively transcribed in primary human testicular embryonal carcinomas but is not expressed in other embryonic tumors examined. The authors discuss the biological implications of these findings.

pmid-8477781.summary_ja: ヒト奇形腫由来の培養細胞株を、腫瘍増殖と初期ヒト胚発生の研究モデルとして紹介。転写因子、細胞外マトリックス、増殖因子が胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の増殖と分化をどう制御するかを検討している。
pmid-8477781.summary_en: This review describes cultured cell lines derived from human teratomas as models for studying tumor growth and early embryonic development. The authors outline their efforts to define how transcription factors, extracellular matrix components, and growth factors regulate the growth and differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor cells. These lines provide windows into both tumor biology and normal human embryogenesis.

pmid-8478583.summary_ja: 31歳女性と15歳女性の肺内奇形腫の2例を報告した。両者とも発熱を主訴とし、胸部X線検査で左上葉に浸潤影を認めた。前者は左上葉切除術、後者は左舌区域切除術を受け、腫瘍はいずれも縦隔と交通していなかった。組織学的に胸腺組織を含まない肺奇形腫と診断された。肺内奇形腫は極めて稀で、文献上の報告は本例を含め27例のみである。
pmid-8478583.summary_en: This report describes two rare cases of intrapulmonary teratoma, one in a 31-year-old woman and one in a 15-year-old girl. Both presented with fever, and routine chest radiography revealed a left upper lobe consolidation. Treatment consisted of left upper lobectomy in the first patient and left lingual segmentectomy in the second. Neither tumor communicated with the mediastinum, and histology showed pulmonary teratoma without thymic tissue. The authors note that only 27 cases, including these two, had been reported in the literature.

pmid-8484333.summary_ja: 精巣の典型的セミノーマ15例、未分化型セミノーマ17例、精母細胞性セミノーマ3例について、DNA解析を行った。フローサイトメトリーでは全例が異数体を示した。未分化型はG2M期の割合が高く、異型核分裂像と一致した。精母細胞性では二倍体の小型細胞と、40Cまでの大型細胞が認められた。両手法の併用が有用であった。
pmid-8484333.summary_en: DNA analysis by flow cytometry and cytofluorometry was performed on 15 typical seminomas, 17 anaplastic seminomas, and 3 spermatocytic seminomas of the testis. All cases showed aneuploidy by flow cytometry. Anaplastic seminomas had a higher G2M fraction, consistent with their atypical mitoses. Spermatocytic seminomas showed diploid small cells and large cells up to 40C. The authors found that combining both methods was beneficial.

pmid-8486432.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来F9細胞の温度感受性変異株を非許容温度に置くと、細胞分化が誘導される。分化した細胞はin vivoでの腫瘍形成能を失う一方、in vitroでの増殖能は保持していた。腫瘍形成能の喪失は増殖能の変化ではなく分化に起因すると結論づけられた。増殖停止と分化は独立した事象であり、遺伝学的に分離しうる。
pmid-8486432.summary_en: Temperature-sensitive mutants derived from the mouse teratocarcinoma line F9 were studied at non-permissive temperature, where they differentiate. Differentiated cells lost in vivo tumorigenicity while retaining in vitro proliferative capacity. The authors conclude that loss of tumorigenicity results from differentiation rather than altered proliferation. They propose that proliferation arrest and differentiation are independent events that can be genetically separated.

pmid-8486524.summary_ja: ヒトセミノーマ細胞をscid-nudeマウスに移植すると、原発腫瘍では発現していなかった精子特異的LDH-Xアイソザイムが発現した。異種移植片およびリンパ節・腎臓の転移巣でも発現し、形態は正常精子形成に類似した。一方、移植片から新たに樹立した分裂増殖細胞ではLDH-Xは消失した。アイソザイム発現は形態変化と並行していた。
pmid-8486524.summary_en: Human seminoma cells transplanted into scid-nude mice expressed LDH-X, a sperm-specific lactate dehydrogenase isozyme absent in the original tumor. Xenografts and lymph node and kidney metastases expressed it, with morphology changing toward normal spermatogenesis. However, LDH-X disappeared in mitotically dividing cells newly established from the xenograft. The findings link isozyme expression with morphological differentiation of seminoma cells.

pmid-8487061.summary_ja: 治療終了後1年以上の精巣がん患者88例（セミノーマ39例、非セミノーマ49例）とホジキン病患者85例を比較した。精巣がん群は性的快感の低下や不健康な生活習慣など局所的症状が多く、ホジキン病群は倦怠感や就労障害など全身症状が多かった。差の多くは罹患部位によるもので、全身症状には治療の影響が認められた。
pmid-8487061.summary_en: This study compared psychosocial outcomes in 85 men with Hodgkin's disease and 88 men with testicular cancer (39 seminomatous, 49 nonseminomatous), interviewed at least one year after treatment. Testicular cancer survivors reported more focused symptoms such as reduced sexual enjoyment and poor health habits. Hodgkin survivors reported more generalized fatigue and work impairment. Most differences were site-related, while treatment affected generalized symptoms.

pmid-8489091.summary_ja: 閉経後出血の精査中に、76歳女性の直腸に毛髪を伴う3cmの有茎性腫瘤が見つかった。スネア法による内視鏡的切除で摘出し、組織学的に三胚葉成分を有する良性嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。その後の手術で子宮内膜癌が判明した。原発性直腸奇形腫は1865年以降に33例しか報告されていない。
pmid-8489091.summary_en: A 76-year-old woman with postmenopausal bleeding was found to have a 3-cm pedunculated rectal mass with visible hair. The lesion was removed by snare polypectomy, and histology showed benign cystic teratoma with three germ layers. Subsequent hysterectomy revealed endometrial carcinoma. The authors note that only 33 primary rectal teratomas had been reported since 1865.

pmid-8489464.summary_ja: 28歳女性が胞状奇胎の分娩8か月後に絨毛癌の脳転移を発症した。手術と術後メトトレキサート化学療法により尿中hCGは正常化し、排卵も回復した。約4年半後に妊娠し、健康な男児を出産した。母子ともに出産後7年間良好な経過をたどり、転移性絨毛癌の治療後も妊孕性が保たれうることを示した。
pmid-8489464.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman developed brain metastasis of choriocarcinoma eight months after delivering a hydatidiform mole. Surgical resection and postoperative methotrexate chemotherapy normalized her urinary hCG and restored ovulation. She conceived 4.5 years later and delivered a healthy boy, and both mother and child remained well for seven years after delivery. The report highlights fertility potential after successful treatment of metastatic choriocarcinoma.

pmid-8490198.summary_ja: 両側精巣セミノーマの32歳男性が、精巣摘除による不妊を避けるため、精巣鞘膜内へのメトトレキサート注射療法を4クール受けた。毒性は認められず、6か月後の精巣生検で悪性細胞は陰性であった。6年後も再発なく妊孕性を保っており、精巣温存を目指す一部のセミノーマ患者に対する外来での選択肢となりうる。
pmid-8490198.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with bilateral testicular seminoma declined bilateral orchidectomy because it would render him sterile. He received four courses of methotrexate injected into the tunica vaginalis, with five doses every five days followed by three weeks of rest. No toxicity occurred, and a biopsy six months later showed no malignant cells. Six years later he remained free of recurrence and fertile. The outpatient approach may offer an organ-preserving option for selected seminoma patients.

pmid-8490260.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌3例を含む絨毛組織の計23例で、モノクローナル抗体Ber-EP4の免疫染色性を検討した。Ber-EP4は妊娠初期の細胞性栄養膜細胞とその腫瘍性対応物を選択的に標識し、絨毛癌で顕著であった。従来のhCGなどのパネルより確実に悪性腫瘍中の細胞性栄養膜系を同定でき、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断補助として有用な可能性がある。
pmid-8490260.summary_en: This study examined the monoclonal antibody Ber-EP4 in trophoblastic tissue, including three gestational choriocarcinomas and 20 villous and extravillous trophoblast cases. Ber-EP4 selectively labeled first-trimester cytotrophoblast and its neoplastic counterpart, persisted in molar tissue, and was prominent in choriocarcinoma. It identified cytotrophoblastic lineage in malignancy more reliably than conventional hCG, hPL and P1AP panels. The authors suggest it may aid diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-8491476.summary_ja: 9歳と10歳の女児に発生した、内胚葉成分優位の未熟卵巣奇形腫の2症例を報告。いずれも病期Iで3剤併用化学療法を受けた。神経外胚葉成分を欠き、AFPが高値でhCGは低値であった。上皮は肝、食道、腸管、甲状腺へ内胚葉分化を示し、間葉は広範に分化した。卵黄嚢腫瘍や胎児性癌に伴う内胚葉分化の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8491476.summary_en: This report describes two grade 2 immature ovarian teratomas, predominantly of endodermal type, in girls aged 9 and 10 years, both at stage I and treated with triple-agent chemotherapy. Unlike typical immature ovarian teratomas, these lacked neuroectodermal components and showed high alpha-fetoprotein with low hCG levels. Epithelial derivatives expressed endodermal differentiation toward liver, esophagus, intestine, and thyroid. Focal hCG positivity suggested endoderm-trophoblast developmental links. The mesenchyme differentiated widely and co-expressed vimentin and keratin, supporting an endodermal origin hypothesis. The authors suggest these may represent endodermal differentiation within related germ cell tumors such as yolk sac tumor or embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-8491688.summary_ja: インディアナ大学でセミノーマ患者35例を抽出し、放射線照射を受けた19例に非侵襲的血管評価を実施した。対側骨盤を対照として比較した結果、異常は19例中3例で、照射のみに起因すると判断されたのは1例(5%)であった。セミノーマの高い治癒率を考慮すると、低線量照射による無症候性血管変化の頻度は許容範囲と結論づけている。
pmid-8491688.summary_en: Thirty-five seminoma patients treated with pelvic radiotherapy at Indiana University were identified. Nineteen volunteered for noninvasive vascular testing, including Doppler ultrasound, segmental leg pressures, pulse volume recordings, and post-exercise testing, using the untreated contralateral pelvis as a control. Three of 19 had abnormal results, and only one was attributed solely to irradiation (5%). Given the high cure rate of seminoma, the authors consider this incidence acceptable and recommend studying high-dose patients.

pmid-8493450.summary_ja: 後妊娠性ラット絨毛癌細胞株を用い、各種増殖因子の増殖への影響をMTT法で検討した。上皮増殖因子とインスリンに増殖促進作用が認められた。細胞栄養膜細胞は上皮増殖因子受容体とトランスフェリン受容体を、より分化した巨細胞はトランスフェリン受容体のみを発現していた。
pmid-8493450.summary_en: Using the MTT assay, the authors examined how several growth factors affect a postgestational rat choriocarcinoma cell line cultured under optimal and suboptimal serum conditions. Epidermal growth factor and, to a lesser extent, insulin promoted growth alone, while other factors had additive or no effects. Cytotrophoblast cells expressed both EGF and transferrin receptors, whereas more differentiated giant cells expressed only transferrin receptors.

pmid-8494705.summary_ja: 1977〜1990年に白金製剤ベースの化学療法を受けた原発性悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍18例の後方視的解析である。セミノーマの7例は全例が無病生存した。非セミノーマの11例では化学療法後に残存腫瘤の外科的切除を行い、9例で完全寛解が得られた。
pmid-8494705.summary_en: This retrospective study of 18 patients with primary malignant mediastinal germ cell tumours treated with platinum-based chemotherapy from 1977 to 1990 reports improved outcomes. All seven patients with pure seminoma survived disease-free, and most nonseminoma patients achieved complete remission after chemotherapy and residual mass surgery. One patient died from bleomycin pneumonitis. Mediastinal radiotherapy and surgery contributed to management decisions.

pmid-8494708.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者76例を対象に、治療前と治療後6・12・36か月の性生活を質問票で評価した。治療後6か月で不満足と答えた患者が増え、36か月でも18%が治療前より劣ると回答した。両側後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の乾性射精は12例であった。治療前後のカウンセリングが推奨される。
pmid-8494708.summary_en: Questionnaires assessed sexual function in 76 testicular cancer patients before treatment and at 6, 12, and 36 months afterward. Dissatisfaction rose at 6 months and remained in 18% at 36 months. Libido and erectile function declined transiently in most patients, and 12 reported permanent dry ejaculation after bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Older age and psychological distress correlated with problems, supporting pre- and post-treatment counselling.

pmid-8497378.summary_ja: 放射線療法を受けたセミノーマの既往部位(左鼠径部)に生じた肉腫の症例報告である。精巣がんの放射線療法後の照射後肉腫は稀である。本例は早期発見により根治的外科的治療が可能となり、治癒が推定された。セミノーマで照射を受けた患者には綿密なフォローアップが勧められる。
pmid-8497378.summary_en: A patient with left groin sarcoma arising within a previously irradiated seminoma site is described. Postirradiation sarcomas are rarely reported after radiotherapy for testicular cancer. Early detection allowed radical surgery and presumed cure, in contrast to the usual aggressive course. The authors recommend continuous, precise follow-up of patients irradiated for seminoma.

pmid-8499994.summary_ja: 1980〜1989年に治療された病期I精巣腫瘍138例を対象とし、治療戦略を比較した。セミノーマでは放射線療法群の再発率が低く、非セミノーマ性腫瘍では後腹膜リンパ節郭清群で再発率が低かった。ただし再発例は全て化学療法で完全奏効し、生存率に差はなかった。精巣摘除術後の経過観察は、より介入的な治療と同等の成績が得られ実施可能と結論づけられた。
pmid-8499994.summary_en: This study compared outcomes in 138 patients with stage I testicular tumours treated between 1980 and 1989. Seminoma patients received either adjuvant radiotherapy or surveillance, and non-seminomatous patients underwent RPLND or surveillance. Relapse rates were lower with adjuvant treatment in both groups, but all relapses responded to chemotherapy and survival did not differ. The authors concluded that surveillance after orchiectomy is feasible and yields results equivalent to more interventionist approaches.

pmid-8500806.summary_ja: 生後3か月と1歳の男児に発生した胃奇形腫の2症例を報告している。1例目は充実性、2例目は充実嚢胞性の腫瘤であった。胃奇形腫は極めてまれな病変で、主に男児の乳児に見られる。文献上の報告が限られる中、本報告は症例の蓄積に寄与する性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の貴重な記録である。
pmid-8500806.summary_en: Two infants with gastric teratoma, aged 3.5 months and 1 year, are reported. The first tumour was predominantly solid, while the second was a solid-cystic mass. Gastric teratoma is an extremely rare lesion, most often seen in male infants. The authors note that these cases add to the limited number of gastric teratomas reported in the world literature. Such extragonadal germ cell tumours are uncommon, and the report contributes to the scant literature describing this presentation.

pmid-8502318.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に伴うリンパ節腫大のため腹部放射線療法を受けた25歳男性の症例である。治療前の腹膜物質移動係数は正常範囲内であった。放射線療法後1か月と2か月の時点で腹膜透過性が上昇し、持続携行式腹膜透析が困難となった。胚細胞腫瘍患者における治療関連の腹膜機能障害を示した報告である。
pmid-8502318.summary_en: A 25-year-old man with a testicular teratoma and retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy received abdominal radiotherapy. Before treatment his peritoneal mass transfer coefficients were normal. One and two months after radiotherapy, peritoneal permeability had increased so much that continuous ambulatory peritoneal dialysis became impractical. The report highlights a treatment-related complication affecting peritoneal function in a patient with germ cell tumour.

pmid-8503018.summary_ja: 本総説は、原発部位不明の低分化癌を診断するための細胞遺伝学的および分子遺伝学的アプローチを論じている。胚細胞腫瘍、神経上皮性腫瘍、リンパ腫に特異的な染色体マーカーが同定されている。胚細胞腫瘍では、特異的な細胞遺伝学的マーカーがシスプラチン併用化学療法への反応性と長期無病生存を予測した。従来の細胞遺伝学的解析が不成功の場合、定量的サザンブロットやFISHなどのDNAハイブリダイゼーション法が診断の確定に役立った。
pmid-8503018.summary_en: This review discusses cytogenetic and molecular genetic approaches for diagnosing poorly differentiated carcinomas of unknown primary site. Specific chromosomal markers have been identified for germ cell tumours, neuroepithelial tumours and lymphoma. For germ cell tumours, a specific cytogenetic marker predicted response to cisplatin-based chemotherapy and long-term disease-free survival. DNA hybridization methods such as quantitative Southern blot and FISH helped confirm germ cell tumour diagnosis when conventional cytogenetics failed.

pmid-8503337.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌に対して右根治的精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた24歳男性で、術後に射精が完全に消失した。イミプラミンでは順行性射精は得られなかった。膀胱内から回収した精液を用いた人工授精を5回目に行い妊娠に至り、健康な男児が出生した。精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の逆行性射精による不妊の治療法を考察している。
pmid-8503337.summary_en: A 24-year-old man who had right radical orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular teratocarcinoma developed complete loss of ejaculation with normal erection and orgasm. Antegrade ejaculation could not be induced with imipramine. After five attempts at artificial insemination using semen retrieved from the bladder, pregnancy was achieved and a healthy infant was delivered. The authors discuss treatment options for infertility from retrograde ejaculation after RPLND for testicular cancer.

pmid-8503739.summary_ja: 41歳女性の右卵巣の単房性嚢胞性腫瘍を摘出した。組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であり、壁在結節から浸潤性のアポクリン腺癌が認められた。腫瘍細胞は好酸性の細胞質と断頭分泌を示し、鉄顆粒やPAS陽性顆粒を含んでいた。卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じたまれな悪性転化の症例である。
pmid-8503739.summary_en: A 41-year-old woman had a unilocular cystic tumour of the right ovary removed. Histology showed a mature cystic teratoma with a mural nodule containing an infiltrative apocrine adenocarcinoma. The adenocarcinoma cells had eosinophilic cytoplasm with decapitation secretion, and iron granules and PAS-positive granules were present. The authors describe this rare malignant transformation arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-8504434.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎から絨毛癌への移行における血小板由来成長因子(PDGF)の関与を検討した。in situハイブリダイゼーションで完全胞状奇胎の細胞性栄養膜細胞では、PDGFβ受容体遺伝子が正常胎盤より最大100倍活性が高かった。絨毛癌への進展はPDGF-B遺伝子の10〜20倍の活性化と相関した。PDGF自己刺激ループの制御異常が胞状奇胎から絨毛癌を生じさせると提唱している。
pmid-8504434.summary_en: This study examines the role of platelet-derived growth factor (PDGF) in the transition from hydatidiform mole to choriocarcinoma. In situ hybridization showed the paternal PDGF beta receptor gene was up to two orders of magnitude more active in complete mole cytotrophoblasts than in normal placentae. Progression to choriocarcinoma correlated with 10- to 20-fold activation of the PDGF-B gene. The authors propose a deregulated PDGF autostimulatory loop drives the genesis of choriocarcinoma from hydatidiform mole.

pmid-8506800.summary_ja: 精巣単純嚢胞、白膜嚢胞、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の3例を報告した症例報告。陰嚢疾患の画像診断で超音波検査の利用が増え、嚢胞性精巣病変が増加したと述べている。超音波検査は非腫瘍性嚢胞と充実性精巣腫瘍に伴う嚢胞性病変の鑑別に有用であった。
pmid-8506800.summary_en: This report describes three patients with cystic testicular diseases: a simple testicular cyst, a cyst of the tunica albuginea, and a mature cystic teratoma. The authors note that cystic testicular lesions were once considered rare but are increasingly detected because of wider use of ultrasonography for scrotal disorders. Ultrasonography helped distinguish nonneoplastic cysts from cystic lesions of solid testicular tumors. The paper is a short clinical case series that emphasizes the diagnostic value of imaging in differentiating benign cystic testicular conditions.

pmid-8507200.summary_ja: レチノイン酸応答性の増殖因子ミッドカインが、マウスP19胎児性癌細胞の神経分化を媒介することを示した基礎研究。ミッドカインへの曝露でニューロンが誘導され、抗体によりレチノイン酸の作用が抑制された。胎児性癌細胞を研究モデルとした発生生物学的研究で、臨床的内容は含まれない。
pmid-8507200.summary_en: This study shows that midkine, a retinoic acid-responsive growth factor, mediates neuronal differentiation of P19 murine embryonal carcinoma cells. MK exposure induced neurons with choline acetyltransferase activity. Retinoic acid increased MK synthesis and release, as shown by Western blotting. An anti-MK antibody blocked the neuronal differentiation induced by retinoic acid. The findings identify MK as one mediator of retinoic acid action in EC cells. The work is basic developmental biology using an embryonal carcinoma cell model, with no clinical component.

pmid-8507558.summary_ja: 血清添加培地で増殖する多能性の胎児性癌細胞株P19を総説した論文。レチノイン酸によりニューロンやグリア細胞へ、DMSOにより心筋や骨格筋などへ分化する。遺伝子導入も可能で、多能性細胞の発生制御研究のモデルとして適していると述べている。患者の臨床管理は扱わない。
pmid-8507558.summary_en: This review describes P19 cells, a pluripotent embryonal carcinoma line that grows continuously in serum-supplemented medium. Retinoic acid induces neurons, astroglia, and microglia, while dimethyl sulfoxide drives aggregates to form endodermal and mesodermal derivatives, including cardiac and skeletal muscle. P19 cells can be stably transfected with recombinant genes. The authors present them as a suitable model for studying the molecular control of developmental decisions in pluripotent cells. The paper concerns embryonal carcinoma cell biology rather than clinical care of patients.

pmid-8507568.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌が、ヒトの精巣および卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍を理解するための主要な実験モデルとなってきた経緯を総説している。腫瘍幹細胞の分化と増殖の調節が解明され、その悪性度は遺伝的に決定されエピジェネティックに修飾されうると述べる。主題は胚細胞腫瘍の組織発生であり、患者の管理は扱わない。
pmid-8507568.summary_en: This review explains why murine teratocarcinomas have served as a key experimental model for human testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors. Tumors produced from early postimplantation embryos revealed how tumor stem cells differentiate and how their growth is regulated. The malignancy of teratocarcinoma stem cells is genetically determined but epigenetically modifiable. The authors argue that tumor events have normal embryonic counterparts. Studies of early embryos inform oncology, while teratocarcinoma research clarifies normal developmental events. The paper addresses germ cell tumor histogenesis rather than patient management.

pmid-8508362.summary_ja: 58歳男性の症例報告。前立腺由来と考えられるセミノーマが膀胱へ浸潤していた。前立腺肥大の症状で受診し、膀胱鏡で膀胱頸部を取り囲む腫瘍を認め、生検でセミノーマと診断された。ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、エトポシドによる化学療法で完全寛解が得られた。
pmid-8508362.summary_en: This case report describes a 58-year-old man with seminoma probably originating in the prostate that also involved the urinary bladder. He presented with prostatic enlargement, and cystoscopy revealed a fungating neoplasm surrounding the bladder neck. Biopsy confirmed seminoma, and complete remission was achieved after combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, cisplatin, and etoposide. The authors describe this as the first reported case of extragonadal seminoma arising in the prostate with bladder involvement.

pmid-8508413.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ42例に対するカルボプラチン単剤療法の第II相試験。完全寛解は71%で、リンパ節転移のみの症例は内臓転移より寛解率が高かった。毒性は軽度で、初回からのカルボプラチン療法が最終的な治癒率を損なわない可能性が示唆された。ただし無作為化試験による検証が必要である。
pmid-8508413.summary_en: A phase II trial of single-agent carboplatin (400 mg/m2 every 4 weeks, up to six cycles) in 42 evaluable patients with advanced seminoma. Complete remission was achieved in 71%, with higher response in nodal-only disease than in visceral metastases (97% versus 50%). Eight patients relapsed, and all patients failing carboplatin received cisplatin-based regimens. Toxicity was mild. The authors suggest up-front carboplatin does not compromise ultimate curability, pending randomized confirmation.

pmid-8508876.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の患者10例の臨床病理学的検討。平均年齢は22.1歳で、多くが腹骨盤部腫瘤を主訴とした。当施設の胚細胞腫瘍の4.0%を占め、6例が病期Iであった。治療は初回手術による適切な病期分類と多剤併用化学療法が推奨されるとしている。
pmid-8508876.summary_en: This clinicopathologic study reviews 10 patients with immature ovarian teratoma, with a mean age of 22.1 years. Most presented with an abdominopelvic mass. Immature ovarian teratomas accounted for 4.0% of germ cell tumors and 2.1% of all ovarian neoplasms at the institution. Six patients had Stage I disease, and most tumors were unilateral. The authors conclude that adequate primary surgical-pathologic staging followed by multiagent chemotherapy is the treatment of choice.

pmid-8508882.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫に発生した原発性無色素性悪性黒色腫の症例報告。組織学的にS-100およびメラノーマ抗原陽性で確定された。術後21か月の放射免疫シンチグラフィで傍結腸部の病変が示唆された。患者は化学療法と再手術を拒否したが、術後1年時点で良好に生存している。放射免疫シンチグラフィによる転移評価の有用性が提案されている。
pmid-8508882.summary_en: This case report describes primary amelanotic malignant melanoma arising within an ovarian dermoid cyst. No pigmented lesions were grossly seen, but histology and positive S-100 and melanoma antigen staining confirmed melanoma. Radioimmunoscintigraphy 21 months after surgery suggested a possible secondary paracolic lesion. The patient declined chemotherapy and second-look surgery, yet remained alive and well one year after surgery. The authors suggest this imaging may help assess metastatic spread in this malignancy.

pmid-8512515.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ56例の後方視的検討。精巣摘除術後の予防的放射線療法を54例に実施し、3年生存率は96%であった。再発は4例（7%）で、救援化学療法は結節性再発3例中2例で奏効した。サーベイランスが困難な施設では予防照射が推奨されている。
pmid-8512515.summary_en: A retrospective review of 56 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated from 1982 to 1988, 54 of whom received post-orchiectomy elective radiotherapy to ipsilateral iliac-inguinal and para-aortic nodes. The three-year survival was 96%, with four relapses (7%). Salvage chemotherapy succeeded in two of three nodal relapses. No radiation-related complications were noted, and no adverse prognostic factor correlated with relapse. The authors recommend elective irradiation, especially where surveillance is impractical.

pmid-8512735.summary_ja: デンマークのがん登録データに基づき、1943〜1987年の男性生殖器がん患者の生存率を検討した章である。精巣がんの1年相対生存率は約70%から95%へ改善し、非セミノーマでは53%から94%へ向上した。治療の進歩が背景とされ、診断後早期に超過死亡が最も多いことが示された。
pmid-8512735.summary_en: This Danish registry-based chapter describes survival among men with prostate and testicular cancer from 1943 to 1987. Testicular cancer, which mostly affects men in their 20s and 30s, showed rising one-year relative survival from about 70% to 95%, with non-seminomas improving from 53% to 94%, attributed to therapeutic advances. Excess mortality was greatest in the first years after diagnosis.

pmid-8513838.summary_ja: 1988〜1992年にインスブルック大学で、精巣腫瘍56例に神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した成績である。病期に応じて術式を調整し、病期IIb・IIcでは多剤化学療法後に手術を行った。56例中47例で順行性射精を温存できた。後腹膜再発はなく、肺再発が1例（1.7%）、平均29か月のフォローアップであった。
pmid-8513838.summary_en: This 1988 to 1992 Innsbruck series reports 56 patients treated with nerve-preserving retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for testicular tumors. The operative extent was tailored to stage: stage I patients underwent orchiectomy followed by lymphadenectomy, while advanced-stage patients received modified dissection after polychemotherapy. Antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 47 of 56 patients. No retroperitoneal recurrence occurred, and one lung relapse was seen during a mean follow-up of 29 months.

pmid-8514282.summary_ja: 37歳男性で、既往に後腹膜セミノーマに対する手術と放射線療法があった。その後、肝臓・脾臓・リンパ節に及ぶ致死的なペリオーシスを発症した。著者らは、ペリオーシスの発症機序に関する現在の仮説を文献的にレビューし、考察している。本例は後腹膜セミノーマ治療後の稀な合併症を示す。
pmid-8514282.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man who had previously undergone surgery and radiotherapy for retroperitoneal seminoma. He later developed fatal peliosis involving the liver, spleen and lymph nodes. The authors review current hypotheses on the pathogenesis of peliosis, a vascular lesion with blood-filled spaces, in the context of this unusual case.

pmid-8514426.summary_ja: 32歳男性で、β-hCG陽性の片側精巣セミノーマと対側精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）を有し、転移はなく臨床病期Iであった。カルボプラチン療法を1コース受けた後、対側TINの治療は拒否した。その4か月後に妻が健康な児を出産した。残存精巣にTINがあっても不妊とは限らず、父親となることを望む場合は監視療法も選択肢になりうると論じている。
pmid-8514426.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a beta-hCG-positive unilateral seminoma and contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia, without metastases (clinical stage I). After one course of adjuvant carboplatin, and despite declining further treatment for the TIN, he fathered a healthy child four months later. The authors conclude that TIN in a solitary testis does not necessarily cause infertility, and that surveillance may be an option where paternity is desired.

pmid-8514986.summary_ja: 肥大した陰核などの外性器異常を示した生後9か月の46,XY乳児を報告する。不完全型純粋性腺異形成と診断され、両側性の性腺芽腫が認められた。両側卵管性腺摘出術と部分子宮摘出術が施行された。乳児期でも性腺腫瘍が存在しうるため、46,XY性腺異形成では診断時の性腺摘出の必要性が強調されている。
pmid-8514986.summary_en: This report describes a 9-month-old infant with ambiguous genitalia and a 46,XY karyotype, diagnosed with incomplete pure gonadal dysgenesis. Examination of both gonads revealed bilateral gonadoblastoma. Bilateral salpingo-gonadectomy and partial hysterectomy were performed, and the child is being raised as a girl. The authors argue that gonadectomy should be performed at diagnosis in 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis, since neoplasia can be present even in infancy.

pmid-8515172.summary_ja: 10歳男児が胸部への衝撃後に急性の胸痛を呈し、縦隔奇形腫が心膜嚢へ穿破したことによる心タンポナーデと診断された。心膜ドレナージ後に腫瘍を摘出し、良性成熟奇形腫と病理診断された。膵組織が含まれており、膵酵素による自己消化が穿破の原因と考えられた。本例は心タンポナーデを合併した縦隔奇形腫の報告例のうち最年少である。
pmid-8515172.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old Japanese boy who presented with sudden chest pain after a blow to the chest. He was found to have cardiac tamponade caused by perforation of a mediastinal teratoma into the pericardial sac. Pericardial drainage was performed, and the benign mature teratoma was later resected. Pancreatic tissue was found histopathologically, supporting autodigestion as a likely cause of perforation. This is the youngest of 14 reported cases, including this one.

pmid-8515636.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者の治療後の妊孕性を検討した研究である。病期IおよびIIAの34例は全例が5年生存した一方、病期IIBおよびIIIの非セミノーマ性腫瘍では5年生存率が50%未満であった。化学療法後に精子形成が正常化した例があった。下腸間膜動脈を離断した後腹膜リンパ節郭清では射精障害が生じたが、温存すると射精は保たれた。
pmid-8515636.summary_en: This Japanese study examines fertility after treatment for testicular tumors. All 34 patients with stage I or IIA disease survived five years, whereas those with stage IIB or III nonseminomatous tumors had less than 50% five-year survival. Spermatogenesis recovered in three patients after chemotherapy. Ejaculation was impaired after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with division of the inferior mesenteric artery, but was preserved when the artery was spared.

pmid-8515644.summary_ja: 36歳男性の異時性両側精巣セミノーマの症例である。6年前に右精巣セミノーマに対し右高位精巣摘除術と補助放射線療法を受けていた。無痛性の左精巣腫大で来院し、未分化セミノーマと診断された。両側精巣のDNAヒストグラムは類似した異数性パターンを示し、病期Iとしてフォローアップされている。HLA-A24の所見は、HLAと異時性両側精巣腫瘍の関連を示す既報と一致した。
pmid-8515644.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with metachronous bilateral testicular seminomas. Six years after right high orchiectomy and adjuvant irradiation for typical seminoma, he presented with a painless enlarged left testis. Histopathology showed anaplastic seminoma, and DNA histograms of both testes showed similar aneuploid patterns. He was staged as stage I and is being followed closely. HLA-A24 was identified, consistent with prior reports of HLA associations.

pmid-21573366.summary_ja: レトロウイルス挿入により作製された胚性癌細胞変異株NR1-6の形態、接着、レチノイン酸応答、腫瘍原性を、体細胞融合による雑種細胞で解析した。3つの雑種クローンはいずれも親株に類似し、変異表現型は示さなかった。親株の形質が優性であり、これらの表現型は遺伝的に関連すると結論された。
pmid-21573366.summary_en: The authors previously isolated an embryonal carcinoma cell mutant, NR1-6, generated by retroviral insertion, which differs in morphology, tumorigenicity, and retinoic acid response.
