pmid-1326038.summary_en: This 43-year single-institution review (1945–1988) of 38 girls with malignant ovarian tumors, aged 3–16, found 54% survival with a median follow-up of 8 years. Tumors were histologically classified as germ cell, sex cord/stromal, or epithelial. The authors highlight that pure endodermal sinus tumor was previously confused with embryonal carcinoma, that gonadoblastoma is premalignant in 45,X/46,Y karyotypes, and that sex cord/stromal tumors cannot be predicted to metastasize from histology. They advocate conservative surgery to preserve fertility and note chemotherapy as the future.

pmid-1326221.summary_ja: 5年間に4回の胞状奇胎を繰り返した後に転移性絨毛癌を発症した38歳女性の症例報告。肺転移を有しながら妊娠し、正常満期出産に至った。肺病変の外科的切除と化学療法により20か月の無病生存を確認している。活動性絨毛癌と満期妊娠の併存が稀な点を示す。
pmid-1326221.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma that followed four recurrent consecutive hydatidiform moles over five years. She conceived while having pulmonary metastases, carried a coexistent normal pregnancy, and delivered a healthy infant at term. Surgical resection of the lung lesion combined with chemotherapy achieved sustained remission, with no evidence of disease at 20 months' follow-up. The report highlights the rare coexistence of active gestational choriocarcinoma and a term pregnancy.

pmid-1326777.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の放射線学的および病理学的所見を概説したレビューである。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の最も多い部位は前縦隔である。最も一般的な組織型は成熟奇形腫で、通常は無症状で、画像上は嚢胞成分、脂肪、石灰化を示す。悪性腫瘍は若年男性で症状を伴い大きな腫瘤として出現することが多く、CTでセミノーマは均一、非セミノーマ性腫瘍は不均一に描出される。治療は手術、放射線療法、化学療法から細胞型に応じて選択され、予後は成熟奇形腫と純粋セミノーマでは良好、非セミノーマ性および混合型腫瘍では不良である。
pmid-1326777.summary_en: A radiologic–pathologic review of mediastinal germ cell tumors, the most common extragonadal germ cell tumor site being the anterior mediastinum. Mature teratoma is the most common histologic type, usually asymptomatic and incidental, with cystic components, fat or calcification on imaging. Malignant tumors typically present as large masses in symptomatic young men; seminomas are homogeneous while nonseminomatous tumors are heterogeneous on CT. Treatment includes surgery, radiotherapy or chemotherapy depending on cell type, with excellent prognosis for mature teratoma and pure seminoma, and poor prognosis for nonseminomatous and mixed tumors.

pmid-1326848.summary_ja: 初回は子宮頸部妊娠と誤診された原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告。メトトレキサートによる保存的治療が無効で、子宮摘出術とアクチノマイシンDによる化学療法を施行した。20か月のフォローアップでβ-hCGは正常化し、良好な経過を示した。報告例は約60例と極めて稀である。
pmid-1326848.summary_en: A case report of primary cervical choriocarcinoma, initially misdiagnosed as cervical pregnancy. Conservative treatment with methotrexate failed, so the patient underwent hysterectomy followed by actinomycin-D chemotherapy. At 20 months of follow-up she was in good condition with normal serum beta-hCG levels. Primary cervical choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, with only about 60 cases reported.

pmid-1327005.summary_ja: 17歳男性の未熟精巣奇形腫で、主体となっていた黒色神経外胚葉腫瘍の症例報告。縦隔に成熟奇形腫も併存していた。免疫組織化学で神経上皮性と間葉系の形質を示した。精巣由来の黒色神経外胚葉腫瘍は初報告とされ、胚細胞由来の神経外胚葉分化と考えられる。
pmid-1327005.summary_en: A case report of a 17-year-old man with melanotic neuroectodermal tumour as the predominant component of an immature testicular teratoma, who also had a mature mediastinal teratoma. Immunohistochemistry showed neuroepithelial and mesenchymal features, with positivity for NSE, S-100, HMB45, cytokeratin and vimentin, and myogenic foci. The authors believe this is the first reported testicular origin of MNT, most likely reflecting neuroectodermal differentiation of germ cell origin within an immature teratoma.

pmid-1327076.summary_ja: 推定性腺外胚細胞腫瘍49例を、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる治療成績で検討した研究。完全寛解率は80%、中央値41か月で76%が無病生存。後腹膜腫瘍例の42%に精巣の上皮内癌が認められ、真の性腺外腫瘍ではない可能性や共通の悪性前駆細胞の存在が示唆された。
pmid-1327076.summary_en: A study of 49 patients with presumed extragonadal germ cell tumors (39 retroperitoneal, 8 mediastinal, 2 CNS) treated with high-dose or conventional cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin based on prognostic factors. Complete remission was 80%, and 76% were alive without disease at a median of 41 months. Bilateral testicular biopsies found carcinoma in situ in 42% of retroperitoneal tumor patients, suggesting these tumors may not be truly extragonadal or share a malignant progenitor.

pmid-1328977.summary_ja: 転移性高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌の女性12例に対し、エトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド、ビンクリスチンの多剤併用療法を行った研究である。10例が完全寛解、2例が部分寛解となった。1例で再発したが、シスプラチン併用化学療法で救援された。中央値26か月の追跡で全生存率は100%であった。重篤な毒性はなく、本レジメンは忍容性が高く有効と結論された。
pmid-1328977.summary_en: This study evaluated a multiagent regimen of etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, and vincristine in 12 women with metastatic high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma. Ten achieved complete response and two partial response. One patient relapsed and was salvaged with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Overall survival was 100% with median follow-up of 26 months. Toxicities were manageable, with neutropenia causing treatment delays in a minority of cycles and no life-threatening events. The authors concluded that this regimen is well tolerated and highly effective for high-risk gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-1329050.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋標本31例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を対象に、フローサイトメトリーによるDNA量解析を行い、部分奇胎と完全奇胎の鑑別を検討した研究である。組織学的に部分奇胎と診断された24例のうち8例が三倍体であった。核型解析が得られた9例中8例で結果が一致した。完全奇胎や持続性絨毛性疾患は二倍体であった。保存組織における部分奇胎の診断に有用な迅速法と結論された。
pmid-1329050.summary_en: This study applied flow cytometric DNA content analysis to paraffin-embedded specimens from 31 trophoblastic disease cases to distinguish partial from complete hydatidiform moles. Eight of 24 histologically diagnosed partial moles were triploid, matching karyotype in 8 of 9 cases with available cytogenetics. Complete moles, hydropic abortion, and persistent disease were diploid. One choriocarcinoma showed abnormal DNA content with a DNA index of 1.3. The authors conclude that flow cytometry is a reliable, fast method for diagnosing partial moles in archival tissue. The sample size is limited.

pmid-1329224.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチンの代替としてのカルボプラチンの有用性を、ロイヤルマーズデン病院の先行研究から検討したものである。転移性非セミノーマ76例にカルボプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンを併用し、完全寛解率は95%であった。転移性セミノーマ33例では単剤カルボプラチンを用い、無増悪生存率は79%であった。カルボプラチンはシスプラチンと同等の効果を示し、毒性は少ないと結論された。
pmid-1329224.summary_en: This review summarizes Royal Marsden pilot studies of carboplatin in testicular germ cell tumors. In 76 patients with metastatic nonseminoma treated with carboplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin from 1984 to 1988, complete remission was 95% and cause-specific survival 98.5% at median 24-month follow-up. In 33 patients with advanced metastatic seminoma treated with single-agent carboplatin, actuarial progression-free survival was 79% over median 36 months. The authors conclude carboplatin has activity comparable to cisplatin and is less toxic, offering an alternative in testicular GCT.

pmid-1329449.summary_ja: 1985年から1991年に、進行胚細胞腫瘍12例を対象に、4種類のリスク基準の予後予測能を比較した臨床研究である。3サイクル以内に完全寛解した群と、それ以外の群に分けて検討した。インディアナ病期分類が最も有用と考えられた。症例数が少なく単施設研究である点が限界とされる。
pmid-1329449.summary_en: This Japanese urology study compared four risk criteria for germ cell tumors in 12 patients treated with VAB-6 or PVeBV induction followed by VIP salvage chemotherapy between 1985 and 1991. Patients were grouped by whether they achieved complete remission within three cycles (good response) or not (poor response), and the groups were compared with each risk classification. The Indiana Staging System appeared most useful in this small series. The findings are limited by the small sample size and single-institution design.

pmid-1329610.summary_ja: ターナー症候群(45,XO)を有する23歳女性が卵巣腫瘍で受診し、組織学的に胎児性癌と診断された症例報告である。発生異常を伴う性腺から胎児性癌が生じることは稀で、純粋な45,XO核型ではさらに稀とされる。化学療法と外科的治療の役割が強調された。異形成性性腺の悪性転化リスクを文献的に概説し、予防的な性腺摘出の是非についても論じている。
pmid-1329610.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old woman with Turner syndrome who presented with an ovarian neoplasm, histologically confirmed as embryonal carcinoma. Karyotype showed pure 45,XO. Embryonal carcinoma arising in a dysgenetic gonad is uncommon, and even rarer with a pure 45,XO karyotype. The report highlights the roles of chemotherapy and surgery in management. The authors also review the clinical features, genetic variants, and malignant transformation risk in dysgenetic gonads, and discuss prophylactic removal of these gonads.

pmid-1329910.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎および絨毛癌の患者40例を対象に、化学療法開始前に子宮動脈のドップラー超音波検査を行い、薬剤耐性との関連を前向きに検討した研究である。拍動指数1.1以下の患者で薬剤耐性が有意に多かった。拍動指数は転移や子宮出血とは関連しなかった。治療前の子宮動脈評価は薬剤耐性の予測に有用と結論された。
pmid-1329910.summary_en: This prospective study assessed uterine artery Doppler ultrasound in 40 consecutive patients with invasive mole or choriocarcinoma before chemotherapy. Patients with a pulsatility index of 1.1 or less were significantly more likely to develop drug resistance (P < 0.04). Pulsatility index was not associated with metastatic disease or uterine bleeding. Of eight patients who developed resistance, five could potentially have avoided inadequate initial treatment if Doppler findings were included in the scoring system for selecting chemotherapy. The authors conclude pre-treatment uterine artery Doppler assessment helps predict drug resistance.

pmid-1330244.summary_ja: 直径3〜7cmの片側性卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫の生殖年齢女性18例に対する腹腔鏡手術の成績を報告したものである。9例は嚢胞摘出術、9例は片側卵巣摘出術または卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた。大きな手術合併症はなく、入院期間も短かった。腹腔鏡手術は卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に対する安全で有効な方法と結論された。症例数が少なく、長期成績は示されていない。
pmid-1330244.summary_en: This clinical series reports laparoscopic management of unilateral benign ovarian cystic teratoma measuring 3 to 7 cm in 18 women of reproductive age. Nine underwent pelviscopic cyst enucleation and nine underwent unilateral oophorectomy or salpingo-oophorectomy. No major surgical complications occurred, and hospital stays were short. The authors conclude that operative laparoscopy is a safe and effective approach for benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. The series is small, and the abstract reports no long-term follow-up.

pmid-1330448.summary_ja: 1983年から1990年に治療された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍87例を対象としたフランスの後方視的研究である。セミノーマ23例では22例(96%)が治療後無病となり、2年生存率は86%だった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍64例では52%が無病となり、2年生存率は53%であった。他部位原発の非セミノーマより予後は不良だが、治療の有効性は確認された。
pmid-1330448.summary_en: This French retrospective study analyzed 87 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors treated between 1983 and 1990. Among 23 with pure seminoma, 96% were disease-free after treatment, with a two-year survival of 86%. Among 64 with nonseminomatous tumors, 52% became disease-free and two-year survival was 53%, rising to 87% in those achieving complete response. Seven patients relapsed after complete response. The authors conclude that prognosis is worse than for nonseminomatous tumors from other primary sites, but that therapy is effective.

pmid-1331547.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた113例を解析し、残存腫瘍の分布を検討した。残存腫瘍の大部分は大動脈周囲に存在した。残存病変を有する60例中14例で腫瘍が縮小郭清範囲外にあったが、残存腫瘤切除と縮小郭清の併用で後腹膜に腫瘍が残るのは8%のみであった。選択された患者では縮小郭清が適切と結論している。
pmid-1331547.summary_en: This study of 113 patients with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who had bulky retroperitoneal disease and underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy mapped where residual tumor lay. Most residual tumor was in the para-aortic area on the left and interaortocaval area on the right. Only 14 of 60 patients with residual disease had tumor outside the modified template, and removing the residual mass plus modified dissection would have left tumor in just 8% of patients. The authors conclude modified RPLND is appropriate for selected patients.

pmid-1332066.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍45例で8つの多型マーカーを用い、生殖系列と腫瘍のゲノム型を比較して12番染色体長腕の欠失を解析した。12q13と12q22に高頻度の欠失が認められ、候補腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在部位と考えられた。KITとMGFの発現はセミノーマと非セミノーマで異なり、胚細胞腫瘍の発生への関与が示唆された。
pmid-1332066.summary_en: This study mapped chromosome 12 deletions in 45 male germ cell tumor patients by comparing germline and tumor genotypes at eight polymorphic loci. Frequent losses occurred at 12q13 and 12q22, which the authors propose as sites of candidate tumor suppressor genes. One tumor showed a homozygous deletion including the MGF gene at 12q22. KIT and MGF expression differed between seminomatous and nonseminomatous tumors in 24 biopsies and three cell lines, implicating these genes in germ cell tumorigenesis and differentiation.

pmid-1332835.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍は、境界悪性の胞状奇胎から高度に侵襲性の絨毛癌までの疾患スペクトラムである。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の連続測定、臨床経過、病変の進展様式を統合して管理し、予後因子を適切に適用することが重要とされる。統合的管理により、毒性を最小限に抑えつつ完全寛解の可能性を最大化できると述べている。
pmid-1332835.summary_en: This review covers gestational trophoblastic tumours, a spectrum ranging from hydatidiform mole, a borderline malignancy, to highly aggressive choriocarcinoma. The authors argue that management should integrate serial hCG measurements, clinical history, and the pattern of disease spread to apply prognostic variables appropriately. Such an integrated approach maximizes the chance of complete remission with minimal toxicity, and they suggest death from trophoblastic tumour should be uncommon. The title refers to the immune system, but the abstract focuses on clinical management.

pmid-1333336.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍115例を、精巣摘除術後の監視療法で管理した成績である。約30%が再発し、大半は1年以内であった。再発例の大部分は白金製剤を含む化学療法で救済され、2例が死亡した。血管・リンパ管侵襲が再発と関連したが、組織型や術前の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は関連しなかった。腫瘍マーカーのみで発見された再発が多く、十分なフォローアップの重要性が示された。
pmid-1333336.summary_en: This report describes 115 patients with clinical Stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumours managed by orchiectomy and surveillance, with median follow-up of 36 months. About 30% relapsed, most within a year, and most were salvaged with platinum-based chemotherapy. Two patients died, both with intermediate malignant teratoma and vascular or lymphatic invasion. Vascular or lymphatic invasion predicted relapse, while histology, T stage, and preorchiectomy AFP did not. Tumour marker alone detected many relapses, underscoring the need for thorough follow-up.

pmid-1333851.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍39例と胚・胎児8例で中間径フィラメントタンパク質などのマーカーを免疫組織化学的に検討し、腫瘍発生と胚発生の類似点と相違点を比較した。未分化胚細胞に相当するセミノーマと胎児性癌は中間径フィラメントの発現に乏しかった。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の不均一な成分を明らかにし、混合型胚細胞腫瘍には2つの型が存在し発生機序が異なると考察している。
pmid-1333851.summary_en: This study examines intermediate filament proteins and special markers in 39 testicular germ cell tumors and eight embryos or fetuses, comparing tumor development with embryogenesis. Seminoma and embryonal carcinoma, the tumoral counterparts of undifferentiated germ cells, showed little intermediate filament expression. Tumorigenesis appeared to skip normal maturation steps. Immunostaining revealed heterogeneous elements in nonseminomatous tumors, and the authors propose combined and diffuse patterns in mixed germ cell tumors, suggesting different tumorigenic mechanisms.

pmid-1334606.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する術中凍結切片診断の正確性を後方視的に検討した研究。1962〜1991年に行われた30例を検証し、悪性24例・良性2例のすべてを正しく診断した。誤診は精巣温存手術の判断に影響しうるため、診断の信頼性は重要である。凍結切片診断は精巣がんの診断に有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-1334606.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated the accuracy of frozen section examination for testicular masses. Thirty frozen sections performed between 1962 and 1991 were reviewed, and 26 cases had the entire testicle available for histologic evaluation. Frozen sections correctly identified all 24 malignant and 2 benign masses. The authors conclude that frozen section can accurately diagnose testicular cancer. Because misdiagnosis could lead to inappropriate testis-sparing surgery, the findings are relevant to surgical decision-making in testicular tumors.

pmid-1334607.summary_ja: 閉経後の54歳女性に発生した後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。右側の腎疝痛で受診し、3か月後に後腹膜腫瘍が確認された。開腹生検で胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、体外照射による放射線療法を受けたが、9か月後に転移により死亡した。閉経後女性では稀な発生例であり、鑑別診断として念頭に置くべきことを示している。
pmid-1334607.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old postmenopausal woman who presented with right renal colic. A retroperitoneal tumor was found three months later, and laparotomy with biopsy revealed a germ cell tumor. She received external beam radiotherapy but died of metastatic spread nine months later. The authors consider this an uncommon occurrence of germ cell tumor in a postmenopausal woman. The report highlights that retroperitoneal germ cell tumors, though rare in this age group, should be considered in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-1335156.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で精巣摘除術と腹部放射線療法を受けた患者の性機能を、アンケートで調べた研究。放射線療法群は対照群より勃起・射精・性欲で有意に低下し、約24%が身体的な障害を感じていた。早期セミノーマに対する放射線療法の意義を疑問視している。
pmid-1335156.summary_en: This questionnaire study assessed sexual function in patients with testicular germ cell tumors after orchidectomy with or without abdominal radiotherapy. Responses from 137 irradiated patients, 18 surveillance patients and 121 controls were compared. Irradiated patients performed significantly worse in erection, ejaculation and libido, and nearly 24% felt disabled or disfigured. Sexual function declined with age, and treatment-related differences did not change across the two time periods. The authors question the role of radiation for early-stage seminoma given these morbidities.

pmid-1336479.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍76例の核DNA量をフローサイトメトリーで解析した研究。成人例はほぼ全例が異数性で、思春期前の例は倍数性を示し、発生機序の違いが示唆された。成人の非セミノーマ性腫瘍はDNA指数が低く、DNA不均一性を伴う例は進行例に多かった。予後因子としての意義が示唆されている。
pmid-1336479.summary_en: This Japanese study used flow cytometry to measure nuclear DNA content in 76 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, including adult seminomas, adult nonseminomatous tumors and prepubertal tumors. Adult tumors were almost uniformly aneuploid, whereas prepubertal tumors were euploid, supporting a different pathogenesis. Adult nonseminomatous tumors had lower DNA indices than pure seminomas, and lower indices with DNA heterogeneity appeared linked to advanced disease. The authors suggest these parameters may have prognostic relevance for adult nonseminomatous tumors.

pmid-1336925.summary_ja: 卵管不妊手術の10か月後に、強い腹痛とショックを呈した33歳の多産婦の症例報告。開腹で子宮筋層・傍子宮組織に及ぶ破裂した間質部異所性妊娠が見つかり、組織学的に絨毛癌と診断された。不妊手術後の絨毛癌は稀で、生命を脅かす重篤な病態である。
pmid-1336925.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old highly parous woman who developed severe abdominal pain and circulatory collapse ten months after tubal sterilisation, without pregnancy symptoms. Laparotomy revealed a ruptured interstitial ectopic pregnancy extending into the myometrium and parametrium. Histopathology showed choriocarcinoma within the ectopic pregnancy. The authors emphasize that this combination is rare but life-threatening, particularly in a sterilised woman who presented without typical pregnancy symptoms.

pmid-1342958.summary_ja: 乳児卵黄嚢腫瘍に伴う精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（ITGCN）の症例を報告しています。タンデムリピート配列を用いたin situハイブリダイゼーションで、ITGCN細胞は3倍体、浸潤した腫瘍細胞は4倍体と判明しました。乳児型は成人型と異なる発生経路をたどるという仮説に疑問を投げかける内容です。
pmid-1342958.summary_en: This case report describes intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) in an infantile yolk sac tumour. Infantile yolk sac tumours are often considered less aggressive and to follow a different tumorigenic path from adult testicular germ cell tumours. Using tandem repeat in situ hybridization with a chromosome 1 probe, the authors showed triploid ITGCN cells, while invasive tumour cells were tetraploid. This argues against intratubular invasion by the adjacent tumour and suggests that infantile yolk sac tumours share the adult tumorigenic pathway.

pmid-1344819.summary_ja: ダウン症候群の胎児（妊娠18週）の精巣に、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（ITGCN）に類似した異常胚細胞を認めた症例報告です。細胞はPAS陽性で、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼも陽性でした。胚細胞腫瘍の発生における最初の発癌事象は、出生前に起こる可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-1344819.summary_en: This report describes a fetal testis from an 18-week elective termination after trisomy 21 was detected by amniocentesis. The testis contained abnormal germ cells resembling intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN), with a distribution similar to that seen in children with dysgenetic gonads and androgen insensitivity. The cells were PAS positive and showed placental-like alkaline phosphatase. The findings suggest that the first oncogenic event in germ cell tumour development may occur in utero or earlier. ITGCN in Down syndrome had not been reported before, although these patients have increased germ cell tumour risk.

pmid-1345462.summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3の培養上清がヒトNK細胞およびLAK細胞の細胞傷害活性に与える影響を検討したものです。上清は用量依存的にこれらの活性を抑制し、高いエフェクター対標的比でより強く抑制されました。絨毛癌由来の因子が細胞性免疫を広く抑制する可能性が示唆されており、責任となる免疫調節分子の同定が今後の課題とされています。
pmid-1345462.summary_en: This 1992 study examined how supernatant from the JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell line affects human natural killer (NK) and lymphokine-activated killer (LAK) cell cytotoxicity against K562 target cells. Choriocarcinoma supernatants suppressed both NK and LAK activity in a dose-dependent manner, with stronger inhibition at higher effector-to-target ratios. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma-derived factors may broadly inhibit cellular immunity, and they call for further work to identify the responsible immunoregulatory molecules.

pmid-1346098.summary_ja: 本研究は、血清hCG高値を示した3例の絨毛性腫瘍を、ミニサテライトDNAプローブを用いて遺伝学的に解析したものです。1例は胚細胞腫瘍から妊娠性絨毛癌へ再分類され、別の1例は妊娠性絨毛癌と診断されていたものの非妊娠性由来であることが判明しました。残る1例は直前の正期妊娠ではなく、過去の胞状奇胎に由来していました。トロホブラスト性腫瘍の正確な分類にDNA解析が有用であると結論づけています。
pmid-1346098.summary_en: This study used minisatellite DNA probes to analyze tumors with trophoblastic differentiation from three patients with elevated serum hCG. DNA fingerprinting revealed that one tumor initially classified as a germ cell tumor was in fact a gestational choriocarcinoma, while another diagnosed as gestational choriocarcinoma was of nongestational origin. The third tumor arose from a previous hydatidiform mole rather than the antecedent term pregnancy. The authors conclude that DNA analysis is valuable for accurately classifying trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-1346359.summary_ja: 46XY性腺異形成を伴う表現型女性が、卵黄嚢成分を含む卵巣悪性奇形腫を発症し化学療法を受けた症例です。26か月後に肝臓、脾臓、腎臓、リンパ節を侵す真の組織球性悪性腫瘍が生じ、さらに8か月後に急性単芽球性白血病を発症しました。両者の併発は同様の患者で初の報告とされ、胚細胞腫瘍と血液悪性腫瘍の関連はY染色体を持つ異形成性性腺が関係する可能性が提唱されています。
pmid-1346359.summary_en: This case report describes a phenotypically female patient with 46XY gonadal dysgenesis who first had an ovarian malignant teratoma with yolk sac elements, treated with chemotherapy. Twenty-six months later she developed a true histiocytic malignancy involving the liver, spleen, kidney, and lymph nodes, followed by acute monoblastic leukemia eight months after that. The authors report this as the first case of these two rare malignancies in such a patient. They propose that the association between germ cell tumors and hematologic malignancy may relate to dysgenetic gonads carrying a Y chromosome.

pmid-1346363.summary_ja: 多発性内分泌腫瘍症2A型(Sipple症候群)の患者にみられた左卵巣ストルマカルチノイドの症例報告です。本腫瘍は甲状腺様濾胞とカルチノイド像が混在する単一胚葉性卵巣奇形腫で、副腎褐色細胞腫の精査中に発見されました。免疫染色では神経内分泌マーカーに陽性で、濾胞はサイログロブリン陽性、カルシトニン陰性でした。著者らは、他部位のカルチノイドと同様に、本腫瘍もMEN2Aに伴って発生しうると述べています。
pmid-1346363.summary_en: This case report describes a left ovarian strumal carcinoid, a monodermal teratoma with thyroid-like follicles admixed with carcinoid patterns, found in a patient with multiple endocrine neoplasia type IIA (Sipple's syndrome). The patient had a prior medullary thyroid carcinoma and was being evaluated for bilateral adrenal pheochromocytomas when the ovarian tumor was discovered. Immunohistochemistry showed reactivity for neuroendocrine markers, with thyroglobulin staining in follicles but no calcitonin staining. The authors suggest that ovarian strumal carcinoid, like carcinoid tumors elsewhere, can arise in association with MEN IIA.

pmid-1348423.summary_ja: 本研究は、Y染色体特異的およびローカス特異的ミニサテライトプローブを用いて、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍2例の遺伝学的起源を調べたものです。両例とも妊娠性由来と確認されました。1例は正常な女性受精卵に由来し、もう1例は絨毛癌との関連がより一般的な純型完全胞状奇胎に由来していました。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は、胞状奇胎と正常妊娠のいずれからも生じうることが示されました。
pmid-1348423.summary_en: This study used Y chromosome-specific and locus-specific minisatellite probes to determine the genetic origin of two placental site trophoblastic tumours. Both were confirmed as gestational in origin. One arose from a normal female conceptus, while the other derived from a homozygous complete hydatidiform mole, an abnormal conceptus more typically linked to choriocarcinoma. The findings show that placental site trophoblastic tumours can originate from either a hydatidiform mole or a normal pregnancy.

pmid-1349168.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌におけるPCNA(増殖細胞核抗原)の発現を、パラフィン切片を用いた免疫染色で比較したものです。正常胎盤では細胞性栄養膜細胞の核に強く発現し、合胞体栄養膜細胞は陰性でした。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌でも、発現は主に細胞性栄養膜細胞と中間型栄養膜細胞に限られ、合胞体は多くが陰性でした。PCNAは日常的に処理された胎盤組織の増殖領域を正確に示し、腫瘍化後も合胞体の増殖能は低いと結論づけています。
pmid-1349168.summary_en: This pediatric pathology study examined proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) expression in normal placentas, hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas using immunohistochemistry on paraffin sections. In normal placentas, PCNA was strongly expressed in cytotrophoblast nuclei, but not in syncytiotrophoblast. In hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinomas, PCNA expression remained predominantly in cytotrophoblast and intermediate trophoblast, while the syncytium was largely unreactive. The authors conclude that PCNA accurately marks proliferative areas in routinely processed placental tissue, and that syncytial cells have low proliferative activity even after neoplastic transformation.

pmid-1351110.summary_ja: 38歳男性が膿性痰を伴う咳嗽と右前胸部痛で受診した。胸部X線で右肺野と前縦隔に腫瘤を認め、SLXとSCCの上昇から肺膿瘍や気管支原性癌が疑われた。開胸ドレナージで毛髪と粥状物質が確認され、奇形腫と診断された。腫瘤内の膵組織がSLXを産生しており、奇形腫では腫瘍マーカーが上昇しうると考察している。
pmid-1351110.summary_en: A 38-year-old man presented with productive cough and right anterior chest pain. Chest X-ray showed connected masses in the right lung and anterior mediastinum. Elevated SLX and SCC suggested lung abscess or bronchogenic carcinoma, but open chest drainage revealed hair and atheromatous material, establishing a teratoma diagnosis. Immunostaining showed SLX in pancreatic tissue within the mass. The authors propose that teratomas may commonly elevate tumor markers.

pmid-1353118.summary_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群の患者で、両側の停留精巣にそれぞれ同時性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍が認められた症例報告である。停留精巣は悪性転化のリスクが高いことが背景として示されている。持続性ミュラー管症候群で停留性性腺を有する患者では、胚細胞腫瘍のリスクに留意すべきと強調している。
pmid-1353118.summary_en: The authors report a patient with persistent müllerian duct syndrome who had bilateral cryptorchid testes. Both undescended gonads harbored synchronous mixed germ cell tumors. The report highlights that undescended testes carry an increased risk of malignant transformation. It suggests that clinicians should consider germ cell tumor risk in patients with persistent müllerian duct syndrome and undescended gonads. The report describes a single patient.

pmid-1355081.summary_ja: 停留精巣に生じたセミノーマ26例の臨床像と治療成績を検討した。診断時に16例（62%）でリンパ節転移を認めた。治療は放射線療法15例、化学療法10例、両者併用1例であった。中央値9.6年の観察で再発は1例のみで、再発後は化学療法で救済された。5年および10年生存率は92%と79%であった。
pmid-1355081.summary_en: The authors reviewed 26 patients with seminoma arising in undescended testes, most located in the iliac fossa or inguinal canal. Sixteen patients (62%) had nodal metastases at diagnosis. Fifteen received radiotherapy alone, ten chemotherapy alone, and one both. At a median follow-up of 9.6 years, only one patient relapsed, and he was salvaged with chemotherapy. Five- and ten-year survival rates were 92% and 79%, respectively, with an excellent overall outcome.

pmid-1355656.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞（奇形癌の悪性幹細胞）の炭水化物抗原が、分化に伴いどう変化するかを、ヒト多能性EC細胞株NTERA-2を用いて解析した。未分化細胞ではグロボ系糖脂質が主に発現していた。レチノイン酸で分化させると、ラクト系およびガングリオ系へ顕著に移行した。分化細胞のサブセットごとに異なる抗原パターンがみられ、胚発生時の細胞同定や形態形成に寄与すると考察されている。
pmid-1355656.summary_en: This article examines carbohydrate antigens of embryonal carcinoma cells, the malignant stem cells of teratocarcinomas. Using the pluripotent human EC line NTERA-2, the authors show that undifferentiated cells predominantly express globo-series glycolipids. Retinoic acid induction shifts expression toward lacto- and ganglio-series glycolipids, and distinct differentiated subsets display different antigen patterns. These changes may mark cell identity and support morphogenetic interactions during embryonic development.

pmid-1355663.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常および停留精巣、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマ、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍におけるグルタチオンS-転移酵素（GST）の発現を免疫組織化学で検討した。GST Piは精細管内胚細胞腫瘍とセミノーマの腫瘍性胚細胞で強く発現し、奇形腫の全成分でも認められた。原発巣と化学療法後の転移巣で差はなかった。GST Piは精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の新たなマーカーとして提案された。
pmid-1355663.summary_en: This study examined glutathione S-transferase (GST) isoenzyme expression by immunohistochemistry in normal and cryptorchid testes, intratubular germ cell neoplasia, seminoma, and non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. All isoenzymes were expressed in Leydig and Sertoli cells. GST Pi was strongly expressed in neoplastic germ cells of intratubular germ cell neoplasia and seminoma, and in all teratoma elements, with no difference between primary tumours and post-chemotherapy metastases. GST Pi is proposed as a new marker for intratubular germ cell neoplasia, with a possible but undefined role in drug resistance.

pmid-1360871.summary_ja: ミニサテライトDNAプローブを用いたDNAフィンガープリント解析により、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍20例の組織発生を、腫瘍組織と宿主単核細胞を比較して検討した。成熟奇形腫では一部の症例で宿主の多型バンドが部分的に消失しており、悪性転化と未熟奇形腫でもバンドの消失が見られた。ディスジャーミノーマは宿主のフィンガープリントと完全に一致した。著者らは、嚢胞性成熟奇形腫は様々な減数分裂段階で停止した胚細胞に由来し、未熟奇形腫は減数分裂後の胚細胞に由来し、ディスジャーミノーマは減数分裂前の卵原細胞に由来すると結論づけている。
pmid-1360871.summary_en: The histogenesis of 20 ovarian germ cell tumours was investigated using minisatellite DNA fingerprinting to compare tumour tissue with host mononuclear cells. Mature teratomas showed partial loss of host polymorphic bands in some cases, and malignant transformation and immature teratomas also showed band loss. Dysgerminomas matched the host fingerprint completely. The authors conclude that mature cystic teratomas arise from germ cells arrested at various meiotic stages, immature teratomas from postmeiotic germ cells, and dysgerminomas from premeiotic oogonia.

pmid-1362513.summary_ja: 1970年から1991年に紹介された精巣胚細胞腫瘍273例を後方視的に検討した。停留精巣の発生率は全体で11%であり、黒人（32%）と混血（18%）では白人（7%）より有意に高かった。黒人患者は精巣固定術を受けておらず、腹部または鼠径部の腫瘤として発見され、セミノーマの割合が高かった。
pmid-1362513.summary_en: This review of 273 patients with testicular germ cell tumours from 1970 to 1991 examined the association between cryptorchidism and testicular cancer across ethnic groups. Undescended testis occurred in 11% overall, significantly more often in black (32%) and mixed-race (18%) patients than in white patients (7%). Black patients had rarely undergone orchiopexy, and presented with abdominal or inguinal masses and a higher proportion of seminomas, with a mean age of 40 years.

pmid-1363396.summary_ja: 男性の右腎に発生した絨毛癌の症例報告。発熱・肉眼的血尿・側腹部痛で受診し、4か月間両側腎結石として治療されたため診断が遅れた。腎摘除後の組織検査と免疫組織化学で確定した。PVB療法に一時的に反応したが、全身化学療法開始4か月後に脳転移と呼吸不全で死亡した。腎腫瘤と血尿の鑑別で絨毛癌を考慮すべきことを示す。
pmid-1363396.summary_en: A case report of a man with choriocarcinoma of the right kidney, presenting with fever, gross hematuria and flank pain. The diagnosis was delayed about four months because the condition was initially treated as bilateral renal stones. It was confirmed only after nephrectomy, with immunohistochemistry supporting the diagnosis. The tumor responded briefly to PVB chemotherapy (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin), but the patient died of brain metastasis and respiratory failure four months after starting systemic treatment. The report highlights that renal choriocarcinoma is extremely rare and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of renal masses with hematuria.

pmid-1370066.summary_ja: インディアナ大学で1975〜1988年に治療された非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移24例を後方視的に検討した。全身病変がコントロール可能な症例では全脳照射と化学療法により長期生存が得られ、6例が5年以上無病であった。進行例の緩和的照射では生存例はなかった。
pmid-1370066.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 24 patients treated at Indiana University from 1975 to 1988 for brain metastases from nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Patients were grouped by presentation: brain metastases at diagnosis, brain-only relapse after complete response, or progression after first-line chemotherapy. Patients with potentially controllable systemic disease who received whole-brain irradiation with surgery and concurrent chemotherapy achieved long-term survival, and six were disease-free beyond five years. No patient with progressive disease treated palliatively survived. The authors recommend curative-intent treatment for selected patients.

pmid-1370070.summary_ja: セミノーマに高カルシウム血症を合併した4例と文献上の3例、計7例を報告。PTHは多くで正常、calcitriolは測定された2例で上昇していた。化学療法で腫瘍の縮小とともにカルシウムは正常化し、7例全例が完全寛解に至った。セミノーマの未認識の傍腫瘍症候群と考えられる。
pmid-1370070.summary_en: Four cases of seminoma with hypercalcemia are reported, together with three from the literature. All patients had normal serum phosphorus and no skeletal metastases, and parathyroid hormone was normal in most tested patients. Calcitriol was elevated in the two patients tested. Hypercalcemia resolved with systemic chemotherapy as tumor volume decreased, and calcitriol levels normalized after treatment. Hypercalcemia did not worsen prognosis, since all seven patients achieved complete remission. The authors propose it as an unrecognized paraneoplastic syndrome of seminoma.

pmid-1370332.summary_ja: 1977〜1988年に単一施設で治療された播種性精巣胚細胞腫瘍150例の長期成績。化学療法と残存腫瘤切除により82%が無病状態に到達し、中央値49か月の観察で長期無病生存率は77%であった。インディアナ大学病期分類が最も予測能が高かった。成熟奇形腫を含む軽〜中等度例は予後が極めて良好であった。
pmid-1370332.summary_en: A single-institution series of 150 patients with disseminated testicular germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin between 1977 and 1988. Of these, 82% achieved a disease-free status with chemotherapy, with or without resection of residual masses. With a median follow-up of 49 months, the estimated long-term probability of remaining free of failure and surviving was 77%. Multivariate analysis showed the Indiana University staging system was highly predictive, while other systems were less useful. Patients with minimal or moderate disease containing mature teratoma in the orchiectomy specimen had an excellent prognosis.

pmid-1370759.summary_ja: 1989〜1990年に治療した転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者53例を対象とした検討です。化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化した10例では残存腹部腫瘤を切除しました。化学療法に抵抗性で切除可能な病変を持つ3例では、外科手術により腫瘍マーカーが速やかに低下し、7〜25か月の無病生存が得られました。治療抵抗例に対する介入的手術の検討を提案しています。
pmid-1370759.summary_en: This study of 53 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumours treated in 1989 to 1990 examined the role of surgery after chemotherapy. Residual abdominal masses were resected in ten patients once tumour markers normalised. In three patients with large intra-abdominal masses and plateauing or rising markers despite intensive chemotherapy, surgery led to a rapid marker fall, and all three remained disease-free at 7 to 25 months. The authors suggest interventional surgery should be considered for chemotherapy-refractory patients with resectable lesions.

pmid-1370771.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患における遊離β-サブユニットの測定値が施設間で大きく異なる原因を検討しました。ニックを持つ分子を異なる抗体がどう認識するかを3種の免疫測定法で比較しました。抗体1E5は完全な分子のみを検出し、FBT11とB204は総βサブユニットを測定したため、値は最大10倍高くなりました。ペプチドのニックと抗体認識が測定値に大きく影響すると結論づけています。
pmid-1370771.summary_en: This study examined why laboratories report widely different free beta-subunit hCG values in trophoblastic disease. Three immunoassays with different antibodies were tested on nicked and intact standards, then on sera from normal pregnancy, Down syndrome, hydatidiform mole and persistent trophoblastic disease. Antibody 1E5 detected only intact molecules, while FBT11 and B204 measured total beta-subunit, giving values up to ten-fold higher. The authors conclude that peptide nicks and antibody recognition substantially affect reported free beta-subunit concentrations.

pmid-1371235.summary_ja: 血清β-hCGが50,000 mIU/mlを超える男性の胚細胞腫瘍を後方視的に検討し、甲状腺機能亢進症を評価しました。評価可能な17例中7例(41%)でT4が上昇し、いずれもβ-hCGが200,000 mIU/mlを超えていました。原発巣の制御後には甲状腺機能が正常化しました。高β-hCG胚細胞腫瘍では潜在性甲状腺機能亢進症が比較的多いことが示唆されます。
pmid-1371235.summary_en: This retrospective review assessed hyperthyroidism in men with germ cell tumours and serum beta-hCG above 50,000 mIU/ml. Of 17 evaluable patients, seven (41%) had elevated T4 levels, all with beta-hCG above 200,000 mIU/ml, and T4 correlated with beta-hCG. Manifestations included tachycardia, hypertension and systolic murmur, but no goitre. Only one patient needed antithyroid treatment. Thyroid function normalised after control of the primary disease, suggesting subclinical hyperthyroidism is common when beta-hCG is high.

pmid-1372134.summary_ja: 化学療法を受けた転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者77例で予後因子を評価しました。Indiana分類と数式モデルはそれぞれ84.4%、87.0%の症例を正しくリスク群に分類し、M.D. Anderson分類の61%を上回りました。純粋な絨毛癌の組織型、高値のβ-hCG、性腺外原発も一部で不良な予後と関連しました。リスク分類にはIndiana分類または数式の使用が推奨されています。
pmid-1372134.summary_en: Seventy-seven patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumours treated with chemotherapy were assessed for prognostic factors. The Indiana classification and a mathematical formula correctly allocated 84.4% and 87.0% of patients to risk groups, outperforming the M.D. Anderson system at 61%. Serum beta-hCG above a threshold, pure choriocarcinoma histology and possibly an extragonadal primary predicted adverse outcome in a small number of patients. The authors recommend the Indiana classification or the formula for risk allocation.

pmid-1372196.summary_ja: 健常者と精巣がん患者の血清中のhCG、遊離β-hCG、遊離αサブユニットを免疫酵素測定法で定量しました。遊離αサブユニットは全ての健常者で検出され、hCGは男性の54%で検出されました。精巣がん13例の長期フォローアップでは、3指標の値は並行して変動しました。セミノーマの27%、非セミノーマの13%で遊離β-hCGと遊離αが選択的に上昇し、腫瘍マーカー陽性率を高めました。予後予測には有用ではないものの、診断精度を改善します。
pmid-1372196.summary_en: Monoclonal antibody immunoenzymometric assays measured hCG, free beta-hCG and free alpha-subunit in healthy people and testicular cancer patients. Free alpha was present in all healthy subjects, and hCG in 54% of men. In 13 long-term follow-up patients, the three analytes varied in parallel. Free beta-hCG and free alpha were selectively raised in 27% of seminoma and 13% of nonseminoma patients, raising marker positivity from 15% to 42% and 57% to 70%. Free subunits improve diagnosis but not prognosis.

pmid-1372658.summary_ja: 純粋セミノーマ35例で肘静脈血と精巣静脈血のβ-hCGを測定した研究です。末梢血では26%、精巣静脈血では80%で高値を示し、多くのセミノーマが末梢では検出されない量のβ-hCGを産生することが示されました。β-hCG陽性は攻撃性ではなく腫瘍量を反映するとの見解で、腫瘍マーカーの解釈に示唆を与えます。
pmid-1372658.summary_en: This study measured beta-hCG and alpha-fetoprotein in cubital and testicular vein blood of 35 patients with pure seminoma. Elevated beta-hCG appeared in 26% of peripheral samples but 80% of testicular vein samples, suggesting most seminomas produce beta-hCG at levels undetectable peripherally. The authors conclude that beta-hCG positivity in pure seminoma reflects tumor mass rather than greater aggressiveness. This has implications for interpreting serum tumor markers and managing testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-1372756.summary_ja: 一次化学療法後に再発した精巣がんに対する救援療法をレビューした論文です。シスプラチンを基本とする救援化学療法にイホスファミドやエトポシドなどを併用すること、残存病変の外科的切除、自家骨髄救援を伴う大量化学療法について論じています。白金抵抗性の症例は予後不良であると指摘しています。
pmid-1372756.summary_en: This review addresses salvage treatment for testicular cancer that relapses after primary chemotherapy. It recommends aggressive cisplatin-based salvage regimens, often with ifosfamide and vinblastine or etoposide, and discusses growth factor support. Follow-up depends on marker status and residual disease. Surgical resection of residual masses is considered when feasible, with uncertainty about optimal postoperative therapy. High-dose chemotherapy with autologous marrow rescue is suggested for patients failing second-line treatment, and platinum-refractory disease carries a poor prognosis.

pmid-1372757.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後における外科的切除の役割を検討したレビューです。セミノーマでは3cm以上の残存腫瘤が残存悪性腫瘍の高リスクを示します。非セミノーマ性では画像上の完全奏効でも約20%に残存奇形腫や癌が存在するため、より適切な症例選択の必要性を述べています。
pmid-1372757.summary_en: This review examines the role of surgical resection after chemotherapy in advanced germ cell tumors. For seminoma, residual masses of 3 cm or more identify patients with a high risk of residual malignancy. For nonseminomatous tumors, a normal radiographic response does not exclude residual teratoma or carcinoma, with roughly a 20% risk despite radiographic complete response. The authors call for better selection criteria to reduce unnecessary surgery and the toxicity of curative therapy.

pmid-1372787.summary_ja: 精巣または転移性の胚細胞腫瘍10例を検討し、6例でセミノーマから卵黄嚢腫瘍への移行像を確認した論文です。移行部では、サイトケラチン、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の免疫染色性が変化しました。セミノーマは非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変となりうるとの見解を支持しています。
pmid-1372787.summary_en: Ten testicular or metastatic germ cell tumors were examined for seminoma-to-yolk sac tumor transformation. Abrupt transitions from seminoma to yolk sac tumor patterns were identified in six cases, often at lobule peripheries. Immunostains for cytokeratins, placental-like alkaline phosphatase, and alpha-fetoprotein showed corresponding changes at transition foci. The findings support the view that seminoma may act as a precursor to nonseminomatous germ cell tumors rather than an endpoint neoplasm.

pmid-1373636.summary_ja: 一施設で転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性53例に行ったPOMB/ACE化学療法の成績を報告した後方視的研究です。完全奏効率は62%、5年生存率は61%で、BEP療法を上回りませんでした。エトポシドの相対用量強度0.75以上で5年生存率が有意に高く(79%対44%)、用量強度の重要性が示唆されました。
pmid-1373636.summary_en: This retrospective study reports outcomes of POMB/ACE chemotherapy in 53 men with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumor treated at one center. The complete response rate was 62%, with 5-year survival of 61%, and the regimen was not superior to BEP. Etoposide relative dose intensity of at least 0.75 was associated with significantly better 5-year survival (79% vs 44%). Cisplatin and overall dose intensity showed no survival benefit, suggesting etoposide dose intensity is an important determinant of outcome.

pmid-1374974.summary_ja: 単側性胚細胞腫瘍患者99例の対側精巣生検で、4%に上皮内癌(CIS)が見つかった。充実性胚細胞腫瘍74例では腫瘍周囲組織の76%にCISが認められた。CISを有する精巣には放射線療法が第一選択となりうるとされ、対側精巣への日常的なスクリーニング生検が推奨される。
pmid-1374974.summary_en: Contralateral testicular biopsies from 99 patients with unilateral germ cell tumor found carcinoma in situ in 4%. In 74 patients with solid germ cell tumors, biopsies of macroscopically normal tissue around the tumor showed CIS in 76%. Radiation therapy was used for CIS-bearing testes, and germ cells were absent in irradiated patients after treatment, suggesting radiotherapy as first-line therapy for CIS. The authors recommend routine screening biopsy of the contralateral testis in germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-1375576.summary_ja: 1979～1990年に一施設で治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍33例の後方視的検討である。白金製剤を含む術後化学療法を多くが受け、フォローアップ中央値66か月で97%が無病生存であった。セカンドルック手術では成熟奇形腫が6例で確認された。
pmid-1375576.summary_en: This retrospective review of 33 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated at one institution from 1979 to 1990 included dysgerminomas, endodermal sinus tumors, immature teratomas and mixed tumors. Most patients received platinum-based postoperative chemotherapy, and second-look surgery showed mature teratoma in six patients. With median follow-up of 66 months, 97% were alive without evidence of disease, supporting the prognostic benefit of platinum regimens.

pmid-1376217.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対する化学療法患者のCT画像を後方視的に検討した。ブレオマイシンを緩徐注入したEBCi(3)では、静脈内ボーラス投与のPVBやBEPに比べ肺毒性が少ない傾向だった。有意差はPVBとEBCi(3)の比較でのみ認められた。さらなる検討が必要とされる。
pmid-1376217.summary_en: Retrospective review of CT images from patients treated with chemotherapy for testicular teratoma found lower rates of bleomycin-associated lung toxicity with slow infusion (EBCi(3)) than with intravenous bolus (PVB or BEP). The difference reached significance only for PVB versus EBCi(3). The authors conclude that further investigation is justified because fatal bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis has been reported after bolus administration.

pmid-1376303.summary_ja: PA-1奇形癌由来細胞株を用い、レチノイン酸(RA)前処理後の化学感受性を比較した。RA感受性株ではシスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンの細胞毒性が増強し、N-ras形質転換RA耐性株では低下した。RAと細胞傷害性薬剤の併用療法を一般化できる根拠は得られなかったと結論づけている。
pmid-1376303.summary_en: PA-1 teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines were compared for chemosensitivity after retinoic acid pretreatment. In RA-sensitive lines, cytotoxicity of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin increased, whereas N-ras-transformed RA-resistant lines showed reduced cytotoxicity. Transformed lines were 3- to 5-fold more resistant to cisplatin and etoposide than non-transformed lines. The authors conclude that a general rationale for combining RA with cytotoxic drugs cannot be inferred from these data.

pmid-1376616.summary_ja: 化学療法で全身病変が奏効した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者3例で、精巣または中枢神経系という薬剤が届きにくい保護部位に再発がみられた。いずれも無症状で、腫瘍マーカーの上昇により発見された。外科手術±放射線療法による局所治療で2例は無病となり、1例は局所病変の進行で死亡した。化学感受性のある病変の再発時には保護部位の腫瘍を考慮すべきで、局所療法が根治につながりうると述べている。
pmid-1376616.summary_en: This report describes three patients with testicular germ cell tumours who relapsed in a sanctuary site, either the testis or the central nervous system, after responding to chemotherapy for systemic disease. All were asymptomatic, and relapse was first suggested by rising tumour marker levels. Local treatment with surgery, with or without radiotherapy, was given. Two patients became disease-free, while one died from progression of local disease. The authors recommend considering sanctuary-site relapse when chemosensitive disease relapses, since local therapy may be curative.

pmid-1376618.summary_ja: 高リスク非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍34例に、シスプラチン・イホスファミド・ブレオマイシン（PIB）療法を行った長期成績である。完全寛解は59%、残存腫瘍切除後の無病例を含めた無病率は74%であった。中央値38か月の追跡で76%が生存していた。骨髄抑制、神経毒性、腎毒性が主な毒性で、化学療法関連死は2例だった。PIBは有効な導入療法であるが、用量強化の優位性は対照試験で確認が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-1376618.summary_en: This study reports long-term outcomes of 34 patients with high-risk non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours, stage IIC or IVC/IVD, treated with cisplatin, ifosfamide and bleomycin (PIB) as first-line therapy. Twenty patients achieved complete remission, and five more had no evidence of disease after surgical removal of residual masses. At a median follow-up of 38 months, 76 percent were alive. Major toxicities included myelosuppression, neurotoxicity and nephrotoxicity, and two deaths were chemotherapy-related. The authors conclude that PIB is an effective induction regimen, though controlled trials are needed to confirm the benefit of dose intensification.

pmid-1376619.summary_ja: 未治療の非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍12例に、カルボプラチン単剤を1コース投与した。12例中10例で、hCGまたはAFPの50%超の低下、あるいは腫瘍容積の50%超の縮小が認められた。治療中に病勢進行した例はなかった。カルボプラチン単剤の高い活性が示され、併用化学療法に組み込む根拠になると結論づけている。
pmid-1376619.summary_en: This study assessed the response to a single course of carboplatin in 12 patients with previously untreated non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. Carboplatin dosing targeted a specific area under the curve. Ten of the 12 patients showed either a more than 50 percent fall in serum HCG or AFP, or a more than 50 percent reduction in tumour volume, after one course. No patient progressed during carboplatin treatment. The authors conclude that single-agent carboplatin is highly active in non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours and supports its use in combination chemotherapy.

pmid-1377738.summary_ja: 卵巣原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍5例について、捺印細胞診と組織学的所見を解析した。血清AFPは460～13,464 ng/mlであった。組織型では内胚葉洞パターンが最も多く、次いで多小胞卵黄嚢パターンであった。細胞診では立方状細胞が多く、紡錘形細胞、裸細胞、奇怪な細胞もみられた。細胞学的特徴は卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断に役立つと考えられる。
pmid-1377738.summary_en: This study analysed imprint cytology and histology in five women aged 14 to 37 with yolk sac tumour, all with primary ovarian lesions. Serum AFP ranged from 460 to 13,464 ng/ml. Histologically, the endodermal sinus pattern was most common, followed by the polyvesicular vitelline pattern. Cuboidal cells predominated in cytology, with spindle-shaped cells also common, and naked and bizarre cells were noted. The cell features described may help in the cytological recognition of yolk sac tumour.

pmid-1377761.summary_ja: 胸痛を主訴とする15歳男性の前上縦隔の大きな腫瘤に関する症例報告である。血清AFPが上昇しており、経皮的生検で胎児性癌が示唆された。腫瘍は完全切除され、術後にシスプラチンを含む併用化学療法が施行された。患者は手術から8か月後に再発により死亡した。著者らは、AFPが診断と臨床経過の追跡に非常に有用であったと述べている。
pmid-1377761.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old man with a large anterior superior mediastinal mass presenting with chest pain. Serum AFP was raised, and percutaneous biopsy suggested embryonal carcinoma. The tumour was totally resected, and postoperative combination chemotherapy including cisplatin was given. The patient died of recurrence eight months after surgery. The authors note that AFP was very useful for diagnosis and for follow-up of the clinical course.

pmid-1378830.summary_ja: 精巣原発のヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株TG1が、亜セレン酸ナトリウムを添加した化学的定義培地で持続的に増殖することを示した。この培地でもAFPやトランスフェリンなど卵黄嚢由来のタンパク質を産生した。血清培地で培養した細胞と比べ、AFPとトランスフェリンの糖鎖のコアフコース修飾が異なり、α1-6フコシルトランスフェラーゼ活性が高かった。
pmid-1378830.summary_en: This study established that the human testicular yolk sac tumour cell line TG1 grows continuously in a chemically defined, serum-free medium supplemented with sodium selenite. TG1 cells in this medium continued to produce yolk sac-derived proteins, including AFP and transferrin. However, the core fucosylation of AFP and transferrin changed. Fucosyltransferase activity was higher in serum-free culture than in serum-containing culture. The authors suggest that the medium selectively increases alpha 1-6 fucosyltransferase activity.

pmid-1378875.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍59例、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍37例、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍3例で、血清AFP・hCG・CEAを測定した。卵黄嚢腫瘍はAFP、絨毛癌はhCG、混合型はいくつかのマーカーが高値を示した。マーカーは再病期分類や治療効果の判定に役立つが、正常値でも腫瘍細胞が残存しうると述べている。
pmid-1378875.summary_en: This study measured serum AFP, hCG and CEA in 59 patients with testicular germ cell tumours and serially in 37 with ovarian and three with extragonadal germ cell tumours. Seminoma, dysgerminoma and mature teratoma typically had normal AFP, while yolk sac tumours had elevated AFP, choriocarcinoma elevated hCG, and compound tumours high levels of several markers. Marker levels helped restaging and tracked treatment response, with a rise from nadir heralding recurrence. However, normal marker levels did not exclude marker-negative tumour cells.

pmid-1380990.summary_ja: 精巣がん28例の根治的精巣摘除術標本を組織学的に検討し、腫瘍近傍と遠隔部の精子形成を評価しました。腫瘍近傍では同側の精子形成が著しく障害されていました。遠隔部の精子形成の質は、腫瘍マーカー値や上皮内癌の有無ではなく腫瘍型に左右されました。妊孕性の相談にも関わる知見です。
pmid-1380990.summary_en: This histological study of radical orchiectomy specimens from 28 testicular cancer patients evaluated spermatogenesis in tubules adjacent to and distant from the tumor. Marked impairment of ipsilateral spermatogenesis was associated with testicular carcinoma, especially near the tumor. Distant spermatogenesis quality depended on tumor type rather than on serum tumor marker elevation or carcinoma in situ. The findings suggest tumor histology influences spermatogenic function, which is relevant to fertility counseling.

pmid-1381136.summary_ja: 本研究は、腫瘍患者の血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を測定する化学発光免疫測定法について、遊離βサブユニットとの交差反応性を検討したものです。遊離βサブユニットに対して高い反応性を示し、精巣がんのセミノーマおよび非セミノーマ患者で感度の高い検出が可能でした。他の2法とも良好な相関を示しました。
pmid-1381136.summary_en: This study assesses an enhanced chemiluminescence immunoassay for serum hCG in oncology patients, focusing on its cross-reactivity with the free hCG beta-subunit. The assay showed 625% molar cross-reactivity with the free beta-subunit, giving high sensitivity for both intact hCG and free hCG-beta in patients with seminomatous or nonseminomatous testicular cancer. Correlation with two other assays was strong. The authors note that the broad reactivity highlights limitations of serum hCG measurement.

pmid-1381144.summary_ja: 性腺外（腹部）胚細胞腫瘍の11例をレトロスペクティブに検討した報告で、セミノーマ1例を含みます。シスプラチン併用化学療法と一部症例での減量手術が行われました。完全臨床奏効は7例(63%)、長期無病生存は5例(45%)でした。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍とは有意差はないものの、精巣がんより予後は不良でした。
pmid-1381144.summary_en: This retrospective chart review of eleven patients with abdominal germ cell tumors, including one seminoma, treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and sometimes surgical debulking. Seven patients (63%) achieved a complete clinical response, and five (45%) are long-term disease-free survivors at 4 to 10 years. Outcomes did not differ significantly from mediastinal germ cell tumors at the same institution, but were worse than in testicular cancer. Extragonadal sites carry a less favorable prognosis.

pmid-1381455.summary_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマ(ステージIIC、III)の7例にVAB-6化学療法を3サイクル実施しました。3例は完全寛解に至り、追加治療なしで無病生存しています。残存腫瘤を有する4例は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、2例で線維化、2例で転移性セミノーマが認められました。転移例には術後放射線療法が行われ、いずれも無病生存を維持しています。
pmid-1381455.summary_en: Seven patients with advanced testicular seminoma (stages IIC and III) received three cycles of VAB-6 induction chemotherapy. Three achieved complete remission and remain disease-free without further treatment. Four underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for residual 2-4 cm masses, finding fibrosis in two and metastatic seminoma in two. Patients with metastatic residue received postoperative retroperitoneal radiation, and all remain disease-free.

pmid-1381901.summary_ja: 北ナイジェリアの小児に生じた感染を伴う縦隔の奇形腫様腫瘍の症例報告です。慢性膿胸と誤診され診断が遅れました。報告地域では小児の縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の初例とされ、奇形腫は乳幼児のさまざまな部位で見られることも述べています。感染様の所見を伴う縦隔腫瘤では胚細胞腫瘍も鑑別に考慮すべきと示しています。
pmid-1381901.summary_en: This case report describes an infected teratodermoid tumour of the mediastinum in a child from Northern Nigeria. The mass was erroneously diagnosed as chronic empyema thoracis, which delayed correct diagnosis. The authors report it as the first primary mediastinal germ-cell tumour in a child from that region. They note that teratomas occur at diverse sites in infants and children at their institution. The report highlights that mediastinal masses with infection-like features in children should prompt consideration of a germ-cell tumour.

pmid-1381929.summary_ja: 後腹膜などの性腺外発生の腹部胚細胞腫瘍51例を、精巣原発の対照51例と腫瘍量・マーカー・年齢などで対応させて比較しました。2年・5年生存率は性腺外群で82%・70%、対照群で78%・63%と有意差はありませんでした。病変の広がりが同等なら、性腺外発生が予後を悪化させるわけではないと結論づけています。
pmid-1381929.summary_en: This study compared 51 patients with abdominal germ-cell tumours presenting extragonadally, typically with retroperitoneal masses, against 51 matched testicular controls. Matching covered bulk of disease, tumour marker levels, age and year of treatment. Survival at 2 and 5 years was 82% and 70% for extragonadal cases versus 78% and 63% for controls, with no significant difference. The hazard ratio for death was 0.7. Extragonadal retroperitoneal presentation therefore does not independently worsen prognosis when disease extent is equivalent. Extragonadal presentation was rarely associated with small-volume disease.

pmid-1381946.summary_ja: 保存パラフィン包埋の精巣標本44例(非セミノーマ25例、セミノーマ18例など)を用いて、PCRとオリゴヌクレオチドハイブリダイゼーションでRAS変異を解析しました。KRAS12コドンに4例(9.1%)で変異が検出されました。他のRASコドンや正常精巣には変異はありませんでした。精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるRAS変異の頻度は比較的低いと結論づけています。
pmid-1381946.summary_en: This study examined RAS oncogene mutations in archival paraffin-embedded orchiectomy specimens from 25 nonseminomas, 18 seminomas and one Leydig cell tumour. PCR and oligonucleotide hybridisation were used. KRAS codon 12 mutations were found in 4 of 44 neoplasms (9.1%): one seminoma and three nonseminomas. No mutations were found at other RAS codons, or in normal control testes. One nonseminoma mutation was also detected in adjacent nonmalignant tissue. The authors conclude that RAS mutations are relatively uncommon in testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-1382250.summary_ja: 若年男性の両側女性化乳房に対して、潜在性精巣腫瘍を評価せずに両側乳房切除術が行われた症例です。その後、見逃されていた陰嚢内腫瘤と著明高値の血清hCGを伴う転移性精巣がんが判明しました。若年男性の女性化乳房では精巣腫瘍を必ず考慮すべきと警告しています。精巣の診察は外科的治療より先に行うべきです。
pmid-1382250.summary_en: A young man with bilateral progressive gynaecomastia underwent bilateral subcutaneous mastectomy without evaluation for an occult testicular tumour. Metastatic testicular cancer was subsequently found, with an overlooked scrotal mass and a markedly elevated serum hCG tumour marker. The case is reported as a diagnostic pitfall. The authors recommend considering testicular tumour in any male, particularly younger men, presenting with gynecomastia. Testicular examination should precede surgical treatment of the breast changes.

pmid-1382552.summary_ja: 良好予後の転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍121例に対するカルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン(CEB)療法で、カルボプラチン用量と治療失敗の関係を解析しました。用量が低いほど失敗率が高く、AUC 5.0 mg.min/ml以上では失敗率2.7%でした。体表面積ではなく糸球体濾過量に基づく用量設定を推奨しています。
pmid-1382552.summary_en: This study analysed carboplatin dose-response in 121 patients with good-prognosis metastatic nonseminomatous germ-cell tumours treated with carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (CEB). Failure rates were higher with lower doses: 11% versus 3.4% at 400 mg/m2 or more, and 14.9% versus 2.7% at AUC 5.0 mg.min/ml or more. Failure rose further at low exposures. The authors recommend basing carboplatin dosing on glomerular filtration rate rather than body surface area, citing more precise determination of toxicity and efficacy.

pmid-1382832.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が高値だった非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍15例で、孤立性転移の外科的切除の成績を検討しました。手術のみで7例が無病、再発後の化学療法を含めると15例中11例が無病でした。hCG高値例は全例が術後に再発し、腫瘍マーカー高値のみを理由に切除を避けるべきではないと結論づけています。
pmid-1382832.summary_en: This study reviewed 15 patients with nonseminomatous germ-cell tumours and elevated AFP and/or hCG after cisplatin-based chemotherapy, who underwent resection of solitary metastases. Seven remained disease-free after surgery alone, and 11 of 15 were disease-free overall after subsequent chemotherapy for relapse. All five patients with elevated hCG relapsed after surgery, versus three of ten with only elevated AFP. Retroperitoneal metastases relapsed less often than visceral disease. The authors conclude that surgery should be considered despite raised markers in patients without a durable response to chemotherapy.

pmid-1383486.summary_ja: 母子同時発症の絨毛癌の症例報告である。乳児の肝内に巨大腫瘍が生じ、同じ腫瘍の所見を示した母親とともに治療が行われた。治療後1年の時点で母子とも生存し健康であり、これは記録上最長の乳児生存例とされる。母子での同時発症は極めて稀である。
pmid-1383486.summary_en: This report describes simultaneous choriocarcinoma in a mother and her infant. The infant developed a massive intrahepatic tumor, which led to treatment of the infant and of the mother, who showed evidence of the same tumor. Both patients were alive and well one year after treatment, which the authors describe as the longest recorded infant survival. Simultaneous occurrence of choriocarcinoma in mother and child is extremely rare.

pmid-1384089.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマの9例に放射線療法を行い、全例で胸部X線上の完全奏効が得られた。縦隔全体への照射を受けた3例に再発はなかったが、部分照射野での照射を受けた6例中4例に辺縁再発がみられた。縦隔全体への照射の有効性が示唆されている。
pmid-1384089.summary_en: Nine patients with primary mediastinal seminoma were treated with radiotherapy, and all achieved a complete response on chest radiography. None of the three patients who received whole mediastinal irradiation relapsed, whereas four of six patients treated with involved-field irradiation had marginal relapses. The authors conclude that whole mediastinal irradiation appears more effective than involved-field irradiation for this tumor.

pmid-1384156.summary_ja: 40歳女性の羊水穿刺で、1qと19pの三染色体性を持つモザイク核型が判明した。羊水中AFPの上昇と超音波所見から顔面奇形腫と頭蓋内腫瘍が疑われ、中絶後の剖検で確認された。奇形腫では異常細胞株が優位だったが正常組織では認められず、染色体不均衡が奇形腫の病因に関与すると考えられた。
pmid-1384156.summary_en: A 40-year-old woman underwent amniocentesis at 15.4 weeks, revealing a mosaic karyotype with trisomy of 1q and 19p in 90% of cells. Elevated amniotic fluid alpha-fetoprotein and ultrasound findings suggested a facial teratoma and an intracranial tumor, both confirmed at autopsy after pregnancy termination. Chromosome analysis showed the abnormal cell line predominated in the teratomas but not in normal tissues, implicating chromosomal imbalance in teratoma development.

pmid-1384296.summary_ja: 精巣原発の純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍で脳転移を伴う37歳男性の症例報告である。入院時に肺・肝転移があり、血清AFPは786ng/mlであった。入院5日後に脳転移と出血による片麻痺が生じた。PVB化学療法などにより完全寛解が得られたが、薬剤性肝炎のため治療を中断し、開頭術後6か月で死亡した。
pmid-1384296.summary_en: This report describes a 37-year-old man with pure yolk sac tumor of the testis, presenting with lung and liver metastases and serum AFP of 786 ng/ml. Five days after admission he developed hemiplegia from cerebral metastasis and hemorrhage. Chemotherapy with PVB and right posterior lobectomy produced complete remission and normalized AFP, but a second course was stopped because of drug-induced hepatitis. He died of massive brain metastasis six months after craniotomy.

pmid-1384444.summary_ja: 前縦隔病変の吸引液中のアミラーゼ高値は、縦隔奇形腫の診断の手がかりとなる。手術時にタンパク分解酵素活性が認められた例がある。術前に吸引液のアミラーゼ上昇を確認し、奇形腫と診断できた例もあった。膵外分泌酵素の測定が術前診断に有用である可能性が示唆される。
pmid-1384444.summary_en: Mediastinal teratoma may be suspected when fluid aspirated from an anterior mediastinal lesion has high amylase content. In two cases, proteolytic enzyme activity was evident at operation. In two later cases, elevated amylase in aspirated fluid before surgery aided the preoperative diagnosis of mediastinal teratoma. The authors suggest that exocrine pancreatic enzyme measurement may help in preoperative diagnosis.

pmid-1384658.summary_ja: i(12p)マーカー染色体は胚細胞腫瘍に非ランダムに関連する異常である。セントロメアのFISH法を72例の新鮮な腫瘍生検標本に適用した。結果は染色体分染法とよく一致し、核型解析が失敗した例でも検出できた。i(12p)はセミノーマでは7%と少なく、非セミノーマでは75%であった。
pmid-1384658.summary_en: The i(12p) marker chromosome is nonrandomly associated with germ cell tumors. The authors extended a chromosome 12 centromere FISH method, previously validated in cell lines, to 72 fresh tumor biopsies. FISH results agreed well with banded cytogenetics and succeeded where karyotyping failed. The i(12p) marker was far less frequent in seminomas (7%) than in nonseminomas (75%), supporting FISH as a reliable diagnostic and prognostic tool.

pmid-1384951.summary_ja: 1979〜1988年に小児胚細胞腫瘍60例を治療した。VAC、PVB、またはその交互投与に放射線療法を併用した。5年生存率は病期Iで100%、病期IVで56%であった。性腺外腫瘍はVAC単独では反応が不良で、交互投与で改善した。進行例では治療強化、限局期では毒性軽減が必要とされる。
pmid-1384951.summary_en: Sixty children with germ cell tumors treated at St. Jude from 1979 to 1988 received chemotherapy with VAC, PVB, or alternating VAC/PVB, with or without radiation. Five-year survival was 100% for stage I, 87% for stage II, 72% for stage III and 56% for stage IV disease. Extragonadal tumors responded poorly to VAC alone but well to alternating regimens. The authors conclude that advanced disease needs treatment intensification, while limited-stage trials should focus on reducing toxicity.

pmid-1385131.summary_ja: 精巣がんの腫瘍マーカーであるAFPとhCGについての実践的レビュー。セミノーマや絨毛癌、胎児性癌など組織型ごとのマーカー上昇パターン、病期判定への利用、化学療法後のマーカー正常化の解釈と、残存腫瘍を画像検査で確認する必要性について解説している。
pmid-1385131.summary_en: A practical review of serum AFP and hCG as tumor markers in testicular cancer. It outlines how marker patterns relate to histology: elevated AFP in seminoma suggests choriocarcinoma elements, while elevated hCG above 100 ng/ml suggests choriocarcinoma, and elevated AFP in choriocarcinoma suggests embryonal carcinoma. Marker elevation in pathologic stage I nonseminomatous tumors indicates stage II or III disease. Marker normalization after chemotherapy signals response but does not exclude residual tumor, which requires radiologic follow-up.

pmid-1385132.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の男性18例を対象に、末梢静脈血と精索静脈血のβ-hCGおよびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を比較した研究。純粋セミノーマでは両マーカーは正常範囲内だったが、セミノーマと胎児性癌または奇形癌の混合腫瘍の3例では末梢血と精索静脈血の双方で上昇していた。精索静脈血の測定は末梢血マーカーの確認に有用と結論している。
pmid-1385132.summary_en: This study measured beta-hCG and AFP in peripheral and spermatic venous blood of 18 men with testicular tumors, mostly seminoma. Marker levels were normal in all pure seminomas and in one mixed tumor, while elevations were seen in peripheral and spermatic blood of three patients with mixed seminoma and embryonal carcinoma or teratocarcinoma. The authors conclude that spermatic venous sampling is a valuable confirmation of peripheral marker levels.

pmid-1386713.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWo、JEG-3、Jarにおけるインターフェロンγ受容体の数と機能的応答を調べた研究。受容体数は細胞株間で差がなく、増殖抑制の程度も同程度だった。アクチノマイシンDと併用すると細胞溶解は用量依存的に生じ、Jar細胞は溶解が少なかった。応答の差は受容体数ではなく受容体後の機構によると結論づけている。
pmid-1386713.summary_en: This study quantified interferon-gamma receptors on three choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, JEG-3, Jar) and tested their functional responses. Receptor numbers were similar across lines, and interferon-gamma inhibited proliferation of all three to a similar extent. With actinomycin-D, dose-dependent lysis occurred, with Jar cells showing less lysis. The authors conclude that response differences arise from postreceptor mechanisms rather than receptor number.

pmid-1387913.summary_ja: 良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)25例に対する腹腔鏡手術の経験報告。嚢腫摘出術16例と卵巣摘除術9例を行った。手術中の嚢腫内容物の漏出を防ぐ術式が工夫され、手術手技は症例を重ねるごとに改善された。合併症は稀で入院期間は24時間未満だった。悪性GCTではなく良性の卵巣奇形腫が対象である。
pmid-1387913.summary_en: This series reports laparoscopic management of benign ovarian cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) in 25 patients: 16 cystectomies and nine oophorectomies. Techniques were developed to avoid cyst spillage during surgery, and the approach evolved over the series. Outcomes were good, complications rare, and hospital stays under 24 hours. The study addresses benign ovarian teratoma, not malignant germ cell tumor.

pmid-1388682.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者の骨盤および傍大動脈リンパ節への放射線療法において、精巣への散乱線量を減らすための鉛製精巣シールドの固定方法を報告した技術論文。患者を固定し、シールドの位置を安定して再現できる方法を開発した。放射線治療の照射準備に関する実務的な内容である。
pmid-1388682.summary_en: This dosimetry note describes a method for immobilizing seminoma patients during pelvic and para-aortic lymph node irradiation while using lead testicular clamshell shields to reduce scatter dose to the testes. The authors developed a patient immobilization approach that provides stable and reproducible shield positioning. It is a technical report on radiation therapy setup in testicular seminoma, aimed at protecting the testes from scattered radiation during treatment.

pmid-1389495.summary_ja: 早期乳がん患者と病期I精巣セミノーマの男性を対象に、局所放射線療法後6年間の末梢血リンパ球subsetを追跡した研究。両群で同様の変化がみられ、CD4メモリーT細胞は回復したが、CD4ナイーブT細胞は長期間低下したままだった。CD8細胞は変化せず、HLA-DR陽性の活性化T細胞は増加した。感染感受性や抗腫瘍免疫への影響を考察している。
pmid-1389495.summary_en: Blood lymphocyte subsets were tracked for up to six years after local radiotherapy in early breast cancer patients and in men with stage I testicular seminoma. Both groups showed similar patterns: CD4 memory T cells recovered, while CD4 naive T cells stayed reduced for years. CD8 counts were unchanged and HLA-DR positive activated T cells increased. The authors discuss implications for infection susceptibility and antitumor immunity.

pmid-1390342.summary_ja: 1980〜1989年に病期I精巣セミノーマと診断された128例の治療成績を報告。56例は精巣摘除後に放射線療法を受け、72例はサーベイランスを行った。再発率は放射線療法群5.4%、サーベイランス群18%で、再発例は全例救済された。確実なフォローアップが可能なら、サーベイランスは安全な代替法と考えられるが、長期データが得られるまでは補助放射線療法が推奨される。
pmid-1390342.summary_en: This 1992 report reviews 128 patients with Stage I testicular seminoma treated between 1980 and 1989. Fifty-six received post-orchidectomy radiotherapy and 72 underwent surveillance, with higher-risk patients generally irradiated. No tumour-related deaths occurred. Relapse rates were 5.4% in the irradiated group and 18% in the surveillance group, and all relapses were salvaged. The authors conclude that surveillance is a safe alternative to adjuvant radiotherapy only with reliable, prolonged follow-up, should be done within formal studies, and that adjuvant radiotherapy remains the preferred treatment until long-term data are available.

pmid-1390353.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法後に、背部痛と神経症状を呈した51歳男性の症例。当初は放射線線維症と考えられたが、手術で特発性硬膜外脂肪腫症と判明し、過剰な脂肪組織の切除で症状は完全に消失した。放射線療法後の脊髄症状では、本疾患も鑑別に挙げるべきである。
pmid-1390353.summary_en: A 51-year-old man developed back pain, reduced mobility and neurological symptoms after radiotherapy for Stage I seminoma. The symptoms were initially attributed to radiation fibrosis, but investigation and surgery revealed idiopathic epidural lipomatosis. Removal of the excess epidural fat led to complete resolution of symptoms. The report highlights that epidural lipomatosis can mimic radiation-induced spinal injury, so it should be considered in the differential diagnosis of back pain and neurological deficits in patients previously irradiated for germ cell tumours.

pmid-1391971.summary_ja: 性腺異形成症を伴う45,X/46,X,Ynf核型の2例についてDNA解析を実施した。性腺芽腫を発症した1例では非蛍光Yqの12座位すべてが検出され、20歳時点で発症のなかった1例では近位6座位のみが検出された。両例の比較から、非蛍光Yq領域の残存と性腺芽腫の発生との関連が示唆される。
pmid-1391971.summary_en: This 1992 Japanese genetics study analysed DNA from two patients with gonadal dysgenesis and a 45,X/46,X,Ynf karyotype. The patient who developed gonadoblastoma had all 12 loci of the non-fluorescent Yq region detected, whereas the patient without gonadoblastoma at age 20 had only the proximal six loci detected. Comparing the two cases links the extent of retained Yq material with the presence of gonadoblastoma, a precursor germ cell lesion in dysgenetic gonads.

pmid-1393392.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫からの心臓内転移の2例を報告し、それぞれ心エコー検査と心血管造影により診断された。胚細胞腫瘍の転移部位としてはまれであるが重要であり、患者評価の際には心臓病変を念頭に置くべきだと論じている。適切な画像検査による確認の重要性も示している。
pmid-1393392.summary_en: Two cases of intracardiac deposits from testicular teratomas are described, diagnosed by echocardiography and angiocardiography respectively. The authors stress that intracardiac metastasis is an uncommon but important site of spread from germ cell tumours and that clinicians should recognise it. The short report underlines the need to consider cardiac involvement when evaluating patients with germ cell tumours and to use appropriate imaging to confirm it.

pmid-1397383.summary_ja: 本総説は、初期胎盤における栄養膜細胞の増殖・分化、EGFや甲状腺ホルモンの作用、プロゲステロンによるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)合成の調節を概説する。正常胎盤ではプロゲステロンがhCG合成を抑制するが、絨毛癌では反応せず、絨毛癌のhCGは正常hCGに比べシアル酸含量が著しく低い。この糖鎖の差異は絨毛癌の早期診断に有用と述べている。
pmid-1397383.summary_en: This review of trophoblast biology covers proliferation and differentiation of syncytiotrophoblast and cytotrophoblast in early placenta, the roles of EGF and thyroid hormone, and progesterone regulation of hCG. Progesterone suppresses hCG synthesis in normal placenta but not in choriocarcinoma, and choriocarcinoma hCG has markedly lower sialic acid content than normal hCG. The authors suggest these carbohydrate differences could support early diagnosis of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-1399123.summary_ja: 本研究はマウスF9奇形癌(teratocarcinoma)細胞について、未分化細胞は肝臓に、レチノイン酸とcAMPで分化誘導した細胞は肺に定着することを比較した。分化細胞では各種基質への接着能がむしろ低下しており、接着の増強では肺定着の変化を説明できなかった。一方、分化細胞のみが肺由来抽出物による増殖刺激に応答し、臓器特異的な増殖刺激が肺定着に関与することが示唆された。
pmid-1399123.summary_en: This study compares liver and lung colonization by F9 murine teratocarcinoma cells, which colonize liver when undifferentiated but lung when induced to differentiate with retinoic acid and cyclic AMP. Differentiated cells showed reduced adhesion to all tested substrates, so enhanced adhesion does not explain the shift to lung. Instead, differentiated cells, unlike undifferentiated ones, responded to growth stimulation by lung-derived extracts, implicating organ-specific growth stimulation in lung colonization.

pmid-1399236.summary_ja: 27歳女性の2回目開腹術で採取された腹腔洗浄液に、上衣成分が主体の悪性卵巣単一胚葉性奇形腫を認めた症例報告である。細胞ブロックでは細胞異型の乏しい細胞が集簇し、集塊の辺縁は円柱状で繊毛を有する細胞に縁取られていた。液状細胞診でこの稀少腫瘍が検出された初の報告であり、卵管上皮症との鑑別が問題になると述べている。
pmid-1399236.summary_en: This case report describes a malignant ovarian monodermal teratoma with a predominant ependymal component, detected in peritoneal washings obtained at second-look laparotomy in a 27-year-old woman. Cell blocks showed sheets and clusters of bland cells, with columnar, ciliated cells lining the clusters. The authors note this is the first report of this rare neoplasm on fluid cytology, and that its bland appearance may be confused with endosalpingiosis.

pmid-1399315.summary_ja: 舌に生じた奇形腫の症例報告と文献的考察である。口腔内の稀な腫瘍で、既報告例は6例のみであった。発生は結節隆起からの細胞迷入が関与すると考えられる。舌病変の鑑別診断には甲状舌管嚢胞、舌甲状腺、類皮嚢腫などが含まれ、CTは診断と進展範囲の評価に有用である。レーザー切除で根治が得られ、再発は稀とされる。
pmid-1399315.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes a teratoma of the tongue, a rare oral cavity tumor with only six prior reported cases. The authors review its embryology, thought to involve misplaced cells from the tuberculum impar, and the differential diagnosis of tongue lesions, including thyroglossal duct cyst, lingual thyroid, and dermoid cyst. They note CT aids diagnosis and extent assessment, and that laser excision is curative with rare recurrence.

pmid-1399316.summary_ja: 2歳女児の耳下腺に生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告で、化学療法後に再発した。小児頭頸部の胚細胞腫瘍の多くは奇形腫であるため、本症例は稀である。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は鑑別診断と腫瘍進行の評価に有用なマーカーであると強調している。
pmid-1399316.summary_en: This case report describes an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor of the parotid gland in a 2-year-old girl, which recurred after chemotherapy. The authors note that most pediatric head and neck germ cell neoplasms are teratomas, making this presentation unusual. They emphasize that serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) is a helpful marker for differential diagnosis and for evaluating tumor progression.

pmid-1399387.summary_ja: 臨床病期IIA/IIBの非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍65例に対し、シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン(PVB)を基本とする化学療法(エトポシド併用例を含む)を初回治療として行い、残存病変には後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。完全寛解は62例(95.4%)で、フォローアップ期間6～79か月で65例中60例(92.3%)が無病生存した。死亡は3例、完全寛解後の再発は3例であった。
pmid-1399387.summary_en: This prospective study treated 65 patients with clinical stage IIA/IIB nonseminomatous testicular tumors using primary chemotherapy with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin (PVB), with or without etoposide, followed by retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for residual disease. Sixty-two patients (95.4%) achieved complete response, and 60 of 65 (92.3%) were alive without evidence of disease at 6 to 79 months of follow-up. Three patients died and three relapsed after complete response.

pmid-1400561.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の対側精巣生検で精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)が陰性と判定された偽陰性例を検討した論文。胎児性癌の初回生検は陰性だったが、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇を受けた15か月後の再生検でTINが確認された。既報の偽陰性6例を総括し、偽陰性は稀で、思春期以降はTINがランダムに分布するため単一生検で代表させ得ると述べ、対側生検は両側性腫瘍の早期発見に有用とする。
pmid-1400561.summary_en: This paper reviews false-negative contralateral testicular biopsies for testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) in patients with testis cancer. A patient with embryonal carcinoma had a negative initial biopsy, but a rebiopsy 15 months later, prompted by rising alpha-fetoprotein, showed TIN. Reviewing six previously reported false-negative cases alongside thousands of biopsies worldwide, the authors conclude such errors are rare. They suggest that after puberty TIN is generally randomly distributed, so a single biopsy is representative, and contralateral biopsy remains valuable for detecting bilateral tumors.

pmid-1401220.summary_ja: 46,XX核型で外性器は正常、高アンドロゲン症状のない妊娠中の26歳女性に生じた性索芽細胞腫の症例報告。腫瘍の大部分はディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)で、胚細胞成分が急速に増殖していた。多くの症例は性腺異形成を背景とするが、本例は形態的・機能的に正常な性腺に発生した。妊娠は正常経過で満期産となった。性索芽細胞腫は従来考えられていたより正常な性腺にも生じ得ると著者らは示唆する。
pmid-1401220.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old pregnant woman with a 46,XX karyotype and normal genitalia who had gonadoblastoma with a predominant dysgerminoma component. Unlike most gonadoblastoma cases, which arise in dysgenetic gonads, this tumor developed in apparently normal gonads, and its germ cell component had overgrown rapidly. She had a normal term pregnancy. The authors suggest gonadoblastoma may occur in functionally and morphologically normal gonads more often than previously reported.

pmid-1402413.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが頸胸椎に転移した症例の報告。臨床経過と画像所見を示し、病態の進行について考察している。脊椎への転移は稀であり、精巣がんの転移部位としての頸胸椎病変を示す。治療内容や転帰の記載は限られている。本誌は脊椎医学・徒手療法の雑誌であり、腫瘍学の専門誌ではない点に留意が必要である。
pmid-1402413.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastatic testicular seminoma involving the cervicothoracic spine. The paper presents the clinical course along with radiographic findings and discusses disease progression. It appears in a manipulative and physiological therapy journal and illustrates a rare site of seminoma metastasis to the spine. The report offers limited detail on treatment and outcome.

pmid-1403057.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣腫瘍に対し、精巣摘除術のみで経過観察した前向き研究。2年無再発率は75%、5年で73%。血管・リンパ管浸潤、未分化細胞、卵黄嚢成分の欠如という3〜4項目の危険因子を持つ群では無再発率54%であった。経過観察の安全性が確認され、高リスク例に対する白金製剤の補助化学療法の第II相試験が開始された。
pmid-1403057.summary_en: This prospective Medical Research Council study followed 396 patients with stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumor managed by surveillance after orchidectomy alone. The 2-year relapse-free rate was 75% and the 5-year rate 73%, with five deaths from tumor or treatment complications and 98% five-year survival. Patients with three or four adverse histologic factors (vascular or lymphatic invasion, undifferentiated cells, absence of yolk sac elements) had a 54% relapse-free rate. Surveillance was judged safe, and a phase II trial of adjuvant platinum chemotherapy in high-risk patients was initiated.

pmid-1403156.summary_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌の術後で、放射性ヨウ素の集積を示す骨盤内病変を認めた30歳女性の症例。全身シンチグラフィーで仙骨と膀胱の間の軟部組織に局在した。直腸壁の良性奇形腫であり、放射性ヨウ素治療前に外科的に摘除され、卵巣への被曝を減らした。摘除術中に携帯型ガンマ検出器で病変を同定し、術後の全身スキャンで摘除を確認した。
pmid-1403156.summary_en: This nuclear medicine report describes a 30-year-old woman with previously resected papillary thyroid carcinoma who had a pelvic lesion showing radioiodine uptake. Simultaneous whole-body iodine and bone scans localized it to soft tissue between the sacrum and bladder. The lesion, a benign teratoma of the rectal wall, was surgically removed before radioiodine therapy, sparing the ovaries from radiation. Intraoperative gamma detection guided resection, and postoperative scanning confirmed removal. The teratoma contained thyroid and gastric epithelium, with uptake limited to thyroid follicles.

pmid-1403511.summary_ja: ブリティッシュコロンビア小児病院で5年間に治療した仙尾部奇形腫の新生児12例を検討。4例に臨床的に有意な凝固障害が生じ、2例が死亡した。原因は多因子性と考えられ、羊水過多、胎盤腫大、胎児水腫、うっ血性心不全は予後不良の徴候である。出産前の高リスク同定、帝王切開による腫瘍への外傷の軽減、早期切除による生存率向上を提唱している。
pmid-1403511.summary_en: This review of twelve neonates with sacrococcygeal teratoma treated over five years at British Columbia Children's Hospital found clinically significant coagulopathy in four, with two deaths. One patient had DIC and another thrombocytopenia. The coagulopathy appears multifactorial. Risk indicators include polyhydramnios, placentomegaly, hydrops fetalis, and congestive heart failure. The authors recommend prenatal identification of high-risk patients, cesarean delivery to minimize tumor trauma, and expeditious resection to improve survival.

pmid-1403540.summary_ja: 40年間に治療された仙尾部奇形腫の小児73例を後方視的に検討。良性57例、悪性16例(22%)。良性群の再発5例のうち、初回尾骨摘除を受けていなかったのは1例のみ。未熟成分を伴い良性と思われた1例が再発を繰り返し胎児性癌と判明し、化学療法で7年無病生存。良性例は悪性例より若年で発見された。尾骨摘除を伴う広範切除が再発予防に有効と結論。
pmid-1403540.summary_en: This retrospective review of 73 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma over four decades examines demographics, histology, treatment and outcome. Most cases were benign (57), with five recurrences, only one of which had not undergone initial coccygectomy. Malignant tumors occurred in 16 children (22%). One tumor that initially appeared benign with immature elements later recurred and proved to be embryonal carcinoma; it was treated with chemotherapy and the child was disease-free at seven years. Benign tumors presented at younger ages. The authors conclude that wide resection with coccygectomy helps prevent recurrence.

pmid-1405116.summary_ja: 32歳女性の肺成熟奇形腫の切除例を報告する。15歳時に胸部異常陰影を指摘され、後に微熱や血痰などを伴った。CTで左上葉の嚢胞内に充実性腫瘤を認め、気管支造影で気管支との交通が確認された。左上葉切除により成熟奇形腫と確定診断された。肺奇形腫は極めてまれであり、本例は手術時に診断された。
pmid-1405116.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman with a mature teratoma of the lung is described. An abnormal chest shadow had been noted at age 15, and she later had low-grade fever, cough, hemoptysis, and recurrent respiratory infections. Chest radiography and CT showed a cystic lesion with an intracystic solid mass in the left upper lobe, which communicated with the B5a and B5b bronchi on bronchography. Left upper lobectomy was performed, and histology confirmed a mature teratoma. The authors note that pulmonary teratoma is very rare and was diagnosed at surgery.

pmid-1409158.summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎内に発生した胎盤のin situ絨毛癌の症例を報告する。過去の報告を再検討し、化学療法が必要とされた症例の多くは別の診断であった可能性を指摘した。部分奇胎後の持続性栄養膜病変のリスクは、正常妊娠後と比べて高くない可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1409158.summary_en: A placental in situ choriocarcinoma arising within a partial hydatidiform mole is described. The authors review reported cases of persistent trophoblastic disease after partial mole and note that many cases reported as needing chemotherapy may reflect alternative diagnoses. They argue that in situ choriocarcinoma may be the incipient lesion in gestational choriocarcinoma after normal pregnancy, so its presence in a partial mole suggests the risk of persistent trophoblastic disease after partial mole is no greater than after normal gestation.

pmid-1413360.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌が下大静脈内に進展し、右心房へ達して三尖弁に転移した症例を報告している。著者らはこのような報告は初めてだとしている。精巣胚細胞腫瘍が血管内を経て心臓に広がるまれな進展経路を示す。外科的治療計画や病期診断に影響しうる重要な知見である。
pmid-1413360.summary_en: This case report describes testicular teratocarcinoma extending into the inferior vena cava and reaching the right atrium, with metastasis to the tricuspid valve. The authors state this is the first such reported case. The report highlights an unusual route of intravascular tumor spread from a testicular germ cell tumor to the heart. Such extension can be clinically significant for surgical planning and staging. The case is directly relevant to germ cell tumor management and metastatic patterns.

pmid-1414342.summary_ja: 生後45日の男児に発生した、石灰化を伴う大きな腹部腫瘍の症例報告である。胃壁の一部を含めて切除され、病理学的に未熟な神経成分を伴う胃奇形腫と診断された。術後8年間再発はみられなかった。英文と和文の文献から集めた胃奇形腫88例のレビューも含む。乳児期に発生した性腺外奇形腫の一例である。
pmid-1414342.summary_en: This report describes a 45-day-old boy with a large calcified abdominal tumor, gastrointestinal bleeding, and anemia, who underwent resection of a mass involving the gastric wall. Pathology showed a gastric teratoma with immature neural elements. No recurrence was seen eight years later. The paper also reviews 88 reported cases of gastric teratoma from English and Japanese literature. It illustrates an extragonadal teratoma presenting in infancy.
