pmid-1414741.summary_ja: 30歳女性に発生した後腹膜成熟奇形腫の症例報告である。左上腹部痛を契機に受診し、血清CA19-9が異常高値を示した。切除組織でも高いCA19-9が免疫組織化学染色で確認された。CA19-9を産生する奇形腫としては3例目であり、文献的考察を加えている。性腺外奇形腫における腫瘍マーカーの意義を示す。
pmid-1414741.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with a retroperitoneal mature teratoma that produced abnormally high serum CA19-9. She presented with left upper abdominal pain. High CA19-9 levels were also found in the resected tissue, confirmed by immunohistochemistry. The authors describe this as the third reported CA19-9-producing teratoma and review the literature. The case highlights CA19-9 as a potential tumor marker in extragonadal teratoma.

pmid-1416983.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株HT-E (833k)から200 kDaのPNA結合糖タンパク質gp200を精製し特性を解析した。レクチンブロットで、発現は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に限られていた。gp200は細胞表面の膜貫通型糖タンパク質で、培養上清にも存在する。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の腫瘍マーカー候補として提案されている。
pmid-1416983.summary_en: This biochemical study purifies gp200, a 200-kDa PNA-binding glycoprotein, from the human embryonal carcinoma cell line HT-E (833k). Lectin blotting showed its expression was limited to nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The protein is a surface integral membrane glycoprotein that is also released into culture medium. Its carbohydrate chains are N-linked, partially sialylated, and contain terminal galactose. The authors propose gp200 as a candidate tumor marker for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor.

pmid-1418153.summary_ja: 正期産の女児に生じた未熟性頸部奇形腫の症例報告。超音波検査により正確に診断された。良性であるものの呼吸障害を来したため外科的に摘出され、10か月のフォローアップで再発はなかった。新生児の奇形腫はまれであり、超音波検査が有用な診断法であると報告している。
pmid-1418153.summary_en: This case report describes an immature cervical teratoma in a term female neonate, diagnosed accurately by ultrasonography. Although histologically benign, the mass caused respiratory compromise. Surgical resection was performed, and no recurrence was seen at 10-month follow-up. The authors note that such neonatal teratomas are rare, occurring in roughly 1 in 20,000 to 40,000 live births, and emphasize ultrasound as a reliable diagnostic tool.

pmid-1421710.summary_ja: 予後不良の進行転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍28例に対し、改変PVeBVの2サイクルに続けて大量シスプラチン-エトポシド-シクロホスファミドとABMTを施行した第II相試験。17例(61%)が完全寛解に達したが、3例が再発した。中央値66か月の追跡で12例が寛解生存、3年生存率は40%であった。
pmid-1421710.summary_en: This phase II trial treated 28 patients with poor-prognosis advanced metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors using two cycles of modified double-dose PVeBV chemotherapy followed by high-dose cisplatin-etoposide-cyclophosphamide and autologous bone marrow transplantation. Of 28 patients, 17 (61%) achieved complete remission, though three relapsed and several died early from progressive disease or treatment-related causes. At median follow-up of 66 months, 12 patients were alive in remission, with a 3-year survival of 40%. The authors proposed a randomized trial to test whether high-dose therapy improves outcomes.

pmid-1425792.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の14歳男児に生じた縦隔の混合型悪性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。化学療法後20か月間再発はなかった。文献レビューでは、原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の少なくとも8%がクラインフェルター症候群を合併し、その頻度は期待値の約50倍であった。
pmid-1425792.summary_en: A 14-year-old boy with Klinefelter syndrome presented with a large mediastinal mass. Histology showed a mixed malignant germ cell tumor of choriocarcinoma and mature teratoma. Treatment with cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide led to 20 months without recurrence. A literature review of 40 further cases found Klinefelter syndrome in at least 8% of primary mediastinal germ cell tumors, about 50 times the expected frequency, with nonseminomatous histology in all cases.

pmid-1426336.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者の凍結精子を用い、卵子囲卵腔下挿入によって妊娠に至った初の報告である。精子運動性は低く受精卵は1個のみだったが、健康な男児が38週で出生した。精子バンキングと補助生殖技術は、精巣悪性腫瘍患者の生殖能力維持に役立つと論じている。
pmid-1426336.summary_en: The first pregnancy achieved by subzonal insertion of cryopreserved sperm from a man with testicular seminoma and severe oligoasthenospermia is reported. Only three to seven motile sperm were injected per oocyte, and one oocyte fertilized and was transferred at the eight-cell stage. A healthy boy was born at 38 weeks. The authors argue that sperm banking combined with assisted fertilization can preserve reproductive potential in patients with testicular malignancy.

pmid-1428596.summary_ja: 上咽頭に生じる奇形腫は稀な先天性病変で、出生時の喘鳴や呼吸困難を起こすことが多い。気道確保、正中部の中枢神経奇形の画像による除外、悪性転化・窒息・顔面変形を防ぐための早期外科切除が管理の要点である。性腺外奇形腫の乳児期症例に関する臨床的な考察である。
pmid-1428596.summary_en: Epipharyngeal teratomas are rare congenital lesions that often cause neonatal stridor and respiratory distress. The authors recommend securing the airway, radiographically excluding midline CNS malformations, and early surgical excision to prevent malignant transformation, asphyxia and facial deformity. The report is a short clinical review of an extragonadal teratoma in infancy with a focus on management.

pmid-1428725.summary_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍に対するイホスファミド併用化学療法で、尿路保護薬N-アセチルシステインとメスナを比較した277例の解析である。血尿はNAC群27.9%、メスナ群4.2%であった。奏効率は両群で同等であり、メスナの方が尿路保護に優れると結論している。
pmid-1428725.summary_en: This study compares N-acetylcysteine with mesna as uroprotectors during ifosfamide-containing chemotherapy in 277 evaluable patients with refractory germ cell tumors. Hematuria was far more frequent with NAC (27.9%) than mesna (4.2%), and ifosfamide dose reductions for urothelial toxicity occurred only in the NAC group. Response rates were similar, leading the authors to conclude mesna gives better urothelial protection.

pmid-1429209.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍24例（胚細胞腫瘍7例を含む）でp53遺伝子変異をPCR-SSCP法で解析した。全体の50%に変異があり、上皮性卵巣癌で最も多かった。類皮嚢腫由来の扁平上皮癌と未分化のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）にも変異が見られた。変異はp53蛋白の核内蓄積やDNA異数性と相関していた。
pmid-1429209.summary_en: p53 gene mutations were analyzed by PCR-SSCP in 24 ovarian tumors, including 14 carcinomas, 7 germ cell tumors and one stromal tumor. Mutations were found in 50% overall, most often in epithelial carcinoma, and also in a squamous cell carcinoma arising in a dermoid cyst and an anaplastic dysgerminoma. p53 mutation correlated with nuclear accumulation and DNA aneuploidy, suggesting these changes arise together in ovarian tumor progression.

pmid-1433638.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣がん患者に対し、腹腔鏡下修正両側後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した症例報告である。精巣がん転移の好発部位すべてからリンパ節組織を切除することが技術的に可能であり、開腹手術に比べ侵襲の軽減が期待できると述べている。単一症例の報告であり、有効性や長期成績の評価は今後の検討課題である。
pmid-1433638.summary_en: This case report describes laparoscopic modified bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) performed on a patient with clinical stage I testicular cancer. The authors argue that laparoscopy is technically feasible for removing lymph node tissue from all primary landing sites of testicular cancer metastases and may reduce morbidity compared with open surgery. Because it is a single case, the findings are preliminary and cannot establish efficacy or long-term oncologic outcomes.

pmid-1434293.summary_ja: 48歳男性の精母細胞性セミノーマに対し、精巣摘除術と放射線照射を行った症例報告である。術後10か月で再発はみられていない。他の胚細胞腫瘍を伴わない純粋型として、本邦の既報17例をレビューしている。希少な組織型の臨床像を示す報告である。
pmid-1434293.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old man with spermatocytic seminoma of the testis treated by left high inguinal orchiectomy followed by radiotherapy to the hypogastrium and paraaortic region, with no recurrence at 10 months. The authors review 17 previously reported Japanese cases of pure spermatocytic seminoma, excluding mixed tumors, and position this as the 17th such case. The report offers clinical characteristics of this rare subtype but provides limited evidence for management.

pmid-1434857.summary_ja: 16歳女性のIII期ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に伴う体液性高カルシウム血症の症例報告である。手術後にhCG値は速やかに低下し、全腹部照射によりカルシウム値は正常化した。7年以上無病生存している。腫瘍に伴う傍腫瘍症候群としての高カルシウム血症を示した希少な症例である。
pmid-1434857.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl presented with weight loss, hypercalcemia, and a pelvic mass, and was diagnosed with stage III dysgerminoma after laparotomy with hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Syncytial giant cells showed hCG-positive cytoplasmic staining, and serum hCG beta-subunit fell rapidly after surgery. Whole-abdominal irradiation normalized calcium, and the patient has remained disease-free for over seven years. The report links humoral hypercalcemia to this tumor, a rare paraneoplastic presentation.

pmid-1438085.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株FEG-3を用い、メトトレキサートがhCG産生とc-myc発現に与える影響を検討した基礎研究である。薬剤処理により細胞分裂が停止し、c-myc mRNAは低下した一方、hCGのα・β鎖は上昇した。両者は逆相関を示した。子宮頸がん細胞との比較から、栄養膜細胞と非栄養膜細胞のhCG産生は異なる機序で制御されると示唆している。
pmid-1438085.summary_en: This study uses FEG-3, a clonal human choriocarcinoma line, to examine effects of methotrexate on growth, c-myc mRNA, and hCG production. Methotrexate blocked cell division and reduced c-myc mRNA, with effects reversible after drug removal. Alpha and beta hCG levels rose during treatment, showing an inverse relationship with c-myc expression. In contrast, ectopic alpha hCG in cervical carcinoma cells was suppressed, suggesting different regulatory mechanisms. The work is preclinical and in vitro.

pmid-1438754.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍28例を対象に、カラードプラ超音波検査の所見を検討した。腫瘍径が大きいほど血流が豊富で、1.6cm以上の腫瘍の95%が高血流性であった。組織型と血流所見は相関せず、グレースケール所見と病歴から全例で腫瘍性病変が示唆された。著者らは精巣腫瘍の評価におけるカラードプラの役割は限定的と結論した。
pmid-1438754.summary_en: This study evaluated color Doppler ultrasound in 28 patients with surgically confirmed testicular tumors. Tumor size correlated with vascularity: most tumors larger than 1.6 cm were hypervascular, while most smaller ones were hypovascular. Histologic type did not correlate with vascularity. Gray-scale findings and clinical history correctly suggested neoplasm in all cases. The authors conclude that color Doppler has only a limited role in evaluating testicular tumors.

pmid-1438941.summary_ja: 病期Iおよび病期IIの精巣セミノーマ176例を対象に、精巣摘除後の放射線療法の成績を中央値7年の追跡で検討した。5年再発非発生生存率は病期Iで95%、病期IIで77%であった。病期IIの縦隔再発5例中4例は化学療法で治癒した。予防的縦隔照射は不要と考えられ、腫瘍マーカーは転移の検出に有用でなく、フォローアップは5年で十分と結論された。
pmid-1438941.summary_en: This study reviewed 176 patients with stage I or II testicular seminoma, treated mainly with orchidectomy followed by radiotherapy, with a median follow-up of 7 years. Five-year relapse-free survival was 95% for stage I and 77% for stage II. Five stage II patients relapsed in the mediastinum, and four of them were cured with chemotherapy. The authors concluded that prophylactic mediastinal irradiation was unnecessary, tumor markers were not useful for detecting metastases, and a 5-year follow-up may suffice.

pmid-1440209.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌による頭蓋内動脈瘤破裂で脳内出血を呈した症例の報告である。血腫除去と動脈瘤クリッピングを行ったが、術後に自然脾破裂による出血性ショックを生じた。動脈瘤壁に絨毛癌が浸潤しており、腫瘍による血管壁破壊が動脈瘤形成の機序と考えられた。生殖可能年齢の脳出血では転移性絨毛癌を鑑別に挙げるべきと著者らは述べている。
pmid-1440209.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with intracerebral hemorrhage caused by a ruptured intracranial aneurysm from metastatic choriocarcinoma. Surgery evacuated the hematoma and clipped the aneurysm, but the patient then developed hypovolemic shock from spontaneous splenic rupture. Histology showed choriocarcinoma invading the aneurysm wall, suggesting tumor-related vessel damage as a pathogenic mechanism. The authors recommend considering metastatic choriocarcinoma in women of reproductive age with intracerebral or subarachnoid hemorrhage.

pmid-1440946.summary_ja: 精巣の胎児性癌(病期IIIA)に対し手術、化学療法、放射線療法を受けた若年患者が、11年後にホジキン病を発症した症例報告である。予期しない経過をたどる場合には組織診断を行うことの重要性が強調されている。胚細胞腫瘍治療後に晩期の二次性悪性腫瘍が生じうることを示す一例である。
pmid-1440946.summary_en: This case report describes a young patient who developed Hodgkin's disease 11 years after surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy for stage IIIA testicular embryonal carcinoma. The authors stress that a tissue diagnosis should be obtained when the disease course is unexpected. The report illustrates the potential for late secondary malignancy after germ cell tumor treatment. It describes a single patient rather than a cohort.

pmid-1447034.summary_ja: 1973〜1974年に放射線治療を受けた387例のセミノーマ患者を15年以上追跡した長期成績である。15年生存率は病期I 83%、病期II 68%で、再発の抑制は良好であった。一方、二次がんや心臓死などの非がん死が有意に増加し、その多くは縦隔照射後に生じた。病期Iでは照射野の縮小、病期IIAでは縦隔照射の省略、病期IIBでは化学療法が推奨されている。
pmid-1447034.summary_en: This long-term follow-up of 387 US patients with seminoma treated with radiation in 1973 and 1974 extends observation beyond 15 years. Survival at 15 years was 83% for Stage I and 68% for Stage II, with high freedom from recurrence. However, second malignancies (8%) and non-cancer deaths, particularly cardiac death, were significantly increased, and most cardiac deaths followed mediastinal irradiation. The authors recommend smaller radiation fields in Stage I, eliminating mediastinal radiation in Stage IIA, chemotherapy for Stage IIB, and lower radiation doses.

pmid-1454200.summary_ja: 生後8か月の乳児の精巣に生じた高異型度未熟奇形腫の症例報告である。成人や他部位の小児奇形腫では未熟成分が予後を悪化させるが、乳児期の精巣奇形腫では予後に影響しないと考えられ、精巣摘除術単独で十分な治療となると結論づけている。小児精巣腫瘍の治療方針を考えるうえで示唆に富む報告である。
pmid-1454200.summary_en: This case report describes an 8-month-old infant with high-grade immature teratoma of the testis. Testicular teratomas in infants are rare and often show immature elements. The authors note that, unlike in adults and in pediatric teratomas at other sites, immature components in infantile testicular teratoma do not appear to affect prognosis. They therefore conclude that orchiectomy alone is adequate therapy for these neoplasms.

pmid-1455691.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマ20例を対象に、腫瘍浸潤リンパ球を免疫組織化学的に解析した研究。T細胞が主体でCD8陽性優位にびまん性に分布し、B細胞は集簇してリンパ濾胞様構造を形成することがあった。宿主の免疫応答は細胞傷害性T細胞の浸潤とB細胞の機能的成熟を伴う複雑なものと考察している。
pmid-1455691.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study characterizes tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes in 20 cases of stage I seminoma using monoclonal antibodies. T cells, predominantly CD8-positive, were diffusely distributed, while B cells tended to aggregate and sometimes formed lymphoid follicles resembling secondary follicles. The findings suggest a complex host immune response to seminoma, with cytotoxic/suppressor T-cell infiltration and functional maturation of B cells.

pmid-1458445.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍22例で第12染色体の変化をサザンブロットで解析した研究。多くの腫瘍で12p領域のコピー数増加がみられ、着糸点での体細胞分裂により生じたi(12p)が示唆された。増加した12p断片の由来は父由来と母由来が混在し、性別依存的なインプリンティングは認められなかった。
pmid-1458445.summary_en: This study analyzed chromosome 12 changes in 22 patients with testicular germ-cell tumors using Southern blot hybridization. Most tumors showed increased copy number of 12p, consistent with i(12p) isochromosomes formed by somatic division of the centromere. The parental origin of the increased 12p fragments was mixed, indicating no sex-limited imprinting. The marker most likely arose from sister chromatids of a single homolog.

pmid-1464213.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫が尿管内に転移した症例の報告である。文献上これまで報告がない、尿管内転移という非典型的な転移形式を示している。精巣奇形腫の既往がある患者で尿路症状が出現した場合、このような転移部位も鑑別に含める必要があることを示す簡潔な報告である。
pmid-1464213.summary_en: This case report describes a patient in whom a testicular teratoma metastasized to the ureter, forming an intra-ureteric metastatic lesion. The authors state that this metastatic route has not previously been reported in the literature. The report is brief and documents this unusual site of spread from a testicular teratoma. It is important for clinicians to recognize such atypical sites when evaluating urinary tract symptoms in patients with a history of testicular teratoma.

pmid-1469547.summary_ja: 新生児の口から突出した巨大で高度に器官様構造を示す腫瘤が呼吸障害を引き起こし、切除された。肉眼的・組織学的所見では、胎児内胎児と高度に器官化したエピグナトゥス(奇形腫)の鑑別が困難であった。新生児におけるこの両者の診断的重なりを示す報告。
pmid-1469547.summary_en: A huge, highly organoid mass protruding from the mouth of a newborn caused respiratory embarrassment and was resected. Gross and histological examination made it difficult to distinguish fetus in fetu from a highly organized epignathus, a teratoma arising from the oral cavity. The paper highlights the diagnostic overlap between these two entities in neonates, given the marked organization of the lesion. The report is brief, focusing on the clinical presentation and pathological ambiguity rather than outcomes or long-term follow-up.

pmid-1469557.summary_ja: 生後2日の新生児が呼吸窮迫で挿管・人工呼吸管理を要し、気管を圧迫する縦隔奇形腫が認められた。気管圧迫の解除のため緊急開胸術が行われた。新生児の縦隔奇形腫は症状を呈することが稀で、気道閉塞を伴う場合は迅速な外科的介入が救命につながることを示す症例報告。
pmid-1469557.summary_en: A 2-day-old neonate with respiratory distress requiring intubation and mechanical ventilation was found to have a mediastinal teratoma compressing the trachea. Urgent thoracotomy was performed to relieve the tracheal compression. The authors note that mediastinal teratomas rarely cause symptoms in newborns and describe the clinical, radiological, and surgical features of this case. The report emphasizes that prompt surgical intervention can be life-saving when a neonatal mediastinal teratoma causes airway obstruction.

pmid-1473743.summary_ja: 完全奇胎の患者4例から採取した絨毛液が、単核球および活性化単核球の細胞傷害活性を抑制するかを検討した。平均抑制率は単核球で48.3%、活性化単核球で91%であった。奇胎組織が母体の免疫応答を抑制する因子を産生することが示唆され、治療的応用の可能性が論じられている。
pmid-1473743.summary_en: Molar villous fluid (MVF) from four women with complete molar pregnancy was tested for effects on cytotoxicity of mononuclear cells (MNC) and lymphokine-activated mononuclear cells (LA-MNC). Compared with patient sera, all MVF samples significantly inhibited both activities, with mean inhibition of 48.3% for MNC and 91% for LA-MNC. The authors conclude that molar tissue produces factors that suppress maternal immune responses. They suggest that therapies blocking this effect might improve outcomes in complete molar pregnancy and postmolar gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-1473754.summary_ja: ステージIIIの未熟卵巣奇形腫に対する化学療法から11年後に、卵巣と肝臓に同時性の成熟奇形腫が生じた症例を報告する。悪性の胚細胞腫瘍が成熟奇形腫へ変化する現象(退形成)は通常、診断後1年以内に現れるため、この経過は極めて稀である。CT所見、発生頻度、生物学的意義を考察し、治療後の長期的な経過観察の重要性を示している。
pmid-1473754.summary_en: This case report describes synchronous mature teratomas of the ovary and liver in a patient who presented 11 years after chemotherapy for stage III immature ovarian teratoma. Transformation of a malignant germ cell tumor into mature teratoma, known as retroconversion, usually occurs within the first year after diagnosis, so this late presentation is unusual. The authors discuss the CT imaging appearance, the incidence of this phenomenon, and its biological significance. The case highlights the need for long-term surveillance after treatment of immature ovarian teratoma.

pmid-1473840.summary_ja: 若年男性の足底に生じた性腺外悪性奇形腫の症例を報告する。鼠径部にも同じ組織像の結節を認めた。精巣、後腹膜、縦隔には異常がなく、他の原発巣も確認されなかった。四肢の末端に奇形腫が生じた例は文献上これまで報告がなく、生物学的な説明が難しいとされる。
pmid-1473840.summary_en: This report describes an extragonadal malignant teratoma arising on the sole of the foot in a young man, with a similar nodule in the groin. The testes, retroperitoneum and mediastinum, typical sites for germ cell tumours, were normal, and no other primary was found. The authors note that a teratoma at the tip of an extremity is unique and biologically difficult to explain, and that it had not been reported before to their knowledge. The case expands the recognized range of sites where extragonadal germ cell tumors may arise.

pmid-1474324.summary_ja: 精巣のセミノーマおよび上皮内癌(CIS)18例を対象に、2種類のモノクローナル抗体でアンドロゲン受容体の発現を免疫組織化学的に調べた。陽性率は抗体により約42〜45%で、抗体ごとの特異性の違いも認められた。腫瘍性の胚細胞に受容体が存在することから、アンドロゲンが精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の発症に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1474324.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry with two monoclonal antibodies to examine androgen receptor expression in testicular seminoma and carcinoma in situ from 18 patients. About 42 to 45 percent of samples were androgen receptor positive, depending on the antibody, and differences in antibody specificity were noted. Granular staining of normal germ cells was also observed with one antibody. Because androgen receptor protein was present in neoplastic germ cells, the authors suggest that androgens may contribute to the pathogenesis of testicular germ cell tumors. The findings link hormonal exposure to germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-1474702.summary_ja: 前胸部痛を訴えた35歳男性の縦隔腫瘍で、術前は浸潤性胸腺腫が疑われた。外科的切除で腫瘍と胸腺、左上葉の一部、心膜を切除したところ、心膜を貫通する純粋型セミノーマと判明した。精巣と後腹膜に異常がないことから縦隔原発と判断された。シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる補助化学療法と放射線治療を行い、術後7か月で良好な経過である。
pmid-1474702.summary_en: A 35-year-old man presented with anterior chest pain, and imaging suggested an invasive thymoma. Surgical resection removed the tumor along with the thymus, a portion of the left upper lobe, and the pericardium. Pathology showed pure seminoma penetrating the pericardium. Since the testis and retroperitoneum were normal, the tumor was judged to be of mediastinal origin. Adjuvant chemotherapy with cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide plus irradiation was given, and the patient remained well 7 months after surgery.

pmid-1478233.summary_ja: 細胞消化を応用したエッチング支援走査電子顕微鏡法で、正常精巣と精巣がん検体の結合組織の骨格を観察した。正常精巣では精細管周囲のコラーゲンが明瞭な層構造を示す。胚細胞腫瘍では管周囲の結合組織が肥厚し、セミノーマでは外縁が保たれたが、非セミノーマでは保たれなかった。コラーゲンの変化が局所の腫瘍進展に影響する可能性がある。
pmid-1478233.summary_en: A new technique called Etching facilitated scanning electron microscopy was used to examine the connective tissue framework of normal testis and testicular cancer specimens. In normal testis, collagen around seminiferous tubules showed distinct lamellae and a well-defined outer border. In germ cell tumours, the tubular connective tissue was hypertrophied; a seminoma kept its outer border, while a non-seminoma did not. A non-germ cell lymphoma showed marked distortion. The authors suggest these collagen changes may affect local tumor development.

pmid-1478945.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株から、上皮様のepi株と線維芽細胞様のlc株を樹立した。lc株は低濃度のフィブロネクチン上でも接着・伸展し、遊走能も高かった。両株のインテグリン発現は同等で、フィブロネクチン接着にはα5β1が主に関与した。形態差はα6β4とラミニンの分布の変化と相関した。絨毛外栄養膜細胞の遊走にフィブロネクチンが関与する可能性がある。
pmid-1478945.summary_en: The authors isolated two stable variant lines from the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line: epithelioid epi cells and fibroblastoid lc cells. lc cells adhered to fibronectin at lower density and migrated more efficiently. Integrin expression was identical in both variants, with alpha5beta1 mainly mediating fibronectin adhesion and alphavbeta1 acting as a vitronectin receptor. Morphological differences correlated with alpha6beta4 and laminin distribution. The authors suggest fibronectin may guide the migration of extravillous trophoblast, with migratory phenotype switching via integrin activation.

pmid-1479492.summary_ja: 1992年の小児外科誌報告。ターナー様症状を示す表現型女児7例を対象とし、Y染色体断片を有する45,X核型の症例で両側性腺摘除術を施行した。2例に予期せぬ性腺芽腫が認められ、転移はなかった。Y染色体の可能性がある場合は性腺摘除を推奨し、染色体評価の重要性を強調している。
pmid-1479492.summary_en: This 1992 pediatric surgery case series describes seven phenotypically female girls with Turner-like features and a 45,X karyotype with a Y-chromosome fragment. Because Y-chromosomal material raises the risk of gonadoblastoma in dysgenetic gonads, bilateral gonadectomy was performed. Gonadoblastoma was unexpectedly found in two patients, without metastases, while five showed Leydig cells and rete testis-like tubules. The authors emphasize complete chromosomal evaluation of females with primary amenorrhea or Turner-like features, and recommend gonadectomy whenever a Y chromosome cannot be excluded.

pmid-1479752.summary_ja: 1992年の泌尿器科報告。病期I精巣セミノーマに対し、精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を行った27例と、サーベイランスのみの23例を後方視的に比較した。サーベイランス群では8.7%が非バルキーな後腹膜病変で再発し、放射線療法群では3.7%だった。少数例での比較であり、慎重な解釈が必要である。
pmid-1479752.summary_en: This 1992 Japanese urology study compares surveillance with adjuvant radiotherapy after orchiectomy for stage I testicular seminoma. Twenty-seven patients received radiotherapy, while 23 entered a surveillance-only protocol with a median follow-up of 43 months. Surveillance included tumor markers, chest X-rays, and CT scans. Relapse occurred in 8.7% of the surveillance group, all with nonbulky retroperitoneal disease, versus 3.7% in the irradiated group. The comparison is retrospective and based on small numbers, so interpretation requires caution.

pmid-1481782.summary_ja: 1992年の症例報告。32歳男性の左精巣胎児性癌（病期IIA）に対し、シスプラチン併用化学療法3コース後、神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。術前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGは正常であった。術後3週で正常な射精が得られた。化学療法先行が神経温存を伴う郭清に有用かもしれないと考察している。
pmid-1481782.summary_en: This 1992 Japanese case report describes a 32-year-old man with left testicular embryonal carcinoma, stage IIA, and low-volume left para-aortic nodes. He received three cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy, then underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection despite marked nodal shrinkage, because preoperative AFP and beta-hCG were normal and no yolk sac element was seen. A nerve-sparing technique preserved the lumbar splanchnic nerves, and he ejaculated normally three weeks after surgery. The authors suggest that chemotherapy first may facilitate nerve-sparing RPLND.

pmid-1487646.summary_ja: 48歳女性が咳と喀痰を訴え、CTで肺アスペルギローマが疑われた。手術では成熟型縦隔奇形腫が気管支と肺を穿通し、腫瘍嚢胞内にアスペルギローマを合併していた。腫瘍を切除し、術後2年4か月の時点で再発はみられていない。まれな合併例の報告である。
pmid-1487646.summary_en: A 48-year-old woman presented with cough and sputum, and chest CT suggested aspergilloma. At surgery, a mature-type mediastinal teratoma was found to have perforated the bronchus and lung, with aspergilloma within the tumour cyst. The tumour was resected and the bronchial drainage was closed. The patient remained free of recurrence for over two years. The report describes a rare combination of mature mediastinal teratoma with pulmonary perforation and fungal infection.

pmid-1489291.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のうち、シスプラチン併用化学療法でも予後不良となる症例への治療法をレビューしている。従来の救済療法、増強導入療法、自家骨髄移植を伴う大量化学療法を比較する。化学療法感受性のある症例では長期寛解が得られるが、不応例では効果が限られると述べている。
pmid-1489291.summary_en: This review addresses poor-prognosis disseminated non-seminomatous germ cell tumours, a subset that dies despite cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Poor prognostic features include bulky disease, visceral involvement, high markers and slow marker decline. Options discussed include conventional induction followed by salvage, more intensive induction with growth factor support, and high-dose chemotherapy with autologous marrow rescue. Autografting yields durable remissions in chemotherapy-responsive disease but not refractory disease. Elective early autografting for very-poor-risk patients is proposed as a future approach.

pmid-1491874.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが自然に退縮した1症例の報告。フランスの文献で「セミノーム瘢痕」と呼ばれる現象に相当する。免疫学的な防御機構が自然消退に関与する可能性が示唆されている。最終経過観察時には正常で、再発は認められていない。
pmid-1491874.summary_en: The authors report a patient with spontaneous regression of a testicular seminoma, a phenomenon French authors call 'seminome cicatrice'. They suggest that immunological defences may be fundamental to complete or partial spontaneous resolution of this tumour type. The clinical and surgical management is described, and the most recent control examination was normal, with the patient relapse-free. The paper is a brief case-based discussion without detailed data.

pmid-1491908.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫が膀胱出口を閉塞し、先天性膀胱破裂と尿性腹水、両側水腎症を生じた新生児例の報告。胎児後期に閉塞が起きたと考えられる。膀胱破裂が内部減圧として腎機能の保護に働いた可能性が述べられており、術後は速やかに腎機能が回復した。
pmid-1491908.summary_en: This pediatric radiology report describes congenital bladder rupture with urine ascites and bilateral hydronephrosis caused by a sacrococcygeal teratoma obstructing the bladder outlet. The absence of pulmonary hypoplasia and renal dysplasia, together with rapid renal recovery after decompressive surgery, suggested that obstruction occurred late in fetal life. Bladder rupture may have acted as an internal decompression mechanism that protected renal function. The case highlights a fetal complication of sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-1495740.summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性腺形成不全(Swyer症候群)に生じた進行期のディスジャーミノーマ症例の報告。予想外の腸管浸潤のため、腸切除、子宮全摘、両側性腺摘除を含む一塊切除が必要であった。Swyer症候群では広範な手術切除が必要となり得ると述べている。
pmid-1495740.summary_en: A case of advanced dysgerminoma arising in a patient with Swyer syndrome (46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis) is reported. Unexpected regional invasion of the intestine required bowel resection, total abdominal hysterectomy, and bilateral salpingogonadectomy for en bloc excision of the primary mass and dysgenetic gonads. The report emphasises that extensive operative resection may be necessary in Swyer syndrome patients with germ cell tumours. It is a short case report in obstetrics and gynaecology.

pmid-1497118.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫2例に前立腺組織が見られた報告で、いずれも他は典型的な腫瘍であった。免疫染色は正常前立腺と一致し、文献上さらに4例が確認された。46,XXの腫瘍であることから、局所で産生されたアンドロゲンが誘導因子と考えられている。
pmid-1497118.summary_en: The authors describe two mature cystic teratomas of the ovary containing prostatic tissue, both incidental findings in otherwise typical tumours. The prostatic glands showed a simple branching pattern resembling the peripheral zone of the prostate, with transitional cells and Cowper's gland-like acini in one case. Immunohistochemistry matched normal prostate. A literature review identified four additional cases. The authors suggest that locally produced androgen, possibly from luteinised stromal cells, induced this tissue in a 46,XX tumour.

pmid-1498708.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが十二指腸の潰瘍性腫瘤として発見された症例の報告。胚細胞腫瘍の約5%で腸管浸潤がみられ、転移性リンパ節腫大からの進展が多い。本例ではCTで小腸の浸潤と潰瘍が描出された。従来、画像診断で腸管潰瘍が確認された報告はないとされる。
pmid-1498708.summary_en: The authors report a case of testicular seminoma presenting as an ulcerating duodenal mass. Germ cell tumours involve the bowel in about 5% of patients, usually by extension from metastatic lymphadenopathy. Such involvement often causes obstruction and bleeding, but radiologic identification of bowel ulceration had not been reported. Here, small bowel invasion and ulceration were identified on CT, caused by adenopathy from testicular carcinoma. The paper is a brief imaging case report.

pmid-1500030.summary_ja: 正期産の非奇胎性胎盤に生じた絨毛癌で、母体に広範な転移を来した症例を報告する。非転移性の病変は数個の絨毛に限局しうるため見逃されやすく、肉眼的病変は胎盤梗塞と誤認されることがあると指摘する。転移性疾患には積極的な併用化学療法が推奨されるが、最適な治療は不明であり、母体と児の予後は従来不良であった。
pmid-1500030.summary_en: This report describes a choriocarcinoma arising in a term, nonmolar placenta that caused widespread maternal metastases. The authors note that nonmetastatic placental choriocarcinoma is often missed because it may involve only a few villi, and grossly visible lesions may be mistaken for placental infarction. Optimal treatment is unknown, but aggressive combination chemotherapy is suggested for metastatic disease. Historically, both maternal and infant prognoses have been poor.

pmid-1501269.summary_ja: 文献上わずか30例程度しか報告されていない肺内奇形腫の症例を報告し、文献レビューを行う。起源は第三咽頭嚢と考えられ、上葉に生じることが多い。画像上は分葉状腫瘤として描出され、石灰化や周辺部の空気を伴うことがある。良性と悪性の両方が存在し、特徴を表にまとめて検討している。
pmid-1501269.summary_en: This report describes an intrapulmonary teratoma, an extremely rare tumor with only about 30 cases in the literature. The authors review its suspected origin from the third pharyngeal pouch, its demographics, and its radiographic appearance as a lobulated mass with possible calcification or peripheral air, usually in the upper lobes. Benign and malignant forms are described, with malignant lesions sometimes having favorable postoperative outcomes. A new case is presented alongside a review of prior reports and a tabular summary of characteristics.

pmid-1501960.summary_ja: 18か月と2歳の男児における精巣奇形腫の超音波所見を報告する。1例は嚢胞性で壁に高エコー成分を伴い、もう1例は石灰化と嚢胞を含む複雑な腫瘤であった。いずれも病理所見と良好に対応した。特徴的所見を認識すれば術前診断が可能であり、小児では精巣摘除術後の予後は良好であると結論づけている。
pmid-1501960.summary_en: This paper reports sonographic findings in two children, aged 18 months and 2 years, with testicular teratoma. Both showed intratesticular masses, one predominantly cystic with echogenic wall components and the other a complex mass with calcifications and cysts. Pathologic correlation was excellent in both cases. The authors conclude that preoperative diagnosis is possible when characteristic sonographic features are recognized, and that prognosis after orchiectomy in pediatric patients is good.

pmid-1503781.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株において、白血病抑制因子（LIF）がレチノイン酸や低温により誘導される分化を阻害するかを検討した。OTF9細胞では分化が抑えられたが、親株F9では抑制されなかった。LIFは分化の早期に作用し、壁側内胚葉様産物の出現を抑える。胎児性癌細胞の分化機構を解析するモデルとして有用であると述べている。
pmid-1503781.summary_en: This study examines leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) effects on murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines during retinoic acid-induced and low-temperature differentiation. LIF blocks differentiation in OTF9 cells but not in parental F9 cells, acting early by inhibiting parietal endoderm-type product cells while leaving an early retinoic acid-induced event unchanged. The authors propose this model for dissecting embryonal carcinoma differentiation mechanisms and as a target for studying LIF action.

pmid-1503914.summary_ja: オーストラリア・ビクトリア州で1950〜1978年に診断された精巣腫瘍1009例を、英国精巣腫瘍パネルの分類で再検討した集団ベースの研究である。再検討によりセミノーマの割合は減少し、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は増加した。一部は非悪性と判明した。再分類は年齢別発生率に影響したが、標準化した推移は変わらなかった。疫学研究および臨床管理への意義を論じる。
pmid-1503914.summary_en: This population-based study in Victoria, Australia, re-reviewed 1009 testicular tumours diagnosed from 1950 to 1978 using the British Testicular Tumour Panel system. Review reduced seminoma proportions and increased non-seminoma germ cell tumour (NSGCT) and non-germ cell tumour classifications, with some cases found to be nonmalignant. Reclassification altered age-specific incidence of seminoma and NSGCT, especially in the 1950s, while standardised trends for seminoma and NSGCT were unaffected. The authors discuss implications for epidemiology and clinical management.

pmid-1511197.summary_ja: 小児期に性腺または仙尾部以外の性腺外奇形腫で手術を受けた32例を、5〜40年追跡して晩期合併症を評価しました。精巣または縦隔奇形腫の成人男性10例中5例で精液所見やホルモン値の異常がみられ、性腺機能障害は部位によらず生じうると結論づけています。
pmid-1511197.summary_en: This study evaluated late sequelae in 32 patients who underwent surgery in childhood for gonadal or non-sacrococcygeal extragonadal teratomas, with follow-up of 5 to 40 years. Surgical physical abnormalities occurred in patients with oral or mediastinal teratomas, and spina bifida occulta was seen radiographically in three. Males showed gonadal dysfunction, including impaired semen quality and abnormal hormone levels, in five of ten adult men who had testicular or mediastinal teratomas. The authors conclude that some sequelae correlate with tumor site, while gonadal dysfunction and vertebral anomalies can occur regardless of location.

pmid-1512152.summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ22例を12年間にわたり後方視的に検討し、5年生存率は76%でした。病期I例は保存的治療と再発時の救済療法で全例生存し、病期III・IV例は手術後の放射線療法で約66%の5年生存率でした。後腹膜リンパ節病変は腹膜播種より予後が良好に見えたと報告しています。
pmid-1512152.summary_en: This retrospective study of 22 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated over 12 years reports a 5-year survival of 76%. Stage I patients had 100% survival with conservative surgery and salvage therapy on recurrence. Stage III and IV patients who underwent surgery followed by irradiation had 5-year survival rates of about 66%. Retroperitoneal nodal disease appeared to carry a better prognosis than peritoneal spread. Elective mediastinal and supraclavicular irradiation seemed beneficial, while extent of surgery did not significantly affect survival.

pmid-1515239.summary_ja: 進行転移性セミノーマ70例に単剤カルボプラチンを4〜6コース投与しました。3年無再発生存率は77%、全生存率は91%で、毒性は軽度でした。化学療法後の放射線療法は再発を有意に減らし、再発例の多くは救済化学療法で制御されました。単剤療法は再発率が高いため、高齢や合併症のある症例を除き研究的治療にとどまるべきと結論しています。
pmid-1515239.summary_en: This study reports 70 patients with advanced metastatic seminoma treated with 4 to 6 courses of single-agent carboplatin. Toxicity was low, and the 3-year relapse-free survival was 77%, with overall survival of 91%. Post-chemotherapy radiotherapy to involved nodes reduced relapse significantly. Most patients who relapsed were salvaged with combination chemotherapy. The authors conclude that single-agent carboplatin achieves survival similar to cisplatin-based combinations but has a higher relapse rate, so it should remain investigational except in unfit patients.

pmid-1516748.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞は分化するまでTGF-β2を発現しない。本研究では、TGF-β2プロモーターの断片をレポーター遺伝子CATに連結したコンストラクトを用い、分化による転写活性の変化を調べた。分化誘導でCAT活性は約9倍に上昇した。プロモーターには正の制御配列が2つ以上あり、負の制御配列で隔てられていた。基礎研究であり、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の患者を対象としたものではない。
pmid-1516748.summary_en: Embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells do not express detectable TGF-beta 2 until they differentiate. This study used CAT reporter constructs containing portions of the TGF-beta 2 promoter to test whether differentiation controls transcription. CAT activity rose about ninefold on differentiation. The promoter contains at least two positive regulatory elements separated by a negative element. A CRE/ATF-like site was identified as responsible for a positive element between -77 and -40. The work is basic research using EC cells as a differentiation model.

pmid-1518023.summary_ja: 低身長の12歳女児で、小さなY染色体由来マーカー染色体を伴うモザイク核型（45,X/46,X,+mar）が見つかった。DNA解析とin situハイブリダイゼーションにより、精巣決定領域は欠失していたがY染色体短腕と動原体由来物質は存在した。手術で線状性腺が確認され、左側性腺では性腺芽細胞腫から発生したディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が見られた。極めて小さなY由来マーカーでも性腺腫瘍の素因となり得ることを示す。
pmid-1518023.summary_en: A 12-year-old girl with short stature had mosaic 45,X/46,X,+mar karyotype with a small Y-derived marker chromosome. DNA analysis and in situ hybridization showed absence of the testis-determining region but presence of some Y short arm and centromeric material. Laparotomy revealed streak gonads; histology after gonadectomy showed dysgenetic gonads with dysgerminoma arising from gonadoblastoma in the left gonad. The authors conclude that very small Y-derived markers can predispose phenotypic females to gonadal neoplasia.

pmid-1521235.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎の女性と夫の末梢血リンパ球、および胞状奇胎11例と絨毛癌2例の培養組織で、姉妹染色分体交換（SCE）と染色体切断を調べた。SCEは正常対照と差がなく、悪性化の指標にはならなかった。一方、染色体切断は正常線維芽細胞より有意に多く、切断は脆弱部位やがんの切断点に多く生じていた。全般的なDNAの不安定性が絨毛癌の素因となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1521235.summary_en: Sister chromatid exchange (SCE) and chromosome breakage were studied in peripheral lymphocytes from women with complete hydatidiform moles and their husbands, and in cultured tissues from 11 moles and 2 choriocarcinomas. SCE did not differ from normal controls, so it was not a useful marker of malignancy. Chromosome breakage, however, was significantly higher in moles and choriocarcinomas than in normal fibroblasts, with breaks often at fragile sites and cancer breakpoints. The authors suggest general DNA instability may predispose to choriocarcinoma.

pmid-1521236.summary_ja: 悪性奇形腫を含む3例の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍について細胞遺伝学的解析を行った。腫瘍と宿主の核型、動原体多型、DNAフィンガープリントを比較した。1例は第一減数分裂の前の胚細胞に由来すると考えられ、別の1例では減数分裂の誤りが示唆された。奇形腫は2つの卵子の融合によって生じる可能性が提案されている。
pmid-1521236.summary_en: This report presents cytogenetic data on three malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, diagnosed as malignant teratoma with yolk sac, endodermal sinus tumor/embryonal carcinoma/choriocarcinoma, and yolk sac with embryonal carcinoma elements. Karyotypes were scored along with centromeric heteromorphisms and DNA fingerprints comparing tumor and host. One tumor appeared to arise from a germ cell before the first meiotic division, another suggested meiosis I error or failed meiosis, and the third showed altered heterozygosity patterns. The authors propose that teratomas could arise by fusion of two ova.

pmid-1522263.summary_ja: 本研究は、胸部・腹部・骨盤の奇形腫を有する小児15例のCT所見を再検討したものである。良性10例では脂肪、石灰化、壁在結節が高頻度にみられた。悪性5例は主に充実性で、約80%に局所浸潤または転移の所見があった。典型的な奇形腫のCT所見は悪性より良性で多く認められ、画像上の鑑別に役立つと結論づけている。
pmid-1522263.summary_en: This 1992 study reviewed computed tomography findings in 15 pediatric patients with teratomas of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis. Ten lesions were benign and five malignant. Fat, calcification, and mural nodules were more frequent in benign teratomas. Malignant teratomas were predominantly solid, and about 80% showed local invasion or distant metastases. The authors conclude that typical CT features of teratoma occur more often in benign lesions than in malignant ones, which is useful for distinguishing them radiologically.

pmid-1524004.summary_ja: 本研究は1970～1989年に治療した精巣腫瘍115例の臨床解析である。組織型はセミノーマが68例と最多で、病期I は69例であった。5年生存率はセミノーマ87.9%、非セミノーマ68.9%であった。1983年以降のCDDP含有化学療法と、それ以前の治療との間で生存率に有意差はなかった。
pmid-1524004.summary_en: This 1992 Japanese clinical study analyzed 115 patients with testicular tumors treated from 1970 to 1989. Seminoma was the most common histology (68 cases), and 69 patients had stage I disease. Treatments included orchiectomy, radiotherapy, chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The five-year survival was 87.9% for seminoma and 68.9% for non-seminoma. Survival did not differ significantly between patients treated before 1982 and those treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy after 1983.

pmid-1529821.summary_ja: 本報告は、17か月と24か月の小児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍2例を紹介したものである。AFPは初診時に上昇し、精巣摘除術後に正常化した。両例とも病期I であった。日本の小児例56例を再検討し、病期I の再発はなかった。思春期前の病期I は精巣摘除術のみで治療し、進行例には積極的な化学療法が有効と結論している。
pmid-1529821.summary_en: This 1992 Japanese report describes two children, aged 17 and 24 months, with testicular yolk sac tumor. Both presented with painless scrotal swelling and elevated alpha-fetoprotein that normalized after orchiectomy. Both were stage I. The authors reviewed 56 Japanese pediatric cases since 1981, noting no recurrences in stage I. They conclude that prepubertal stage I disease is best treated by orchiectomy alone, while advanced stages benefit from aggressive chemotherapy.

pmid-1533025.summary_ja: XY核型のSwyer症候群の表現型女性において、異形成索状性腺を腹腔鏡下に摘出した症例報告である。病理検査で3mmの性腺芽細胞腫を認めたが、悪性転化はなかった。患者は術後翌日に職場復帰した。性腺異形成例の予防的性腺摘出に、腹腔鏡手術が安全で簡便な選択肢になると提案している。
pmid-1533025.summary_en: This report describes laparoscopic removal of dysgenetic streak gonads from a phenotypic female with Swyer syndrome (XY karyotype). Pathology revealed a 3 mm gonadoblastoma without malignant transformation. The patient tolerated the procedure well and returned to work the next day. The authors propose laparoscopy as a safe, cost-effective, and simple approach for prophylactic gonadectomy to prevent neoplasia in individuals with gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-1535210.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの早期病期に対する放射線療法の論点を論じた論文である。病期I・IIAでは横隔膜下照射が標準で、選択的縦隔照射は不要とされる。適切に選んだ病期I症例では積極的サーベイランスも選択肢になる。両側リンパ管造影が病期分類や照射野設定に有用と述べ、線量と標的体積の論争を挙げている。
pmid-1535210.summary_en: This paper addresses controversies in radiotherapy for early-stage testicular seminoma. Subdiaphragmatic irradiation remains standard for stage I and IIA disease, while elective mediastinal irradiation is not indicated. For well-selected stage I patients, aggressive surveillance is a reasonable alternative. The authors emphasize bipedal lymphangiography for staging, field design, and follow-up. Remaining debates include optimal radiation dose and target volume.

pmid-1536722.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍42例で、上皮内癌胚細胞マーカーの抗体43-9Fを評価した研究である。胎児性癌15例すべてに染色され、13例では強染色であった。セミノーマでは弱陽性、奇形腫では一部陽性、絨毛癌は陰性であった。サイトケラチンより特異性と安定性に優れ、組織診断に有用と結論している。
pmid-1536722.summary_en: This study evaluates monoclonal antibody 43-9F, a marker of carcinoma-in-situ germ cells, for diagnosing testicular embryonal carcinoma. Among 42 testicular germ cell tumors, 43-9F stained all 15 embryonal carcinomas, strongly in 13. It was more specific and consistently expressed than cytokeratin staining. It showed weak reactivity in seminomas, variable staining in teratomas, and was negative in the choriocarcinoma component. The authors suggest 43-9F may aid histological diagnosis and support the link between carcinoma in situ and embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-1538369.summary_ja: 47歳女性が腹痛と下腹部腫瘤で受診した症例報告である。部分的大網切除で摘出された腫瘤は、大網内の副卵巣に生じた嚢胞性奇形腫であった。副卵巣は婦人科領域でまれな所見である。本例は、副卵巣組織が良性の奇形腫の母地となりうることを示す。
pmid-1538369.summary_en: This case report describes a 47-year-old woman with abdominal pain and a palpable lower abdominal mass. Partial omentectomy revealed a supernumerary ovary of the greater omentum containing a cystic teratoma. Supernumerary ovary is a rarely described gynecologic finding, and this case shows that ectopic ovarian tissue in the omentum can harbor germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-1541441.summary_ja: 一見順調だった正期妊娠の後に、胎盤に限局した絨毛癌が偶発的に見つかった症例報告である。新生児は胎児母体間出血による重度の貧血と血小板減少を呈したが、輸血で回復した。母体は無症状で転移検索は陰性であり、待機的に管理された。血清β-hCGは分娩後5週間で非妊娠時のレベルまでほぼ対数的に低下した。
pmid-1541441.summary_en: This case report describes choriocarcinoma confined to the placenta, found incidentally after an apparently uneventful term pregnancy. The newborn had severe anemia and thrombocytopenia from fetomaternal hemorrhage and recovered with transfusion. The asymptomatic mother had a negative workup for metastatic disease and was managed expectantly. Serial serum beta-hCG declined nearly logarithmically to non-pregnant levels within five weeks of delivery.

pmid-1541442.summary_ja: 初診時に血清LDHが著明高値を示した病期IIIC期の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の症例報告である。手術とVAC化学療法4コースでLDHは正常化し、再発時には再上昇、救済BEP化学療法で再び正常化した。ディスジャーミノーマではAFPやhCGが有用でないことが多く、連続的なLDH測定が再発の検出に役立つと結論している。
pmid-1541442.summary_en: This report describes a patient with stage IIIC ovarian dysgerminoma whose serum LDH was markedly elevated at diagnosis. After surgery and four cycles of VAC chemotherapy, LDH normalized. It rose again with recurrence and fell after salvage BEP chemotherapy. The authors conclude that serial LDH measurements may detect recurrence in dysgerminoma, where AFP and hCG are typically not useful, a finding not previously documented.

pmid-1543003.summary_ja: 膀胱原発の絨毛癌を男性2例で報告した。両例で血清・尿中のhCGが著明に上昇していた。細胞診では奇怪な多核巨細胞が認められ、組織学的には一例は純粋な絨毛癌、他例は絨毛癌と移行上皮癌の混在であった。免疫染色で移行上皮癌細胞の一部もhCG陽性を示し、移行上皮癌から栄養膜細胞への化生ないし逆分化が成因として考えられた。
pmid-1543003.summary_en: This report describes two men, aged 70 and 72, with primary choriocarcinoma arising in the urinary bladder. Both had markedly elevated serum and urinary hCG. Cytology showed bizarre giant cells with hemorrhage and necrosis. Histology revealed pure choriocarcinoma in one case and a mixture of choriocarcinoma and transitional cell carcinoma in the other. Immunohistochemistry showed hCG positivity in syncytiotrophoblasts and some transitional carcinoma cells, suggesting that bladder choriocarcinoma may arise by metaplasia or retrodifferentiation of transitional cell carcinoma.

pmid-1546428.summary_ja: 水瘤があると精巣の触診が不正確になり、水瘤液の解析報告はまれである。本報告は、精巣セミノーマに伴う水瘤内に悪性細胞を細胞学的に証明した症例である。精巣セミノーマと水瘤の併存は予想されるものの、文献上の記載は少ない。精巣の触診が難しい症例では、水瘤液の細胞診が悪性の診断と評価に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-1546428.summary_en: Accurate palpation of the testis can be obscured by a hydrocele, and hydrocele fluid analysis is seldom reported. The authors describe cytologic demonstration of malignant cells within a hydrocele accompanying testicular seminoma. Although this connection is not unexpected, it is rarely documented. The case highlights that hydrocele fluid cytology can reveal malignancy in patients with testicular seminoma and may aid evaluation when the testis is difficult to examine.

pmid-1546576.summary_ja: 66歳男性が5年間かけて増大した左陰嚢内腫瘤で受診した。血清β-hCGと乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)が著明に上昇していた。切除標本は26×16×13 cm、2,258 gに達し、左精巣から発生して左鼠径部へ進展していた。組織学的には純粋なセミノーマであった。異例の巨大精巣腫瘍で、腫瘍マーカーの高値を伴った症例である。
pmid-1546576.summary_en: A 66-year-old man presented with a slowly growing left scrotal mass over five years. Serum beta-hCG and lactate dehydrogenase were markedly elevated. The resected tumor measured 26 by 16 by 13 cm and weighed 2,258 grams. It arose from the left testis and extended into the left inguinal region. Histology showed pure seminoma. The report illustrates an unusually large testicular seminoma with substantial marker elevation.

pmid-1546577.summary_ja: 22歳の遺残性ミュラー管症候群の男性が、左側腹部痛、巨大な腹部腫瘤、左陰嚢内精巣の欠如を呈して受診した。有効な化学療法により腫瘤は縮小し、摘出術でセミノーマと遺残性ミュラー管構造が確認された。本症例は左側の横行精巣異所性を示していた。日本の文献的検討では、精巣腫瘍を伴う横行精巣異所性の既報告例が16例同定され、この稀な併存と診断上の課題が強調されている。
pmid-1546577.summary_en: A 22-year-old man with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome presented with left flank pain, a large abdominal mass, and an absent left intrascrotal testis. Effective chemotherapy reduced the mass, and extirpation confirmed seminoma together with persistent Müllerian duct structures. The case showed left transverse testicular ectopia. A review of Japanese literature identified 16 previously reported cases of transverse testicular ectopia associated with testicular tumors, highlighting this rare combination and its diagnostic challenges.

pmid-1548875.summary_ja: 1968年から1988年に、早期病期の精巣セミノーマ75例を精巣摘除術後に放射線療法で治療した。10年・20年生存率は95%・90%であった。8例(11%)に計9個の二次癌が発生し、そのうち3例は照射野内に発生した。セミノーマ患者では二次癌リスクが高く注意が必要だが、全体の予後は良好であると結論された。
pmid-1548875.summary_en: This study assessed second primary cancers in 75 patients with early-stage (stage I and IIA) testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy and radiation therapy at a single center between 1968 and 1988. Ten- and 20-year survival was 95% and 90%. Eight patients (11%) developed nine second cancers, with a cumulative rate of one per 1,000 years of follow-up. Three occurred within the irradiated field. The authors conclude that seminoma survivors have an increased second-cancer risk that warrants greater clinical awareness, although overall prognosis remains favorable.

pmid-1550086.summary_ja: 本後方視的検討は、1972年から1987年にマギル大学病院で精巣摘除術と補助照射を受けた病期Iおよび病期IIの精巣セミノーマ69例を対象とした。10年生存率は病期Iで94%、病期IIで93%であった。治療に失敗したのは3例のみで、そのうち2例は脳転移により死亡した。重篤な急性毒性や晩期合併症は認められなかった。著者らは、精巣摘除術後の放射線療法が病期Iおよびほとんどの病期IIのセミノーマに対する第一選択であると結論づけ、病期分類とサーベイランスをめぐる論点を考察している。
pmid-1550086.summary_en: A retrospective review of 69 patients with stage I and II testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy and adjuvant irradiation at McGill University Hospitals from 1972 to 1987. Ten-year survival was 94% for stage I and 93% for stage II. Only three patients failed treatment, and two of them died from brain metastases. No serious acute toxicity or late complications were observed. The authors conclude that postorchiectomy radiation therapy is the treatment of choice for stage I and most stage II seminoma, and they discuss staging and surveillance controversies.

pmid-1552427.summary_ja: 14か月の男児が血腹症で受診し、鎌状靭帯から左肝葉へ進展する壊死性腫瘍が認められた。減量術後に修正Einhorn化学療法を5か月施行し、部分奏効を得た。その後の再開腹で肝左葉切除と鎌状靭帯の一括切除を行い、2年後も転移の兆候なく生存している。鎌状靭帯内に発生した原発性卵黄嚢腫瘍の初めての報告である。
pmid-1552427.summary_en: A 14-month-old boy presented with hemoperitoneum and was found to have an extremely friable, necrotic tumor arising from the falciform ligament and extending into the left liver lobe. Debulking was followed by five months of modified Einhorn chemotherapy, with partial response. A second-look laparotomy then allowed left hepatic lobectomy and en bloc resection of the falciform ligament. The patient showed no metastases and was alive two years later. The authors report the first case of primary yolk sac tumor arising within the falciform ligament.

pmid-1552432.summary_ja: 18歳男性が嵌頓鼠径ヘルニアとして受診したが、鼠径部類皮嚢腫と判明した。鼠径部腫瘤の鑑別には、ヘルニアのほか婦人科的疾患や血管病変を含める必要がある。類皮嚢腫は皮膚付属器を含む良性の嚢胞性奇形腫であり、鑑別診断に含めるべきと述べている。
pmid-1552432.summary_en: An 18-year-old boy presented with an incarcerated inguinal hernia that proved to be an inguinal dermoid cyst. The authors review the differential diagnosis of inguinal masses, including hernias and gynecologic and vascular lesions. Histologically, the cyst had a squamous epithelial lining and a fibroconnective wall containing hair follicles and sebaceous, eccrine, and apocrine glands, distinguishing it from epidermoid and sebaceous cysts. Lacking foreign structures, dermoid cysts are benign cystic teratomas, and the authors urge their inclusion in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-1552581.summary_ja: HIV陽性男性5例に精巣腫瘍6例が発生し、米国平均の約57倍の頻度であった。組織型は主に混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、セミノーマとバーキットリンパ腫も1例ずつ認めた。切除した低病期3例は1〜9か月で再発し、白金系化学療法を要した。HIV陽性者では臨床病期の過小評価が起こりうる。
pmid-1552581.summary_en: Five HIV-positive men developed six testicular tumors, an incidence about 57 times the US average. Histology was mostly mixed germ cell tumor, with one seminoma and one Burkitt lymphoma. Three patients with low-stage disease who underwent resection relapsed within 1 to 9 months and required platinum-based chemotherapy. Clinical staging may underestimate disease in HIV-positive men, and tolerance of chemotherapy depended mainly on whether HIV progressed to AIDS.

pmid-1552591.summary_ja: 陰嚢上部の腫瘤として発生した性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。術前・化学療法後とも精巣超音波検査は正常で、精巣内病変ではないと判断された。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は344.55 ng/mlと著明に上昇し、手術と化学療法後に正常化した。精巣が正常でも陰嚢腫瘤では性腺外起源を考慮する必要がある。
pmid-1552591.summary_en: A case report of an extragonadal yolk sac tumor presenting as a superior scrotal mass. Testicular ultrasonography was normal both before and after chemotherapy, indicating the lesion was not intratesticular. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 344.55 ng/ml and normalized after surgery and chemotherapy, supporting its use as a tumor marker for monitoring. The report highlights that extragonadal origin should be considered when scrotal masses are sonographically normal in the testis.

pmid-1554453.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された巨大なエピグナタス(口蓋・口咽頭原発の希少な奇形腫)を有する新生児の症例である。胎盤循環を維持したまま気管切開を行い、気道を確保した後に循環を遮断して腫瘍を摘出した。子宮外でこの手技を用いた手術の成功例は初めてと報告された。ハイリスク新生児の気道管理には多職種の連携が重要である。
pmid-1554453.summary_en: A newborn with a large prenatally diagnosed epignathus, a rare teratoma arising from the palate and oropharynx, was managed with a new airway approach. Tracheotomy was performed while maternal-fetal circulation was maintained, then circulation was interrupted to remove the tumor. The authors state this is the first extrauterine surgery using this technique. They propose multidisciplinary airway planning for high-risk neonates involving pediatricians, neonatologists, anesthesiologists, and otolaryngologists.

pmid-1554492.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成を有する9歳女児の異形成性腺に、上皮内癌、性腺芽腫、早期浸潤性腫瘍が認められた症例報告である。形態学的および免疫組織化学的検討から3成分の密接な関連が示された。性腺芽腫を含むすべての胚細胞腫瘍は、胎生初期に形成された上皮内癌の胚細胞に由来するとの仮説を支持する。
pmid-1554492.summary_en: A nine-year-old girl with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis had carcinoma in situ, gonadoblastoma, and early invasive neoplasia in a dysgenetic gonad. Morphological and immunohistochemical studies supported a close relationship among the three components. The authors argue that all germ cell tumors, including gonadoblastomas, arise from carcinoma in situ germ cells formed during early embryonic life. This case supports that developmental origin hypothesis.

pmid-1555191.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍37例でX染色質、性染色体および倍数性を検討した。X染色質は奇形腫と複合型腫瘍で多く、セミノーマではほとんど認められなかった。核型解析した腫瘍の多くは少なくとも1本のY染色体を有し、高倍数性と12番染色体異常(i(12p))が特徴であった。
pmid-1555191.summary_en: X-chromatin, sex chromosomes, and ploidy were examined in 37 testicular germ cell tumors. X-chromatin was found in most teratomas and combined tumors but rarely in seminomas, which tended to have higher chromosome numbers. Most karyotyped tumors had two X chromosomes and at least one Y chromosome. High ploidy (at least 55 chromosomes) and i(12p) were common, suggesting an origin from a triploid or tetraploid cell. The authors question whether Y retention is a universal feature.

pmid-1555193.summary_ja: 両側性または家族性精巣がん患者12例のリンパ球を高解像度Gバンド法で解析し、生殖細胞系列の染色体変異を探索した。3p、11pを含むいずれの染色体にも変異は認められなかった。95%信頼区間に基づき、検出可能な生殖細胞系列変異が原因となる例は23%未満と結論された。
pmid-1555193.summary_en: Lymphocytes from 12 Norwegian patients with bilateral or familial testicular cancer were examined by high resolution G-banding to detect constitutional germline chromosomal mutations. No mutations were found in 3p, 11p, or any other chromosome. Using a 95% confidence interval, the authors conclude that fewer than 23% of familial or bilateral cases are caused by germline mutations detectable at this resolution. The study also standardized the laboratory's resolution determination.

pmid-1555373.summary_ja: 悪性精巣奇形腫の脳転移に出血を伴った症例の報告である。MRIでは反復する出血に一致する複雑な所見がみられた。出血により脳病変は増大して症状が進行し、頭蓋外病変や他の脳病変が安定していても進行しうることが示された。
pmid-1555373.summary_en: A case report describing haemorrhagic cerebral metastases from a malignant testicular teratoma. MRI showed complex appearances consistent with repeated haemorrhage. Bleeding caused enlargement and symptomatic progression of the brain lesions, even when extracranial disease and other cerebral lesions were stable. The report highlights that metastatic intracranial hemorrhage can drive clinical deterioration independent of systemic disease status.

pmid-1555953.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者39例を対象に、横隔膜下放射線療法の急性・亜急性副作用を質問票で前向きに評価した。治療終了時には全例が悪心を訴え、下痢、腹痛、鼓腸も多くみられた。治療中に体重と全身状態は低下したが、血液毒性は軽度であった。1年後には身体機能が回復し、副作用は中央値9週間で可逆的であった。
pmid-1555953.summary_en: In 39 testicular cancer patients receiving infra-diaphragmatic radiotherapy, acute and subacute side effects were prospectively assessed with questionnaires before, during, and after treatment. Nausea was reported by all responding patients at the end of therapy, and diarrhea, abdominal pain, and meteorism were common. Weight and performance status fell during therapy, while hematologic toxicity was low. Symptoms worsened at 3 months, and patients regained physical fitness by one year. Side effects were significant but reversible, lasting a median of 9 weeks.

pmid-1561154.summary_ja: 成熟型の仙尾部奇形腫が、左臀部に過剰肢様の外観を呈し、未発達の骨盤・下肢骨を伴った稀な症例を報告している。この外部病変とは別に、深部の直腸傍部に独立した成熟奇形腫が存在していた。十分に発達した外部肢と深部奇形腫の組み合わせは既報があるとされる。仙尾部奇形腫の非典型的な提示例を示す病理症例報告である。
pmid-1561154.summary_en: The authors describe a mature presacral sacrococcygeal teratoma that presented as a supernumerary limb in the left gluteal region, with a rudimentary hemipelvis and lower limb bones. The external limb-like mass coexisted with a separate, deep pararectal mature teratoma. The combination of a well-developed external limb and a deep teratoma is noted as having been described previously. This is a pathology case report of an unusual presentation of sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-1561962.summary_ja: 36歳男性の進行期（IIB期）セミノーマ症例で、根治的精巣摘除術後にカルボプラチン単剤療法を4コース施行した。初回後に腫瘍マーカーLDHとβ-hCGは正常化し、後腹膜転移も著明に縮小した。シスプラチン併用療法に比べ毒性は軽微であり、治療終了9か月後も無増悪であった。単剤療法は有効で毒性の少ない選択肢となり得ることを示唆する。
pmid-1561962.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with stage IIB seminoma treated with left radical orchiectomy followed by four courses of single-agent carboplatin. LDH and beta-hCG normalized after the first course, and retroperitoneal metastases shrank significantly. Toxicity was milder than cisplatin-based regimens, with no septicemia, thrombocytopenic bleeding, renal injury, alopecia, neuropathy, or hearing loss. Nine months after completion, the patient remained disease-free, suggesting carboplatin monotherapy may be an effective, less toxic option for advanced seminoma.

pmid-1563744.summary_ja: 精巣および性腺外セミノーマ15例を対象に、光顕・電顕・免疫組織化学染色により浸潤炎症細胞と腫瘍細胞の相互作用を解析した。全例でリンパ球が腫瘍細胞と密接に接触し、細胞膜や細胞質の障害を生じさせ、一部は核内にまで侵入していた。一方、リンパ球自身は保たれていた。上皮様細胞やマクロファージも腫瘍細胞に障害を与え、これらの免疫細胞が直接的な細胞傷害作用を有する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1563744.summary_en: This study examines 15 testicular and extragonadal seminomas using light and electron microscopy and immunohistochemistry, focusing on interactions between infiltrating inflammatory cells and tumor cells. Lymphocytes contacted tumor cells closely in all cases, causing membrane and cytoplasmic damage, and some penetrated into the nucleus, while the lymphocytes themselves remained intact. Epithelioid cells and macrophages also damaged tumor cells. The authors suggest these immune cells may be directly cytotoxic to seminoma cells in the tumor microenvironment.

pmid-1563747.summary_ja: 1960～1985年にナイジェリアのイバダンで診断された407例の奇形腫のうち、18%が小児例であった。小児例は仙尾部と卵巣に由来する2つのピークを示し、女児は男児の約5倍であった。成熟奇形腫が81%、未熟奇形腫が15%、悪性奇形腫が4%を占めた。悪性例は2例とも仙尾部から発生し卵黄嚢成分を含んでいた。奇形腫は胚細胞由来と考えられている。
pmid-1563747.summary_en: This retrospective pathology review of 407 teratomas from University College Hospital, Ibadan, Nigeria (1960-1985) found that 18% occurred in children. Childhood teratomas showed a bimodal peak incidence from sacrococcygeal and ovarian sites, with a female-to-male ratio of 5:1. Of these, 81% were mature, 15% immature, and 4% malignant. The two malignant tumors arose in the sacrococcygeal region in older children and contained yolk sac elements. The authors support a germ cell origin for these neoplasms.

pmid-1563750.summary_ja: 37歳女性の部分胞状奇胎が、化学療法1コース後も持続し、10か月の寛解後に血清β-hCGが14,600 mIU/mLまで上昇した症例報告である。掻爬により絨毛癌と診断された。フローサイトメトリーで奇胎は3倍体、絨毛癌は2倍体であった。転移はなく、多剤併用化学療法で治療された。部分胞状奇胎から絨毛癌が生じうるかという論点を扱う。
pmid-1563750.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old woman whose partial hydatidiform mole persisted after one course of chemotherapy. After 10 months of remission, routine follow-up showed serum beta-hCG rising to 14,600 mIU/mL. Curettage revealed choriocarcinoma. Flow cytometry showed the mole to be triploid and the choriocarcinoma diploid. The patient had no metastatic disease and was successfully treated with multiple-agent chemotherapy. The authors address whether choriocarcinoma can follow a partial mole.

pmid-1564719.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、二次性無月経を呈した46,XYの純粋型性腺異形成患者を記述している。血清テストステロンおよび遊離アンドロゲン指数の上昇から精査され、両側の性腺に性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマが認められた。子宮、卵管、膣は正常であった。リンパ節腫脹があったため、性腺を摘出し化学療法を施行した。本症例は、Y染色体を有する異形成性腺における胚細胞腫瘍のリスクと、このような患者における性腺摘出の重要性を示している。
pmid-1564719.summary_en: This case report describes a 46,XY patient with pure gonadal dysgenesis who presented with secondary amenorrhea. Elevated serum testosterone and free androgen index prompted evaluation, which revealed bilateral gonadoblastomas and dysgerminomas in the gonads. The uterus, fallopian tubes, and vagina were normal. The gonads were removed, and chemotherapy was given because of lymphadenopathy. The case illustrates the germ cell tumor risk in dysgenetic gonads carrying a Y chromosome and the importance of gonadal removal in such patients.

pmid-1564819.summary_ja: 7歳女児の縦隔に生じた二重腫瘍の症例報告である。胸部X線で異常陰影を指摘され、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で前縦隔と中縦隔に病変が示された。胸腺とともに両腫瘍を切除した。病理組織学的に前縦隔は奇形腫、中縦隔は気管支原性嚢胞と診断された。
pmid-1564819.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 7-year-old girl with two mediastinal tumors identified on chest radiography. CT and MRI indicated tumors in the anterior and middle mediastinum. Surgical resection removed both masses along with the thymus. Histology revealed a teratoma in the anterior mediastinum and a bronchogenic cyst in the middle mediastinum. The authors also reviewed pertinent literature on this combination of mediastinal lesions.

pmid-1565387.summary_ja: 胎児の心膜内奇形腫に伴う大量の心嚢液貯留を心エコーで診断した報告である。子宮内心嚢穿刺により心タンポナーデを回避し、胎児死亡を防いだ。計画的な産科・新生児管理のもと、心肺症状が出現する前に外科的切除を行い、腫瘍は完全に摘出された。出生児は無症状である。希少な先天性奇形腫に対する出生前介入の役割を示す症例である。
pmid-1565387.summary_en: This obstetric report describes a fetus with an intrapericardial teratoma and a large pericardial effusion detected by echocardiography. Intrauterine pericardiocentesis was performed to prevent cardiac tamponade, a common cause of fetal death. Planned obstetric and neonatal management allowed surgical excision before cardiorespiratory distress developed. The tumor was completely removed, and the infant remained asymptomatic. The paper illustrates the role of prenatal intervention in managing a rare congenital teratoma.

pmid-1565399.summary_ja: 妊娠中に発見された純粋型のディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)3例の報告である。保存的手術の後に正期産で分娩に至った。進行例の1例は妊娠最終期に化学療法を受けた。血清の腫瘍マーカーであるCA 125と乳酸脱水素酵素の正常化、および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で治療効果を評価した。妊娠中の生殖機能温存を考慮した管理の一例を示している。
pmid-1565399.summary_en: This obstetric study reports three cases of pure dysgerminoma (undifferentiated germ cell tumor) diagnosed during pregnancy and managed with conservative surgery followed by term delivery. One patient with advanced disease received chemotherapy during the last trimester. Tumor response was assessed by normalization of the serum tumor markers CA 125 and lactic dehydrogenase, and confirmed by magnetic resonance imaging. The series describes fertility-sparing management compatible with term delivery in selected cases, though the sample size is small.

pmid-1576432.summary_ja: 本研究はマウス奇形癌OTT6050由来の胚様体（EB）を対象とした基礎研究である。16・22・35日齢のEBを保有する動物から採取した腹水中で培養し、22日齢の腹水にフィブロネクチンが存在することを免疫ブロットで確認した。腹水中にはEBの増殖を促す因子が存在する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1576432.summary_en: This experimental study examined embryoid bodies derived from the murine teratocarcinoma line OTT6050. Embryoid bodies were cultured in ascitic fluid collected from animals bearing embryoid bodies of 16, 22, and 35 days' evolution. Immunoblotting detected fibronectin in the 22-day ascitic fluid. The authors suggest that growth-stimulatory factors for embryoid bodies are present in these fluids. The work is an in vitro and animal-based investigation of teratocarcinoma growth regulation rather than clinical management.

pmid-1580039.summary_ja: 1981年以降に進行セミノーマ28例を治療したSWOG研究である。ビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミドによる化学療法の後、必要に応じて放射線療法を実施した。化学療法のみでの完全奏効率は25％にとどまったが、放射線療法を加えると全体の完全奏効率は64％に向上した。化学療法後残存腫瘤の切除は侵襲が大きいため、進行例には救援化学療法や放射線療法を行う経過観察が提案された。
pmid-1580039.summary_en: This Southwest Oncology Group study evaluated 28 patients with advanced seminoma treated from 1981 with two or three courses of vincristine, actinomycin-D, and cyclophosphamide, followed by radiotherapy for those not achieving complete response. Chemotherapy alone yielded a complete response in only 25 percent of patients, whereas radiation therapy raised the overall complete response rate to 64 percent. Given the morbidity of resecting postchemotherapy residual masses, the authors suggested observation with salvage chemotherapy and/or radiation for patients who progress.

pmid-1580153.summary_ja: 生後5か月の男児に生じた絨毛癌で、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生による思春期早発症を伴った症例の長期治療を報告している。文献上の乳児例13例はいずれも治療に成功していなかった。肝腫瘍の塞栓術、肺と顎下部病変への放射線療法、複数薬による化学療法、脾摘と肝葉切除を行い、その後高用量メルファランと自家骨髄移植を実施した。結果は部分的な成功であった。
pmid-1580153.summary_en: This report describes long-term management of a 5-month-old boy with precocious puberty caused by hCG production from a choriocarcinoma. Among 13 previously reported infantile cases, none had been successfully treated. The patient received embolization of a hepatic tumor, irradiation of lung and submandibular lesions, and chemotherapy with methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, and etoposide. Surgical resection was followed by high-dose melphalan with autologous marrow reinfusion. The outcome was partially successful.

pmid-1580318.summary_ja: セミノーマ成分を含む胚細胞腫瘍の患者に、前兆を伴う片頭痛が加速度的に出現した症例を報告している。胚細胞腫瘍に関連した同様の片頭痛の報告はこれまでになかった。著者らはこれを傍腫瘍症候群のまれな一例と考察している。腫瘍の治療ではなく神経症状に焦点を当てた臨床観察である。
pmid-1580318.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a germ cell tumor containing seminomatous elements who developed accelerated migraine with aura. Such migraine had not previously been described in association with germ cell tumors. The authors propose that this represents a rare paraneoplastic syndrome. The report focuses on the neurological manifestation rather than tumor treatment, offering a clinical observation that may help clinicians recognize similar presentations in future patients with germ cell tumors.

pmid-1582512.summary_ja: 末端肥大症の男性に、消失した精巣腫瘍に続発した後腹膜セミノーマを認めた症例報告です。精巣の超音波検査では腫瘤を認めず、組織学的に精巣は線維組織に置換され腫瘍細胞はありませんでした。成長ホルモン、プロラクチンの上昇とIL-2受容体陽性リンパ球の増加から、免疫活性の亢進が原発腫瘍の破壊に関与した可能性が推測されています。
pmid-1582512.summary_en: A case report describes an acromegalic man with a retroperitoneal seminoma that arose after his testicular tumor had completely disappeared. Testicular ultrasonography showed no mass, and histology revealed the testis replaced by fibrous tissue without neoplastic cells. Elevated growth hormone, elevated prolactin, and increased interleukin-2 receptor-positive lymphocytes suggested enhanced immune activity. The authors speculate that this immunological state may have contributed to destruction of the primary testicular tumor, a phenomenon known as burned-out testicular tumor.

pmid-1586509.summary_ja: 絨毛癌を例に、腫瘍マーカーとしてのヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を総説した。測定法は抗血清やモノクローナル抗体が認識するhCG断片に左右され、解釈には注意が必要である。胞状奇胎を含むhCG産生病変は自然消失から化学療法抵抗性までと幅広い。診断、予後判定、治療のモニタリング、フォローアップ中の再発検出における役割を概説し、病理と薬物動態の理解の重要性を強調する。
pmid-1586509.summary_en: A review of human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) as a tumour marker, using gestational choriocarcinoma as the model. It describes how hCG assays are complicated by antisera specificity and by the range of hCG fragments detected by monoclonal antibodies. The spectrum of hCG-producing lesions runs from self-terminating to chemoresistant disease, including hydatidiform mole. The authors outline hCG's roles in diagnosis, prognostication, monitoring treatment and detecting recurrence during follow-up, and stress the need to understand pathology and hCG pharmacokinetics for correct interpretation.

pmid-1586607.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマで精巣摘除後にサーベイランスを行った103例を解析した。中央値62か月の追跡で5年無再発率は82%、胚細胞腫瘍による死亡はなかった。再発の唯一有意な組織学的因子はリンパ管・脈管侵襲であった。再発の多くは傍大動脈リンパ節に限局し、8例が化学療法を受けた。リスク患者の同定が難しいため、サーベイランスは研究プロトコルにとどめるべきと結論している。
pmid-1586607.summary_en: An analysis of 103 patients managed by orchidectomy and surveillance for stage I testicular seminoma, followed for a median of 62 months. Seventeen relapsed, and the 5-year relapse-free probability was 82%, with no deaths from germ cell tumours. Lymphatic and vascular invasion was the only significant histological predictor of relapse. Most relapses were moderate-volume para-aortic nodal disease, and eight patients received chemotherapy. The authors conclude that surveillance should remain a research protocol because at-risk patients are hard to identify.

pmid-1586633.summary_ja: 1983年から1989年に治療された病期I・IIAの精巣セミノーマ27例を対象に、放射線療法の照射野を検討した。17例は傍大動脈領域のみへの照射を受けた。骨盤内再発はなく、長期合併症も認められなかった。リンパ管造影所見や孤立性骨盤リンパ節転移の稀少性から、傍大動脈のみの照射は合理的で、再発率を高めず合併症を減らしうると結論している。
pmid-1586633.summary_en: A retrospective report of 27 patients with stage I and IIA testicular seminoma treated after orchidectomy between 1983 and 1989. Seventeen received radiotherapy to the para-aortic region only, omitting pelvic fields. No pelvic recurrences occurred and no long-term complications were seen. Based on lymphangiogram findings and the rarity of isolated pelvic nodal disease, the authors argue that para-aortic-only irradiation is logical, should not raise the relapse rate, and may reduce complications.

pmid-1591745.summary_ja: 29歳女性の帝王切開で出生した双生児のうち、女児に仙尾部奇形腫(成熟奇形腫)が見つかった。単純X線とCTで骨盤と下肢の骨が確認された。手術で、未発達な下半身様の構造を含む成熟奇形腫(重量475g)と確認された。双生児は5年間フォローアップされ、神経学的機能は正常である。
pmid-1591745.summary_en: Report of a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma found at cesarean delivery of twins to a 29-year-old woman. The girl had a large benign teratoma containing pelvic and lower limb bones, visible on X-ray and CT. Surgery and histology confirmed a mature teratoma-tridermoma (475 g) containing an underdeveloped lower half of a human body. Both twins were followed for five years with normal neurological function.

pmid-1592864.summary_ja: 絨毛癌と胞状奇胎を含む妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍において、hCG/hLH受容体のmRNAとタンパク発現を正常胎盤や黄体などと比較しました。受容体の発現は絨毛癌で最も高く、胞状奇胎では増殖の程度に応じて増加しました。非絨毛性腫瘍では発現が認められませんでした。hCGが受容体を介して自己分泌的に絨毛細胞の増殖や浸潤を調節する可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-1592864.summary_en: This study examined expression of hCG/hLH receptors in gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, including hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinomas, compared with normal placenta, corpus luteum, and various nontrophoblastic tumors. Receptor mRNA and protein were detected in moles and choriocarcinomas, with the highest levels in choriocarcinoma, while nontrophoblastic tumors lacked receptor expression. Receptor immunostaining increased with the degree of trophoblast hyperplasia. The authors propose that hCG acts through these receptors as an autocrine regulator of trophoblast growth, invasion, and high hCG secretion.

pmid-1593702.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者で化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、郭清標本に奇形腫が認められた症例の報告です。郭清から2年後に腹腔内でデスモイド腫瘍が発見されました。奇形腫の再発は既知ですが、この状況でのデスモイド腫瘍の報告は初めてとされています。化学療法後に後腹膜郭清を受けた精巣がん患者の再発鑑別診断に、デスモイド腫瘍を含めるべきだと提言しています。
pmid-1593702.summary_en: This case report describes an intra-abdominal desmoid tumor found two years after post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in a testicular cancer patient whose lymphadenectomy specimen had shown teratoma. Recurrence of teratoma or carcinoma after such surgery is well recognized, but desmoid tumor had not previously been reported in this setting. The authors describe its characteristics and treatment considerations. They recommend including desmoid tumor in the differential diagnosis of recurrence in testicular cancer patients treated with post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy.

pmid-1602459.summary_ja: 繁殖目的で飼育されていたオスのヨザルに自然発生したセミノーマの症例報告です。左精巣が正常の2〜3倍に腫大しており、外科的に摘出されました。割面は軟らかく白色から淡灰色を呈していました。顕微鏡所見は、セミノーマに合致しました。飼育下の非ヒト霊長類に生じた精巣の胚細胞腫瘍として、比較病理学的に意義があります。
pmid-1602459.summary_en: This report describes a spontaneous seminoma in an adult male owl monkey (Aotus nancymae) maintained for breeding. The left testis, about two to three times normal size, was surgically removed after presenting as a soft, white to pale gray mass bulging above adjacent tissue. Microscopic examination showed tumor cell morphology consistent with seminoma. The report documents a naturally occurring testicular germ cell tumor in a captive nonhuman primate and is relevant to comparative germ cell tumor pathology.

pmid-1607150.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫10例の炎症性浸潤を免疫細胞化学的に検討した研究です。全例でTリンパ球が認められ、多くは腫瘍細胞と混在しながらγインターフェロン陽性でした。Bリンパ球は少数で、3例に胚中心が見られました。マクロファージは常染色標本で想定されるより多く、多くがαインターフェロンを発現していました。クラスII MHC抗原は主にマクロファージとB細胞領域に限られ、腫瘍細胞には発現していませんでした。
pmid-1607150.summary_en: This immunocytochemical study characterized the inflammatory infiltrate in 10 cases of ovarian dysgerminoma. T-lymphocytes were present in all tumors, often intermixed with neoplastic cells, and most were gamma interferon-immunoreactive. B-cells were sparse, although germinal centers appeared in three tumors. Macrophages were more numerous than routine sections suggested, and many expressed alpha interferon. Class II MHC antigens were mainly on macrophages and B-cell areas, and dysgerminoma cells did not express them. The findings describe the immune microenvironment of ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-1608358.summary_ja: 臓器移植を受けた糖尿病患者2例に臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマが発生した症例報告。1例は腎拒絶と抗菌薬による腎障害のため放射線療法を実施できず、もう1例は移植腎を遮蔽して放射線療法を行った。リンパ節構造の手術的変形が照射計画を複雑にした。移植患者では精巣摘除後の放射線療法を個別に検討すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-1608358.summary_en: Two transplant recipients with long-standing diabetes and renal transplants developed clinical stage I testicular seminoma, an uncommon combination given the rarity of seminoma in immunosuppressed patients. Radiotherapy decisions were difficult: one patient did not receive it because of kidney rejection and antibiotic-induced renal damage, while the other received radiotherapy with the transplanted kidney shielded. Surgical distortion of lymph node architecture complicated radiation planning. The authors conclude that postorchiectomy radiotherapy for seminoma in transplant patients should be individualized.

pmid-1610496.summary_ja: 妊娠23週の胎児に、頸部前方の大きな奇形腫による羊水過多と気管閉塞が認められた。早産に至り帝王切開で頭部と肩を娩出し、臍帯を保ったまま気管内挿管を行った。新生児は計画的な切除に備えて安定化されたが、咽頭出血と気管チューブ逸脱により死亡した。転帰は不良だったが、出生前に診断された気管閉塞に対する子宮内での気道確保の実現可能性を示した。
pmid-1610496.summary_en: A 23-week fetus with polyhydramnios and a large anterior cervical teratoma developed tracheal obstruction. Preterm labor led to cesarean delivery with the fetal head and shoulders exteriorized on an intact cord, allowing endotracheal intubation before cord division. The neonate was stabilized for planned resection but died after pharyngeal hemorrhage and tube dislodgement. The case shows the feasibility of in utero airway access for prenatally diagnosed tracheal obstruction, despite the poor outcome.

pmid-1610973.summary_ja: デンマークの男児コホートを用い、精巣がん183例と対照366例で出生順位との関連を検討した症例対照研究。出生順位が上がるほどリスクは低下し、第4子以降では精巣がん全体およびセミノーマのリスクが有意に低かった。社会階級や流行性耳下腺炎・麻疹の罹患時期との関連は認められなかった。小家族での若干のリスク上昇は出生順位と関連していると考えられた。
pmid-1610973.summary_en: Using a Danish cohort of boys born 1941-1957, this case-control study examined birth order and testicular cancer risk among 183 cases and 366 matched controls. Risk declined with increasing birth order (P = 0.020). Fourth or later-born children had markedly lower risk for all testicular cancer and seminoma. Socioeconomic class and childhood mumps or measles timing showed no association. A slightly raised risk in small families was attributed to its link with birth order.

pmid-1612803.summary_ja: 27歳女性が左房粘液腫の症状で受診したが、切除された心腔内腫瘤の病理検査で絨毛癌と判明した。左房内腫瘍として発症した絨毛癌の初報告とされる。悪性の絨毛癌が良性の心臓粘液腫に似た形で現れうること、また切除された心臓腫瘤には必ず組織学的検査を行うべきことを示している。
pmid-1612803.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman presented with symptoms of left atrial myxoma, but histopathology of the excised intracavitary mass revealed choriocarcinoma. The authors report this as the first description of choriocarcinoma presenting as a left atrial tumor. The case highlights that malignant gestational-type trophoblastic tumors can mimic benign cardiac myxomas, and emphasizes the importance of histological examination of any resected cardiac mass.

pmid-1612947.summary_ja: 子宮摘出術の5年後に肺転移と単発の大きな腎病変を呈した患者で、絨毛癌と診断された症例。妊娠性絨毛癌は化学療法への感受性が高く、原発巣が自然退縮して起源が不明瞭になることがある。原発部位の同定が困難であり、腎摘除術の前に組織診断を得ることの重要性を論じている。
pmid-1612947.summary_en: A patient previously treated by hysterectomy five years earlier presented with pulmonary metastases and a solitary large renal lesion, diagnosed as choriocarcinoma. Gestational choriocarcinoma is chemosensitive and may spontaneously regress at the primary site, which can obscure its origin. The authors discuss difficulties in establishing the primary site and stress that tissue diagnosis should be obtained before nephrectomy.

pmid-1613853.summary_ja: 2歳男児の陰茎原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍(卵黄嚢腫瘍)の症例報告。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値を示した。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンの併用化学療法により3サイクル以内に完全奏効を得た。診断後8か月時点で生存し無病である。陰茎における卵黄嚢腫瘍の初報告であり、この稀な部位での組織発生について考察している。
pmid-1613853.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with a primary extragonadal germ cell tumor of the penis, presenting as an endodermal sinus tumor with elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein. He responded to combination bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy, achieving complete response within three cycles. He remained alive and disease-free eight months after diagnosis. The authors state this is the first reported endodermal sinus tumor of the penis and discuss its possible histogenesis at this rare site.

pmid-1613886.summary_ja: セミノーマ14例、精巣悪性リンパ腫2例、正常精巣4例から糖脂質を抽出して比較した研究。グロボトリアオシルセラミドはセミノーマで顕著に蓄積していたが、精巣悪性リンパ腫では少量にとどまった。組織学的に鑑別が困難な症例があり、糖脂質発現パターンの解析が精巣腫瘍の鑑別診断を大きく助けると考えられる。
pmid-1613886.summary_en: This study biochemically extracted glycolipids from 14 seminoma specimens, 2 testicular malignant lymphomas and 4 normal testes. Globotriaosyl ceramide accumulated markedly in seminoma but was present only in small amounts in testicular lymphoma. Because seminoma and lymphoma can be difficult to distinguish histologically, especially with a high mitotic index, the authors propose that glycolipid expression profiling can greatly aid differential diagnosis of testicular tumors.

pmid-1615597.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術と放射線療法の後30年および9年で発生したセミノーマの晩期転移2例を報告。1例は後腹膜リンパ節と肺に転移し、もう1例はS状結腸と左尿管の閉塞を呈した。非典型的部位に生じた晩期転移について文献をレビューしている。治療には外科的切除、放射線療法、全身化学療法があり、既往の放射線療法の毒性を考慮する必要がある。
pmid-1615597.summary_en: This report describes late metastases of seminoma in two patients, occurring 30 and 9 years after orchiectomy and radiotherapy. One patient had retroperitoneal lymph node and lung involvement, while the other had obstruction of the sigmoid colon and left ureter. The authors review previously reported cases of late, atypically localized seminoma metastases. Management options include surgical removal, radiation therapy and systemic chemotherapy, and the toxicity of prior radiotherapy must be considered.

pmid-1615609.summary_ja: 家族性性腺腫瘍の3症例を報告。きょうだいでは胎児性癌と嚢胞性奇形腫が、父子では胎児性癌が認められた。遺伝学的検討は2症例で行われ、パラフィン包埋腫瘍のDNAフローサイトメトリーと体質核型解析を実施した。家族性性腺腫瘍におけるさらなる遺伝学的検討の必要性を強調している。
pmid-1615609.summary_en: Three cases of familial gonadal tumors are reported. In one family, a brother and sister had embryonal carcinoma and benign cystic teratoma respectively, and in another, a father and son had embryonal carcinoma. DNA flow cytometry of paraffin-embedded tumors and constitutional karyotyping were performed in two cases. The study emphasizes the need for further genetic studies in familial gonadal tumors.

pmid-1616524.summary_ja: 自動車事故による鈍的外傷が原因で、卵巣類皮嚢腫(奇形腫)が剥離・破裂した症例報告。初期所見は乏しく身体診察も正常だったが、その後重篤な出血を来し、積極的な循環血液量の補充を要した。CTにより破裂した卵巣類皮嚢腫と診断された。文献検索では同様の症例は報告されていなかった。
pmid-1616524.summary_en: This case report describes avulsion of an ovarian dermoid tumor caused by blunt trauma in a motor vehicle collision. The patient initially had an unimpressive presentation and normal physical examination, but later developed severe hemorrhage requiring aggressive volume resuscitation. Computed tomography eventually diagnosed a ruptured ovarian dermoid tumor. The authors found no similar previously reported cases in the literature review.

pmid-1617536.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた78例中、22%にあたる17例で術中の血管修復が必要であった。下大静脈の関与が最も多く、6例では腫瘍摘出のため下大静脈の全周または一部を切除した。腎動脈の偶発的損傷により3例で腎摘除術が施行された。下大静脈の修復または切除後も、長期的な下肢浮腫は生じなかった。
pmid-1617536.summary_en: This study reviews vascular injury and repair during retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in 78 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Vascular repair was required intraoperatively in 17 patients (22%), most often involving the vena cava. In six patients the inferior vena cava was resected in whole or part to remove tumor. Inadvertent renal artery injuries led to nephrectomy in three cases. Caval repair or resection did not cause long-term leg swelling.

pmid-1617644.summary_ja: 遠心溶出法で絨毛癌細胞株JArを細胞サイズごとに分画し、栄養膜細胞の分化段階の違いを検討した研究。大型の多核細胞で絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(CG)mRNAが最も高値を示し、その増加は転写レベルの制御によるものであった。メトトレキサートは分化を誘導し、CGαおよびβ転写産物を増加させて多核細胞を生じさせた。
pmid-1617644.summary_en: This study uses centrifugal elutriation to separate JAr choriocarcinoma cells by size and examine differences in trophoblast differentiation. Large multinucleated cells showed the highest chorionic gonadotropin mRNA levels, and this increase reflected transcriptional regulation.
