Methotrexate induced differentiation, increasing CG alpha and beta transcripts, shifting cell size and producing multinucleated cells. The multinucleated cells arose partly from karyokinesis without cytokinesis.

pmid-1619311.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫170例で術前後の血清CA19-9値を比較した研究。術前は高値で術後に低下し、腫瘍による産生が示唆された。免疫組織化学では気管支腺と表面上皮に局在を認め、嚢胞液中のCA19-9値は血清より高値であった。CA19-9は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の再発を検出する有用なマーカーと結論づけている。
pmid-1619311.summary_en: This study compares preoperative and postoperative serum CA19-9 levels in 170 patients with mature cystic teratoma. Preoperative levels were high and fell after surgery, suggesting tumor production. In CA19-9 positive cases, immunohistochemistry localized the marker to bronchial glands and surface epithelium, and cystic fluid levels exceeded serum levels, indicating two routes of release into blood. The authors conclude CA19-9 is a useful marker for detecting recurrence.

pmid-1622881.summary_ja: 1983年から1990年にかけてカルボプラチン単剤化学療法を受けた進行セミノーマ66例の再発部位を解析した研究。評価可能な再発14例中7例は、化学療法前に罹患していたリンパ節群またはその隣接部に限局していた。カルボプラチンを初回化学療法とすべきかは不明であり、用いる場合には化学療法後の局所補助放射線療法の役割が考えられる。
pmid-1622881.summary_en: This study analyzes relapse sites in 66 patients with advanced seminoma treated with single-agent carboplatin between 1983 and 1990. Of 14 evaluable relapses, seven were confined to nodal groups involved before chemotherapy or immediately adjacent to them. The authors question whether single-agent carboplatin should be initial chemotherapy for seminoma. If it is used, local adjuvant radiotherapy after carboplatin may have a role in management.

pmid-1625145.summary_ja: 5歳と14歳の女児2例で、卵巣奇形腫に腹膜神経膠腫症を伴った症例を報告しています。腹膜、大網、腸壁に成熟グリア組織からなる多数の転移結節が認められ、AFPとβ-hCGは正常でした。1例に化学療法が行われ、両例とも術後12か月と17か月で再発を認めず、保存的手術が妥当と結論づけています。
pmid-1625145.summary_en: This report describes two girls, aged 5 and 14, with ovarian teratoma and gliomatosis peritonei, in which numerous mature glial metastatic nodules were found on the peritoneum, omentum, and bowel wall. Serum alpha-fetoprotein and beta-hCG were normal. Surgical excision with omentectomy and appendectomy was performed, with chemotherapy given to one patient. Both remained free of recurrence at 12 and 17 months, and the authors argue for the benign nature of this condition and a conservative surgical approach.

pmid-1626001.summary_ja: 肝臓原発の純粋な絨毛癌の剖検例を報告しています。生前に診断されて化学療法を受けましたが、十分な効果は得られませんでした。著者らは既報の肝絨毛癌例を再検討し、この性腺外腫瘍の診断基準を提言しています。稀な性腺外原発の絨毛癌として、臨床と病理の両面から重要です。
pmid-1626001.summary_en: This paper reports a pure choriocarcinoma of the liver, studied at necropsy. The tumor was diagnosed while the patient was alive and treated with chemotherapy, but the response was unsatisfactory. The authors review previously reported hepatic choriocarcinoma cases and recommend diagnostic criteria for this extragonadal neoplasm. The report is relevant as a rare example of primary extragonadal choriocarcinoma with both clinical and pathological documentation.

pmid-1628374.summary_ja: 急性骨髄性白血病の経過中に精巣セミノーマが発見された症例の報告です。このような同時発症は既報がありません。寛解導入療法中の免疫抑制と陰嚢感染が、微小なセミノーマの急速な進行と転移を促した可能性が示唆されていますが、因果関係は証明されていません。
pmid-1628374.summary_en: This case report describes a patient in whom seminoma of the testis was diagnosed during the course of acute myelogenous leukemia, a simultaneous occurrence not previously described. Physical examination and ultrasound were initially normal. The authors suggest that immunosuppression and scrotal sepsis during induction therapy may have promoted rapid progression of a microscopic seminoma and metastasis, though a causal link was not established. The case highlights a potential interaction between hematologic malignancy treatment and germ cell tumor progression.

pmid-1631777.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫に前立腺上皮を認めた2例の症例報告。うち1例では移行上皮も伴っていた。前立腺が尿生殖洞に由来するという発生学的説が支持されるとし、局所ホルモン環境が女性尿路上皮からの前立腺組織形成に関与する可能性を提唱している。成人前立腺およびSkene腺との組織学的・免疫組織学的相違も論じられている。
pmid-1631777.summary_en: Two cases of benign cystic ovarian teratomas containing prostatic epithelium are reported, one with associated transitional epithelium. The findings support the embryologic origin of the prostate from the urogenital sinus. The authors propose that local hormonal influences may drive formation of prostatic tissue from female urothelium. They compare the histology and immunohistochemistry with adult prostate and female periurethral Skene's glands.

pmid-1633643.summary_ja: 核型45X/46XYのモザイク型ターナー症候群の8歳女児に両側性の性腺芽腫が生じた。一方、14歳時点で性腺芽腫のない45X/46XidicYの症例と比較された。蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションでYqの遠位蛍光部が確認され、パラフィン包埋組織のPCRで両例にY由来配列が検出された。蛍光を示すYq領域付近の配列が性腺芽腫の発生リスクに関与する可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-1633643.summary_en: An 8-year-old girl with mosaic Turner syndrome (45X/46XY) developed bilateral gonadoblastoma in rudimentary ovaries. A second mosaic (45X/46XidicY) without gonadoblastoma at age 14 was compared. Fluorescence and in situ hybridization showed the Y chromosome's distal fluorescent Yq segment in the first patient. PCR of paraffin-embedded gonadal tissue confirmed Y-derived sequences in both cases. The authors suggest that sequences near the fluorescent Yq region may contribute to gonadoblastoma risk.

pmid-1634128.summary_ja: 16歳女性が右卵巣に限局した純粋なディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に対し右卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた。1か月後、骨盤・腹部リンパ節腫大、腹膜播種、左乳房腫瘤と腋窩リンパ節転移が出現した。乳房腫瘤の細胞診で純粋なディスジャーミノーマが示唆された。上皮性卵巣癌の乳房転移は稀であり、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の乳房転移の報告はこれが初めてである。
pmid-1634128.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl underwent right salpingo-oophorectomy for a pure dysgerminoma confined to the right ovary. One month later she developed pelvic and abdominal lymphadenopathy, peritoneal carcinomatosis, and a left breast mass with axillary node involvement. Cytology of the breast mass suggested pure dysgerminoma. The authors note that breast metastases of epithelial ovarian carcinoma are uncommon, and this is the first reported breast metastasis of an ovarian dysgerminoma.

pmid-1634130.summary_ja: 30歳女性が悪性卵巣未熟奇形腫と診断され、手術と化学療法を受けた。2年後に肝転移が出現し多剤化学療法で治療された結果、成熟奇形腫様の形態へ変化した。初診から12年後、転移性腺癌へ悪性転化した。卵巣奇形腫は良性様の形態に分化しても、最終的に悪性転化により死に至りうることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-1634130.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman was diagnosed with malignant ovarian immature teratoma, treated with surgery and chemotherapy. Two years later hepatic metastasis appeared and was treated with multiagent chemotherapy, after which the disease appeared to mature. Twelve years after initial diagnosis, it underwent malignant transformation into metastatic adenocarcinoma. The authors emphasize that ovarian teratocarcinoma can differentiate into benign-appearing forms yet ultimately lead to death through malignant transformation.

pmid-1635147.summary_ja: 免疫抑制療法中の腎移植患者が精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術を受けた。外科的切除断端にセミノーマ細胞が認められたため、傍大動脈および鼠径部へ放射線療法が行われた。3年後、尿細胞診と膀胱生検で膀胱への転移再発が確認された。化学療法後は膀胱生検が正常となり完全寛解に至った。症例報告として転移経路の可能性が考察されている。
pmid-1635147.summary_en: A renal transplant recipient on immunosuppression underwent orchiectomy for testicular seminoma. Because the surgical resection plane contained seminoma cells, para-aortic and inguinal radiotherapy was given. Three years later, recurrence in the bladder was detected by urine cytology and confirmed by biopsy. After chemotherapy, repeated bladder biopsies were normal and complete remission was achieved. The authors discuss possible metastatic pathways.

pmid-1636351.summary_ja: 71歳女性に発症した原発性胃絨毛癌の稀な症例報告。心窩部痛と体重減少で受診し、内視鏡的擦過細胞診で奇怪な核と目立つ核小体を有する高度異型細胞を認めた。組織学的に純粋な絨毛癌と確定し、免疫組織化学でhCGとケラチンの発現を確認した。細胞診と免疫染色の組み合わせが本疾患の診断に有用であることを示している。
pmid-1636351.summary_en: This case report describes a 71-year-old woman with primary gastric choriocarcinoma, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting with epigastric pain and weight loss. Endoscopic brushing smears showed highly atypical malignant cells with bizarre nuclei and prominent nucleoli. Histology of multiple sections confirmed pure choriocarcinoma. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated hCG and keratin expression in the malignant cells, illustrating the value of cytology combined with immunostaining for diagnosing this rare entity.

pmid-1638483.summary_ja: 精巣の混合性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍において、転移挙動が異なる成熟奇形腫成分と絨毛癌成分を核型解析で比較した研究。両成分の染色体パターンはほぼ同一であった。転移能の差は微細な染色体変化、または分化系譜によるエピジェネティックな要因によると示唆された。絨毛癌成分は侵襲性が強く血管浸潤性であり、奇形腫成分は悪性度が低いとされる。
pmid-1638483.summary_en: This study karyotyped two histologically distinct components, a mature teratoma and a choriocarcinoma component, of a testicular mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor that differ in metastatic behavior. Both components displayed almost identical chromosomal patterns, suggesting that their different biological behavior may reflect subtle submicroscopic chromosomal differences or be determined largely by epigenetic lineage of differentiation. Trophoblastic differentiation was associated with an aggressive, angioinvasive phenotype, whereas teratoma differentiation showed low malignant potential.

pmid-1638839.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織が主体の希少な卵巣胚細胞腫瘍である、転移を伴う悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の2症例報告。画像診断と経過観察の難しさ、および治療方針の検討が限られた経験に基づく点を論じている。I-131は治療と経過観察の両方に有用と考えられた。疾患活動性の評価には生化学的検査がより信頼できる指標とされた。
pmid-1638839.summary_en: This report describes two patients with metastatic malignant struma ovarii, a rare ovarian germ cell tumor composed mainly of thyroid tissue. The authors discuss the difficulties of imaging and monitoring these tumors and the limited experience available to guide treatment. Iodine-131 was considered useful both therapeutically and for monitoring. However, biochemical testing was judged a more reliable indicator of disease status than imaging alone.

pmid-1640343.summary_ja: 1978年から1989年にスウェーデンで仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた34例のうち、25例で長期機能予後を評価した。排便習慣は60%で正常、40%で便失禁、16%で尿失禁を認めた。骨盤内と骨盤外の腫瘍位置で機能予後に差はなかった。後方視的には、機能障害が腫瘍増大によるか手術によるかを判断することは難しいとされた。
pmid-1640343.summary_en: This Swedish cohort reviewed 34 children operated for sacrococcygeal teratoma between 1978 and 1989, with 25 available for long-term functional follow-up. Bowel habits were normal in 60%, soiling occurred in 40% (several of them under 3 years of age and in diapers), and urinary incontinence in 16%. Anorectal manometry was mostly normal. Functional outcome did not differ between intrapelvic and extrapelvic tumor location. The authors note that it is difficult to determine whether dysfunction results from tumor growth or from surgery.

pmid-1640703.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣がんで化学療法後に2cm未満の残存腫瘍を認めた78例の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を検討した。逆行性射精を減らすため、両側郭清から片側郭清、神経温存手術へと術式を縮小した。片側および神経温存術式では射精機能を温存しつつ、術後合併症は許容範囲内であった。平均83か月の観察で再発は6例であった。
pmid-1640703.summary_en: This study reviews 78 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular cancer who underwent retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for postchemotherapy residual masses under 2 cm. To reduce dry ejaculation, the extent of dissection was progressively reduced from bilateral to unilateral and then nerve-sparing procedures. Histology showed mostly necrosis or fibrosis, with mature teratoma in 28% and viable tumor in 6%. Unilateral and nerve-sparing approaches preserved ejaculation with acceptable morbidity. Recurrence was uncommon after a mean follow-up of 83 months.

pmid-1644437.summary_ja: 180例の二次性ヒト卵黄嚢から、腸管型の異所性内胚葉管状構造を示す3例を解析しました。これらは腸や肺の形成に関わる初期の体細胞性内胚葉に類似しており、卵黄嚢腫瘍の構造とも類似していました。奇形腫の前駆体となる可能性も示唆されています。
pmid-1644437.summary_en: This study analyzed three secondary human yolk sacs from a series of 180 that showed heterotopic gut-type endodermal tubular structures. These structures resembled early somatic endoderm involved in gut and lung formation. The authors propose they arose either from sequestration in disorganized embryos or from differentiation of extraembryonic endoderm. They may be precursors of placental hepatic tissue and teratomas, and their resemblance to structures in yolk sac tumors further highlights the similarity between secondary yolk sacs and yolk sac tumors.

pmid-1644865.summary_ja: 胎児性癌モデルであるF9テラトカルチノーマ細胞を酪酸ナトリウムで分化誘導しました。酪酸ナトリウムは組織型（tPA）と尿酵素型（uPA）の両方のプラスミノーゲン活性化因子を産生させ、レチノイン酸とは異なる結果を示しました。
pmid-1644865.summary_en: This study examined F9 teratocarcinoma cells, a model of embryonal carcinoma, induced to differentiate with sodium butyrate. Unlike retinoic acid, which induces only tissue-type plasminogen activator (tPA), sodium butyrate induced both tPA and urokinase-type plasminogen activator (uPA). The membrane-associated uPA localizes its activity to the cell surface environment, which may contribute to the distinct morphology and characteristics of butyrate-differentiated F9 cells.

pmid-1727154.summary_ja: 脳と肺に転移した絨毛癌の症例で、腫瘍性動脈瘤による脳出血で発症しました。血腫除去と動脈瘤切除後に集中的な化学療法を行い、発症から6年間画像上の再発はありませんでした。転移巣の外科的切除と化学療法が予後改善に有用と結論づけています。
pmid-1727154.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with choriocarcinoma metastatic to the brain and lung who presented with cerebral hemorrhage from neoplastic aneurysms. After hematoma removal and resection of the aneurysms, the tumor was treated with prolonged intensive chemotherapy. The patient remained free of neuroimaging evidence of recurrence for six years after onset. The authors conclude that surgical resection of metastases followed by intensive chemotherapy may improve prognosis in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-1728224.summary_ja: 20歳女性の自然気胸が、絨毛癌の肺転移によるものであった症例です。自然気胸は通常は胸膜下の嚢胞性病変が原因ですが、肺転移も原因として考慮すべきであることを示しています。
pmid-1728224.summary_en: This report describes a 20-year-old woman whose spontaneous pneumothorax was caused by pulmonary metastasis from choriocarcinoma. Although spontaneous pneumothorax is usually due to subpleural apical blebs, metastasis to the lung should be considered as a cause. The case highlights that choriocarcinoma metastasis can initially present unexpectedly as a pneumothorax.

pmid-1729501.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマに対して後腹膜へ放射線療法を行った13年後に、後腹膜線維症が発見されました。尿管閉塞により腎臓1つを失い、同側腎摘除と対側尿管剥離術が必要になりました。精巣がんの放射線療法後の後腹膜線維症の初めての報告とされています。
pmid-1729501.summary_en: This report describes retroperitoneal fibrosis discovered 13 years after 3,000 rad external beam cobalt radiotherapy to the retroperitoneum for stage I testicular seminoma. Ureteral obstruction led to the loss of one kidney, requiring ipsilateral nephrectomy and contralateral ureterolysis. The author notes that this is the first reported case of retroperitoneal fibrosis after radiotherapy for testicular cancer.

pmid-1730420.summary_ja: 1950年から1985年の間に治療された卵巣未分化胚細胞腫23例で、フローサイトメトリーによりDNA含量を解析しました。異数性は19例に認められましたが、DNA含量は従来の予後因子以上には転帰を予測しませんでした。
pmid-1730420.summary_en: This study analyzed nuclear DNA content by flow cytometry in 23 cases of ovarian dysgerminoma treated at a single institution between 1950 and 1985. Five tumors were diploid and 19 were nondiploid. DNA content did not predict patient outcome better than conventional prognostic variables. The authors note that dysgerminoma is homologous to testicular seminoma and occurs in young women.

pmid-1733412.summary_ja: 出生後まもない新生児が呼吸困難を呈し、鼻咽頭の真性奇形腫が原因と判明した症例を報告している。小児奇形腫の大規模な症例集積を再検討し、この部位の奇形腫が稀であることを確認した。さらに症例報告を網羅的に調べ、真性奇形腫の基準を満たす症例の特徴を整理している。鼻咽頭奇形腫は類皮嚢胞、奇形腫様腫、真性奇形腫、胎児顔面奇形腫の4型に分けられ、類皮嚢胞が大多数を占める。
pmid-1733412.summary_en: A term neonate with respiratory distress was found to have a true teratoma of the nasopharynx, a rare extragonadal site. The authors reviewed large pediatric teratoma case series, confirming how rarely this site is involved, and then systematically identified case reports meeting true teratoma criteria and delineated their characteristics. Four nasopharyngeal teratoma types (dermoid, teratoid, true teratoma, epignathus) are distinguished, with dermoids comprising most cases.

pmid-1734222.summary_ja: 18歳男性が悪性組織球症による肝脾腫で受診し、卵黄嚢成分を伴う病期I精巣奇形癌腫と診断された。積極的な化学療法にもかかわらず、6か月後に組織球症で死亡した。剖検では胚細胞腫瘍の残存は認められなかった。悪性組織球症と精巣胎児性癌の同時発症の初報告であり、血液悪性腫瘍に伴う胚細胞腫瘍が性腺外のみに生じるわけではないことを示している。
pmid-1734222.summary_en: The authors describe an 18-year-old man who presented with hepatosplenomegaly from malignant histiocytosis and was found to have stage I testicular teratocarcinoma with endodermal sinus elements. Despite aggressive chemotherapy he died of histiocytosis six months later, and autopsy showed no residual germ cell tumor. This is the first report of simultaneous malignant histiocytosis and testicular embryonal carcinoma, showing that germ cell tumors linked to hematologic malignancy do not arise solely at extragonadal sites.

pmid-1734246.summary_ja: 同一卵巣内に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と卵巣妊娠が併存した症例を報告している。この組み合わせは極めて稀で、文献上は過去に2例しか見つからなかったとしている。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は最も頻度の高い胚細胞腫瘍で、主に生殖年齢の女性に発生する。著者らは本症例を提示し、この病態について考察している。卵巣妊娠は稀な異所性妊娠の一型である。
pmid-1734246.summary_en: The authors report an ovarian pregnancy coexisting with a mature cystic teratoma in the same ovary, a combination they note is exceedingly rare, with only two prior cases in the literature. Ovarian pregnancy is a rare ectopic gestation, and mature cystic teratoma is the most common germ cell tumor, usually occurring in reproductive-age women. The paper presents this single case and discusses the clinical entity.

pmid-1736982.summary_ja: 33歳男性が精巣腫瘍と傍大動脈リンパ節転移を呈し、当初はセミノーマが疑われた。精巣とリンパ節の組織像では著明な肉芽腫性変化がみられ、Kveim試験陽性によりサルコイドーシスと診断された。著者らは従来報告のない提示形式であるとし、細胞障害性治療を開始する前に悪性腫瘍の組織学的確認が不可欠であると強調している。
pmid-1736982.summary_en: A 33-year-old man presented with a testicular tumour and para-aortic lymph node metastasis, initially suspected to be seminoma. Histology of the testis and lymph node showed florid granulomatous change, and a positive Kveim test led to a diagnosis of sarcoidosis. The authors report this as a previously unreported presentation of sarcoidosis and stress that histological confirmation of malignancy is essential before cytotoxic therapy is started.

pmid-1737260.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者48例を、原発巣の脈管侵襲の有無で層別化した研究である。侵襲のない群は厳密なサーベイランスを受け、侵襲のある群はブレオマイシン・エトポシド・白金製剤による化学療法を2コース受けた。再発率は、サーベイランス群で3.8%、化学療法群で9%であった。平均36か月のフォローアップで95.8%が無病であった。
pmid-1737260.summary_en: The authors stratified 48 patients with stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours by vascular invasion in the primary tumour. Patients without invasion underwent surveillance, while those with invasion received two cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and platinum. Relapse rates were 3.8% in the surveillance group and 9% in the chemotherapy group, with a pooled rate of 6.2%. After a mean follow-up of 36 months, 95.8% of patients remained free of disease.

pmid-1737420.summary_ja: 新生児に生じた有茎性の鼻咽頭類皮嚢胞による間欠的かつ完全な気道閉塞の症例を報告している。新生児期に鼻咽頭病変が気道を閉塞する場合の鑑別診断を検討し、系統的な管理方針を提案した。類皮嚢胞は奇形腫の一型であり、性腺外に生じる稀な病変である。本報告は、新生児の気道閉塞の認識と管理に焦点を当てている。
pmid-1737420.summary_en: The authors present a newborn with intermittent, complete airway obstruction caused by a pedunculated nasopharyngeal dermoid. They discuss the differential diagnosis of obstructing nasopharyngeal lesions in the neonatal period and propose an organized management strategy. The report focuses on recognizing and managing neonatal airway obstruction from this teratoma-type lesion, which is a rare extragonadal tumor with important clinical consequences in neonates.

pmid-1739626.summary_ja: 英国家族性精巣がん登録から42家系、精巣腫瘍91例を報告しています。家系の患者は非家族性患者より診断年齢が有意に若く、兄弟の相対リスクは9.8と推定されました。HLAクラスI解析では、MHC領域に主要な易罹患遺伝子が存在する可能性は低いと結論づけています。
pmid-1739626.summary_en: This report from the UK Familial Testicular Cancer Register describes 42 families with two or more affected members, including 91 testicular tumors, of which about half were seminoma. Patients from families were diagnosed about 3.5 years younger than non-familial patients. The estimated relative risk for brothers was 9.8. HLA class I sib-pair analysis showed no sharing pattern suggesting a major predisposing gene in the MHC region.

pmid-1739633.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者54例で、神経特異的エノラーゼ(NSE)を血清腫瘍マーカーとして評価しました。病期Iおよび転移を有する患者の一部で術前に上昇し、病期I例では術後に正常化しました。転移例ではシスプラチン併用化学療法の効果を反映し、感度・特異度はhCGと同程度でモニタリングに有用と考えられます。
pmid-1739633.summary_en: This study assessed neuron-specific enolase (NSE) as a serum tumor marker in 54 patients with seminoma. NSE was elevated in a subset of stage I and metastatic patients before orchiectomy, and it normalized after surgery in all evaluated stage I cases. In metastatic patients on cisplatin-based chemotherapy, NSE tracked treatment response. Its sensitivity and specificity were comparable to hCG, suggesting value for monitoring.

pmid-1281113.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9とP19を用いた分化誘導の基礎研究です。未分化な状態ではラミンBが主で、レチノイン酸などで3日間処理するとラミンA/Cが発現しました。その調節は主に転写レベルで行われると結論しています。臨床腫瘍ではなく、発生モデルとして胎児性癌細胞を用いた研究です。
pmid-1281113.summary_en: This basic research study examines nuclear lamin A/C expression during in vitro differentiation of two embryonal carcinoma cell lines, F9 and P19. Undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cells express mainly lamin B. After three days of exposure to retinoic acid, with or without 3-isobutyl-1-methylxanthine, the cells began expressing lamins A and C at both mRNA and protein levels. The authors conclude that lamin A/C expression is regulated mainly at the transcriptional level and appears once cells have differentiated morphologically and functionally. Embryonal carcinoma cells are used here as a developmental model rather than as clinical tumor material.

pmid-1312020.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌由来細胞株Tera 2を用いて、塩基性線維芽細胞増殖因子（bFGF）の濃度が増殖と運動に与える影響を検討した基礎研究。低濃度は増殖を促進し、高濃度は主に細胞運動を促進した。bFGF受容体は高親和性と低親和性の2種類が示唆された。胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞の性質に関する研究であり、臨床研究ではない。
pmid-1312020.summary_en: This study examines how basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) concentration affects multiplication and locomotion of Tera 2 human teratocarcinoma cells grown in serum-free medium. Low concentrations stimulated proliferation, which protamine sulphate abolished, while high concentrations preferentially promoted cell movement. Scatchard analysis indicated both high- and low-affinity bFGF receptor classes. The work is basic cell biology using a germ cell tumor-derived cell line, without clinical data.

pmid-1312715.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9を、レチノイン酸(RA)、ジブチリルcAMP+テオフィリン(CT)、またはその併用で処理した。RAは原始内胚葉への分化を誘導し、トロンボモジュリンmRNAはほとんど検出されなかった。CTはRAより約4倍多くmRNAを増加させた。RA+CTは壁側内胚葉への分化を誘導し、mRNAを10〜12倍に相乗的に増加させた。転写レベルでの制御が示された。
pmid-1312715.summary_en: F9 embryonal carcinoma cells were treated with retinoic acid (RA), dibutyryl cAMP plus theophylline (CT), or both. RA induced primitive endoderm differentiation and barely detectable thrombomodulin mRNA. CT increased thrombomodulin mRNA about fourfold more than RA. RA plus CT drove parietal endoderm differentiation and synergistically increased thrombomodulin mRNA 10- to 12-fold. Nuclear run-on and transient expression assays indicate transcriptional control, with the RA receptor beta transactivating the human promoter. The cell line serves as a differentiation model rather than a study of patient tumors.

pmid-1316854.summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌細胞を用い、コレラ毒素、TPA、EGF、IGF-I、シクロヘキシミドがステロイド合成関連遺伝子P450sccとアドレノドキシンのmRNA量に与える影響を検討した。コレラ毒素はcAMP経路を介してP450scc mRNAを強く誘導し、TPAやEGFも弱い相乗効果を示した。シクロヘキシミドは両mRNAに逆方向の影響を与え、悪性トロホブラストにおいて両者は異なる機構で制御されると結論づけている。
pmid-1316854.summary_en: This study examined how cholera toxin, TPA, EGF, IGF-I, and cycloheximide regulate mRNA levels of the steroidogenic genes P450scc and adrenodoxin in cultured JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. Cholera toxin strongly increased P450scc mRNA, mainly through the cAMP pathway, with weaker contributions from protein kinase C and EGF signaling. Cycloheximide affected the two transcripts in opposite directions. The authors conclude that these mRNAs are differentially controlled in malignant trophoblasts. The choriocarcinoma line serves mainly as an experimental model.

pmid-1320576.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株P19はレチノイン酸で分化しますが、変異株RAC65は分化しません。RAC65では、C末端側71アミノ酸を欠く切断型のレチノイン酸受容体αを発現しており、これが優性阻害因子として働くことが原因でした。野生型のRARαを導入すると感受性が回復しました。主題は細胞の分化機構であり、患者の疾患研究ではありません。
pmid-1320576.summary_en: P19 embryonal carcinoma cells differentiate in response to retinoic acid, but the RAC65 variant does not. The study shows that RAC65 expresses a truncated retinoic acid receptor alpha lacking 71 C-terminal amino acids, probably from a transposon-like insertion. This truncated receptor binds the retinoic acid response element and acts as a dominant-negative repressor of RARβ activation. Restoring wild-type RARα restored retinoic acid sensitivity, establishing the defect as the cause of resistance.

pmid-1322335.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株P19の分化に対する白血病抑制因子(LIF)の作用を検討した。LIFは内胚葉・中胚葉系の分化を阻害したが、神経外胚葉系の分化は阻害しなかった。LIFはjun B mRNAを増加させた。
pmid-1322335.summary_en: This study tested whether leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) blocks differentiation of P19 embryonal carcinoma cells under different induction conditions. LIF inhibited endodermal and mesodermal differentiation, including skeletal and cardiac muscle, but not neuro-ectodermal differentiation into neurons and astroglia. Thus P19 differentiation divides into LIF-sensitive and LIF-insensitive pathways. LIF did not alter mRNA levels of several differentiation-related genes but markedly increased jun B expression.

pmid-1323493.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株と初期マウス胚におけるスタスミンの発現を解析した。未分化な多分化能細胞で高発現し、分化に伴って低下した。増殖速度ではなく分化に関連した変化である。胚盤胞の内部細胞塊でも高発現であった。
pmid-1323493.summary_en: This study examined stathmin, a cytoplasmic phosphoprotein, in embryonal carcinoma cell lines and early mouse embryos. Stathmin was highly expressed in undifferentiated multipotential F9, 1003, and 1009 cells. Its expression fell when F9 cells differentiated with retinoic acid and dibutyryl-cAMP, and it was also low in trophectodermal and committed derivative lines. The decrease tracked differentiation rather than proliferation. Stathmin was likewise high in inner cell mass cells of the blastula, suggesting it may be a marker of multipotential cells.

pmid-1333844.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来の栄養膜様細胞株BeWoを用い、TGF-β受容体の結合特性を解析した。TGF-β1と2は同程度の親和性を示し、主にIII型/ベータグリカン受容体が結合に関与した。さらに新規の38kDa結合糖タンパク質を同定し、メトトレキサートによる分化誘導で増加した。研究は胎盤栄養膜の生物学のモデルとして細胞株を用いており、臨床的な絨毛癌を扱ったものではない。
pmid-1333844.summary_en: This study characterizes TGF-beta receptors on BeWo cells, an established human choriocarcinoma trophoblast line. Scatchard and affinity-labeling analyses show similar affinities for TGF-beta1 and TGF-beta2 and predominant type III/betaglycan receptors, along with a novel 38-kDa binding glycoprotein. The 38-kDa protein is upregulated after methotrexate-induced differentiation. The cell line is used as a model of placental trophoblast biology, not to study clinical choriocarcinoma, so the paper's relevance to gestational trophoblastic disease is uncertain.

pmid-1371113.summary_ja: 胎盤組織と絨毛癌細胞株を用いて、in vivoで転写されているCGβ遺伝子を同定しました。6つのCGβ遺伝子のうち少なくとも5つ、場合によっては全てが転写されていました。以前は偽遺伝子とされていたCGβ1およびCGβ2からも転写産物が検出され、選択的スプライシングにより翻訳能を持つ可能性が示されました。主題はhCG遺伝子の生物学であり、絨毛癌細胞株は材料の一つです。
pmid-1371113.summary_en: This study identified which chorionic gonadotropin beta (CGβ) genes are transcribed in vivo, using RT-PCR on placental tissue and a choriocarcinoma cell line. Transcripts from five and possibly all six genes were detected, with CGβ5 the most highly expressed. Transcripts from the CGβ1 and CGβ2 genes, previously considered pseudogenes, were found and appear translation-competent through alternative splicing. The work mainly addresses hCG gene biology, with the choriocarcinoma line serving as one RNA source.

pmid-1372527.summary_ja: 生細胞上の膜結合型hCG、そのサブユニットおよびフラグメントを定量するフローサイトメトリー法を開発した論文です。二抗体反応を用いた抗体の選定と品質管理を検討し、絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞などで発現を確認しました。腫瘍マーカーhCGの測定法が主題で、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍研究ではありません。
pmid-1372527.summary_en: This study develops a quantitative flow cytometry method to detect membrane-associated human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), its subunits, and fragments on living cancer cells. It uses a double-antibody reaction with validated monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies, with HeLa cells as an hCG-producing quality control. Choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells were analyzed, and many cancer cells expressed these sialoglycoproteins. The work is primarily methodological and concerns hCG as a tumor marker, with choriocarcinoma cells as one of several test systems rather than a clinical germ cell tumor study.

pmid-1374031.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoが産生するhCG-βサブユニットの糖鎖構造を解析した研究です。正常尿由来のhCG-βと比べて三本鎖糖鎖やバイセクティングGlcNAcが多く、新規のO型糖鎖も同定されました。腫瘍マーカーhCGの生化学的特徴が主題で、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍治療を扱うものではありません。
pmid-1374031.summary_en: This study characterizes N-linked and O-linked carbohydrate chains of the hCG beta subunit produced by the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line. Structural analysis using NMR and chromatography revealed more triantennary chains, higher alpha1-6 fucosylation, a bisecting GlcNAc, and alpha2-6-linked sialic acid than in normal urinary hCG beta. Two novel O-glycans were also identified. The work is primarily biochemical, using a cell line as the hCG source, and does not address clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-1383035.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞P19から得た変異株RAC65を親株と比較し、レチノイン酸による分化応答を調べた基礎研究です。RAC65ではレチノイン酸受容体αの欠陥などにより、CRABP遺伝子の発現低下と核内への取り込み増加が見られました。臨床的な腫瘍の挙動は扱っていません。
pmid-1383035.summary_en: This basic study compares RAC65, a mutant embryonal carcinoma clone derived from mouse P19 cells, with its parental line in response to retinoic acid. RAC65 fails to differentiate terminally, which is attributed to a truncated retinoic acid receptor alpha. The authors also find a defect in RAR alpha mRNA that may reflect RNA splicing, reduced CRABP mRNA induction after treatment, and altered nuclear retinoic acid binding. Together these suggest increased nuclear flow of retinoic acid. The work addresses embryonal carcinoma differentiation biology rather than clinical tumour behaviour.

pmid-1385214.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC7-Mz1を神経発生のモデルとして用い、レチノイン酸受容体のα1、α2、β2アイソフォームの発現を解析した基礎研究。α1は恒常的に発現し、α2はレチノイン酸投与で持続的に誘導され、β2は一過性にしか誘導されなかった。分化能の異なる変異株でも比較されており、臨床のGCT患者を対象とした研究ではない。
pmid-1385214.summary_en: Mouse embryonal carcinoma cell line PCC7-Mz1 is used as a model of neural development. Northern blot analysis examined the expression of retinoic acid receptor isoforms alpha1, alpha2 and beta2 in uninduced and retinoic acid-induced cells and in variants with different developmental potential. Alpha1 was constitutive, alpha2 was induced and sustained, and beta2 was only transiently induced. The study concerns retinoid signaling in differentiation rather than germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-1385460.summary_ja: 表面にデスモソームを欠くF9胎児性癌細胞を、胚性上皮の発生モデルとして用いた基礎研究。レチノイン酸による上皮分化の前後でデスモソーム構成タンパク質の局在を調べた。ケラチン線維がデスモソームタンパク質の細胞表面への輸送を助ける可能性が示唆された。GCT患者を対象としたものではない。
pmid-1385460.summary_en: F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, which lack surface desmosomes and keratin filaments, were used as a model of embryonic epithelial development. The study examined desmoplakins, desmoglein I and plakoglobin before and after retinoic acid-induced epithelial differentiation. Desmosomal proteins became organized into desmosome-like structures, suggesting that keratin filaments may help transport these proteins to the cell surface. The focus is desmosome assembly, not germ cell tumors.

pmid-1437064.summary_ja: 新生児の口腔底に生じた先天性類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。腸型上皮で裏装された微小囊胞形成と、ムチン組織化学所見を考察している。口腔底の類皮嚢腫は発生由来の病変であり、胚細胞腫瘍としての位置づけは明確ではない。組織学的特徴の記載が本論文の主な意義である。
pmid-1437064.summary_en: A case report describes a congenital dermoid cyst on the floor of the mouth in a newborn. The authors discuss microcyst formation lined by intestinal-type epithelium and mucin histochemistry findings. Because oral dermoid cysts are developmental lesions rather than germ cell tumors, relevance to this site is uncertain. The paper's significance lies in its histologic description of gastrointestinal-type epithelium within a dermoid cyst.

pmid-1446786.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JARによる甲状腺ホルモンT3の膜輸送を解析した。取り込みは時間依存的で、非飽和成分と飽和性の単一機構（Km 586 nM）からなり、温度・細胞内エネルギー・膜電位に依存し、Na+勾配には依存しなかった。正常ヒト栄養膜細胞と類似した値であり、腫瘍細胞株は疾患そのものではなく生理学的モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-1446786.summary_en: This study characterizes the uptake of triiodothyronine (T3) by JAR, a human choriocarcinoma cell line. Uptake was time-dependent, with about 24% non-saturable and a single saturable mechanism (Km 586 nM). It depended on temperature and cellular energy and was independent of the sodium gradient but sensitive to membrane potential. The values resembled those in cultured normal human trophoblast cells, supporting JAR as a model of placental thyroid hormone transport. The tumor line is used as a physiological model rather than studied as a disease.

pmid-1449187.summary_ja: 14か月の女児に生じた広範な中耳皮様嚢腫の症例報告と文献レビューである。皮様嚢腫や奇形腫は頭頸部に多いが、中耳や側頭骨での発生はまれである。本稿は臨床像と治療の経過を詳述し、関連文献を整理している。胚細胞腫瘍としての位置づけは、病変の発生起源の解釈に依存する。
pmid-1449187.summary_en: This case report describes an extensive dermoid tumor of the middle ear in a 14-month-old girl. Dermoids and teratomas are common in the head and neck but rarely occur in the middle ear or temporal bone. The paper details the clinical presentation and management and reviews the literature on this entity. Its relevance to germ cell tumors depends on the interpretation of the lesion's origin, which is not established here.

pmid-1451960.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌細胞株（F9、PCC4、P19）と胚性幹細胞株BLC6における小型熱ショックタンパク質hsp25の発現を比較した。hsp25はP19・BLC6が分化すると、長期培養、レチノイン酸処理、胚様体形成によって増加する。著者らはこれを分化マーカーとして提案している。本研究は患者の腫瘍ではなく、胚性癌細胞株を分化モデルとして用いている。
pmid-1451960.summary_en: This paper examines the small heat shock protein hsp25 in murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) and embryonic stem cell lines. hsp25 is constitutively present in F9 cells and absent in PCC4 and in undifferentiated P19 and BLC6 cells, but it accumulates when P19 and BLC6 cells differentiate through prolonged culture, retinoic acid treatment, or embryoid body formation. The authors propose hsp25 as a differentiation marker. The study uses EC lines as differentiation models rather than investigating tumors in patients.

pmid-1451963.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞の分化に対する細胞外基質の影響を検討した。コラーゲン、ラミニン、フィブロネクチン、Matrigelなどを平面コーティングではなく三次元構造で提示すると、細胞は円形コロニーを形成して増殖が低下し、絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの分泌は最大10倍に増加した。プロゲステロンとアルカリホスファターゼは不均一な反応を示し、接着には影響がなかった。基質の組成だけでなく三次元構造が分化を制御することが示された。
pmid-1451963.summary_en: This study examines how three-dimensional extracellular matrix structures influence differentiation of BeWo human choriocarcinoma cells. When matrix molecules such as collagen, laminin, fibronectin, Matrigel, or placental matrix were presented as 3D structures rather than flat coatings, cells formed rounded colonies, proliferation decreased, and chorionic gonadotropin secretion rose up to tenfold. Progesterone and alkaline phosphatase responses were variable, and adhesion was unaffected. The findings show that matrix architecture, not just composition, regulates differentiation in tumor-derived trophoblast cells.

pmid-1455234.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍のモデルであるF9奇形癌細胞を用い、Gαi2が原始内胚葉への分化を制御することを示した基礎研究。レチノイン酸処理でGαi2が減少し、アンチセンスによる抑制で分化様の表現型と増殖時間の短縮が生じた。活性型変異体はレチノイン酸による分化を阻害した。
pmid-1455234.summary_en: This study examines how the G protein subunit Gαi2 regulates differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma cells, a model of embryonal carcinoma, into primitive endoderm. Gαi2 protein decreases during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Antisense reduction of Gαi2 induces an endoderm-like phenotype without retinoic acid, reduces receptor-mediated inhibition of adenylyl cyclase, shortens doubling time, and increases tissue-type plasminogen activator. A constitutively active mutant blocks retinoic acid-induced differentiation, suggesting that Gαi2 controls stem cell differentiation and growth.

pmid-1458477.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性の小細胞肺がん株と胎児性癌株（Tera-CP）を用い、7種類の白金製剤に対する細胞内グルタチオンの関与を検討した基礎研究。グルタチオン量は感受性と相関したが、BSOによる修飾効果は細胞株や薬剤により予測困難であった。シスプラチン耐性の克服はシスプラチンとエンロプラチンに限られた。
pmid-1458477.summary_en: This study examines how cellular glutathione affects sensitivity to and resistance against seven platinum compounds. Experiments used a cisplatin-resistant small cell lung cancer line and a cisplatin-resistant embryonal carcinoma line (Tera-CP) with their parental lines. Glutathione levels correlated with drug sensitivity, but glutathione depletion by BSO modulated resistance unpredictably, varying by cell line and platinum compound. Reversal of cisplatin resistance was achieved only for cisplatin and enloplatin.

pmid-1461650.summary_ja: 温度感受性変異を持つF9奇形癌細胞の分化における、c-mycとp53遺伝子発現を検討した基礎研究。分化誘導可能な変異株では、温度シフト後にc-mycとp53のmRNAが一過性に減少し、c-junは急速に誘導された。p53 mRNAは分化可能な変異株でのみ特異的に増加し、増殖から分化への移行における両遺伝子の異なる役割が示唆された。
pmid-1461650.summary_en: This study examines c-myc and p53 gene expression during differentiation of temperature-sensitive mutants of F9 teratocarcinoma cells. In differentiation-inducible mutants, both c-myc and p53 mRNA transiently decreased after the temperature shift, while c-jun was rapidly induced. A non-inducible mutant did not show these changes. p53 mRNA specifically increased in the inducible mutants. The authors propose distinct roles for p53 and c-myc in the transition of teratocarcinoma stem cells from proliferation to differentiation.

pmid-1462780.summary_ja: 中耳および乳突蜂巣に生じた、きわめて稀な類皮腫（毛髪性ポリープ）の症例報告。画像、手術、組織所見を検討し、類皮嚢腫と奇形腫の鑑別について考察している。側頭骨領域でこれらの腫瘍が稀であることも述べられている。耳科医が鑑別診断を考えるうえで参考になる報告である。
pmid-1462780.summary_en: This report describes a rare dermoid tumour of the middle ear and mastoid cavity, termed a hairy polyp, in an unusual location. The radiological, surgical, and histological features are discussed. The authors comment on distinguishing dermoid cysts from teratomas and note how scarce both tumours are in the temporal bone area. Given the rarity of such lesions in the temporal bone, the report provides a useful reference for otologists considering this differential diagnosis.

pmid-1467987.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株P19をレチノイン酸で神経細胞へ誘導し、微小管関連タンパク質(MAPs)の発現時間経過を解析した基礎研究。初期MAPは12時間後、後期MAPは3～5日後に出現し、生体内の神経細胞に類似した発現パターンを示した。P19は神経分化におけるMAPの研究に有用なモデル系であると結論づけている。
pmid-1467987.summary_en: This basic study examines the chronological expression of microtubule-associated proteins (MAPs) in murine embryonal carcinoma P19 cells induced into neural cells with retinoic acid. Early MAPs (pMAP1B, MAP2C) appeared at 12 hours and late MAPs (MAP1A, MAP2A/B) at 3 to 5 days, resembling in vivo neural development. The authors propose P19 as a good model for studying MAP expression during neuronal differentiation. The work uses a germ cell tumor-derived cell line as a model rather than studying the tumor itself.

pmid-1469254.summary_ja: 新生児の後頭部脳瘤(髄膜脳瘤)の修復術中に、脳瘤内に発生した類皮嚢腫が偶然発見された症例報告。この組み合わせの報告は初めてとされる。類皮嚢腫は奇形腫の亜型に分類されることがあるが、本例は先天性の神経管閉鎖障害に伴う病変である。
pmid-1469254.summary_en: The authors report a neonate with a dermoid cyst arising within an occipital encephalocele, discovered during routine repair of a meningoencephalocele. The lesion was an unexpected intraoperative finding. The authors state this is the first described association of an occipital encephalocele with a dermoid cyst. The report is a brief case description focused on the operative discovery, without follow-up or treatment detail. Its relevance to germ cell tumors is limited because the dermoid is a congenital inclusion lesion within a neural tube defect.

pmid-1472012.summary_ja: 培養ヒト絨毛癌細胞株BeWoと子宮頸癌細胞株HeLaを比較し、NBMPR感受性ヌクレオシド輸送を解析した生化学研究。BeWoは高い輸送能と多数の結合部位を有し、エリスロサイト型輸送体の高発現が示唆された。腫瘍の臨床的挙動ではなく、細胞株を輸送機構の実験モデルとして用いた研究である。
pmid-1472012.summary_en: The authors characterize nitrobenzylthioinosine (NBMPR)-sensitive nucleoside transport in cultured human choriocarcinoma BeWo cells, compared with HeLa cervical carcinoma cells. BeWo cells have about 27 million NBMPR-binding sites per cell in two affinity populations, and thymidine transport Vmax values 20 to 30 times higher than HeLa. The authors attribute this to high expression of erythrocyte-like transport elements. The work uses the choriocarcinoma cell line as a biochemical model of nucleoside transport rather than studying the tumor's clinical behavior.

pmid-1472059.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株の分化過程における補体成分と補体受容体のmRNA発現を検討した基礎研究。C2、C3、C4、C5およびCR1、CR2の転写産物が検出され、C3、C4、CR1は恒常的に発現していた。発生過程の炎症を制御する分子機構としての補体系の関与を論じている。
pmid-1472059.summary_en: The authors examined mRNA expression of complement components and receptors during differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cell lines, motivated by constitutive TNF expression in early embryos. Transcripts for C2, C3, C4, C5, and the receptors CR1 and CR2 were detected, with C3, C4, and CR1 expressed constitutively. Scavenger receptors SR-I and SR-II were negative. The authors discuss complement-mediated ontogenic inflammation as a regulatory mechanism during embryonal development at the molecular level.

pmid-1479325.summary_ja: ロンドンの6病院で行った症例対照研究で、良性上皮性卵巣腫瘍、機能性嚢胞、類皮嚢腫の女性と対照132例の生殖・避妊・月経因子を比較した。未経産と不妊は上皮性腫瘍のリスクを高め、多産はリスクを下げた。直近の経口避妊薬使用は3種すべてのリスクを下げた。類皮嚢腫は良性の胚細胞腫瘍だが、本研究の主題は良性卵巣腫瘍全般である。
pmid-1479325.summary_en: This case-control study in six London hospitals compared reproductive, contraceptive and menstrual factors among women with benign epithelial ovarian neoplasms, functional cysts, and dermoid cysts, with 132 controls. Nulliparity and infertility increased risk of epithelial neoplasms, while multiparity reduced it. Infertility and pelvic inflammatory disease raised risk for functional and dermoid cysts. Recent oral contraceptive use lowered risk for all three tumor types. The authors conclude that the etiology of benign cysts and epithelial neoplasms may differ, though benign and malignant epithelial tumors may share risk factors.

pmid-1550961.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸とcAMPで壁側内胚葉へ分化させ、BMP-2およびBMP-4の発現変化を検討した。BMP-2 mRNAは約11倍に増加し、BMP-4は約12倍に減少した。外因性BMP-2はレチノイン酸処理細胞にのみ増殖と形態の変化をもたらした。レチノイン酸がBMPを制御し、BMPは着床前胚発生にも関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1550961.summary_en: F9 embryonal carcinoma cells were used to examine how retinoic acid and cAMP induce differentiation into parietal endoderm. BMP-2 mRNA rose about 11-fold and BMP-4 mRNA fell about 12-fold during this process. Exogenous recombinant BMP-2 altered growth and morphology only in retinoic acid-treated cells and changed the abundance of several transcripts, including BMP-2 and BMP-4 themselves. The authors suggest that retinoic acid may regulate these osteoinductive proteins and that BMPs may participate in preimplantation embryogenesis.

pmid-1562551.summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌をヌードマウスに移植したモデルで、非ステロイド性アロマターゼ阻害薬R 83 842およびR 76 713の効果を検討した。腫瘍を有するマウスでは子宮重量が増加し、腫瘍内アロマターゼがアンドロゲンをエストロゲンに変換することが示された。経口投与により子宮重量と腫瘍内アロマターゼ活性は用量依存的に低下した。絨毛癌は薬理評価の実験系として用いられており、臨床的な管理を扱う研究ではない。
pmid-1562551.summary_en: The authors tested the non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor R 83 842, the dextro isomer of R 76 713, in ovariectomized nude mice bearing JEG-3 choriocarcinoma xenografts. Tumor-bearing mice showed increased uterine weight, indicating that tumor aromatase converts androgens to estrogens. Oral R 76 713 and R 83 842 reduced uterine weight and suppressed tumor aromatase activity in a dose-dependent manner, with 94% inhibition at 5 mg/kg. The choriocarcinoma line serves mainly as an aromatase-expressing model; the study focuses on pharmacology rather than the tumor's clinical management.

pmid-1563935.summary_ja: 新生児に舌下の甲状舌管嚢胞と類皮嚢腫が同時に発生した稀な症例を報告している。正中部という非典型的な部位で両者が共存しており、両病変の胚発生学的な関連性を考察している。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫の亜型とみなされることがあるが、本論文の主題は先天性頭頸部奇形であり、生殖細胞腫瘍の生物学や腫瘍学的管理は扱っていない。
pmid-1563935.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a sublingual thyroglossal duct cyst and a dermoid cyst occurring together in the midline, an unusual anatomic location. The authors present the clinical findings and discuss a possible embryologic association between these two congenital midline lesions, which have traditionally been explained by different developmental mechanisms. Dermoid cysts are often regarded as mature teratoma variants, so the paper touches the teratoma spectrum, though it focuses on congenital head and neck anomalies rather than germ cell tumor biology or oncologic management.

pmid-1569949.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞が壁側内胚葉へ分化する過程で、PEA3結合蛋白の発現がどう変化するかを調べた分子生物学研究である。約91kDaの蛋白(PEA3-91)が分化に伴い減少することを示した。c-ets-1およびc-ets-2の産物とは一致せず、ショウジョウバエE74Aに対する抗血清と反応する約92kDa蛋白に類似する発現パターンを示した。PEA3-91はマウスE74相同分子の可能性がある。
pmid-1569949.summary_en: This molecular biology study examines PEA3-binding proteins during differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Using UV cross-linking and mobility shift assays, the authors identify a roughly 91-kDa protein (PEA3-91) whose expression falls when F9 cells differentiate into parietal endoderm. The protein does not correspond to c-ets-1 or c-ets-2 products, as neither mRNA nor antiserum matched. Instead, an antiserum against Drosophila E74A recognized a related 92-kDa protein with a similar expression pattern, suggesting PEA3-91 may be a murine homolog of the Drosophila E74 gene.

pmid-1570119.summary_ja: 25歳男性の正中舌下に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。頭頸部では稀であり、口腔底に生じることはさらにまれである。正中矢状切開から嚢腫を無傷で摘出し、経過は良好であった。病理組織学的に皮膚付属器、平滑筋、角化重層扁平上皮の裏打ちが確認され診断された。成熟奇形腫の亜型とみなされることもあるが、主題は良性先天性病変の口腔外科的治療である。
pmid-1570119.summary_en: This dental journal report describes a median sublingual dermoid cyst in a 25-year-old man. Such cysts are uncommon in the head and neck and rare in the floor of the mouth. The cyst was enucleated intact through a midline sagittal incision, with uneventful healing. Histological examination showed a wall containing skin appendages, smooth muscle, and a lining of keratinized stratified squamous epithelium, confirming the diagnosis. Because dermoid cysts are often classified as mature teratoma variants, the case touches the teratoma spectrum, though its focus is oral surgical management of a benign congenital lesion.

pmid-1601186.summary_ja: 胚性癌細胞株であるマウスF9細胞を卵黄嚢内胚葉様細胞へ分化させ、微絨毛を構成するビリン、フィンブリン、ミオシンIの発現と局在を調べた研究です。ビリンは4日目に出現し、6日目には側底面にも分布しました。先端部への集積は整った微絨毛の形成と相関し、ビリンの転写産物はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の発現時期と一致しました。腸管と卵黄嚢上皮に共通する微絨毛形成の機構を示唆しています。
pmid-1601186.summary_en: This study examines expression and localization of villin, fimbrin, and myosin I in mouse F9 embryonal carcinoma cells induced to differentiate into visceral endoderm. Villin appeared at day 4 and moved from the apical to the basolateral surface by day 6, while fimbrin and myosin I were present in undifferentiated cells and became apical after villin. Apical accumulation correlated with organized microvilli, and villin transcripts coincided with the visceral endoderm marker alpha-fetoprotein. The authors propose that the ordered localization of these proteins directs microvillus assembly in gut and yolk sac epithelium.

pmid-1606039.summary_ja: アンドロゲン受容体とは別のアンドロゲン結合タンパクであるMTBPが、絨毛癌由来細胞株JEG-3とヒト胎盤の両方に存在することを示した研究です。どちらにおいてもMTBPは核内に局在し、DNase I抵抗性のクロマチンと強く結合していました。絨毛癌細胞は実験モデルとして使われており、腫瘍生物学や臨床管理は扱われていません。
pmid-1606039.summary_en: This study shows that the methyltrienolone binding protein (MTBP), an androgen-binding protein distinct from the androgen receptor, is present in the human choriocarcinoma cell line JEG-3 as well as in human placenta. In both sources, MTBP was located exclusively in the nucleus and was tightly associated with DNase I-resistant chromatin. The findings concern nuclear localization and chromatin binding of a steroid-binding protein. Choriocarcinoma cells serve as an experimental model rather than a clinical subject, and tumor biology or patient management is not addressed.

pmid-1623557.summary_ja: 非活性化マクロファージが胚由来奇形癌細胞(F9、P19、PCC4)を選択的に殺傷する機序を検討した研究です。標的細胞はマクロファージに生きたまま貪食され、リソソーム依存的に細胞内で殺傷されます。殺傷はH-2抗原の欠如では説明できず、臨床の精巣・性腺外胚細胞腫瘍のデータを含まない前臨床のマウス免疫学研究です。
pmid-1623557.summary_en: This study examines why nonactivated murine macrophages kill embryo-derived teratocarcinoma cells such as F9, P19, and PCC4 while sparing many other tumor cells. The authors found that these cells are phagocytosed alive and destroyed intracellularly through a lysosome-dependent process. Killing was not explained by absence of H-2 (MHC class I) antigen, since H-2-expressing differentiated F9 and P19 cells and fusion hybrids were still killed, whereas H-2-negative testicular 402AX teratocarcinoma and melanoma cells resisted. The work is preclinical murine immunology, with no clinical germ cell tumor data.

pmid-1633114.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞（主にP19細胞）をレチノイン酸で分化誘導した際の上皮成長因子受容体（EGF-R）遺伝子発現を解析した基礎研究。分化に伴いmRNAとタンパク質が増加し、その要因として転写物の安定性と転写活性の軽度な変化が示された。細胞表面のEGF-Rが分化状態の維持に関与する正のフィードバック機構が提唱されている。
pmid-1633114.summary_en: This study examines epidermal growth factor receptor (EGF-R) gene expression during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma cells, mainly P19 cells. Receptor mRNA and protein rise sharply upon differentiation toward neural and glial lineages, with transcript levels increasing 35 to 70-fold. Analyses of mRNA and protein stability, along with nuclear run-on transcription assays, suggest that both post-transcriptional stability and modest transcriptional changes contribute. The authors propose a feedback loop in which surface EGF-R sustains differentiation.

pmid-1727699.summary_ja: ラットの絨毛癌細胞（Rcho）を腎被膜下に移植すると、夜間のプロラクチン分泌サージやセロトニン誘導性分泌が抑制されました。胎盤性ラクトゲンの分泌が、妊娠中期以降のプロラクチン分泌の消失に関わる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-1727699.summary_en: This study examined how pregnancy and rat choriocarcinoma (Rcho) cells affect serotonin- and TRH-induced prolactin release in rats. Rcho cells, which secrete placental lactogen I, were implanted beneath the kidney capsule and suppressed nocturnal prolactin surges and serotonin-induced prolactin release. TRH-induced release was not affected. The authors suggest that placental lactogens may antagonize the stimuli that drive prolactin surges in early pregnancy.

pmid-1727811.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株NUC1を胎盤モデルとして用い、TNFαがhCG分泌を抑制することを示しました。hCGβ mRNAの発現も低下し、細胞毒性によるものではありませんでした。TNFαが栄養膜細胞のhCG産生を直接調節することが示唆されます。
pmid-1727811.summary_en: This study showed that tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) reduces hCG secretion in normal chorionic villi and in the NUC1 choriocarcinoma cell line, used as an in vitro placental model. TNF-alpha decreased hCG secretion and hCG beta mRNA expression, and the effect was not due to cytotoxicity. The findings suggest TNF-alpha directly modulates trophoblast hCG production.

pmid-37281561.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で誘導したF9マウス胚性癌細胞の内胚葉分化過程で、アルカリホスファターゼの活性と発現を検討した。活性は著明に上昇し、4日目にはII型が主要な型となった。αフェトプロテインなどの内胚葉マーカーも発現が誘導された。mRNAの増加は活性上昇に先行し、翻訳後調節の関与が示唆された。
pmid-37281561.summary_en: This study investigates alkaline phosphatase (ALPase) changes in F9 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells during endodermal differentiation induced by retinoic acid. ALPase specific activity rose markedly, and treated cells expressed both type I and type II isozymes, with type II becoming dominant by day 4. Endoderm-specific transcripts, including alpha-fetoprotein, type IV collagen, and laminin B1, were induced. Expression of L/B/K/P-type ALPase mRNA preceded the increase in enzyme activity, suggesting translational or post-translational regulation.

pmid-1281302.summary_ja: c-jun遺伝子の両対立遺伝子を欠損させたマウスES細胞を作製し、増殖・分化・腫瘍形成能を検討した研究です。in vitroでは影響は見られませんでしたが、同系マウスへの皮下移植では奇形癌の形成が著しく減少しました。生体内での効率的な腫瘍増殖にはc-Junの機能が必須と結論しています。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学に関連するモデルですが、主題は転写因子の機能解析です。
pmid-1281302.summary_en: This study generated mouse embryonic stem cell lines lacking both copies of the c-jun gene to examine its role in growth, differentiation, AP-1 activity, and tumorigenicity. Loss of c-jun did not affect viability, growth rate, or in vitro differentiation, and AP-1 reporter activity was maintained. However, when injected subcutaneously into syngeneic mice, c-Jun-deficient cells formed far fewer teratocarcinomas. The authors propose that other Jun proteins compensate for c-Jun in vitro, while functional c-Jun is essential for efficient tumor growth in vivo. The teratocarcinoma assay relates to germ cell tumor biology, but the paper is primarily about transcription factor function.

pmid-1337368.summary_ja: クアラルンプール総合病院での2年間の後方視的研究で、卵巣腫瘍280例を分類しました。良性腫瘍では奇形腫が最も多く、中国系の患者では転移性腫瘍と胚細胞腫瘍の頻度が高いことが示されました。卵巣腫瘍全体の分布を示す研究であり、胚細胞腫瘍はその一部です。
pmid-1337368.summary_en: This two-year retrospective study of 280 ovarian tumour cases at General Hospital, Kuala Lumpur, classified lesions as benign, malignant or borderline. Serous and mucinous tumours were prominent, and teratomas were the commonest benign tumour among Malay and Chinese patients. Chinese patients had a higher incidence of metastatic and germ cell tumours, while Malays showed more malignant epithelial tumours. Endometrioid tumours presented earlier, around age thirty. Germ cell tumours form one component of a broad ovarian tumour spectrum.

pmid-1402172.summary_ja: 近畿大学病院で手術された縦隔腫瘍24例のうち、嚢胞性病変9例を検討した。内訳は胸腺嚢胞5例、奇形腫3例、心膜嚢胞1例。胸腺嚢胞は平滑な壁と水様内容を示し、奇形腫は嚢胞と充実成分が混在し壁厚が不均一であった。奇形腫1例は胸膜腔へ破裂し、膵組織由来の消化酵素による自己融解が一因と推測された。術前画像による縦隔嚢胞性病変の鑑別がテーマである。
pmid-1402172.summary_en: This Japanese series reviewed 24 mediastinal tumors operated at Kinki University Hospital, of which nine were cystic: five thymic cysts, three teratomas, and one pericardial cyst. Thymic cysts had smooth walls and water-density contents, while teratomas showed mixed cystic and solid components with irregular wall thickness. One teratoma ruptured into the pleural cavity, possibly due to pancreatic digestive enzymes causing autolysis. Pericardial cysts were typically found at the cardiophrenic angle. The paper focuses on imaging differentiation of mediastinal cystic lesions.

pmid-1418418.summary_ja: ラット絨毛癌と胎盤の細胞性栄養膜細胞を認識するモノクローナル抗体22H6を報告する。他の腫瘍にはほとんど反応せず、成体では肝細胞と小腸上皮に限られる。補体依存性細胞傷害は示さなかった。ラット栄養膜細胞の良性・悪性双方の唯一のマーカーとして提唱されている。
pmid-1418418.summary_en: This study describes a monoclonal antibody, 22H6, that recognizes a cytotrophoblast antigen. It reacts with cytotrophoblasts of rat choriocarcinoma and placental junctional zone cells, but not with most other tumors, and is absent from most adult normal organs except hepatocytes and small intestinal epithelium. The antibody is not cytotoxic in complement-dependent assays. The authors propose it as the only known marker of benign and malignant rat cytotrophoblast. The primary focus is antigen characterization rather than tumor management.

pmid-1429826.summary_ja: 雌ラットを1か月齢、3か月齢、14〜16か月齢で両側卵巣摘出し、片側卵巣を脾臓へ自家移植して卵巣腫瘍の発生を調べた動物実験である。腫瘍発生率は生後1か月での手術で最も高かった。ディスジャーミノーマは若齢群のみで見られた。年齢が腫瘍の組織発生に影響すると考察している。
pmid-1429826.summary_en: Female rats were ovariectomized at 1, 3, or 14-16 months, and one ovary was autografted into the spleen to study age-related ovarian tumour development. Tumour incidence was highest after surgery at one month, and Sertoli and Leydig cell tumours increased with age. Dysgerminomas and luteomas appeared only in the young group, suggesting that age and gonadotropic response influence tumour histogenesis.

pmid-1438925.summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘍の患者を対象に、MRIとCTの診断能を後方視的に比較した。奇形腫は9例中7例でMRIに特徴的な所見が認められ、CTでは8例中5例が正しく診断された。悪性腫瘍9例はすべてMRIで正しく悪性と判定された。全体としてはほぼ同等の情報が得られたが、一部の症例ではMRIのみが悪性度や特異的診断に関する情報を提供した。
pmid-1438925.summary_en: This retrospective comparison assessed MRI and CT in patients with anterior mediastinal tumors (28 MR and 25 CT studies). Seven of nine teratomas showed characteristic MRI findings, versus five of eight on CT. Both modalities provided nearly equal information overall, but in some cases only MRI gave information about malignancy or a specific diagnosis. All nine malignant tumors were correctly identified as malignant on MRI.

pmid-1450620.summary_ja: 非腫瘍性疾患に対する低用量メトトレキサート治療中に悪性腫瘍を発症した3例の報告である。膀胱尿路上皮癌、治療開始16か月後に診断された悪性奇形腫、皮膚扁平上皮癌が含まれる。悪性奇形腫の症例は4か月後に死亡した。因果関係は証明されていないが、厳格な治療基準、綿密な監視、前向き研究の必要性が指摘されている。
pmid-1450620.summary_en: This report describes three patients who developed malignancies during low-dose methotrexate therapy for non-oncologic conditions. The cases included urothelial carcinoma of the bladder, a malignant teratoma diagnosed 16 months after starting methotrexate, and cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. The malignant teratoma patient died of rapid progression within four months. The authors do not claim causation but call for strict treatment criteria, close surveillance, and prospective studies of long-term low-dose methotrexate.

pmid-1469546.summary_ja: 乳児の腹部腫瘤として稀な胎児内胎児(fetus in fetu)の症例報告。単卵性二羽膜性双胎の取り込みが原因と考えられ、肝臓右葉内での発生は初めての報告とされる。奇形腫とは、脊柱軸や四肢芽などを備えた胎児様構造の有無で区別される。文献的考察も含む。
pmid-1469546.summary_en: This case report describes fetus in fetu, a rare cause of abdominal mass in infancy thought to arise from an included monozygotic diamniotic twin. The lesion was found in the right lobe of the liver, a site not previously reported. The authors distinguish it from teratoma, which lacks a vertebral axis with limb buds or appropriately situated bones or organs. The paper also reviews the literature on sites of occurrence, including the upper retroperitoneum, pelvis, ileal mesentery, cranial cavity, and scrotum.

pmid-1470607.summary_ja: 妊娠各期および妊娠関連疾患の絨毛におけるGal α1-3Gal抗原の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌では高侵襲性絨毛で染色性が増強し、自然流産やXO型モノソミーでは低下していた。抗Gal抗体は妊娠初期や子癇前症で上昇し、絨毛の侵襲能を制御する役割が示唆された。
pmid-1470607.summary_en: The authors examined expression of galactose alpha1-3 galactose (Gal alpha1-3 Gal) on human trophoblast across normal pregnancy and pathological conditions. Staining was increased in highly invasive trophoblast from molar pregnancy and choriocarcinoma, and decreased in spontaneous abortion and XO monosomy. Anti-Gal antibody titers rose in early pregnancy and in pre-eclampsia and eclampsia. The findings suggest Gal alpha1-3 Gal may mark trophoblast invasive capacity and that maternal anti-Gal antibodies may help limit excessive trophoblast invasion during implantation.

pmid-1526504.summary_ja: 本研究は婦人科腫瘍医への調査により、治療後無病の婦人科悪性腫瘍患者のフォローアップ計画を検討したものである。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍マーカーとCA-125は、以前に上昇していた場合に5年間測定された。対象は婦人科悪性腫瘍全般であり、胚細胞腫瘍は一部の項目として扱われている。
pmid-1526504.summary_en: This 1992 survey of gynecologic oncologists defines a follow-up schedule for asymptomatic, disease-free patients after treatment of gynecologic malignancies. Visits were recommended every 3 months in the first year, then at longer intervals, with annual visits after five years. Ovarian germ cell tumor markers and CA-125 were measured during the first five years only if previously elevated. The study covers gynecologic cancers broadly, and germ cell tumors are only a minor part of the findings.

pmid-1529129.summary_ja: 本総説は、非腫瘍性と腫瘍性の卵巣腫瘤について画像と病理の対応を解説したものである。成熟奇形腫は脂肪・軟部組織・石灰化を伴う嚢胞性で、主に充実性の未熟奇形腫と超音波で区別される。転移性疾患は頻度が低いが他の腫瘤に類似することがある。卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断が主題である。
pmid-1529129.summary_en: This 1992 Radiographics review correlates imaging and pathology in ovarian masses, both nonneoplastic and neoplastic. It describes ultrasound features of functional cysts, surface epithelial tumors, and sex cord-stromal tumors. Mature teratomas are typically cystic with fat, soft tissue, and calcium, and differ sonographically from immature teratomas, which are mostly solid. Metastatic disease is less common and may mimic other masses. The paper focuses on differential diagnosis across ovarian mass types.

pmid-1551943.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍を含む悪性疾患患者10例(12周期)で、凍結融解精子を用いた体外受精・胚移植を行った。受精率は排卵前卵子の60%で、4例が妊娠に至った。精巣腫瘍患者の成績は最も不良で、非罹患精巣の配偶子形成機能低下が示唆された。精子バンクと体外受精・胚移植は、悪性疾患患者の生殖能力の温存に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-1551943.summary_en: This study reports IVF and embryo transfer outcomes using cryopreserved and thawed sperm from 10 patients (12 cycles) with malignancies, including seminoma and testicular carcinoma. Fertilization occurred when swim-up recovered sufficient motile sperm, and the fertilization rate of preovulatory oocytes was 60%. Four patients achieved pregnancy. Patients with testicular neoplasms had the poorest outcomes, suggesting impaired gametogenesis in the unaffected testis. Sperm banking followed by IVF and embryo transfer may help preserve reproductive capacity in patients with malignancy.

pmid-1583782.summary_ja: 東海卵巣癌研究グループが1974〜1985年に治療した悪性卵巣腫瘍約1,000例を解析しました。全病期で5年生存率が約20%改善しています。40歳未満の若年者、漿液性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍で予後改善が顕著でした。胚細胞腫瘍としての扱いは、主に上皮性悪性腫瘍の中の一組織型にとどまります。
pmid-1583782.summary_en: This Japanese study analyzes about 1,000 malignant ovarian tumors, including borderline cases, treated by the Tokai Ovarian Cancer Study Group between 1974 and 1985. The 5-year survival rate improved by about 20% over time across all stages. Progression was most evident in patients under 40 and in serous carcinoma and yolk sac tumor. The paper also reviews changes in autopsy findings and treatment by specialty. Germ cell content is limited to yolk sac tumor as one histologic subgroup among mainly epithelial ovarian malignancies.

pmid-1583785.summary_ja: 悪性・境界悪性・良性卵巣腫瘍と良性子宮疾患の血清腫瘍マーカーを測定し、診断能を比較しました。CA125は感度が高く、CA72-4は特異度に優れていました。複数マーカーの併用は有効ではありませんでした。ディスジャーミノーマ7例ではLDHが著明に上昇しており、早期悪性腫瘍におけるBFPの有用性も示唆されています。
pmid-1583785.summary_en: This study measured CA125, CA19-9, TPA, CA72-4, BFP and LDH in 148 malignant, 41 borderline, and 71 benign ovarian tumors, and in 64 benign uterine disease cases. Using ROC-derived cut-offs, CA125 was the most sensitive marker, while CA72-4 showed high specificity. Combined marker assays were not effective. Seven dysgerminomas showed markedly elevated LDH, and BFP was suggested to be useful for early malignant tumors. The authors propose tumor marker assays to help determine malignancy and histology before surgery.

pmid-1729791.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘤の内部で血液と脂肪を区別するために、脂肪抑制像と水抑制像のMR画像を評価しました。出血性病変は両画像で脂肪と異なる信号を示し、脂肪を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫4例は脂肪と同様の信号を示しました。鑑別診断に有用とされています。
pmid-1729791.summary_en: This study evaluated lipid- and water-suppression MR images for distinguishing blood from lipid within ovarian masses in 16 patients with 21 lesions. Hemorrhagic lesions were brighter than fat on lipid-suppression images and darker on water-suppression images, while the four lipid-containing mature cystic teratomas resembled fat on both. These techniques allowed accurate distinction and may be useful in the differential diagnosis of ovarian masses.

pmid-28305580.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を高頻度に発生するLTXBOマウス由来の単為発生細胞の発生能を、凝集キメラを用いて検討した。腫瘍組織には栄養膜成分が多く見られるが、単為発生細胞は栄養膜組織への寄与を示さなかった。一方で形態異常が高頻度にみられ、単為発生細胞が催奇形性作用を持つことが示唆された。
pmid-28305580.summary_en: This study examined the developmental potential of parthenogenetic cells derived from LTXBO mice, a strain that frequently develops ovarian teratomas. Because these tumors arise from parthenogenetically activated oocytes, trophoblast formation would not be expected, yet trophoblast-rich elements are common in the tumors. Using aggregation chimeras, the authors found no contribution of parthenogenetic cells to trophoblast tissues. However, morphological abnormalities were frequent, suggesting a teratogenic effect of the parthenogenetic cells.

pmid-1645268.summary_ja: 本報告は、growing teratoma syndromeを発症した、転移性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の精巣症例4例の放射線学的所見を示す。腫瘍マーカーが正常であったにもかかわらず、化学療法中に転移巣が増大し、残存腫瘤は悪性細胞を含まない成熟奇形腫であった。1例では肺結節の空洞化が認められた。著者らは、診断およびフォローアップにはCTが最も優れた手法であると結論づけている。
pmid-1645268.summary_en: This report presents radiologic findings in four patients with metastatic mixed germ cell tumors of the testis who developed growing teratoma syndrome. Metastases enlarged during chemotherapy despite normal tumor markers, and residual masses showed mature teratoma without malignant cells. One patient had cavitation of a pulmonary nodule, a rarely described finding. The authors conclude that CT is the best modality for diagnosis and follow-up.

pmid-1645564.summary_ja: 1971年から1984年のイングランドおよびウェールズの全国がん登録データを用いて、卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍を年齢、経時的推移、地域分布の観点から解析しています。奇形腫とディスジャーミノーマはいずれも15〜19歳に発生ピークを示し、65〜69歳にも奇形腫を主体とする二次的ピークがあります。奇形腫の発生率は若年層で増加し高齢層で減少し、ディスジャーミノーマは変化がありませんでした。これらの傾向は精巣がんの疫学に類似し、性別ごとのゴナドトロピン値の推移と並行していると考察されています。
pmid-1645564.summary_en: Using England and Wales national cancer register data from 1971 to 1984, this study analyzes ovarian germ cell cancers by age, time trends, and geography. Teratomas and dysgerminomas both peak at ages 15-19, and a second peak at 65-69 is mainly teratomas. Teratoma incidence has risen at younger ages but fallen at older ages, while dysgerminoma incidence was stable. The age and trend patterns resemble testicular cancer epidemiology and parallel sex-specific gonadotropin profiles.

pmid-1645819.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍44例を抗神経特異エノラーゼ抗体で免疫染色し、9例では手術前後の血清NSE値を測定しました。NSEはほとんどのセミノーマや多くの胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍の一部、奇形腫成分で陽性でした。血清NSE値は多くのセミノーマ症例で術前に高く、術後に低下しました。NSE染色は組織診断の補助に、血清NSEは経過観察や診断に有用な可能性があるとしています。
pmid-1645819.summary_en: This study examined neuron-specific enolase (NSE) in 44 testicular germ cell tumors by immunohistochemistry and measured serum NSE in nine patients before and after tumor removal. NSE was detected in most seminomas, many embryonal carcinomas and yolk sac tumors, and teratomatous components. Serum NSE was elevated before surgery and fell afterward in most seminoma cases. The authors suggest NSE staining may aid histologic diagnosis and serum NSE may help monitor disease course and diagnose seminoma.

pmid-1646453.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍と精細管内悪性胚細胞に対し、抗胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ抗体と抗セミノーマ単クローナル抗体M2Aを用いた免疫染色を比較しています。PLAPはセミノーマと胎児性癌の両方を染色しましたが、M2Aはセミノーマと精細管内悪性胚細胞を染色し、胎児性癌は染色しませんでした。セミノーマは胎児性癌よりも精細管内悪性胚細胞に近縁と考えられ、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生起源の理解に示唆を与えています。
pmid-1646453.summary_en: This study compares immunoperoxidase staining of testicular germ cell tumors and intratubular malignant germ cells using antibody to placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and a monoclonal anti-seminoma antibody, M2A. PLAP stained seminomas and embryonal carcinomas, while M2A stained seminomas and intratubular malignant germ cells but not embryonal carcinomas. The authors suggest seminomas are more closely related to intratubular malignant germ cells than to embryonal carcinomas, offering insight into testicular germ cell tumor histogenesis.

pmid-1646683.summary_ja: 本研究はオーストラリア・ビクトリア州の精巣がん発生率を1950年から1985年まで検討した。組織学的に確認された症例と登録データを用い、発生率は約2.9倍に上昇した。セミノーマと非セミノーマの両方で増加が認められ、非セミノーマでは若年層への移行が顕著であった。他のオーストラリア州でも同様の上昇が報告された。
pmid-1646683.summary_en: This registry-based study examined testicular cancer incidence in Victoria, Australia, from 1950 to 1985 using 1116 histologically checked cases and later registry data. Incidence rose nearly threefold, from 1.44 to 4.16 per 100,000. Rises were seen for both seminoma and nonseminoma, with nonseminomas increasingly affecting younger age groups. Cohort analysis supported these trends, and comparable increases were found in other Australian states.

pmid-1647564.summary_ja: OTT6050奇形癌腫由来の胚様体を同系マウスの腹腔内に移植し、5、7、9日後の増殖とラミニン・フィブロネクチン発現を検討した。ラミニンは嚢胞型と単純型の両方で内胚葉細胞に強く発現したが、フィブロネクチンの発現はわずかであった。本モデルは細胞外基質タンパク質の研究に有用と結論された。
pmid-1647564.summary_en: Embryoid bodies derived from the OTT6050 teratocarcinoma were injected intraperitoneally into isogenic mice, and their growth and extracellular matrix expression were studied at 5, 7 and 9 days. Laminin was strongly expressed on endodermal cells in both cystic and simple embryoid bodies, while fibronectin expression was only slight. The authors conclude that this in vivo model is useful for studying extracellular matrix proteins in embryogenesis and tumorigenesis.

pmid-1648634.summary_ja: 急性骨髄単球性白血病の診断から約3年後に精巣の胎児性癌を発症した症例を報告した。患者は放射線療法もアルキル化剤も受けていなかったため、二次性悪性腫瘍と考えられた。考えられる寄与因子について考察している。血液悪性腫瘍と続発する胚細胞腫瘍との関連を示す症例である。
pmid-1648634.summary_en: The authors describe a patient who developed testicular embryonal carcinoma about three years after being diagnosed with acute myelomonocytic leukemia. The patient had received neither irradiation nor alkylating agents, which makes the tumor likely a secondary malignancy. The report discusses possible contributing factors for the development of this second cancer. This case highlights the potential link between hematologic malignancy and subsequent germ cell tumors.

pmid-1648998.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞癌の転移巣が治療後に成熟奇形腫へ変化し、その内部に平滑筋肉腫が生じた症例を報告した。肉腫の出現は治療から18年後で、放射線誘発性と考えられた。奇形腫由来病変は通常は良性経過をたどるが、悪性転化が起こり得ることを示す症例である。
pmid-1648998.summary_en: The authors describe a leiomyosarcoma arising within a mature teratoma that had been present as a metastasis from nonseminomatous germ cell carcinoma of the testis. Chemotherapy had converted the metastatic embryonal carcinoma into mature teratoma. The sarcomatous component appeared 18 years after therapy and was judged likely to be radiation-induced. Such lesions usually follow a benign course, but this case shows malignant transformation can occur.

pmid-1649776.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、遺伝子マーカー解析により母性染色体1組と父性染色体2組と確認された部分胞状奇胎に続いて絨毛性腫瘍を発症した症例を記述している。フォローアップ中、血清hCGは持続的に高値であった。化学療法前の採取標本は妊娠性絨毛癌が疑われる形態を示した。部分奇胎が非胞状流産よりも妊娠性絨毛癌のリスクを高めるかは不明であり、持続性疾患の検出のために連続的なhCG測定が重要であると強調している。
pmid-1649776.summary_en: This case report describes a partial hydatidiform mole, confirmed by genetic marker analysis as one maternal and two paternal chromosome sets, followed by a subsequent trophoblastic tumor. Serum hCG remained persistently elevated during follow-up. Curettage specimens obtained before chemotherapy were morphologically suspicious for gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors note that it remains uncertain whether partial mole carries a higher risk of gestational choriocarcinoma than non-molar abortion, and emphasize careful serial hCG monitoring to detect persistent disease.

pmid-1649880.summary_ja: 妊娠初期の正常栄養膜細胞と胞状奇胎由来栄養膜細胞を用い、増殖因子の効果を検討した研究である。正常栄養膜細胞はEGF・PDGF・インスリン・GM-CSFの併用で強く増殖し、奇胎由来細胞はEGFやインスリンで増殖が促進された。両細胞とも長期培養が可能となった。妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株GCH-1は増殖因子に反応しなかった。
pmid-1649880.summary_en: This study examined how growth factors affect long-term cultures of normal first-trimester trophoblasts and molar trophoblasts from hydatidiform moles. Normal trophoblasts responded strongly to a combination of EGF, PDGF, insulin and GM-CSF, while molar trophoblasts were stimulated by EGF or insulin. Both cell types were maintained for many months and were identified as trophoblasts by CAM 5.2 staining. The gestational choriocarcinoma line GCH-1 did not respond to any growth factor and served as a comparator.

pmid-1649925.summary_ja: 化学療法後の大きな転移を伴う非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清時に下大静脈切除または腫瘍栓摘出を行った42例の報告である。適応は腫瘍の遺残除去、瘢痕閉塞、下大静脈腫瘍栓の3つであった。静脈壁の病理はリンパ節病理を反映し、合併症は概ね一過性であった。化学療法の選択肢を使い果たした患者での生存率は71%であり、侵襲的手術の妥当性を示した。
pmid-1649925.summary_en: This report analyzes 42 patients who underwent inferior vena cava resection or intraluminal tumor thrombectomy during retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for bulky metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after chemotherapy. Indications were tumor clearance, caval scar occlusion, and caval tumor thrombus. Pathology of the resected vena cava mirrored nodal pathology, and complications were generally transient. The 71% survival rate, achieved in patients who had exhausted chemotherapy options, is presented as justification for this intensive surgical approach.

pmid-1651526.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の48例を後方視的に検討し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤における悪性所見や奇形腫の有無を、CT所見と初発病理所見で除外できるかを評価しました。腫瘤サイズや縮小率などのCT所見では予測できず、画像・病理所見のみで残存悪性腫瘍や奇形腫を確実に除外することはできないと結論づけています。
pmid-1651526.summary_en: This retrospective study of 48 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumors evaluated whether CT features and initial pathology can exclude malignancy or teratoma in residual masses resected after chemotherapy. Neither residual mass size, attenuation, shrinkage during treatment, nor primary tumor cell type reliably predicted residual histology. Among nine patients with both a teratoma-free primary and over 90 percent shrinkage, two had malignancy and two had teratoma. The authors conclude that radiographic and pathologic features cannot reliably exclude residual malignancy or teratoma after chemotherapy for nonseminomatous testicular cancer, underscoring the need for resection of residual masses.

pmid-1651828.summary_ja: 1972年から1985年にかけて治療された絨毛癌と侵入奇胎の209例を解析した報告です。主に5-FUおよびKSMを用いた化学療法が行われ、絨毛癌の死亡率は84.3%から32.7%に、侵入奇胎では32.4%から8.1%に低下しました。回復後に妊娠した患者の子どもはすべて正常に成長しています。
pmid-1651828.summary_en: This Chinese Medical Journal report reviews choriocarcinoma and invasive mole treated at one hospital from 1948 to 1985, focusing on 209 cases from 1972 to 1985. A 5-FU and/or KSM regimen was the main treatment. Metastases were present in over 90 percent of choriocarcinoma cases, and mortality fell from 84.3 to 32.7 percent for choriocarcinoma and from 32.4 to 8.1 percent for invasive mole. Many chemotherapy-treated survivors later conceived, and all their children were normal and healthy.

pmid-1651992.summary_ja: 一次治療でシスプラチンに失敗した転移性胚細胞腫瘍の30例に、PEI(シスプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミド)によるサルベージ療法を行った研究です。約3分の1で完全寛解が得られ、先行治療への反応良好例で成績が良好でした。主な用量制限毒性は骨髄抑制でした。
pmid-1651992.summary_en: This 1991 Journal of Clinical Oncology study evaluated salvage therapy with cisplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide (PEI) in 30 patients with metastatic germ cell carcinoma that progressed after first-line cisplatin. Ten patients (33 percent) became tumor-free, and response to prior cisplatin predicted outcome: 57 percent of previously responsive patients achieved a second complete response versus 9 percent of others. Median survival was 311 days overall and 400 days in the favorable group. Myelosuppression was dose-limiting. The authors conclude that PEI induces a second remission in about one third of patients, with cure mainly expected in those with prior favorable responses.

pmid-1652171.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療の変遷を概説した総説です。後腹膜リンパ節郭清や放射線療法から、経過観察、温存型リンパ節郭清へと変化してきました。再発リスクは、局所進行度、脈管侵襲、胎児性癌などの組織型で評価され、治療は患者ごとに個別化すべきとしています。
pmid-1652171.summary_en: This urology review traces the management of stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis over three decades, from retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy and radiotherapy to surveillance and modified or nerve-sparing lymphadenectomy. Key predictors of relapse include local tumor stage, vascular or lymphatic invasion, and histology such as embryonal carcinoma. Patients with unfavorable features should generally undergo lymphadenectomy, while favorable-risk patients may choose surveillance or lymphadenectomy. The authors emphasize individualized treatment, pathologic review, accurate imaging, and future research on fertility and risk-adapted chemotherapy.

pmid-1652567.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍107例を対象に、新規のモノクローナル抗体を用いてp53蛋白の発現を免疫組織化学で評価した研究です。84%の症例で核内陽性を示し、胎児性癌はセミノーマより陽性率が高くなっています。前浸潤性病変の59%でも陽性で、p53異常は発がんの比較的早期に起こると考えられます。
pmid-1652567.summary_en: This 1991 study examined p53 protein accumulation in a broad range of human testicular germ cell tumors using a newly developed monoclonal antibody and a polyclonal antiserum. Immunohistochemistry showed nuclear p53 positivity in 84 percent of 107 tumors, with higher rates in embryonal carcinoma than seminoma. Normal testes were negative, while 59 percent of preinvasive intratubular germ cell neoplasia lesions were positive. The authors conclude that p53 alteration is a common feature of invasive male germ cell tumors and likely an early event in testicular cancer pathogenesis.

pmid-1652995.summary_ja: まれな妊娠性トロホブラスト疾患である悪性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の致死的症例の報告です。腫瘍細胞は主にhPLを発現し、hCGは局所的にのみ陽性でした。経過中に絨毛癌類似の二相性パターンを呈しました。転移が生じると、治療にかかわらず予後は不良です。
pmid-1652995.summary_en: This report describes a fatal case of malignant placental site trophoblastic tumor, a rare gestational trophoblastic neoplasm. Immunohistochemistry showed that the tumor cells predominantly expressed human placental lactogen, with hCG present only focally. Over time, the tumor developed a biphasic pattern resembling choriocarcinoma. The authors review the clinical and pathological features of malignant PSTT and note that diagnosis and prediction of behavior can be difficult. Once metastases occur, prognosis is poor regardless of therapy.

pmid-1653575.summary_ja: 4歳女児の後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告です。主な成分はウィルムス腫瘍様で、未熟奇形腫や悪性奇形腫の典型像とは異なっていました。完全切除の3か月後に再発した腫瘍は奇形腫成分を含まず、ネフロブラストーマ様成分のみでした。まれな腫瘍の組織発生についても考察されています。
pmid-1653575.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-year-old girl with a retroperitoneal teratoma whose predominant component resembled Wilms tumor (nephroblastoma), unlike typical immature or malignant teratomas. The mature elements included adipose tissue, neural tissue, cartilage, muscle, and respiratory and gastrointestinal epithelium. Three months after complete excision, a recurrent tumor developed that contained only nephroblastomatous elements without teratomatous components. The authors discuss the possible histogenesis of this rare tumor.

pmid-1654130.summary_ja: 精巣がんの疫学と治療の進歩をまとめた総説です。精巣摘除術後の腫瘍マーカー上昇速度は、薬剤抵抗性疾患の予測因子となることが示されています。病期I非セミノーマでは補助化学療法で再発率が低下し、セミノーマでは補助療法としての放射線療法の役割が見直されつつあります。
pmid-1654130.summary_en: This 1991 review covers testicular cancer advances: germinal epithelial atrophy as a common pathway in tumor development, elevated FSH at diagnosis as a marker of second-tumor risk, and post-orchiectomy tumor marker kinetics as a predictor of drug-resistant disease. For stage I nonseminoma, two courses of adjuvant chemotherapy produced lower relapse rates than surgical staging. In seminoma, combination chemotherapy cures nearly all patients and carboplatin alone about 80 percent, prompting reconsideration of adjuvant radiotherapy. Two courses of adjuvant carboplatin gave equivalent results with possibly less toxicity.

pmid-1655215.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の両側同時性発生で、組織型が異なる症例の6例目を報告する。既報は5例のみである。異時性の対側発生は約3%、同時性両側発生は約0.5%とされ、両側腫瘍は通常組織学的に同一であることを踏まえ、発生機序と臨床上の意義を考察している。
pmid-1655215.summary_en: This report describes the sixth published case of synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors with different histologic types. Metachronous development in the contralateral testis occurs in about 3% of patients with a testicular GCT, and synchronous bilateral GCT in about 0.5%. Bilateral testicular tumors are usually histologically identical. The authors discuss the clinical and pathogenetic implications of this rare bilateral presentation.

pmid-1655226.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の40歳男性が、自家骨髄移植後にアスペルギルス感染症を発症した症例報告。Hickmanカテーテル出口部の皮膚感染から真菌血症を経て播種性に進展した。好中球減少がみられなかった点が特徴的で、大量化学療法後の感染リスクとカテーテル関連感染への注意を示す。
pmid-1655226.summary_en: A 40-year-old man with extragonadal germ cell tumor developed disseminated Aspergillus fumigatus infection after autologous bone marrow transplantation. The infection spread hematogenously after fungemia, originating from a skin infection at a Hickman catheter exit site. Notably, the patient had no neutropenia, which is atypical for invasive aspergillosis. The report highlights infection risk after high-dose therapy and catheter-related sources in patients with GCT.

pmid-1655464.summary_ja: 後腹膜のセミノーマ(未分化成分を伴う)に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法で完全寛解した44歳男性が、88か月後に右精巣摘除術で精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌とセミノーマ未分化成分)と診断された症例。第2の腫瘍の発生機序について考察している。
pmid-1655464.summary_en: A 44-year-old man with retroperitoneal classic seminoma containing anaplastic areas achieved complete remission after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Eighty-eight months later, he was diagnosed with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor, consisting of embryonal carcinoma with anaplastic seminoma areas, after right orchiectomy. The authors discuss the potential mechanisms by which this second tumor developed.

pmid-1656057.summary_ja: デンマークの全国コホートで、1960〜1979年に初発の胚細胞腫瘍と診断された男性2,850例を対象に、対側精巣の二次性腫瘍リスクを評価した。73例(2.6%)が対側に腫瘍を発症し、25年累積リスクは5.2%であった。非セミノーマ(8.4%)はセミノーマ(3.6%)より高かった。相対リスクは24.8と高値で、残存精巣の上皮内がんのスクリーニングと治療を含む厳重な経過観察が推奨されている。
pmid-1656057.summary_en: This Danish nationwide cohort study assessed the risk of a second primary contralateral testicular germ cell cancer in 2,850 men first diagnosed with germ cell cancer from 1960 to 1979. Seventy-three men (2.6%) developed a contralateral tumor, with a 25-year cumulative risk of 5.2%. The risk was higher after nonseminoma (8.4%) than after seminoma (3.6%). The overall relative risk was 24.8 and was not affected by age, calendar period, or time since diagnosis. The authors recommend close surveillance of the remaining testicle, including screening for and treating carcinoma in situ.

pmid-1656346.summary_ja: ウェリントン病院で治療された精巣がん79例を対象に、腫瘍発見から手術までの期間と予後の関係を検討した。期間が短い群と長い群で生存に差はなかったが、期間が短い群では腫瘍が小さい傾向があった。腫瘍の発見が遅すぎるため期間短縮だけでは生存は改善しないが、患者自身による早期発見と精巣自己検査の啓発が重要だと結論づけている。
pmid-1656346.summary_en: This Wellington Hospital study of 79 patients with testicular cancer examined whether the interval from tumor recognition to surgery affected prognosis. No survival difference was found between patients with short and long intervals, but shorter intervals were associated with smaller tumors. The authors conclude that tumors are recognized too late for shortening the interval to improve survival. They suggest that earlier recognition by patients could allow diagnosis at an earlier stage and support public education on testicular self-examination.

pmid-1656435.summary_ja: ヒト奇形腫の神経組織マーカーとして、NCAMの長鎖ポリシアル酸に対するモノクローナル抗体を評価した。S-100、GFAP、ニューロフィラメント蛋白、NGFRと比較した結果、抗ポリシアル酸抗体は成熟・未熟の両方の神経組織を一貫して標識した。未熟な神経成分は奇形腫の予後に関わるため、その同定に最も感度が高く有用なマーカーであると結論づけている。
pmid-1656435.summary_en: This study evaluated a monoclonal antibody against polysialic acid, a long-chain form of NCAM, as a marker of neural tissue in human teratomas. Its staining was compared with S-100, GFAP, neurofilament protein, and NGFR. The anti-polysialic acid antibody consistently labeled both mature and immature neural elements, whereas the other markers were less reliable. Because immature neural components carry prognostic significance in teratomas, the authors conclude that this antibody is the most sensitive and useful marker for identifying them.
