To test its role, the authors introduced a constitutively expressed N-myc gene. The transformants proliferated faster, were harder to induce, differentiated more slowly, and gained increased tumorigenic potential in nude mice, forming tumors of embryonal carcinoma stem cells. The findings suggest that a modest increase in N-myc expression confers a more transformed state.

pmid-1955781.summary_ja: 多分化能を持つヒト胎児性癌細胞株NEC14を用い、5種類の分化誘導因子を検討しました。中でもHMBAが最も強い分化誘導作用を示し、分化した細胞は増殖を停止し、ヌードマウスで腫瘍を形成しなくなりました。担癌マウスへの腹腔内投与では腫瘍増殖が抑制されました。胎児性癌は分化誘導を用いたがん治療の有用なモデルであると結論づけています。
pmid-1955781.summary_en: The pluripotent human embryonal carcinoma line NEC14 formed nude mouse tumors containing differentiated somatic and extra-embryonic elements. Of five differentiation inducers tested in vitro, HMBA was the most potent. Exposure to 10^-2 M HMBA for three days differentiated all cells morphologically, after which they stopped proliferating and became non-tumorigenic. Differentiation markers appeared, and intraperitoneal HMBA inhibited tumor growth in tumor-bearing mice. The authors conclude that human embryonal carcinoma is a useful model for differentiation-induction cancer therapy.

pmid-1958631.summary_ja: 奇形腫内に胎児性癌とセミノーマを伴う症例から、新規ヒト胚細胞腫瘍株NOC-Tsを樹立しました。細胞は上皮様の単層シートとして増殖し、倍加時間は約30〜32時間でした。モデル染色体数は73本で、大型の亜中部動原体型マーカー染色体を1本含んでいました。温度感受性と腫瘍原性も検討されています。
pmid-1958631.summary_en: The authors established and characterized NOC-Ts, a new cell line derived from a teratoma containing embryonal carcinoma and seminoma. Cells grew as an epithelial-like monolayer with a population doubling time of about 30 to 32 hours. The model chromosome number was 73, including one large submetacentric marker chromosome. Temperature sensitivity and tumorigenicity of the line were also tested. The report describes culture conditions and basic cytogenetic features of this human germ cell tumor strain.

pmid-1959792.summary_ja: 65歳日本人女性の成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に原発した悪性黒色腫の症例報告。顕微鏡検査で偶然発見された。腫瘍は放射状・垂直方向に増殖し、周囲にメラニン沈着を伴う上皮を認めた。腫瘍が小さく腹膜播種がない点が特徴的である。卵巣奇形腫の悪性転化として稀な病態の形態学的所見を詳述している。
pmid-1959792.summary_en: A 65-year-old Japanese woman had a primary malignant melanoma arising within a mature ovarian cystic teratoma, discovered incidentally on microscopic examination. The tumor showed radial and vertical growth and was surrounded by epithelium showing melanosis. Its small size and absence of peritoneal dissemination were notable. The report details the morphological features of this rare ovarian melanoma, a malignant transformation of mature teratoma.

pmid-1960446.summary_ja: 精巣未熟奇形腫に対し精巣摘除術、リンパ節転移切除、シスプラチン併用化学療法を施行された34歳男性の症例。左腕頭静脈から上大静脈を経て右心房に進展した腫瘍栓を人工心肺下に摘出し、転移性奇形腫と確認した。術後14か月間無再発で、化学療法後の積極的な外科的管理の有用性が示された。
pmid-1960446.summary_en: A 34-year-old man with testicular immature teratoma underwent left orchiectomy, lymph node resections, and five cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. In 1988, imaging revealed a tumor thrombus extending from the left brachiocephalic vein through the superior vena cava into the right atrium, with pulmonary infarcts. Cardiopulmonary bypass was used to remove the thrombus, which proved to be metastatic teratoma. The patient remained disease-free for 14 months, supporting aggressive surgery after chemotherapy.

pmid-1960458.summary_ja: 46歳男性が突然の胸痛で受診し、縦隔奇形腫が心膜を穿孔して心タンポナーデを来した症例。心膜ドレナージのみでは心不全が改善せず、入院5日目に腫瘍を切除した。病理学的に成熟型縦隔奇形腫で、嚢胞内の黄色液が心膜腔へ流出していた。心膜穿孔を伴う縦隔奇形腫は国内外で報告例が少なく、本例は希少例である。
pmid-1960458.summary_en: A 46-year-old man presented with sudden chest pain due to cardiac tamponade caused by a mediastinal teratoma that had perforated the pericardium. Pericardial drainage failed to resolve heart failure, so the tumor was resected on hospital day 5. Pathology showed a mature-type mediastinal teratoma, and yellowish fluid from its cyst had leaked into the pericardium. The authors note that only about 10 such cases have been reported in Japan and abroad.

pmid-1960791.summary_ja: 先天性上咽頭奇形腫の新生児例で、急性の気道閉塞として発症した。直ちに経口気管挿管で気道を確保し、上咽頭・中咽頭を充満する有茎性腫瘤を完全切除した。組織学的に三胚葉すべてを含む成熟奇形腫で、初期の臓器分化を認めた。頭頸部の先天性奇形腫が救急対応を要する呼吸器緊急症となりうることを示す。
pmid-1960791.summary_en: A congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma presented as acute airway obstruction in a neonate. Immediate orotracheal intubation secured the airway, and a pedunculated mass filling the nasopharynx and oropharynx was completely removed. Histology showed a mature teratoma containing all three germ layers with early recognizable organ differentiation. The case highlights that congenital head and neck teratomas can present as life-threatening respiratory emergencies requiring prompt airway management.

pmid-1960997.summary_ja: 1976年から1988年にインディアナ大学で治療された縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の男性21例の報告。初回治療を受けた14例ではシスプラチン併用化学療法と可能な限りの残存病変切除を行い、5例（36%）が無病生存した。再発した7例は救援化学療法を受けたが全例死亡し、生存期間中央値は6か月であった。再発例に対する新たな治療法の検討が必要である。
pmid-1960997.summary_en: Twenty-one men with mediastinal yolk sac tumor were treated at Indiana University from 1976 to 1988. Fourteen received initial cisplatin-based chemotherapy with surgical resection of residual disease when possible, and five (36%) remained alive and disease-free. Seven relapsed and received salvage chemotherapy, but all died, with a median survival of six months. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based chemotherapy followed by resection is optimal, and new regimens are needed for relapse.

pmid-1985547.summary_ja: 縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫が破裂し右胸腔へ漏出した27歳女性の症例。嚢胞液中のアミラーゼとCEAが著明に高値であった。アミラーゼ活性が破裂の原因と考えられた。胸水中の高CEAは必ずしも悪性を示さないが、縦隔腫瘍患者では奇形腫破裂を示唆しうると指摘しており、鑑別の際の注意点を示している。
pmid-1985547.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman with a ruptured mediastinal cystic teratoma had markedly elevated amylase and carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) in the cyst fluid. Amylase activity was considered the likely cause of the rupture into the right pleural cavity. The authors note that high CEA in pleural fluid does not necessarily indicate malignancy, but in patients with mediastinal tumors it may suggest a ruptured teratoma.

pmid-1986147.summary_ja: 1980年から1984年にボンベイのタタ記念病院で治療された純粋型卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）27例の症例検討。病期I例は手術単独または補助療法を受け、進行例には術後放射線療法が行われた。当院で初回治療を受けた24例の無病生存率は81%、全生存期間(全生存率)は108か月で88%であった。病期I・IIでは100%であった。
pmid-1986147.summary_en: Twenty-seven patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated at Tata Memorial Hospital, Bombay, from 1980 to 1984 were reviewed. Stage I patients received surgery alone or with adjuvant treatment, while advanced stages were managed with surgery and postoperative radiotherapy. For 24 patients treated primarily at the institution, disease-free survival was 81% and overall survival 88% at 108 months. Survival in stages I and II was 100%. The authors call for controlled trials and chemotherapy in advanced disease.

pmid-1988722.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣がん15例で、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の残存腫瘤切除の意義を検討した。残存腫瘤に悪性腫瘍または成熟奇形腫が認められたのは12例だった。2回の手術で組織所見が異なったのは7例で、そのうち4例は2回目の標本でより不良な病理像を示した。残存病変をすべて切除することが有利とされた。
pmid-1988722.summary_en: This study of 15 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular cancer examined sequential operations that removed residual masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy despite normal hCG and AFP levels. Residual malignancy or mature teratoma was found in 12 of 15 patients, and histology differed between the two operations in seven. The authors conclude that excising all post-chemotherapy residuals is favorable. However, patients with no teratomatous elements and complete necrosis or fibrosis at first resection may have a high likelihood of complete necrosis in remaining tumors.

pmid-1989875.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来の2つの細胞株を用い、ヌクレオチドプールを枯渇させる抗代謝薬メトトレキサートとヒドロキシウレアの遺伝子発現への影響を検討した。両薬剤はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のαおよびβサブユニットと胎盤型アルカリフォスファターゼを強く誘導し、c-mycを検出困難な水準まで低下させた。ヒドロキシウレアによるhCGαサブユニット遺伝子の誘導は転写レベルで起こり、プロモーター内の応答配列が関与していた。
pmid-1989875.summary_en: This study treated two choriocarcinoma-derived cell lines with methotrexate or hydroxyurea, both nucleotide-depleting antimetabolites. Both drugs strongly induced the hCG alpha and beta subunit genes and placental alkaline phosphatase, and reduced c-myc expression to near undetectable levels, while beta2-microglobulin was unchanged. Hydroxyurea induction of the hCG alpha subunit gene occurred at the transcriptional level and was mediated by a responsive element in its promoter. The similar effects suggest nucleotide pool alteration rather than specific ligand effects.

pmid-1990205.summary_ja: 多剤併用化学療法後の残存成熟奇形腫10例を、DNA（ヨウ化プロピジウム染色）とサイトケラチン（抗体染色）による二重パラメータフローサイトメトリーで解析した。サイトケラチン陽性の腫瘍細胞はすべて異数体であり、既報の細胞遺伝学的データと一致した。陰性の二倍体細胞は宿主の間質や炎症細胞と考えられた。成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍で二倍体は極めて稀であると結論している。
pmid-1990205.summary_en: Residual mature teratomas from 10 patients treated with polychemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumor were analyzed by dual-parameter flow cytometry, staining DNA with propidium iodide and cytokeratins with specific antibodies. Cytokeratin-positive tumor cells were consistently aneuploid, matching prior cytogenetic data, while cytokeratin-negative diploid cells were considered normal host stromal and inflammatory cells. The authors conclude that diploid testicular germ cell tumors are extremely rare in adults and that even histologically benign somatic tissue in residual mature teratoma after chemotherapy is aneuploid.

pmid-1991256.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の患者43例と対照55例にアンケート調査を行い、放射線療法の長期的影響を後方視的に検討した。排便回数は対照と比べて有意に異なっていた一方、膀胱機能には有意差がなかった。子宮を有する患者の大半はホルモン補充下で月経様出血があり、挙児例はなかった。性交痛がわずかに増加したが、多くは性機能に満足していた。
pmid-1991256.summary_en: A retrospective chart review and questionnaire study assessed long-term effects of radiation therapy in 43 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma compared with 55 controls. Bowel movement frequency differed significantly from controls, while no significant differences were found in bladder function, and no thyroid disorders were attributed to mediastinal radiation. Most patients with intact uteri had monthly bleeding on hormonal replacement, three resumed menses after abdominopelvic radiation, and none conceived. Dyspareunia was slightly increased, but most patients were satisfied with sexual function.

pmid-1992986.summary_ja: 62歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）に上皮内扁平上皮癌が生じた症例である。パラフィン包埋組織のフローサイトメトリーでDNA含有量は正常で、増殖活性は中等度から高度であった。染色体分析では上皮内癌と良性嚢胞部の双方が46,XX核型を示した。奇形腫は減数分裂後の単一の胚細胞に由来すると示唆されている。
pmid-1992986.summary_en: A 62-year-old woman developed squamous cell carcinoma in situ arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst). Flow cytometry of paraffin-embedded tissue showed normal DNA content with moderate to high proliferative activity. Cytogenetic analysis of the in situ carcinoma and the benign cystic component both showed a 46,XX karyotype, and the benign portion showed homozygous heteromorphisms absent in peripheral blood. The authors conclude that the carcinoma was euploid and suggest that the teratoma derived from a single germ cell after meiosis I.

pmid-1993392.summary_ja: 雌馬2頭に卵巣奇形腫と顆粒膜細胞腫が同時または順次に発生した症例を報告している。両腫瘍は大きさや嚢胞性の所見が似るため臨床診断が難しくなりうる。奇形腫は骨や歯の触知、顆粒膜細胞腫はホルモン関連の行動や生殖機能の変化により鑑別できる。目立つ病変の陰に隠れた別の腫瘍を見逃さないため、手術標本の詳細な検査が重要であると述べている。
pmid-1993392.summary_en: This report describes two mares with ovarian teratoma and granulosa cell tumor, occurring either simultaneously or successively. The authors note that coexisting tumors may obscure clinical diagnosis, since size, unilaterality, and cystic appearance can be similar. Teratomas may show palpable bone, cartilage, or teeth, whereas granulosa cell tumors cause hormone-related behavioral and reproductive changes. Careful examination of surgical specimens is recommended to detect a second neoplasm hidden beside a more obvious lesion.

pmid-1995482.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性31例を対象に、性染色体の用量変化を分子遺伝学的に解析した研究である。31例中12例(39%)で腫瘍のY染色体用量に変化がみられ、Y染色体欠失例ではX染色体用量の増加も認められた。性染色体の変化は多くの例で3pまたは11pのヘテロ接合性の消失を伴っていた。セミノーマは非セミノーマより影響を受けやすく、男性胚細胞腫瘍の発生や進展に関与すると考察している。
pmid-1995482.summary_en: This molecular genetic study analyzed sex chromosome dosage in 31 men with testicular germ cell tumors using X- and Y-specific and pseudoautosomal probes. Y-chromosome dosage changes occurred in 12 of 31 tumors (39%), and some Y-deficient tumors showed increased X dosage. Sex chromosome changes were often accompanied by loss of heterozygosity at 3p or 11p. Seminomas were more often affected than non-seminomas. The authors suggest these alterations are an important step in male germ cell tumor development or progression.

pmid-1997986.summary_ja: 心膜内奇形腫により胎児全身水腫を来した症例を報告している。腫瘤は心嚢タンポナーデと非免疫性水腫を引き起こした。臨床、心エコー、組織学的所見を示し、心膜内病変の文献的レビューを行っている。性腺外の奇形腫が心膜に生じ、重篤な胎児障害を来しうることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-1997986.summary_en: A fetus with fetal anasarca caused by an intrapericardial teratoma is described. The mass caused pericardial tamponade and nonimmune hydrops. The authors report the clinical, echocardiographic, and histologic findings and review other intrapericardial lesions. This case report shows that extragonadal teratomas can arise in the pericardium and cause severe fetal compromise, a rare presentation that requires prenatal recognition and careful evaluation.

pmid-1999176.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3およびJARを用い、インスリンがhCGの合成と分泌を促進することを示した基礎研究。JEG-3ではインスリンによりhCG分泌が用量依存的に増加し、72〜96時間でピークに達した。正常の初代栄養膜細胞では効果がなく、絨毛癌細胞と正常胎盤細胞でhCG調節が異なることが示された。効果の一部はIGF-I受容体を介すると考えられた。
pmid-1999176.summary_en: This study examined whether insulin regulates hCG production in the choriocarcinoma cell lines JEG-3 and JAR, and in primary human term trophoblast cells. Insulin, human proinsulin and porcine insulin dose-dependently stimulated hCG secretion from JEG-3 cells, with peak release at 72-96 hours, and increased intracellular hCG synthesis. Insulin also increased hCG release from JAR cells but not from primary trophoblasts. An antibody to the IGF-I receptor inhibited the effect in JEG-3 cells. The authors conclude that hCG regulation in choriocarcinoma cells differs from that in normal placental trophoblast, and that the effect may be partly mediated by the IGF-I receptor.

pmid-2000537.summary_ja: 臍部ヘルニアとして発症した良性嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮腫)の症例報告。病変を切除し、患者は完全に回復した。画像や病理所見の詳細は示されていない。珍しい部位の奇形腫が一般的なヘルニアに似ることがあり、臍部腫瘤の鑑別に含めるべきことを示す症例である。
pmid-2000537.summary_en: This brief case report describes a patient in whom a benign cystic teratoma (dermoid tumour) presented as an umbilical hernia. The lesion was resected, and the patient made a complete recovery. The abstract provides limited detail about imaging, histopathology or the duration of follow-up. The case illustrates that a teratoma may mimic a common hernia at an unusual site, so teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of umbilical masses.

pmid-2000890.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの32歳男性に、無症状の心膜転移が出現した症例報告。横隔膜上のリンパ節や肺転移は伴わなかった。心エコーで病変の出現と消失を追跡できたことを示した。心膜転移は稀で、多くは剖検で発見されるため実際の頻度は不明である。診断とフォローアップにおける心エコーの有用性が示された。
pmid-2000890.summary_en: This report describes a 32-year-old man with testicular seminoma who developed asymptomatic pericardial metastases without concomitant supradiaphragmatic nodal or pulmonary metastases. Echocardiography was used to detect the lesions and to follow their appearance and disappearance. The authors review that testicular malignancy typically spreads first to infradiaphragmatic nodes and retroperitoneal lymph channels, then to mediastinal and supraclavicular nodes. Pericardial metastases are rare and usually found at autopsy, so the true incidence is unknown. The paper highlights the usefulness of echocardiography for diagnosis and follow-up.

pmid-2001342.summary_ja: 本報告は、原発性精巣奇形腫に対して精巣摘除術を受けた若年男性で、転移性疾患が自然に退縮したと思われる症例を記述している。連続的な血清腫瘍マーカーの測定では、急激な上昇の後に自然な低下が認められた。患者は個人的な理由から化学療法の延期を希望し、その結果として疾患の自然経過を観察することができた。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の自然退縮は稀であり、本症例は連続した腫瘍マーカーモニタリングの有用性を示している。
pmid-2001342.summary_en: This report describes apparently spontaneous regression of metastatic disease in a young man who had undergone orchidectomy for a primary testicular teratoma. Serial serum tumour marker measurements showed a sharp rise followed by a spontaneous decline. The patient had requested that chemotherapy be deferred for personal reasons, which allowed the natural course of the disease to be observed. Spontaneous regression of metastatic germ cell tumour is rare, and the case highlights the value of serial tumour marker monitoring.

pmid-2003839.summary_ja: 1980〜1987年にWestmead病院で治療された精巣セミノーマ73例の管理と転帰を検討した。追跡期間中央値は51か月。精巣摘除術前のβ-hCG上昇は22%、術後は5%だった。病期I(78%)と病期II(19%)が大半を占め、再発は病期Iで1例、病期IIで2例にみられ、いずれも救済可能だった。早期病変には放射線療法で高い治癒率が得られ、進行例にはシスプラチン併用化学療法が用いられた。
pmid-2003839.summary_en: This review examined 73 consecutive patients with testicular seminoma treated at Westmead Hospital from 1980 to 1987, with median follow-up of 51 months. Beta-hCG was elevated in 22% before orchiectomy and 5% after surgery. Most patients had stage I (78%) or stage II (19%) disease. Relapse occurred in one stage I patient and two stage II patients, all salvaged. Radiotherapy yielded high cure rates for early disease, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy was used for bulky or disseminated disease. Residual masses after radiotherapy were typically non-viable.

pmid-2003942.summary_ja: 静脈内薬物使用歴と歯の膿瘍を有する31歳男性が、感染性心内膜炎の疑いで評価された。心エコーで左心房に腫瘤を認めた。切除標本の組織像は、入院中に発見された右精巣の原発性胎児性癌と一致した。外科的切除と化学療法を経て患者は順調に回復した。精巣胎児性癌の左心系転移を外科的に切除し得た初めての報告と考えられている。
pmid-2003942.summary_en: A 31-year-old man with intravenous drug use and a tooth abscess was evaluated for suspected infective endocarditis. Echocardiography revealed a left atrial mass. Histology matched the primary embryonal carcinoma of the right testis found during admission. The patient recovered after surgical removal and chemotherapy. The authors believe this is the first reported case of testicular embryonal carcinoma metastasizing to the left heart that was successfully removed at surgery.

pmid-2004234.summary_ja: AIDSを発症した男性に精巣セミノーマが生じ、カポジ肉腫および頭蓋内腫瘤を伴っていた症例報告。セミノーマに対して精巣摘除術と放射線療法により良好な反応が得られた。論文はHIV関連の泌尿生殖器病変についても概説し、治療により生活の質が改善しうるため、HIV感染者では積極的に検索すべきだと述べている。
pmid-2004234.summary_en: This report describes a man with AIDS who presented with testicular seminoma, accompanied by Kaposi's sarcoma and an intracranial mass. He responded well to orchiectomy and radiotherapy for the seminoma. The authors also review genitourinary pathologies associated with HIV infection, emphasizing that they should be specifically sought in HIV patients because treatment may improve quality of life.

pmid-2004236.summary_ja: 転移を伴う非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍13例のうち、増大する転移巣が分化した奇形腫のみからなるgrowing teratoma syndromeの症例を検討した。増大が確認された後、速やかに外科的切除を行った。手術に伴う合併症は最小限だった。追跡期間中央値28か月で12例が生存し、うち10例は無病であった。
pmid-2004236.summary_en: This series describes 13 patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors whose enlarging metastases consisted solely of differentiated teratoma. Surgical resection was performed soon after growth was documented. Surgical morbidity was minimal. At a median follow-up of 28 months, twelve patients were alive, ten of them disease-free. The findings support prompt resection of enlarging teratoma lesions during management of non-seminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-2007524.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変である上皮内癌細胞を、ヒト培養精細管で研究した初めての報告。管内の腫瘍細胞は7日間生存し、増殖能を示した。形態学的観察と[3H]チミジンのオートラジオグラフィーで分裂活性が確認された。セミノーマ細胞株や管内腫瘍細胞の培養系は従来報告がなく、実験的研究の新たな手段となる。
pmid-2007524.summary_en: This study established an in-vitro culture of human seminiferous tubules to study early germ-cell-derived tumour cells, the carcinoma-in-situ cells that precede testicular germ cell tumours. Intratubular tumour cells survived for seven days and proliferated, confirmed by morphology and [3H]thymidine autoradiography. The authors note that no seminoma cell lines or intratubular tumour cell cultures had been reported, unlike many non-seminoma lines. The tubule culture offers a new tool for experimental work on carcinoma-in-situ.

pmid-2008000.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3由来の免疫抑制因子が、T細胞およびLAK細胞の増殖応答に及ぼす影響を調べた研究である。本因子はIL-2非依存性T細胞の増殖を完全に抑制したが、活性化マーカーCD25の発現は抑制しなかった。NK活性は抑制されず、増殖過程のみを選択的に抑制すると結論された。絨毛癌が宿主の拒絶反応を免れる機構や、母体による胎児拒絶の防止に関与する可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-2008000.summary_en: This study examined an immunosuppressive factor derived from JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells and its effects on IL-2-dependent and IL-2-independent T cell responses. The factor completely blocked IL-2-independent T cell proliferation without suppressing CD25 expression. It also impaired LAK cell generation depending on the day of culture, while leaving NK activity intact. The authors conclude that the factor selectively suppresses proliferation of immunocompetent cells, possibly helping choriocarcinoma cells evade host rejection or the fetus evade maternal rejection.

pmid-2009969.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株Tera 2と初代胚細胞腫瘍におけるK-FGF癌遺伝子の発現を検討した研究である。未分化のTera 2細胞では発現していたが、レチノイン酸により速やかに低下し、長期培養後に再び出現した。初代胚細胞腫瘍の約3分の1で発現が認められ、正常精巣組織では発現していなかった。胚細胞腫瘍の発生への関与が示唆される。
pmid-2009969.summary_en: The authors studied K-FGF expression in the human teratocarcinoma line Tera 2 and in primary germ cell tumours. K-FGF is expressed in undifferentiated Tera 2 cells but is rapidly downregulated by retinoic acid, with transcripts reappearing after prolonged culture. About one-third of primary germ cell tumours express K-FGF, whereas normal testicular tissue does not, suggesting a possible role for this oncogene in germ cell tumour development.

pmid-2010104.summary_ja: 未治療の卵巣未熟奇形腫20例を対象に、術後化学療法（VAC療法またはシスプラチン含有療法）の成績を検討した。中央値62か月の追跡で18例が無病生存した。grade 1・2の症例は良好に治療でき、妊孕性を希望する患者では子宮摘出を自動的に行う必要はないと結論された。
pmid-2010104.summary_en: This study reviewed 20 untreated patients with ovarian immature teratoma, most of whom received postoperative chemotherapy with VAC or cisplatin-based regimens. Nine patients had stage I disease, and the median follow-up was 62 months. Eighteen patients were alive and disease free, one was alive with liver metastasis, and one died from a recurrent rhabdomyosarcoma after a grade 3 tumor. The authors conclude that grade 1 and 2 immature teratomas respond well to these regimens, so hysterectomy need not be performed routinely in women wishing to preserve fertility.

pmid-2011207.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋標本を用いたフローサイトメトリーで、セミノーマ49例のDNA倍数性とS期細胞分画を評価した研究である。古典的セミノーマの84%、精母細胞性セミノーマの67%で異数性が認められた。精母細胞性セミノーマは臨床的に緩徐な経過にもかかわらず増殖活性が最も高かった。他の胚細胞腫瘍とは起源が異なる可能性が示唆される。
pmid-2011207.summary_en: This study used flow cytometry on paraffin-embedded tissue from 49 seminomas to assess DNA ploidy and S-phase fraction. Aneuploidy was found in most classical seminomas, all seminomas with syncytiotrophoblastic cells, and two-thirds of spermatocytic seminomas. Spermatocytic seminomas showed the highest proliferation activity despite their clinically indolent course. The authors argue that the higher diploid rate in spermatocytic seminoma supports a different origin from other germ cell tumors.

pmid-2012133.summary_ja: Wiedemann-Beckwith症候群を有する新生男児に生じた先天性胃奇形腫の症例報告である。出生前の超音波検査で異常が検出され、10日齢で切除と部分胃切除が行われた。組織学的に全胚葉由来の成熟・未熟組織を含む未熟grade II奇形腫であった。腫瘍か取り込まれた双胎かを考察し、WBSに関連する腫瘍を概説している。
pmid-2012133.summary_en: This report describes a newborn boy with Wiedemann-Beckwith syndrome who had a congenital gastric teratoma. The tumor was detected prenatally by ultrasound showing placental overgrowth, polyhydramnios, omphalocele and posterior abdominal calcifications. Resection and partial gastrectomy at 10 days revealed an immature grade II teratoma containing tissues from all germ layers. The karyotype was normal (46,XY). The authors discuss whether the tumor represents a teratoma or an included twin, and review neoplasia associated with this syndrome.

pmid-2014364.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の患者に両側自然気胸が生じた症例報告である。絨毛癌の合併症としてはこれまで報告がない病態である。胸腔ドレナージと化学療法により治療に成功した。呼吸器症状を示す転移性絨毛癌患者では、気胸の可能性も念頭に置くべきと著者らは指摘している。
pmid-2014364.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastatic choriocarcinoma who developed spontaneous bilateral pneumothoraces, a complication not previously reported for this tumor. The pneumothoraces were managed successfully with tube thoracostomy, and the patient was also treated with chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that clinicians should consider pneumothorax as a possible complication of metastatic choriocarcinoma, particularly in patients presenting with respiratory symptoms.

pmid-2015799.summary_ja: G6PD欠損マウスとX染色体不活化を利用して、卵黄嚢由来奇形腫の起源を検討した研究である。組織化学的解析の結果、卵黄嚢内胚葉に由来する細胞が奇形腫の起源であると結論づけられた。父性X染色体が卵黄嚢内胚葉で特異的に不活化されることが根拠である。奇形腫組織の発生起源に関する知見を与える。
pmid-2015799.summary_en: This study used glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD)-deficient mice and X-chromosome inactivation patterns to trace the origin of teratomas derived from the yolk sac. Histochemical analysis showed that teratomas arising from yolk sac tissue were G6PD-negative when the mother was homozygous deficient, indicating that the cells originated from yolk sac endoderm. The authors conclude that yolk-sac-derived teratomas are of endodermal origin, because the paternal X chromosome is inactivated specifically in the yolk sac endoderm. The work provides insight into the developmental origin of teratoma tissue.

pmid-2018791.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍7例のDNAメチル化状態を解析した研究である。奇形癌では全般的な高メチル化、セミノーマでは低メチル化または脱メチル化がみられた。進展したセミノーマは最も強い低メチル化を示した。メチル化の違いが組織型ごとの発生経路に関与している可能性が示された。X染色体過剰の影響もメチル化により修飾されると考えられる。
pmid-2018791.summary_en: This study analyzed DNA methylation in seven human testicular germ cell tumors, examining X-chromosome genes and probes from several chromosomes. Teratocarcinomas showed generalized hypermethylation, whereas seminomas displayed variable hypomethylation or near-complete demethylation. The most extensively hypomethylated seminoma was disseminated, while the others were localized. The findings suggest that DNA methylation contributes to the divergent developmental pathways of histologic subtypes. The authors also propose that methylation control may modulate the effects of extra X chromosomes frequently seen in testicular tumors.

pmid-2020655.summary_ja: 16か月の女児に生じた肝原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。病変の穿刺吸引細胞診所見を提示し考察している。小児腹部腫瘤の診断におけるFNABの有用性を裏付ける症例である。卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な性腺外発生例として報告されている。小児肝腫瘤の細胞診による評価の可能性を示す。
pmid-2020655.summary_en: This report describes a primary yolk sac tumor of the liver in a 16-month-old female infant. The authors present and discuss the fine needle aspiration biopsy cytology of the lesion. The case supports further exploration of fine needle aspiration biopsy as a diagnostic approach for childhood abdominal masses. It documents a rare extragonadal presentation of yolk sac tumor. The brief report highlights the potential utility of cytologic sampling in evaluating pediatric liver masses.

pmid-2022604.summary_ja: コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で評価した縦隔奇形腫の症例報告である。MRIは病変の各成分を明瞭に描出した。心膜の描出に優れ、心膜浸潤がないことを確認できた。隣接構造の評価により切除可能性を判断するうえでMRIが有用であることを示す。稀な縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の画像所見の対比を主題とする。
pmid-2022604.summary_en: This case report describes a mediastinal teratoma evaluated with computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging. The authors emphasize the imaging features of the mass, with particular focus on magnetic resonance findings. MRI was valuable in clearly delineating all components of the lesion. It also demonstrated the pericardium and confirmed the absence of pericardial invasion. The case illustrates how MRI can help determine surgical resectability by assessing adjacent structures. The report is primarily a radiologic correlation of a rare mediastinal germ cell tumor.

pmid-2022665.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JArおよびJEGと正常ヒト栄養膜細胞を共培養した研究である。共培養によりhCGサブユニットとヒト胎盤性ラクトーゲンの合成が増加した。この効果は栄養膜由来の細胞に特異的であった。ホルモン合成の増加は栄養膜細胞に由来することが示された。絨毛癌と正常細胞の相互作用を研究するモデルとしての意義がある。
pmid-2022665.summary_en: This study examined whether choriocarcinoma cell lines JAr and JEG influence the differentiation of normal human cytotrophoblasts when co-cultured. Co-culture increased the synthesis of chorionic gonadotropin subunits and human placental lactogen, markers of trophoblast differentiation. The effect was specific to trophoblast-derived tumor cells, as non-trophoblastic cell lines had no comparable effect. The cytotrophoblasts were identified as the source of the increased hormone synthesis. The authors propose that choriocarcinoma cell interaction increases differentiating cytotrophoblasts, offering a model for studying tumor–normal cell interactions.

pmid-2024455.summary_ja: 13例の奇形腫（未熟奇形腫3例、類皮嚢腫5例、成熟充実性奇形腫5例）を検討した。未熟神経組織を含む未熟奇形腫では全例でN-myc遺伝子増幅とNSE産生が認められ、2例では二重微小染色体も認められた。類皮嚢腫および成熟奇形腫では認められなかった。これらの指標は、未熟神経組織を含む未熟奇形腫の悪性度評価に有用となりうると述べている。
pmid-2024455.summary_en: This 1991 study examined 13 teratomas, including 3 immature teratomas, 5 dermoid cysts, and 5 mature solid teratomas, for N-myc amplification, neuron-specific enolase (NSE) production, and double minutes. All three immature teratomas containing immature neural tissue showed N-myc amplification and NSE production in primary tissue and cultured cells, and double minutes were found in two cases. Dermoid cysts and mature teratomas lacked these features, and chromosomes were normal. The authors suggest these markers may help assess malignancy when immature neural tissue is present.

pmid-2030209.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌が皮膚に転移した症例報告である。胸部の単発の皮膚結節の生検で、細胞性および合胞体栄養膜細胞からなる転移巣が確認され、合胞体栄養膜細胞の細胞質はβ-hCG陽性であった。精巣摘除術、化学療法、放射線療法により血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は正常範囲に低下し、治療2年後も再発の所見は認められていない。
pmid-2030209.summary_en: This case report describes testicular choriocarcinoma metastatic to the skin, first identified from a single chest skin nodule on biopsy. Immunostaining showed beta-hCG within syncytiotrophoblastic cells. Treatment with orchiectomy, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy reduced serum hCG to normal limits. Two years after treatment, the patient showed no evidence of recurrence.

pmid-2032083.summary_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍48例の臨床・病理・フォローアップの詳細を報告した論文である。手術、化学療法、放射線療法を組み合わせた治療は極めて有効であった。経陰嚢的精巣摘除術は不適切であり、精巣生検は予後を悪化させると結論づけている。小児精巣腫瘍の外科的管理と長期フォローアップの重要性を示す。
pmid-2032083.summary_en: This study presents clinical, pathological and follow-up details of 48 children with testicular tumours, a rare condition in childhood. Combined surgery, chemotherapy and radiotherapy proved highly effective. The authors conclude that transcrotal orchiectomy is an inappropriate surgical approach and that testicular biopsy adversely affects prognosis, offering practical surgical guidance for pediatric testicular tumour management. These findings emphasise the importance of careful surgical planning and long-term follow-up.

pmid-2032594.summary_ja: 低悪性度の未熟奇形腫と腹膜グリオーマトーシスを伴った1症例を報告し、オランダ卵巣腫瘍委員会登録の8例を併せて検討した。フォローアップでは、グレード2の奇形腫でも予後は良好であった。成熟グリア組織からなる腹膜播種は予後に悪影響を与えず、保存的治療が妥当と考えられている。
pmid-2032594.summary_en: This report describes a low-grade immature teratoma with peritoneal gliomatosis, drawing on eight cases registered by the Dutch Ovarian Tumor Committee. Follow-up of these cases indicated a good prognosis, even for grade 2 teratomas. Peritoneal implants composed of mature glial tissue did not adversely affect prognosis, and the authors suggest that a conservative surgical approach may be justified.

pmid-2034061.summary_ja: 24歳男性の後腹膜原発性良性奇形腫の1例を報告している。CTおよびMRIの所見を病理所見と対比して記述した。英文文献でMRI所見が報告された症例は1例のみであった。診断および術前画像診断におけるMRIの有用性を考察している。成人では稀な腫瘍であり、画像所見の理解が重要であることを示す。
pmid-2034061.summary_en: This report describes a 24-year-old man with a primary benign teratoma of the retroperitoneum, a rare entity in adults. The lesion's CT and MRI features are correlated with pathological findings. The authors note that only one prior case with MRI had been published in English literature. They discuss the value of MRI for diagnosis and preoperative imaging of such tumours. This case highlights the diagnostic role of MRI.

pmid-2034818.summary_ja: 73歳女性の下腹部痛を伴う腫瘤で、CTでは嚢胞と充実成分が混在する複雑な腫瘤として描出された。脂液面形成と壁の微細石灰化を伴う嚢胞があり、病理学的に卵巣甲状腺腫と確定した。これまで報告のないCT所見であり、類皮嚢胞の鑑別診断に卵巣甲状腺腫を含めるべきだと述べている。
pmid-2034818.summary_en: This case report describes computed tomographic findings of struma ovarii in a 73-year-old woman presenting with a painful lower abdominal mass. CT showed a complex mass with cystic and solid components, including a cyst with a fat-fluid level and minor wall calcification. Histology confirmed struma ovarii. The authors note these CT features had not been described before and emphasize including struma ovarii in the differential diagnosis of teratodermoid cysts.

pmid-2036854.summary_ja: 16歳男児の原発性縦隔セミノーマと、14歳女児の卵巣セミノーマの傍大動脈リンパ節転移に、大きな初期石灰化が見つかった。単純X線では描出されずCTで検出された。他の胚細胞成分や肉芽腫性感染がないことから、ジストロフィー性石灰化と考えられる。未治療セミノーマでは定期的CTでより多くの石灰化が見つかる可能性を指摘している。
pmid-2036854.summary_en: This report describes rare large initial calcifications in a primary mediastinal seminoma in a 16-year-old boy and in para-aortic nodal metastasis of an ovarian seminoma in a 14-year-old girl. Detected by CT but not by conventional radiography, they were likely dystrophic calcifications given the absence of other germ cell tumor components and granulomatous infection. The authors suggest routine CT might reveal more such calcifications in untreated seminoma.

pmid-2038170.summary_ja: 喘息発作と胸部X線での異常陰影で受診した患者で、原発性縦隔セミノーマと診断された。胸腔鏡下に胚細胞腫瘍と診断し、腫瘍を切除した。術後に放射線療法を施行した。術後1年時点で元気に生存しており、良好な予後が期待されると述べている。
pmid-2038170.summary_en: A patient presented with an asthma attack and an abnormal chest X-ray shadow and was found to have primary mediastinal seminoma. A germ cell tumor was diagnosed by thoracoscopy and the tumor was resected, followed by postoperative radiation therapy. At one year after surgery the patient was alive in good health, and the authors expect a good prognosis. The authors note that this rare tumor is often found only after it has grown large, which can prevent complete resection.

pmid-2040539.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞は同系マウスの尾静脈投与後に肝臓へ優先的に定着し、肺にはほとんど定着しなかった。細胞接着は肺由来の細胞外基質より肝臓由来の方が強く、肝臓抽出物は増殖を促進した。肝転移は接着能と微小環境に対する増殖応答の両方によると結論している。
pmid-2040539.summary_en: Unselected F9 murine embryonal carcinoma cells preferentially colonized the liver after tail-vein injection into syngeneic mice, rarely the lungs. F9 cells adhered better to fibronectin and to liver-derived extracellular matrix than to lung- or kidney-derived matrix, and were rapidly released from the lungs. Liver extracts also promoted F9 growth, while lung and kidney extracts did not. The authors conclude that liver metastasis reflects both adhesive ability and growth response to the local microenvironment.

pmid-2041270.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋標本を用いたフローサイトメトリーにより、精巣セミノーマ27例のDNA倍数性を解析した。核分裂像数および臨床病期とDNA indexの関連を検討したが、有意な相関は認められなかった。高DNA含量が必ずしも悪性度の高さを示すわけではないと示唆された。
pmid-2041270.summary_en: This study used flow cytometry on paraffin-embedded samples to analyze DNA ploidy in 27 testicular seminomas, correlating DNA index with mitotic count and clinical stage. Anaplastic seminomas had a narrower DNA index range than typical ones, and most tumors were aneuploid with some clonal heterogeneity. However, DNA index did not significantly correlate with mitotic count or clinical stage, suggesting that higher DNA content does not reliably predict malignant potential in seminomas.

pmid-2042439.summary_ja: 新生児が鼻咽頭の大きな腫瘤による気道閉塞を呈した症例である。経口的穿刺吸引細胞診で奇形腫と診断され、後の組織学的検査で確認された。鼻咽頭奇形腫の細胞学的特徴と、この種の病変の評価における穿刺吸引生検の有用性を論じている。
pmid-2042439.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with airway obstruction caused by a large nasopharyngeal mass extending into the oropharynx. Transoral fine needle aspiration biopsy established a diagnosis of teratoma, later confirmed histologically. The authors present the cytologic features of nasopharyngeal teratoma and discuss the diagnostic utility of FNA in evaluating such lesions.

pmid-2044057.summary_ja: 86歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫内に原発性悪性黒色腫が発生した剖検例である。良性色素性病変から悪性成分への組織学的移行が認められ、S-100陽性と電顕でのメラノソームが確認された。成熟奇形腫内に既存の良性病変から悪性黒色腫が生じたと考察している。
pmid-2044057.summary_en: This autopsy report describes primary malignant melanoma arising within an ovarian dermoid cyst in an 86-year-old woman. Histology showed transition from benign pigmented lesions to malignant melanoma, and immunohistochemistry and electron microscopy confirmed melanocytic differentiation. The authors suggest the melanoma developed from preexisting benign pigmented lesions within the mature teratoma.

pmid-2044074.summary_ja: 経口避妊薬使用と妊娠性絨毛性疾患の関連を症例対照研究で検討した。5年以上の使用者では妊娠性絨毛癌の相対危険度が6.0と上昇した。侵入奇胎と胞状奇胎でも上昇傾向がみられたが有意ではなかった。長期使用または性感染症などの関連因子が関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2044074.summary_en: This case-control study examined the association between oral contraceptive use and gestational trophoblastic disease. Women with at least five years of oral contraceptive use had a markedly elevated relative risk of gestational choriocarcinoma (RR 6.0), while risks for invasive mole and hydatidiform mole were elevated but not significant. The authors hypothesize that long-term oral contraceptive use or related factors such as sexually transmitted infections increase GTD risk.

pmid-2044478.summary_ja: 小児の先天性頭頸部腫瘤を総説し、甲状舌管異常、鰓器官異常、血管性病変などを扱う。奇形腫と類皮嚢腫は真の先天性腫瘍として鑑別診断に含まれる。病歴、診察、画像検査による診断アプローチと治療方針を論じ、増大性病変や重要臓器に影響する病変には早期切除が必要であると述べている。
pmid-2044478.summary_en: This review covers congenital head and neck masses in infants and children, including thyroglossal duct abnormalities, branchial apparatus lesions, and vascular malformations. Teratomas and dermoid cysts are described as true congenital neoplasms within the differential diagnosis. The authors discuss diagnostic approaches using history, examination, and imaging, and outline management, noting that enlarging lesions and those affecting vital structures typically require early excision.

pmid-2048608.summary_ja: 16歳女性がグレード3の未熟奇形腫を発症し、成熟したグリア組織の腹膜播種(腹膜神経膠腫症)を認めた。2回の開腹術で播種は成熟を保っていたが、5年以上経過後に悪性のグリア性腫瘍が出現した。成熟した腹膜神経膠腫症の悪性転化という稀な経過を報告し、播種組織の成熟度の予後的意義を文献とともに考察している。
pmid-2048608.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl with grade 3 immature ovarian teratoma had extensive peritoneal implants of mature glial tissue, a condition called gliomatosis peritonei. Two laparotomies showed the implants remained mature. Over five years later, she developed a malignant abdominal glial neoplasm, a rare example of malignant transformation of previously mature gliomatosis peritonei. The authors review the literature and emphasize the prognostic significance of implant maturity.

pmid-2049745.summary_ja: 精巣の胎児性癌が下大静脈から右心房へ進展した症例。術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で血管内進展を確認し、体外循環下に血管内および右心房内の進展部を切除した。心内進展は根治的手術の禁忌ではないと結論し、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後の肺・リンパ節腫瘤と同様の治療上の問題を指摘している。
pmid-2049745.summary_en: A patient with embryonal carcinoma of the testis extended into the inferior vena cava and right atrium. Preoperative computed tomography demonstrated the intravascular tumor extent. Using extracorporeal circulation, the intravascular and right atrial extension was successfully resected. The authors conclude that cardiac extension does not contraindicate radical surgery, and that such extension poses therapeutic and prognostic issues similar to pulmonary or nodal masses after chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor.

pmid-2050306.summary_ja: 妊娠に合併した卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告で、報告としては10例目にあたる。卵黄嚢腫瘍は卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍として2番目に多いが、妊娠との合併は極めて稀である。既報の症例を集計し、妊娠中の臨床経過と管理について文献的にまとめている。
pmid-2050306.summary_en: This case report describes a pregnant woman with ovarian endodermal sinus tumor, the second most common malignant ovarian germ cell tumor. It is the 10th reported case of this tumor associated with pregnancy. The authors review the prior literature on endodermal sinus tumors complicating pregnancy, highlighting how rarely the two conditions coincide. Its clinical course and management in pregnancy are summarized from published cases.

pmid-2051106.summary_ja: 前縦隔セミノーマに放射線照射と化学療法を受けた45歳男性が、同部位に骨肉腫を発症した。剖検では胚細胞成分は認めなかった。発生機序として胚細胞腫瘍の間葉成分の悪性転化と放射線誘発性骨肉腫の2仮説を提示し、剖検所見から後者が最も考えられるとしている。長期生存者でも二次性悪性腫瘍の経過観察が必要と指摘する。
pmid-2051106.summary_en: A 45-year-old man treated with radiation and chemotherapy for anterior mediastinal seminoma later developed osteosarcoma in the same field, without residual germ cell component at autopsy. The authors propose two mechanisms: malignant transformation of the mesenchymal component of the germ cell tumor, or radiation-induced sarcoma. Autopsy findings favored radiation-induced osteosarcoma, and they caution that long-term survivors need surveillance for secondary malignancy.

pmid-2052334.summary_ja: 口蓋に生じた稀な口腔内奇形腫(Epipalatus)について報告する。本抄録は、過誤腫、迷入腫、類皮嚢腫、奇形腫様腫瘍、真の奇形腫を含む頭頸部の発生異常性腫瘍の分類を概説し、腫瘍内の胚葉構成と組織の複雑さに基づく分類法を示している。
pmid-2052334.summary_en: This report describes epipalatus, a rare intraoral teratoma arising at the palate. The abstract reviews the classification of developmental head and neck tumors, including hamartoma, choristoma, dermoid cysts, teratoid tumors, and true teratomas. Classification is based on the embryonic layers represented within the tumor and their level of organizational complexity. Distinguishing hamartomas, which grow in parallel with the host, from choristomas, which consist of displaced normal tissue, provides a framework for diagnosing such lesions. The paper highlights the diagnostic difficulty of rare oral teratomas.

pmid-2052511.summary_ja: 本病理報告は、新生児期に同部位から成熟奇形腫が切除された3歳の女児に発生した鼻咽頭卵黄嚢腫瘍を記述している。先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫は通常良性であるのに対し、卵黄嚢腫瘍は侵襲性で通常致命的である。局所再発の後に播種性疾患となり、18か月以内に死亡した。本症例は、良性奇形腫の後に悪性胚細胞腫瘍が生じる経過を示唆しており、長期の注意深いフォローアップの必要性を示している。
pmid-2052511.summary_en: This pathology report describes a 3-year-old girl with endodermal sinus tumor of the nasopharynx who had a mature teratoma excised from the same site in the neonatal period. Nasopharyngeal congenital teratomas are typically benign, whereas endodermal sinus tumors behave aggressively and usually prove fatal. Local recurrence was followed by disseminated disease and death within 18 months. The case suggests a sequence in which a benign teratoma at a site is followed by a malignant germ cell tumor, highlighting the need for vigilant long-term follow-up.

pmid-2052972.summary_ja: 48,XXYY型クラインフェルター症候群の患者に精巣セミノーマが生じた症例を報告する。この核型でのセミノーマの報告は初めてとされる。腫瘍は正常位置に降下した精巣に発生していた。施設入所者では精巣腫瘍の認識が遅れやすいため、こうした患者では精巣腫瘍を鑑別に含めることの重要性を強調している。
pmid-2052972.summary_en: This report describes a patient with the 48,XXYY variant of Klinefelter's syndrome who developed a seminoma. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first reported case of seminoma in this karyotype. The tumor arose in a normally descended testis. The authors note that patients with 48,XXYY syndrome are often institutionalized, where testicular tumors may be recognized less readily. The report emphasizes considering testicular tumor in such patients to avoid delayed diagnosis.

pmid-2053779.summary_ja: 不全流産後に子宮絨毛癌を発症した27歳女性の症例報告である。メトトレキサート2コースは無効で、尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の持続的上昇に対しエトポシドを投与した。hCGは速やかに正常化し、約3か月で完全寛解を得た。メトトレキサート抵抗性の絨毛癌に対するエトポシドのサルベージ療法としての有効性を示す。
pmid-2053779.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 27-year-old woman with uterine choriocarcinoma after an incomplete abortion. Urinary hCG was markedly elevated, and ultrasonography showed a uterine tumor. After total hysterectomy, two courses of methotrexate were ineffective. Persistent hCG elevation led to etoposide therapy, which rapidly normalized hCG and achieved complete remission after about three months of oral treatment. The case illustrates etoposide's value as salvage therapy in methotrexate-resistant gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2057438.summary_ja: 長年存在した皮下の類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫の一型)から扁平上皮癌が生じた44歳男性の症例である。類皮嚢腫の悪性転化は極めてまれで、この部位での報告は初めてとされる。小児期に認められた表在性の正中部病変は、十分な精査と治療が必要であると強調している。奇形腫由来病変の悪性変化の範囲を広げる症例である。
pmid-2057438.summary_en: This report describes a 44-year-old man with squamous cell carcinoma arising in a long-standing subcutaneous dermoid cyst. Malignant transformation of dermoid cysts is exceptionally rare, and this is the first recorded case at this site. The authors stress that superficial midline lesions presenting in childhood require adequate investigation and treatment. The case broadens the recognized spectrum of malignant change in dermoid-derived lesions.

pmid-2058849.summary_ja: 58歳女性に生じた、体重18.75kgに及ぶ成人の仙尾部奇形腫の外科的切除例を報告する。腫瘍は出生時から存在し、34年前に生検のみで治療されていなかった。内腸骨動脈の事前結紮と人工肛門造設を併用した腹仙骨合併切除により、大きな出血なく切除に成功した。病理学的には悪性と診断された。
pmid-2058849.summary_en: This report describes successful removal of what is believed to be the largest adult sacrococcygeal teratoma on record, weighing 18.75 kg, in a 58-year-old woman. The tumor had been present since birth and was biopsied 34 years earlier without further treatment. Careful planning was needed to position the patient safely. A combined abdominosacral resection with preliminary internal iliac artery ligation and diversionary colostomy was performed without major blood loss. Pathology confirmed the tumor was malignant.

pmid-2059799.summary_ja: 常染色体優性遺伝の仙骨無形成を示す家系(罹患者10名)を報告した。4名が仙骨前部奇形腫と前方仙骨髄膜瘤を有し、うち3名で細菌性髄膜炎、奇形腫の局所再発、会陰部敗血症などの重篤な合併症が生じた。脊髄係留や尿路異常などの関連異常も報告されている。著者らは仙骨前部腫瘤の早期診断と外科的切除を推奨している。
pmid-2059799.summary_en: This report describes a family with autosomal dominant sacral agenesis, in which ten members were affected. Four had presacral teratomas with anterior sacral meningoceles, and three of these developed serious complications including bacterial meningitis, local teratoma recurrence and perianal sepsis. Associated anomalies included tethered cord, hydrocephalus, urinary tract abnormalities and hereditary spherocytosis. The authors advise early diagnosis and surgical excision of presacral masses to prevent morbidity and mortality.

pmid-2060358.summary_ja: 26歳男性が肺結節と左精巣腫瘤で受診し、悪性混合性胚細胞精巣腫瘍と診断された。併用化学療法により肺結節は縮小し、β-hCG、LDH、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常化した。その後増大した肺結節を切除したところ成熟奇形腫が確認され、growing teratoma syndromeと診断された。腫瘍マーカーが正常でも病変が増大しうることが示された。
pmid-2060358.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with pulmonary nodules and a left testicular mass was treated for a malignant mixed germ cell testicular tumor. Combination chemotherapy shrank the lung nodules and normalized beta-HCG, LDH and AFP. Later, enlarging nodules were surgically resected and showed mature teratomas, establishing the diagnosis of growing teratoma syndrome, a condition in which mature teratoma grows despite chemotherapy with normalized tumor markers.

pmid-2062572.summary_ja: 33歳男性の精巣の成熟奇形腫内に発生した原発性精巣カルチノイド腫瘍を報告した。アルジロフィル反応およびアルゲンタフィン反応は陽性で、5-HTおよびガストリンに対する免疫反応陽性細胞と神経分泌顆粒が確認された。英文文献の検討で類似例は少なくとも6例であった。
pmid-2062572.summary_en: A rare primary testicular carcinoid tumor arising within a mature teratoma from a 33-year-old man was characterized by histochemistry, immunohistochemistry and electron microscopy. Argyrophil and argentaffin reactions were positive, with immunoreactivity for serotonin and gastrin, and neurosecretory-type granules on electron microscopy. The authors reviewed the English literature and found at least six similar cases.

pmid-2066177.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株Jeg-3はHLA-Gを発現し、NK細胞による傷害には抵抗性を示すが、LAK細胞には傷害される。同種・異種のCTLや増殖応答は誘導されず、Jeg-3細胞はリンパ球増殖を抑制した。この抑制はIL-2で回避可能であり、胎児の生存や腫瘍の免疫回避機構との関連が示唆された。
pmid-2066177.summary_en: This study examines how the choriocarcinoma cell line Jeg-3, which expresses HLA-G and low levels of a novel HLA-C product, is recognized by the immune system. Jeg-3 cells resisted NK cytotoxicity but were killed by LAK cells, partly via T cells. Allogeneic and xenogeneic CTL or proliferative responses were not generated against them. Jeg-3 cells suppressed lymphocyte proliferation, an effect not reproduced by conditioned medium and overridable by IL-2. The authors suggest this trophoblast-like immune evasion may parallel mechanisms that allow fetal survival or tumor persistence.

pmid-2069106.summary_ja: 精巣内腫瘤で根治的精巣摘除術を受けた32歳男性の組織型は、典型的な精巣セミノーマであった。後腹膜腫瘤を転移と考えPVB化学療法を3コース施行したが、腫瘤は残存した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清の結果、良性の神経鞘腫と判明した。部位と化学療法への不応性が、セミノーマのリンパ節転移と他起源の原発腫瘍の鑑別に有用と考察された。
pmid-2069106.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with an intrascrotal mass underwent radical orchiectomy, revealing typical testicular seminoma. A supra-hilar retroperitoneal mass was initially presumed to be metastatic seminoma, and he received three cycles of PVB chemotherapy. The mass persisted, and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy showed a benign schwannoma. The authors propose that tumor location and chemoresistance may help distinguish seminoma nodal metastases from primary tumors of other origin.

pmid-2070582.summary_ja: 転移性未熟卵巣奇形腫の患者7例に手術と併用化学療法を行い、二回目の開腹術を施行した。連続コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で6例にレトロコンバージョンが認められ、病変濃度の上昇、境界の明瞭化、内部石灰化、脂肪・嚢胞変化がみられた。これらの変化はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の正常化と一致した。
pmid-2070582.summary_en: Seven patients with metastatic immature ovarian teratoma were treated with surgery, combination chemotherapy, and a second laparotomy. Serial CT scans showed retroconversion in six patients, with increased lesion density, better-defined margins, and internal calcification with fatty and cystic change. These CT changes matched normalization of raised AFP in all six. The second laparotomy found only mature teratoma, and none has shown malignant relapse after 1 to 6 years of follow-up.

pmid-2072143.summary_ja: 精巣がん病期B1の39例を後方視的に検討した報告です。後腹膜リンパ節郭清のみで治療し、中央値3.5年の観察で再発は3例(8%)でした。著者らは、多くの病期B1患者は郭清単独で十分であり、補助化学療法は再発時に用いるべきと結論しています。病期B2には白金製剤による2～3サイクルの補助化学療法が行われました。
pmid-2072143.summary_en: This retrospective review of 39 patients with pathologic stage B1 testicular cancer found that retroperitoneal lymph node dissection alone achieved a relapse rate of 8% (3 of 39) during a median follow-up of 3.5 years. Relapses occurred only in the lungs or retrocrural nodes and were salvaged. The authors conclude that RPLND alone suffices for most stage B1 patients, reserving adjuvant chemotherapy for relapse, while stage B2 patients received two or three cycles of platinum-based chemotherapy.

pmid-2072607.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者3例で、対側精巣に組織型の異なる異時性腫瘍(いずれもセミノーマ、病期I)が発生した症例報告です。初発腫瘍は卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、混合型腫瘍でした。2例は初診から8～11年後に原病で死亡しており、異時性腫瘍の発生と経過の臨床的特徴が検討されています。
pmid-2072607.summary_en: This report describes three patients with bilateral metachronous testicular germ cell tumors of differing histology. Each patient developed a contralateral seminoma (stage I) years after the initial tumor, which was a yolk sac tumor, teratoma, or mixed tumor, indicating a risk of second primary tumors. Two patients died of cancer 8 to 11 years after the initial diagnosis, and one was treated with radiation for the new lesion. The authors discuss the clinical features of these cases.

pmid-2072611.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がん(病期IIB)の治療後に医原性の逆行性射精を生じた男性の不妊症例です。内服薬やホルモン注射に加え、AIHを4年間で24回行った結果、健康な女児が誕生しました。著者らは、医原性の逆行性射精による不妊に対してAIHは有効であり、より積極的に用いるべきだと述べています。
pmid-2072611.summary_en: A man with non-seminomatous testicular cancer (stage IIB) developed iatrogenic retrograde ejaculation six years after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy. He was treated with oral medications, hormone injections, and artificial insemination of husband (AIH). After 24 AIH sessions over four years, his spouse gave birth to a healthy baby girl. The authors recommend AIH as an effective option for infertility from iatrogenic retrograde ejaculation.

pmid-27463041.summary_ja: 縦隔の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に続発する血液悪性腫瘍についての総説です。血液腫瘍は胚細胞腫瘍の診断後6か月以内に発症することが多く、巨核球系の異常が目立つと報告されています。両者が同じ12p等染色体(i12p)を共有することから、多能性の悪性胚細胞に由来するクローン性の関連が示唆されています。
pmid-27463041.summary_en: This review examines the association between mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumors and subsequent hematologic malignancies, which typically develop within six months of the germ cell tumor diagnosis. Affected patients share isochromosome 12p in both the mediastinal tumor and the leukemic blasts, and the hematologic malignancies show predominantly megakaryocytic features. The authors suggest the two malignancies are clonally related, possibly arising from a multipotent malignant germ cell.

pmid-37281160.summary_ja: 多能性の胎児性癌細胞株PCC3 N/Iを用い、細胞増殖とDNA分裂周期の関係を検討した基礎研究です。DNA分裂周期は比較的一定である一方、細胞増殖周期が変動し、それが増殖の不均一性の主因であると示されました。著者らは二つのサブサイクルからなる細胞周期モデルを提唱し、核細胞質比が細胞周期ごとに変化しうることを報告しています。
pmid-37281160.summary_en: This basic study examines the pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cell line PCC3 N/I, which shows bimodal heterogeneity in growth rate. Using combined protein and DNA staining, the authors found that the DNA-division cycle remained relatively constant while the cell-growth cycle varied, explaining the growth heterogeneity. They propose a two-subcycles cell cycle model and suggest that the nucleo-cytoplasmic ratio can change from one cell cycle to the next.

pmid-1649392.summary_ja: 本研究は、JEG-3絨毛癌細胞を用いたルシフェラーゼレポーター解析により、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)β鎖遺伝子のcAMP応答エレメントを同定したものである。-311〜-202 bpの配列がcAMP応答性を付与し、この領域内に3つのタンパク質結合部位が認められた。CREBは結合せず、CREB以外の転写因子の関与が示唆された。臨床研究ではなく基礎的な転写調節研究である。
pmid-1649392.summary_en: This study defines the cAMP-responsive element of the human chorionic gonadotropin (CG) beta-subunit gene using a luciferase reporter in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. Deletion analysis showed that sequences between -311 and -202 bp confer cAMP responsiveness, and DNase footprinting identified three protein-binding sites within this region. Recombinant CREB did not bind these sites, and the sequence shares no homology with the alpha-gene CRE, suggesting that a non-CREB cAMP-responsive factor regulates the CG beta promoter. This is basic transcriptional biology; the choriocarcinoma line serves as an experimental tool rather than as a clinical subject.

pmid-1666295.summary_ja: 本基礎研究は、多能性細胞株であるP19胎児性癌細胞の接着欠損変異株を解析した。3株すべてでウボモルリン（E-カドヘリン）の発現が低下し、凝集能とレチノイン酸処理後のニューロン形成能が低下していた。接着欠損の表現型は、部分的にウボモルリンの表面発現低下によると結論された。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、細胞接着と分化を扱う研究である。
pmid-1666295.summary_en: This basic science study examined adhesion-defective variants of P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, a pluripotent cell line model. Three mutant lines showed reduced uvomorulin (E-cadherin) expression, impaired aggregation, and lower neuron formation after retinoic acid treatment. The authors conclude that the adhesion defect is partly due to reduced uvomorulin surface expression. The study addresses cell adhesion and differentiation rather than clinical germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-1675427.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株PA-1のN-ras形質転換クローンを用い、レチノイン酸による分化誘導とホメオボックス遺伝子発現の変化を調べた基礎研究です。N-rasで形質転換した細胞では、HOX1遺伝子の誘導が遅延していました。HOX1.4を恒常的に発現させると分化形態と増殖抑制が回復しました。rasによる増殖亢進が分化制御遺伝子を抑制することを示しています。
pmid-1675427.summary_en: This basic research study uses clones of the human teratocarcinoma line PA-1 to examine how activated N-ras alters retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Retinoic acid normally induces sequential expression of HOX1 and HOX2 homeobox genes. In N-ras-transformed clones, induction is delayed, with HOX1.4 and HOX1.3 appearing only after 10 days. Constitutive expression of HOX1.4 restores differentiated morphology and growth inhibition. The findings link ras-driven proliferation to suppression of homeobox genes that control teratocarcinoma differentiation.

pmid-1680548.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌F9細胞に対し、トポイソメラーゼ阻害剤が分化を誘導するかを検討した。レチノイン酸による分化と類似した形態・生化学的変化が生じたが、分化抵抗性変異株では経路が異なることが示された。主に胎児性癌モデルを用いた基礎的細胞生物学研究である。
pmid-1680548.summary_en: The authors examined whether topoisomerase inhibitors (camptothecin, teniposide, genistein) can induce in vitro differentiation of mouse embryonal carcinoma F9 cells. All three agents produced morphological and biochemical changes resembling retinoic acid-induced differentiation into parietal endoderm-like cells. However, mutant cell lines resistant to retinoic acid responded differently, suggesting that the topoisomerase inhibitor pathway involves distinct molecular steps. The study is primarily basic cell biology using an embryonal carcinoma model.

pmid-1681491.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫由来のPA-1細胞株を用い、N-ras癌遺伝子の活性化が分化と腫瘍原性に与える影響を検討した。非腫瘍原性株はレチノイン酸に応答したが、N-ras形質転換の腫瘍原性細胞は応答しなかった。体細胞雑種は非腫瘍原性でレチノイン酸に応答し、染色体欠失を伴う復帰変異株は応答性を失った。腫瘍原性が応答性を規定すると結論している。
pmid-1681491.summary_en: The authors used the human ovarian teratoma-derived line PA-1 to study how N-ras oncogene activation affects differentiation and tumorigenicity. Non-tumorigenic variants responded to retinoic acid, while N-ras-transformed tumorigenic cells did not. Somatic cell hybrids were non-tumorigenic and retinoic acid-responsive, but tumorigenic revertants lost responsiveness after chromosome loss. The authors conclude that tumorigenicity, not oncogene expression alone, controls retinoic acid resistance.

pmid-1682397.summary_ja: 多能性ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NEC14をHMBAで処理し、分化マーカーの変化を検討した。HLA抗原が増加し、SSEA-3からSSEA-1への変化がみられた。ビメンチンとテネイシンが出現し、胚性中胚葉の間葉系成分へ分化したと示唆された。臨床的知見は含まない基礎研究である。
pmid-1682397.summary_en: The authors induced differentiation of a pluripotent human embryonal carcinoma cell line, NEC14, with hexamethylene bisacetamide (HMBA) and tracked changes in cell surface antigens, lectin binding, intermediate filaments, and extracellular matrix proteins. Major histocompatibility antigens increased, stage-specific embryonic antigen expression shifted from SSEA-3 to SSEA-1, and vimentin and tenascin appeared. The findings suggest that the cells differentiated toward embryonal mesodermal mesenchymal elements.

pmid-1683482.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞のレチノイン酸分化過程におけるHox-2.1遺伝子の転写を検討した。誘導後にmRNAと転写速度が上昇した。トポイソメラーゼII阻害剤のエトポシドは転写を阻害したが、mRNAの安定性には影響しなかった。トポイソメラーゼIIが分化時のHox-2.1転写制御に関与すると示された。
pmid-1683482.summary_en: The authors studied Hox-2.1 transcription during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Hox-2.1 mRNA and its transcription rate rose after induction. Treatment with the topoisomerase II inhibitor etoposide blocked this transcription without affecting mRNA stability. The results indicate that topoisomerase II participates in controlling Hox-2.1 gene transcription during differentiation. The study is basic gene regulation research in an embryonal carcinoma model.

pmid-1708373.summary_ja: 胎児性癌のモデル細胞であるF9細胞を用い、cAMPによる壁側内胚葉様細胞への分化を検討した。培地の種類が分化応答を大きく左右し、MEMではレチノイン酸なしでも分化したが、DMEMではレチノイン酸が必要であった。増殖速度に培地差はなかった。従来の陰性結果は培地選択によると考えられる。
pmid-1708373.summary_en: F9 teratocarcinoma cells, a model of embryonal carcinoma, were studied for their differentiation into parietal endoderm-like cells under cAMP treatment. The authors found that culture medium strongly influenced the response: cells in minimal essential medium differentiated with cAMP alone, while those in Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium required retinoic acid. Growth rates were unchanged between media. Prior negative findings may reflect medium choice.

pmid-1710586.summary_ja: 臓側内胚葉様細胞株が、マウスP19胎児性癌細胞の凝集と分化を誘導することを示した研究である。臓側内胚葉様細胞との共培養により心筋や骨格筋への分化が生じたが、壁側内胚葉様細胞株や中胚葉様細胞株では誘導されなかった。END-2株の馴化培地は拡散性因子を介して強力な分化誘導を示した。腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、胚発生モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-1710586.summary_en: This study shows that visceral-endoderm-like cell lines, and medium conditioned by them, induce aggregation and differentiation of murine P19 embryonal carcinoma cells. Coculture with visceral-endoderm-like lines triggered differentiation into cardiac and skeletal muscle, whereas parietal-endoderm and mesoderm-like lines did not. Medium from the END-2 line strongly induced endodermal and mesodermal differentiation through a diffusible factor. The work uses EC cells as a model of embryonic differentiation rather than as a clinical tumor study.

pmid-1761878.summary_ja: 顎下三角に生じた側方類皮嚢腫の1例を報告した症例報告。口腔内の腫脹を先行せずに発症した。診断には超音波検査が有用であり、第一選択の検査とされた。本症は胚細胞腫瘍ではなく先天性の発生性嚢胞であるため、本サイトの対象としての関連性は限定的である。
pmid-1761878.summary_en: A case of a lateral dermoid cyst in the submandibular triangle of the neck is reported in a patient without prior intraoral swelling. Sonography provided the diagnosis and is recommended as the first investigation. The report describes a developmental cystic lesion rather than a germ cell neoplasm. Its relevance to this site is marginal, because neck dermoid cysts are congenital inclusion lesions.

pmid-1766870.summary_ja: 未分化ヒト胎児性癌（EC）細胞に特異的なcDNAクローンを単離するため、オリゴdT-ラテックスとPCRを用いたサブトラクティブcDNAクローニング法を開発した。HMBAで分化誘導したNEC14細胞を比較対象とし、低発現mRNA由来のクローンを効率よく濃縮できた。全体の約3%が未分化EC細胞特異的であった。主に手法に関する報告である。
pmid-1766870.summary_en: The authors used oligo(dT)30-latex-based subtractive cDNA cloning combined with PCR to isolate cDNA clones specific to undifferentiated human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, using the NEC14 cell line induced to differentiate with HMBA as the comparison. The approach improved subtraction efficiency and enrichment of low-abundance transcripts. About 3% of the roughly 10,000 clones were specific to undifferentiated EC cells. The study is primarily a methods paper using an EC cell line model.

pmid-1767339.summary_ja: H6胎児性癌細胞の亜株6B(NG)C25では、uvomorulin（E-カドヘリン）遺伝子の発現が消失しており、遺伝子自体の大きな異常は認められなかった。このコンパクション欠損変異には、遺伝子発現を制御するトランス作用因子の関与が示唆されている。胎児性癌細胞株を用いた細胞生物学的研究で、臨床データは含まない。
pmid-1767339.summary_en: The authors report that the 6B(NG)C25 subline of H6 embryonal carcinoma cells lacks uvomorulin (E-cadherin) protein because of loss of gene expression, without gross alteration of the gene itself. This suggests that the dominant mutation in this compaction-defective variant may involve a trans-acting regulatory factor. The study is a short cell-biology report using an embryonal carcinoma cell line as the model, with no clinical tumor data.

pmid-1816655.summary_ja: 若年男性の口腔底に生じた大きな類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。手による触診で発見され、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で確認された。外科的切除により合併症や再発なく回復した。口腔底の類皮嚢腫を胚細胞腫瘍の範囲に含めるかは分類上の判断を要する。
pmid-1816655.summary_en: This case report describes a large dermoid cyst in the floor of the mouth of a young male patient. The lesion was detected on manual palpation and confirmed by magnetic resonance imaging. The cyst was removed surgically, and the patient recovered without complications or recurrence. The paper is a single-case report with a brief literature review. Whether an oral floor dermoid belongs within the germ cell tumor spectrum, as opposed to a developmental choristomatous lesion, is a classification question, so relevance is uncertain.

pmid-1821848.summary_ja: 単離した正常細胞性栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌由来のJEG-3・BeWo細胞を用いて、E-カドヘリンの発現変化を解析した基礎研究である。細胞融合に伴いE-カドヘリンは消失し、cAMP処理はBeWo細胞の融合とE-カドヘリン低下を誘導した。細胞外ドメインへの抗体は合胞体形成を阻害した。主題は正常胎盤の栄養膜細胞の分化であり、絨毛癌細胞株はモデルとして使用されている。
pmid-1821848.summary_en: This study investigates E-cadherin expression during human trophoblast differentiation, using isolated primary cytotrophoblasts and the choriocarcinoma-derived lines JEG-3 and BeWo. E-cadherin localized at cell-cell contacts during aggregation and was lost as cells fused into syncytia. Non-fusing JEG-3 cells maintained E-cadherin levels, while cAMP treatment induced fusion and reduced E-cadherin mRNA and protein in BeWo cells. Function-blocking antibodies against the extracellular domain inhibited syncytium formation. The main focus is normal placental trophoblast biology, with choriocarcinoma lines used as experimental models, so relevance is uncertain.

pmid-1834345.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株の上清が、ヒトやマウスの免疫応答を抑制することを示した研究です。サプレッサー細胞の誘導も確認されました。胎盤における局所免疫抑制の仕組みを、栄養膜細胞株をモデルとして考察しています。抑制因子の関与が示唆されています。臨床疾患の研究ではなく、基礎免疫学の知見です。
pmid-1834345.summary_en: Supernatants from human choriocarcinoma cell lines (HCS) are tested for immunosuppressive activity in human and murine systems. HCS suppresses mitogen-driven proliferation, mixed lymphocyte reactions, antigen-induced T-cell proliferation, and in vivo allogeneic responses. Intraperitoneal HCS induces suppressor cells that block allogeneic responses in other mice. The authors propose that choriocarcinoma-derived suppressor factors may contribute to local immune tolerance at the placenta, where the cell line serves as a model of trophoblastic immunology rather than as a clinical disease study.

pmid-1840540.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NEC14をHMBAで分化誘導し、N-myc遺伝子の上流制御領域に結合する核因子を解析した基礎研究である。分化初期にDNA-タンパク複合体の形成が減少し、転写レベルでN-mycの発現が抑制されることを示した。臨床症例ではなく細胞株を用いた研究である。
pmid-1840540.summary_en: This basic research study examines how nuclear factors bind the regulatory region of the N-myc gene during HMBA-induced differentiation of the human embryonal carcinoma cell line NEC14. The authors cloned and sequenced the 5' flanking region of the human N-myc gene and identified DNA-protein complexes whose formation decreased during early differentiation. N-myc expression is transcriptionally downregulated, and reduced complex formation correlates with high-level transcription. The work uses cell-line models rather than patients, offering mechanistic insight into embryonal carcinoma biology.

pmid-1841512.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株PCC-7を用い、レチノイン酸による神経分化における細胞凝集の役割を検討した基礎研究である。凝集とレチノイン酸を同時に48時間以上作用させた場合にのみ不可逆的な神経分化が誘導された。細胞同士の接触がレチノイン酸への応答を変えることを示唆する。臨床患者のデータは含まれていない。
pmid-1841512.summary_en: This in vitro study investigates the role of cell aggregation in retinoic acid-induced neural differentiation of the PCC-7 embryonal carcinoma cell line. Forced aggregation alone did not induce neural development, and retinoic acid applied before or after aggregation was also ineffective. Irreversible neural differentiation occurred only when aggregation and retinoic acid acted simultaneously for more than 48 hours. Retinoic acid was toxic to non-aggregated cells. The findings suggest that cell-to-cell contact modifies the cellular response to retinoic acid. No patient data are included.

pmid-1850047.summary_ja: HIVは未分化のNTERA-2胎児性癌細胞では増殖せず、分化誘導後の細胞でのみ増殖する。サイトメガロウイルスの重複感染により、分化細胞のHIV感受性はさらに高まる。HIV感染はラクトシリーズ糖脂質を誘導し、正常な胚発生を妨げる機序が示唆された。胎児性癌細胞はウイルス感受性のモデルとして用いられており、腫瘍そのものの研究ではない。
pmid-1850047.summary_en: HIV replicates in differentiated but not undifferentiated NTERA-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells, which do not express CD4. Cytomegalovirus coinfection enhances HIV permissiveness of the differentiated cells. HIV infection also induces lactoseries glycolipids, suggesting a possible mechanism by which HIV could interfere with normal embryogenesis. The embryonal carcinoma line is used as a model of viral permissiveness, so the paper concerns virology more than germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-1877914.summary_ja: 高齢患者にみられた、約15年前から存在する無症候性の大きなオトガイ下腫脹の症例報告。臨床的に類皮嚢腫と診断され、全摘出により病理学的にも確認された。舌を圧排するほどの大きさでなければ、通常は呼吸困難や嚥下障害、嗄声は伴わないとされる。頸部に生じた発生異常由来の病変で、性腺の胚細胞腫瘍とは異なるため、本サイトとの関連性は不確かである。
pmid-1877914.summary_en: This case report describes an elderly patient with a large, asymptomatic submental swelling present for about fifteen years. Clinically diagnosed as a dermoid cyst, the lesion was completely excised, and histopathology confirmed the diagnosis. The authors note that unless such lesions become very large and displace the tongue, they usually cause no dyspnea, dysphagia, or dysphonia. Because the cyst arose in the neck rather than a gonad, it is a developmental lesion distinct from gonadal germ cell tumors, so its relevance to this site is uncertain.

pmid-1890073.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で胎児性癌細胞株P19を神経様細胞へ分化させた際のミトコンドリアの変化を検討した基礎研究。分化に伴いミトコンドリアの面積比率とサイズが減少し、ミトコンドリアDNA含量も同様に低下した。ミトコンドリアは細胞分化の過程で制御されていることが示された。臨床的な知見ではなく、in vitroの細胞生物学研究である。
pmid-1890073.summary_en: This study investigated mitochondrial changes during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of the P19 embryonal carcinoma cell line into neuron-like cells. Stereologic analysis showed that mitochondrial fractional area and size decreased as cells differentiated. Mitochondrial DNA content, measured with a radiolabeled probe, followed the same pattern. The findings indicate that mitochondria are regulated during differentiation. This is a basic in vitro cell biology study rather than a clinical one.

pmid-1898593.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞の分化に対する酪酸ナトリウムの影響を検討した基礎研究である。処理により細胞形態が大きく変化し、分化マーカーのmRNA量が増加した。酪酸を除去すると未分化幹細胞の表現型へ可逆的に戻り、この復帰には新たなmRNAとタンパク質の合成が必要であった。患者や臨床管理は対象としていない。
pmid-1898593.summary_en: This in vitro study examined how sodium butyrate affects differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Treated cells showed marked morphological changes and increased mRNA levels of differentiation markers. Upon removal of butyrate, the phenotype reverted to undifferentiated stem-cell features, which required de novo mRNA and protein synthesis. The findings are basic cell biology and do not address patients or clinical management of germ cell tumors.

pmid-1909429.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞の分化過程におけるEgr-1とc-fosの発現調節を検討した。Egr-1 mRNAは転写調節により約3倍に増加し、c-fos mRNAは分化後に約20倍に増加した。主にmRNA安定性の上昇によるものだった。両タンパク質は分化細胞で安定化し、終末分化細胞では58 kDaのc-Fos種が目立った。臨床腫瘍学ではなく分化の基礎研究である。
pmid-1909429.summary_en: Study of Egr-1 and c-fos expression during differentiation of P19 embryonal carcinoma cells. Egr-1 mRNA increased threefold over 7-10 days of differentiation, largely through transcriptional regulation with stable transcripts. c-fos mRNA rose 20-fold after differentiation, mainly due to increased mRNA stability. Both proteins became more stable in differentiated cells, and a 58 kDa c-Fos species was prominent in terminally differentiated cells. The work concerns early-response gene regulation in differentiation rather than clinical tumor biology.

pmid-1917782.summary_ja: 1973〜1977年に樹立された奇形癌由来の細胞株を対象に、オリゴヌクレオチドによるDNAフィンガープリンティングを適用した方法論研究。異なる時期に樹立された株を識別でき、PYS-2のサブラインも複数プローブの組み合わせで判別できた。長期培養細胞の変化の監視に有用とされる。
pmid-1917782.summary_en: This methods study applied multilocus oligonucleotide DNA fingerprinting to cell lines established from a human teratocarcinoma between 1973 and 1977. The technique distinguished lines derived at different times and discriminated sublines of the PYS-2 line using combined probes. The authors conclude that oligonucleotide fingerprinting is a useful way to monitor changes and track identity in long-term cultured cell lines.

pmid-1935783.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞を初期胚発生のモデルとして用い、カルシトニン(CT)およびCT遺伝子関連ペプチド(CGRP)の走化性をBoydenチャンバー法で検討した基礎研究である。CTとCGRPは強い走化反応を示し、分化した細胞では反応が低かった。走化作用はcAMP産生を促す濃度より低濃度で生じ、CT遺伝子産物が初期胚発生時の細胞遊走を調節する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1935783.summary_en: This in vitro study examined whether calcitonin (CT) and CT gene-related peptide (CGRP) attract F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, a model of early embryonic development, using a Boyden chamber assay. CT and CGRP produced strong chemotactic responses, with salmon CT and chicken CGRP the most potent. Differentiated F9 cells and parietal endodermal PYS cells responded poorly. Chemotactic activity occurred at lower concentrations than those needed for cAMP stimulation, suggesting CT gene products may regulate cell migration during early embryogenesis. The work is basic cell biology rather than clinical tumor management.

pmid-1936556.summary_ja: マウスP19胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸で処理し、転写因子Egr-1の動態を解析した基礎研究である。Egr-1のmRNAとタンパク質は暴露後30分以内に一過性に急増し、タンパク質合成阻害剤存在下でも誘導が持続した。高濃度ほど反応は速く、Egr-1が分化経路の開始に関与する可能性が示唆された。臨床的な腫瘍管理の内容は含まれない。
pmid-1936556.summary_en: This study investigated the transcription factor Egr-1 in murine P19 embryonal carcinoma cells treated with retinoic acid (RA). Egr-1 transcript and protein rose rapidly and transiently within 30 minutes of RA exposure. Induction persisted in the presence of protein synthesis inhibitors, suggesting relief of a block to transcriptional elongation. The response was faster at higher RA concentrations. The authors propose that Egr-1 may help initiate differentiation pathways in these cells. The paper is basic developmental biology using a cell line model, with no clinical germ cell tumor content.

pmid-1939166.summary_ja: マウスP19奇形癌細胞において、レチノイン酸がアルカリホスファターゼ(ALP)の発現に与える影響を検討した基礎研究である。RAは用量依存的にALP活性を誘導し、4時間後に検出され48時間で最大となった。誘導はタンパク質合成に依存し、mRNA安定化ではなく転写亢進によるものであった。胎児性癌細胞モデルにおける分化マーカーの変化を示すが、臨床的な腫瘍管理の知見は含まれない。
pmid-1939166.summary_en: This study examined how retinoic acid (RA) affects alkaline phosphatase (ALP) in murine P19 teratocarcinoma cells. RA induced ALP activity in a dose-dependent manner, detectable within 4 hours and maximal at 48 hours. The induction depended on protein synthesis and was accompanied by increased ALP protein and mRNA. The increase in mRNA was attributed to enhanced transcription rather than mRNA stabilization. These findings describe a differentiation marker response in an embryonal carcinoma cell model. The work is basic molecular biology without clinical tumor management content.

pmid-1939209.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞をall-trans-レチノイン酸で処理すると神経分化が誘導され、インテグリンαvβ1およびαvβ3の発現が増加した。αvβ1の細胞表面発現は神経突起形成と強く相関し、レチノイン酸抵抗性変異株では誘導されなかった。αvβ1が神経分化に重要な役割を果たすと考えられる。細胞株を用いた基礎研究であり、臨床的な腫瘍管理の内容は含まれない。
pmid-1939209.summary_en: Using P19 murine embryonal carcinoma cells, this study shows that all-trans retinoic acid induces neuronal differentiation with strong upregulation of integrin heterodimers. Surface expression of alpha v beta 1 rose sharply and correlated tightly with neuronal process formation, while alpha v beta 3 was induced to a lesser degree. A retinoic acid-resistant variant failed to induce these integrins. The authors propose that alpha v beta 1 plays an important role in neuronal differentiation. The study is basic cell biology using a cell line, with no direct clinical germ cell tumor management content.

pmid-1986609.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株を用い、メトトレキサートとフォルスコリンが栄養膜細胞の中間型表現型への分化を誘導することを示した。両者ともhCG分泌とアロマターゼ活性を増加させ、核面積も増大した。フォルスコリンはアデニル酸シクラーゼ経路を介して分化を誘導し、メトトレキサートは別の独立したシグナルを介すると考えられた。絨毛癌細胞株は分化のモデルとして用いられている。
pmid-1986609.summary_en: Two chemically dissimilar agents, methotrexate and forskolin, induced cultured BeWo choriocarcinoma cells to shift from a cytotrophoblast toward an intermediate trophoblast phenotype. Both increased hCG secretion, aromatase activity, and nuclear area, and forskolin also raised thymidine incorporation. The findings suggest trophoblast differentiation can be induced in vitro via adenylyl cyclase activation by forskolin, while methotrexate acts through apparently independent signals. The choriocarcinoma line serves as a differentiation model.

pmid-2007996.summary_ja: ポリ(I:C)によるプライミングとスーパーインダクションを用い、正常胎盤細胞と絨毛癌細胞株（JAR、JEG-3、BeWo）のインターフェロン産生を比較した研究である。正常栄養膜細胞などはプライミングに応答したが、絨毛癌細胞は応答しなかった。併用により胎盤線維芽細胞で非常に高い産生量が得られ、正常細胞と悪性転換細胞のインターフェロン感受性の制御機構の理解に寄与すると考えられる。
pmid-2007996.summary_en: This 1991 study examined interferon production by normal placental cells and choriocarcinoma cell lines (JAR, JEG-3, BeWo) after priming and superinduction with poly(I:C). Normal trophoblast, fibroblasts and macrophages responded to priming, whereas choriocarcinoma cells did not. Combined priming and superinduction produced very high interferon yields in placental fibroblasts. The authors suggest these findings clarify how normal and malignant cells control interferon sensitivity, and that the large yields could support antiviral and immunomodulatory research.

pmid-2009524.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞を用い、胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼ（GCAP）の遺伝子転写と酵素活性を検討した研究である。酪酸ナトリウムはGCAPの転写と酵素合成を増加させた。ツニカマイシンによる解析からGCAPは2か所にN結合型糖鎖を持つことが示された。糖鎖を欠いても二量体化や触媒活性は保たれ、糖鎖は酵素機能に必須ではないと結論された。
pmid-2009524.summary_en: This study uses choriocarcinoma cells to investigate germ cell alkaline phosphatase (GCAP), an enzyme closely related to placental alkaline phosphatase. Sodium butyrate increased GCAP gene transcription and enzyme synthesis, and the induction required new protein synthesis. Using tunicamycin, the authors showed that GCAP carries two N-linked glycans. Removing the glycans did not affect dimerization, inhibitor sensitivity or catalytic activity, indicating that glycosylation is dispensable for enzyme function.

pmid-2027759.summary_ja: 胎児性癌cDNAライブラリーから新規ヒト内因性レトロウイルス配列ERV-9を同定した。8kbの転写産物は胎児性癌細胞でのみ検出され、レチノイン酸による分化誘導で発現が抑制された。ゲノム解析でLTR様配列を明らかにし、LTRプロモーターはNT2/D1細胞でのみ活性を示した。胎児性癌細胞に特異的に発現するレトロウイルス要素の特性解析である。
pmid-2027759.summary_en: The authors isolated a novel human endogenous retroviral sequence, ERV-9, from an embryonal carcinoma cDNA library. Its 8 kb transcript was detected only in embryonal carcinoma cells and was downregulated during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of NT2/D1 cells. Genomic analysis revealed LTR-like sequences, and the LTR drove CAT reporter expression specifically in NT2/D1 cells. The study characterizes retroviral elements with cell-type-specific expression in embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-2041056.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で誘導した神経分化で、ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1の神経フィラメントmRNAが増加した。PKA総活性は約7倍、PKCβのmRNAは約12倍に上昇した。これらのキナーゼ変化が分化状態の確立と維持に必要かもしれないと考察している。
pmid-2041056.summary_en: Retinoic acid induced neuronal differentiation of the human embryonal carcinoma line NT2/D1. Differentiated cells showed high neurofilament mRNA, whereas undifferentiated cells did not. Catalytic subunit mRNA and protein of PKA and PKC isoform levels rose, with total PKA activity increasing seven-fold and PKC beta mRNA about twelve-fold. The authors propose these kinase changes may be needed to establish and maintain the differentiated state.

pmid-2065355.summary_ja: 妊娠初期脱落膜の大型顆粒リンパ球(LGL)の、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoおよび分娩時栄養膜に対する細胞傷害活性を検討した。精製したCD56陽性LGLは両標的に傷害活性を示さなかった。IL-2処理した未分画脱落膜細胞はBeWoを傷害したが、栄養膜は傷害されなかった。栄養膜はNK標的構造に乏しいため溶解に抵抗性と考えられる。
pmid-2065355.summary_en: Decidual large granular lymphocytes from early pregnancy were tested for cytotoxicity against the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line and term trophoblast. Purified CD56-positive decidual LGL lacked cytotoxicity against both targets. IL-2 pretreated unfractionated decidual cells lysed BeWo but not term trophoblast. Low binding of trophoblast to effector cells suggests that trophoblast lacks accessible NK target structures, explaining its resistance to lysis.

pmid-1646512.summary_ja: 性腺腫瘍の患者10例について、末梢血の核型を調べ、先天的な染色体異常の有無を検討しています。異数性、染色体の切断、X染色体の欠失が認められ、全例で核型は表現型と一致していました。抄録には腫瘍の組織型が明記されていないため、胚細胞腫瘍を含むかどうかは確認できません。
pmid-1646512.summary_en: This study examined peripheral blood karyotypes of 10 patients with gonadal tumors to detect inherent chromosomal defects. Aneuploidy, chromosomal breakage, and loss of chromosome X were observed. In all cases the karyotype was consistent with the patient's phenotype. The abstract does not specify tumor histology, so whether germ cell tumors were included cannot be confirmed from the text.

pmid-1650624.summary_ja: 発生期腫瘍の遺伝学と細胞生物学の進歩をまとめた総説である。奇形癌(胚細胞腫瘍関連)とウィルムス腫瘍(胎児性腎芽腫)の2つのモデル系に焦点を当てている。腫瘍発生に関連する染色体異常の解析から、発現の維持が選択的に抑制される新しい腫瘍抑制遺伝子群が見出されたことを論じている。胚細胞腫瘍は主題の一部にとどまる。
pmid-1650624.summary_en: This review covers recent advances in the genetics and cell biology of developmental tumours. It focuses on two model systems: teratocarcinoma, a germ cell-related tumour studied largely through embryonal carcinoma cells, and Wilms' tumour (embryonal nephroblastoma). The authors discuss how chromosomal lesions linked to tumour predisposition have revealed a class of tumour suppressor genes whose continued expression is selected against during tumour formation.

pmid-1664635.summary_ja: 本研究は進行固形腫瘍を有する小児6例に対し、アンジオテンシン誘発性高血圧化学療法を施行した。対象には仙尾部悪性奇形腫の1例が含まれるが、他は肝芽腫や骨肉腫などであり、胚細胞腫瘍は主題ではない。3例で部分奏効が得られ、副作用は軽微であった。小児がん治療の新たな手法となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1664635.summary_en: This Japanese pediatric study tested angiotensin-induced hypertension chemotherapy in six children with advanced solid tumors. One patient had a sacrococcygeal malignant teratoma, while the others had heterogeneous diagnoses including hepatoblastoma and osteosarcoma. Partial responses were seen in three children, two had no change, and one received the approach as adjuvant chemotherapy. Side effects were minimal and tolerable. The authors suggest this may be a new approach to pediatric cancer chemotherapy.

pmid-1799345.summary_ja: 1982年から1991年までの妊娠に伴う卵巣腫瘍を後方視的に検討した研究です。分娩653件に1件の頻度でした。最も多いのは良性嚢胞性奇形腫で、次いで漿液性嚢胞腺腫でした。悪性腫瘍は4.5%でした。妊娠初期の超音波検査や帝王切開時の卵巣の確認が重要とされ、治療は患者の年齢や妊娠週数などに応じて個別化すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-1799345.summary_en: This retrospective review of ovarian tumours associated with pregnancy from 1982 to 1991 found an incidence of 1 in 653 deliveries. Most tumours were diagnosed in the first or second trimester, and about a quarter presented as acute emergencies. Benign cystic teratomas were the most common ovarian tumours, followed by serous cystadenomas, and malignancy occurred in 4.5%. The authors stress routine pelvic examination, ultrasound in early pregnancy, and ovarian inspection at caesarean section, and recommend individualized treatment.

pmid-1836123.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍19例の凍結切片でmos癌遺伝子の発現をin situハイブリダイゼーションにより検討しました。胚細胞腫瘍1例と卵巣癌3例で転写産物が検出されました。研究の中心は卵巣腫瘍全般であり、胚細胞腫瘍は少数例の一部です。mosの活性化が果たす役割について考察しています。
pmid-1836123.summary_en: The authors examine mos proto-oncogene expression by in situ RNA hybridization in frozen sections from 19 ovarian tumors, including 15 adenocarcinomas, one seminoma, one immature teratoma, and two benign stromal tumors. Transcripts are detected in one germ cell tumor and three ovarian carcinomas. The paper's focus is ovarian tumors broadly, with germ cell tumor representing only a single case in a small sample. The authors discuss a possible role for mos activation.

pmid-1845814.summary_ja: セントジュード小児研究病院での2259例の小児固形腫瘍のうち、脊髄硬膜外転移を生じた112例を解析している。胚細胞腫瘍は原因腫瘍の一つにすぎない。化学療法や放射線療法のみと椎弓切除術を併用した場合で予後に差はなかった。肉腫では椎弓切除術による改善が大きく、脊髄圧迫を伴う症例の多くで歩行の回復がみられた。
pmid-1845814.summary_en: This St. Jude Children's Research Hospital review analyzed 112 of 2259 children with solid malignancies who developed spinal epidural metastasis with cord compression. Ewing sarcoma and neuroblastoma were most common, with germ-cell tumor among the other causes. Among small-cell tumors, including germ-cell tumors, outcome did not differ between chemotherapy or radiation alone and decompressive laminectomy. Sarcomas improved more with laminectomy.
