pmid-2471877.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌5例と正常胎盤において、基底膜関連タンパク質メロシンの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。絨毛癌5例すべてでメロシンが陽性で、中間栄養膜様の腫瘍細胞に強く染色された。正常胎盤でも中間栄養膜が陽性を示し、中間栄養膜が独立した第3の栄養膜細胞型である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2471877.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined merosin, a tissue-specific basement membrane protein, in five human choriocarcinomas and normal placentas. All five choriocarcinomas were merosin-positive. Staining was strongest in tumor cells with intermediate trophoblast morphology, whereas cytotrophoblast and syncytiotrophoblast cells were negative or weakly stained. In normal placentas, merosin was found in extravillous intermediate trophoblasts of the basal plate and in villous trophoblast basement membranes. The authors suggest the intermediate trophoblast represents a third, independently differentiated trophoblast lineage.

pmid-2472080.summary_ja: 進行期または再発性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍97例に対し、シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン（PVB）療法を行った前向き非ランダム化試験である。非ディスジャーミノーマ例の43%が完全奏効し、セカンドルック開腹術の71%で腫瘍は認められないか成熟奇形腫のみであった。2年生存率は71%、無病生存率は51%であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法は従来のレジメンより優れると結論づけている。
pmid-2472080.summary_en: This prospective nonrandomized Gynecologic Oncology Group trial treated 97 patients with advanced or recurrent ovarian germ cell tumors using cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB). Among 35 patients with measurable non-dysgerminoma disease, 43% achieved complete response. Of 56 second-look laparotomies, 71% showed no tumor or mature teratoma. Two-year survival was 71% and disease-free survival 51%. Patients with persistent or recurrent disease received salvage regimens. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based chemotherapy is superior to prior regimens and cures a substantial proportion of patients.

pmid-2472160.summary_ja: 小児の悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍について、1965～1978年（10例）と1978～1986年（15例）の治療成績を比較した報告。前期は治療が統一されておらず生存は1例のみだったが、後期はシスプラチンを含む多剤併用療法により15例中7例が無病生存しており、シスプラチン導入後に予後が改善したと結論づけている。
pmid-2472160.summary_en: This series compares two periods of treatment for children with malignant germ cell sacrococcygeal tumors. Ten patients treated from 1965 to 1978 received variable surgery, biopsy, radiotherapy, and methotrexate-based chemotherapy, and only one survived. Fifteen patients treated from 1978 to 1986 received a cisplatin-containing multidrug regimen, with radiotherapy in four. Seven of these fifteen remain alive without evidence of disease. The authors conclude that the cisplatin-containing protocol improved survival.

pmid-2472471.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の中枢神経系転移25例に対し、EMAとCOを週ごとに交互投与する化学療法（メトトレキサートは1 g/m2）を行った報告。EMA/CO後に13例（72%）が無病生存したが、早期死亡例もあった。EMA/CO不応・再発例の一部では追加化学療法と手術で無病となり、開頭術は薬剤耐性例で重要な役割を果たした。
pmid-2472471.summary_en: This report describes 25 patients treated for CNS metastases of choriocarcinoma with alternating weekly etoposide, methotrexate, and actinomycin (EMA) and vincristine plus cyclophosphamide (CO), with methotrexate escalated to 1 g/m2. Among these patients, 13 (72%) were surviving disease-free after EMA/CO, though three died early. Two of seven patients who progressed on or relapsed after EMA/CO became disease-free with additional chemotherapy and surgery. The contribution of craniotomy was unclear but was crucial in drug-resistant cases.

pmid-2473044.summary_ja: 組織学的に純粋なセミノーマ83例中10例（12%）で血清β-hCGが上昇していた。病期ごとの治療成績を報告し、病期Iは放射線療法、進行例は導入化学療法と手術または放射線療法で治療されていた。β-hCG陽性セミノーマはセミノーマと非セミノーマの中間に位置する独立したカテゴリーであり、病期別の治療指針を提案している。
pmid-2473044.summary_en: This study analyzes 83 consecutive patients with histologically pure seminoma, of whom 10 (12%) had elevated serum beta-hCG. Outcomes are reported by stage: radiotherapy for stage I, and induction chemotherapy followed by surgery or radiotherapy for advanced disease. One patient had a mediastinal relapse after retroperitoneal radiotherapy. The authors propose that beta-hCG-positive seminomas form a distinct germ cell tumor category between seminoma and nonseminoma, and suggest stage-specific management.

pmid-2473568.summary_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍の多剤化学療法後に残存した後腹膜奇形腫性巨大腫瘍128例を後方視的に解析した報告。救済的切除に伴う毒性や術中・術後合併症の頻度を評価した。平均43か月の追跡で71%が無病生存、22%が腫瘍進行で死亡しており、救済手術の危険性と根治性のバランスを論じている。
pmid-2473568.summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 128 patients with retroperitoneal teratoid bulky tumors after advanced germ cell tumor chemotherapy. The study evaluated toxic side effects and intra- and postoperative complications of salvage resection of residual tumor. With 3 to 110 months of follow-up (mean 43), 71% were alive without evidence of disease, while 22% died of tumor progression. The authors weigh the risks of salvage surgery against its curative potential.

pmid-2474254.summary_ja: モノクローナル抗体を用いて、正常組織・29例の胚細胞腫瘍・200例超の他腫瘍におけるLNTおよびシアル化LNT糖鎖抗原を免疫組織化学で検討した。これらは胚細胞腫瘍に一貫して発現し、主に胎児性癌と卵黄嚢成分に局在していた。Lexは奇形腫成分に認められ、セミノーマではLex陰性だった。
pmid-2474254.summary_en: The authors used monoclonal antibodies K21 and K4 to examine lacto-N-tetraose (LNT) and sialylated LNT carbohydrate antigens by immunohistochemistry in normal tissues, 29 germ cell tumors, and over 200 other tumors, comparing them with Lex. LNT and sialylated LNT were consistently expressed in germ cell tumors, mainly in embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac components, while Lex was in teratoma components. Seminoma expressed LNT variably but was Lex-negative. Distribution may be controlled by glycosyltransferase expression.

pmid-2474392.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の症例で、血清β-hCGサブユニットが画像で転移を確認できるより前に上昇し、無傷型hCGは正常範囲のままだった。このことから、絨毛癌の検出・モニタリングには遊離β-hCGサブユニットの測定、または両者を測定できるアッセイが必要と結論づけている。
pmid-2474392.summary_en: A case report of choriocarcinoma in which the serum beta-hCG subunit rose substantially before metastatic recurrence was visible on imaging, while intact hCG remained normal. The authors conclude that detection or monitoring of choriocarcinoma requires measuring the free beta-hCG subunit, or an assay that measures both free beta-subunit and intact choriogonadotropin. The paper emphasizes assay selection for trophoblastic disease monitoring.

pmid-2475556.summary_ja: 17歳男性の縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍症例で、AFPとLDHが著明に高値であった。CDDP、VP16、PEPによる併用化学療法によりAFPは正常範囲まで低下し、腫瘤は縮小した。胸腺と右上葉の一部とともに切除された標本では完全壊死を認めた。治療開始9か月後も患者は良好な経過をたどっている。
pmid-2475556.summary_en: A 17-year-old man presented with an 8 cm anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor with markedly elevated AFP and LDH isoenzyme I. Combined chemotherapy with cisplatin, VP16, and PEP reduced AFP to the normal range and shrank the mass. Surgical resection, performed together with the thymus and part of the right upper lobe, showed total necrosis. The patient remained well nine months after treatment began.

pmid-2475796.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者にVPB補助療法（4サイクル）を施行し、染色体異常と姉妹染色分体交換を解析した。異常の型は個人差が大きく、用量や時間に依存した変化は認められなかった。ブレオマイシンが異常の過分散に関与した可能性がある。SCE頻度はわずかに増加した。長期的影響については今後の検討が必要である。
pmid-2475796.summary_en: Chromosome aberrations and sister chromatid exchanges were analyzed in testicular tumor patients receiving four cycles of vinblastine, cisplatin, and bleomycin (VPB) adjuvant therapy. Aberration patterns varied widely between individuals, and no clear dose- or time-dependent damage was found. Bleomycin may contribute to aberration overdispersion, and SCE frequency rose slightly. Long-term effects require further study.

pmid-2476076.summary_ja: 術後早期に肝、腰椎骨、傍大動脈リンパ節に転移を生じた卵巣胎児性癌（Higuchi-Kato分類C群）の症例。CDDP、VBL、PEPからなるPVP療法を施行し、良好な結果が得られた。単一症例の報告であり、長期成績は示されていない。
pmid-2476076.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with ovarian embryonal carcinoma (Higuchi-Kato group C) who developed liver, lumbar bone, and para-aortic lymph node metastases shortly after surgery. The patient was treated with a PVP regimen of cisplatin, vinblastine, and peplomycin, which was reported to produce good results. The report describes a single case and does not provide long-term outcomes.

pmid-2476392.summary_ja: 精巣・卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍40例と性腺外例1例を免疫染色でAFP発現を検討した研究。セミノーマと奇形腫はAFP陰性で、胎児性癌の多くと卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型の胎児性癌・卵黄嚢成分は陽性だった。AFP染色はセミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別以外に分類への追加情報は乏しいと結論づけている。
pmid-2476392.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) expression in 40 testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors plus one extragonadal case. All seminomas and teratomas were AFP-negative, whereas most pure embryonal carcinomas, all pure yolk sac tumors, and the embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac components of mixed tumors were AFP-positive. The authors concluded that AFP staining helps only in distinguishing seminomatous from nonseminomatous tumors and adds little to histologic classification.

pmid-2476531.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシンを6サイクル受けた30例を、治療後49〜106か月で神経毒性について評価した研究。73%に感覚障害がみられ、振動覚閾値の上昇や誘発電位の異常が多く認められた。結果は感覚神経節への毒性障害による遠位軸索変性を示唆する。
pmid-2476531.summary_en: Thirty patients treated with six cycles of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin for metastatic germ cell cancer were assessed 49 to 106 months later for neurotoxicity. Most had sensory loss, increased vibration thresholds, and abnormal evoked potentials. Nerve conduction studies showed reduced sural nerve conduction and slowed tibial conduction, and central conduction was prolonged in many patients. The findings suggest toxic injury to the sensory root ganglia, causing dying-back axonal degeneration in central and peripheral nerves.

pmid-2477954.summary_ja: 精巣・卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ・性腺外例を含むセミノーマ21例を免疫染色し、AFPやhCGを産生する細胞を検討した。未分化型セミノーマ4例では血清AFP高値に対応してAFP産生細胞が確認された。大型単核細胞を多分化能を持つ前駆細胞とみなす仮説が提唱されている。
pmid-2477954.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study reviewed 21 seminomas, including testicular, ovarian dysgerminoma and extragonadal cases, to identify cells producing AFP and hCG. Four anaplastic seminomas with elevated serum AFP contained AFP-producing tumor cells, whereas hCG-producing cells could not be identified despite elevated serum hCG in some patients. The authors propose that large mononuclear cells are multipotential precursors that may give rise to germ cell, yolk sac and embryonic differentiation, with anaplastic seminoma representing one stage of this continuum.

pmid-2477965.summary_ja: AFPを産生する後腹膜の未熟奇形腫の症例報告。AFPの産生源として、未熟奇形腫内に散在する肝様細胞の小巣や各種の管状上皮細胞が考察されている。後腹膜発生の奇形腫でも腫瘍マーカーが上昇しうることを示す症例である。組織学的背景の理解は、マーカー値の解釈に役立つ。
pmid-2477965.summary_en: This report describes a retroperitoneal immature teratoma that produced alpha-fetoprotein. The authors discuss the source of AFP production, suggesting it may arise from small islands of hepatoid cells or various tubular epithelial cells within the immature teratoma. The case shows that retroperitoneal immature teratomas can secrete AFP, and that tumor marker elevation may be explained by specific histologic components. This information is useful when interpreting marker levels in such patients.

pmid-2478003.summary_ja: 後腹膜起源と推定された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の2症例を報告した泌尿器科領域の論文。精巣に明らかな腫瘍がなく腹部腫瘤で発症することが多い。精巣がんに準じた治療を行っても反応が不十分な例があり、予後不良因子と関連すると考察している。治療戦略の難しさを強調している。
pmid-2478003.summary_en: This Japanese urologic report describes two cases of so-called extragonadal germ cell tumor thought to originate in the retroperitoneum. Such patients typically present with an abdominal mass without an apparent testicular tumor. Standard testicular cancer treatment was applied, but responses were often poor, which the authors associate with several poor prognostic features seen in these patients. The report emphasizes the difficulty of managing these tumors and the need for careful clinical evaluation.

pmid-2478004.summary_ja: 上腹部腫瘤を訴えた37歳男性で、後腹膜の巨大腫瘍が生検でセミノーマと診断された症例。右精巣は停留・萎縮し、左精巣摘除標本には消退した精巣腫瘍に相当する瘢痕のみが認められた。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ペプロマイシンによる化学療法で部分寛解が得られ、3年間生存している。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍では精巣の精査を十分行うべきと強調している。
pmid-2478004.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man with an upper abdominal mass and a retroperitoneal bulky tumor, diagnosed as seminoma by biopsy. The right testis was undescended and atrophic, and the left orchiectomy specimen showed only scar and fibrosis, consistent with a burned-out testicular tumor. Multidisciplinary chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and peplomycin produced partial regression, and the patient remained alive for three years. The authors emphasize that the testis should be thoroughly examined in extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-2478078.summary_ja: 進行期精巣がんの患者が、BEP療法とPE療法後に新たな肺病変を生じた。エトポシド、シクロホスファミド、シスプラチンによる大量化学療法と自家骨髄移植を施行した。肺転移巣は空洞化後に消失し、維持療法なしで15か月間無病の状態が続いた。難治性胚細胞腫瘍に対する大量化学療法の有用性を示唆する症例である。
pmid-2478078.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with stage III testicular cancer treated with BEP chemotherapy, which gave a partial response. After PE chemotherapy, a new pulmonary tumor developed. He received high-dose chemotherapy with etoposide, cyclophosphamide, and cisplatin followed by autologous bone marrow transplantation. The metastatic lung lesion cavitated and then disappeared. Fifteen months later, there was no evidence of disease without maintenance therapy. The report suggests high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue may be an option for refractory germ cell tumors.

pmid-2478105.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍19例の卵黄嚢腫瘍にみられる間葉様成分を病理学的に検討した。サイトケラチンとビメンチンが両者陽性で、上皮から紡錘形細胞への移行像も認められ、上皮の化生に由来すると考えられた。化学療法後の症例では、この成分のみからなる腫瘍も13例で認められた。化学療法抵抗性で多分化能を持つ細胞集団であり、肉腫の発生母地となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-2478105.summary_en: This pathology study examined the mesenchyme-like component of yolk sac tumor in 19 germ cell neoplasms. Co-expression of cytokeratin and vimentin, along with epithelial-spindle cell transitions, suggested that this component arises from yolk sac tumor epithelium through metaplasia. Thirteen chemotherapy-treated cases consisting solely of this component were also identified. The authors conclude it represents a chemoresistant, pluripotential cell population that may give rise to sarcomas after treatment of germ cell tumors.

pmid-2478726.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣がん111例の化学療法後の残存腫瘍を検討した。壊死・線維化が52例、成熟奇形腫が37例、生存腫瘍が12例であった。原発腫瘍の組織像、化学療法後CTでの完全奏効、正常なαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値を組み合わせると、感度83%で完全壊死を予測できた。約20%の患者で後腹膜リンパ節郭清を省略できる可能性が示された。
pmid-2478726.summary_en: This urology study reviewed 111 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular cancer treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, of whom 101 underwent residual mass resection. Histology showed necrosis or fibrosis in 52, mature teratoma in 37, and vital malignant tumor in 12. Relapses occurred in 16 patients. Combining primary tumor histology, post-chemotherapy CT response, and normal AFP and hCG levels predicted necrosis or fibrosis with 83% sensitivity, suggesting that post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection could be omitted in about 20% of patients.

pmid-2479498.summary_ja: リシヌス・コムニス凝集素I（RCA-I）を用いた交差免疫電気泳動により、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の亜分画を解析した。肝細胞癌、胃癌肝転移、卵黄嚢腫瘍、良性肝疾患、胎児由来試料を比較した。RCA-I反応性を示す亜分画は悪性疾患のみで検出され、AFP産生性悪性腫瘍と良性疾患の鑑別診断に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-2479498.summary_en: Using Ricinus communis agglutinin I affinity immunoelectrophoresis, the authors compared serum AFP subfractions in hepatocellular carcinoma, gastric cancer liver metastases, yolk sac tumor, benign liver disease, and fetal samples. A non-reactive subfraction was common across these groups, while weakly or strongly reactive subfractions were found only in malignancies. The authors interpreted these as galactosialyl, monogalactosyl, and digalactosyl forms. The approach may aid in differentiating AFP-producing malignancies from benign conditions.

pmid-2479605.summary_ja: モノクローナル抗体で検出される卵黄嚢腫瘍抗原2G10の生化学的性状を、乳児胎児性癌細胞株MTEを用いて解析した。本抗原は末端ガラクトースを含む糖タンパク質で、腫瘍細胞から血清中へ脱落する。卵黄嚢成分を有する胚細胞腫瘍で血清値が上昇し、腫瘍マーカーとして有用と考えられた。
pmid-2479605.summary_en: The authors characterized human yolk sac tumor antigen 2G10, detected by a monoclonal antibody, on the infantile embryonal carcinoma line MTE. The antigen is a glycoprotein whose epitope involves terminal galactose, and it sheds from tumor cells into serum. A newly developed ELISA showed high serum levels in patients with yolk sac tumors and germ cell tumors containing yolk sac components, but not in other urogenital or childhood solid tumors. The authors propose serum 2G10 as a useful tumor marker for these tumors.

pmid-2479608.summary_ja: 妊娠後のラット絨毛癌を同系および同種ラットに移植して解析した。同種宿主を免疫しても腫瘍は増殖した。巨細胞、血液で満たされた腔、増殖する細胞性栄養膜細胞が見られ、一部で肺転移を認めた。乳腺の増殖と3β-ヒドロキシステロイド脱水素酵素の発現から、ラクトゲン分泌が示唆され、ヒト絨毛癌との類似性が指摘された。
pmid-2479608.summary_en: The authors characterized a post-gestational rat choriocarcinoma transplanted into syngeneic and allogeneic rats. The tumor grew even after immunization of allogeneic hosts. Histology showed giant cells, blood-filled spaces, and proliferating cytotrophoblasts resembling normal rat placenta, and some animals developed lung metastases. Hormonal activity was suggested by mammary gland proliferation and 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase expression, implying lactogen secretion. The authors consider the model similar to human choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2479778.summary_ja: 純粋セミノーマの患者で、血清hCGが一部の測定法でのみわずかに上昇し、経時的な上昇や腫瘍の他の所見はありませんでした。この不一致な結果に基づき不適切な化学療法が行われましたが、後に非特異的な血清干渉物質が原因と判明しました。hCGの上昇がわずかで進行を示さない場合は、不必要な治療を避けるため不一致結果を疑うべきだと著者らは述べています。
pmid-2479778.summary_en: This report describes a patient with a pure seminoma whose serum hCG was modestly elevated on one assay but normal on others, without serial rise or other evidence of tumor. Based on this discordant result, the patient received inappropriate chemotherapy. Later analysis showed the elevation was caused by a nonspecific serum interfering substance. The authors advise suspecting discordant hCG results when elevation is modest, non-progressive, and not accompanied by other tumor evidence, to avoid unnecessary treatment.

pmid-2480422.summary_ja: 1989年の論文で、縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍における血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の有用性を検討しています。著者らは縦隔病変のすべてでAFPを測定すべきと勧めています。500 ng/mLまでの上昇は胚細胞腫瘍を強く示唆し、1,000 ng/mLを超える極めて高い値はメソブラストーマを示唆するとしています。フォローアップ中のAFP上昇は再発の確実な徴候です。
pmid-2480422.summary_en: This 1989 review discusses the use of serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) in mediastinal germ cell tumors and related mediastinal lesions. The authors recommend measuring AFP in all mediastinal masses. Levels up to 500 ng/mL strongly suggest a germ cell tumor, while levels above 1,000 ng/mL suggest a different lesion called mesoblastoma. A rising AFP during follow-up is a reliable sign of recurrence, making AFP a useful monitoring marker in these patients.

pmid-2480424.summary_ja: 1989年の臨床研究で、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者において血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を検討しました。未熟奇形腫3例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍7例、卵黄嚢腫瘍16例が対象です。未熟奇形腫では化学療法なしでAFPが自然に低下しました。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではAFPが化学療法への反応を反映し、再発の早期発見にも役立ちました。AFPは診断や治療効果判定、フォローアップに有用と結論づけています。
pmid-2480424.summary_en: This 1989 clinical series reviews serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) in ovarian germ cell tumors, including 3 pure immature teratomas, 7 mixed germ cell tumors, and 16 pure endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors. AFP normalized spontaneously in immature teratoma without chemotherapy. In yolk sac tumors, AFP tracked chemotherapy response and detected relapse early. The authors conclude AFP is reliable for diagnosis, response assessment, and follow-up, and useful in managing mixed tumors.

pmid-2480630.summary_ja: 1989年の研究で、卵黄嚢腫瘍と消化管癌の患者から得た血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)について、レクチン親和性免疫電気泳動のパターンを比較しました。ConAとレンズ豆レクチン(LCH)に反応するAFP分画を対応づけ、フコース化や二分岐N-アセチルグルコサミンといった糖鎖構造が結合性に与える影響を検討しています。主に生化学的な研究であり、卵黄嚢腫瘍は対象群の一つです。
pmid-2480630.summary_en: This 1989 study compared lectin affinity immunoelectrophoresis profiles of serum alpha-fetoprotein from patients with yolk sac tumors and from patients with gastrointestinal carcinomas. The authors matched Con A-reactive and LCH-reactive AFP subfractions to explore how sugar chain structures, including fucosylation and bisecting GlcNAc, affect lectin binding. They concluded that their improved techniques support a structural explanation for the observed binding differences. The study is primarily biochemical, with yolk sac tumors as one patient group.

pmid-2480680.summary_ja: M.D.アンダーソンがんセンターの研究で、根治的精巣摘除術後に監視療法を受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の82例を検討しました。胎児性癌が80%未満、血管侵襲なし、AFPが80 ng/dL未満の群では再発例はありませんでした。奇形腫が50%超で血管侵襲のない25例中、再発は1例のみでした。低リスク患者は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を避けつつ監視できると結論づけています。
pmid-2480680.summary_en: This study from M.D. Anderson Cancer Center reviewed 82 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis treated with surveillance after radical orchiectomy. Patients with less than 80% embryonal carcinoma, no vessel invasion, and AFP below 80 ng/dL had no relapses. Among patients with over 50% teratoma and no vessel invasion, only one of 25 relapsed. The authors conclude these low-risk patients can be safely observed, sparing unnecessary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-2481973.summary_ja: 23歳男性の両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告した。左側は未分化セミノーマ、右側は典型的セミノーマであった。両側の精巣摘除術を段階的に施行し、術後化学療法としてCDDP、VP-16、ペプロマイシンを行い、遠隔転移や再発はみられなかった。加えて、本邦文献で報告された両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍136例を検討している。
pmid-2481973.summary_en: Reports a 23-year-old man with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors, with anaplastic seminoma on the left and typical seminoma on the right. Both testes were removed in a staged manner, and postoperative chemotherapy with CDDP, VP-16 and peplomycin was given, with no distant metastasis or local recurrence. The paper also reviews 136 previously reported bilateral cases in the Japanese literature.

pmid-2482285.summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者の血清と尿を対象に、ゲル濾過、等電点電気泳動、ウエスタンブロットでヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の分子形態を解析した。血清hCGは分子量が大きく酸性が強く、完全にシアル酸化されていた。尿中hCGは部分的に脱シアル酸化されており、hCGβ関連断片も検出された。血清と尿で質的な差異が明らかになった。
pmid-2482285.summary_en: Compares the molecular forms of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in paired serum and urine samples from a patient with choriocarcinoma, using gel chromatography, isoelectric focusing and Western blotting. Serum hCG had higher molecular weight, stronger acidic charge and complete sialylation, whereas urinary hCG was partially desialylated. Urine also contained hCG beta-related fragments and a 23 kDa band absent from serum, indicating qualitative differences between the two.

pmid-2482672.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん12例(セミノーマ5例、テラトカルチノーマ3例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例、胎児性癌1例、混合型2例)にシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン(PVB)療法を施行した。測定可能な転移病変を有する10例の奏効率は80%で、完全奏効は3例であった。PVB療法と救済手術後、10例が無病生存となった。予後不良因子を有する症例では効果が得られなかった。
pmid-2482672.summary_en: Reports outcomes of cisplatin-vinblastine-bleomycin (PVB) therapy in 12 patients with advanced testicular cancer, including seminoma, teratocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma and mixed types. Among 10 patients with measurable metastases, the objective response rate was 80%, with 3 complete responses. Ten patients were disease-free after PVB therapy and salvage surgery, while patients with poor prognostic factors did not respond.

pmid-2482675.summary_ja: 28歳男性で、左精巣の胎児性癌(一部セミノーマ)に対し精巣摘除術とPVB療法2コースを施行した。術後、腫瘍マーカーは予想どおり低下した。20か月後、対側精巣の硬結と血清β-hCGの著明な上昇(36.0 ng/ml)が出現し、右精巣摘除術を施行した。病理はピュア・セミノーマであった。その後、補助療法なしで経過観察された。
pmid-2482675.summary_en: Reports a 28-year-old man with left testicular embryonal carcinoma, partly seminoma, treated with orchiectomy and two PVB cycles while tumor markers fell as expected. Twenty months later, contralateral testicular induration and markedly elevated serum beta-hCG (36.0 ng/ml) led to right orchiectomy, which showed pure seminoma. The patient was then followed without adjuvant therapy.

pmid-2483686.summary_ja: ロンドンの2施設で1977〜1988年に非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法を受けた287例のうち、腫瘍マーカーが低下または不変でも腫瘍が増大した8例を検討した。多くは分化型奇形腫で、外科的切除を行った症例の多くが再発なく経過した。活動性腫瘍が残る場合は術後化学療法を併用する方針が有用と示唆された。
pmid-2483686.summary_en: This series from two London hospitals reviewed 287 patients treated with chemotherapy for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors between 1977 and 1988. Eight patients showed enlarging masses despite falling or unchanged tumor markers, most with differentiated teratoma and cystic change on CT. Enlargement occurred within six months of starting treatment. Surgical resection of these masses showed differentiated teratoma in four patients, who remained relapse-free for 15 months to 5 years. Two patients with embryonal carcinoma received postoperative chemotherapy and remained disease-free. Two patients died. The authors conclude that enlarging teratomatous masses can be managed surgically, with postoperative chemotherapy when active tumor is present.

pmid-2486775.summary_ja: 生後2か月と9か月の2例の乳児精巣胎児性癌を、精巣摘除のみで治療した。小児の精巣腫瘍は稀で、胎児性癌が最も多い組織型である。両例とも術後3年および15か月の時点で良好に経過しており、極めて若年例では精巣摘除単独で十分な可能性が示された。
pmid-2486775.summary_en: Two infants, aged 2 and 9 months, with embryonal carcinoma of the testis were treated with orchidectomy alone. The authors note that testicular tumors are rare in children and that embryonal carcinoma is the most common histology. Standard approaches have included orchidectomy with high cord ligation and lymphadenectomy, plus adjuvant chemotherapy or radiation therapy in various combinations. Both infants remained well, 3 years and 15 months after surgery respectively, indicating that orchidectomy alone may be sufficient in these very young patients. The report is a brief case series with a literature review.

pmid-2486812.summary_ja: ナイジェリアの大学病院で8年間に経験した、2週から9歳の小児頸部奇形腫4例を報告する。全例が外科的切除で容易に摘出され、術後の経過は良好であった。病理組織学的に3胚葉の組織を認め、2例では甲状腺組織を伴っていた。1〜4年のフォローアップで甲状腺機能異常は認められなかった。
pmid-2486812.summary_en: This report describes four Nigerian children aged 2 weeks to 9 years with cervical teratoma, seen over eight years at one university teaching hospital. Two tumors were present at birth, one presented symptomatically at two weeks, and two were noticed for years for cosmetic reasons. All were easily resected surgically, and two were anatomically related to the thyroid gland. Histopathology showed tissue from all three germ layers, with neural elements predominating in two and thyroid tissue in the other two. Follow-up of one to four years showed no thyroid dysfunction.

pmid-2501399.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者15例と健常対照11例において、TRHに対するプロラクチン反応を評価した。患者5例では反応が認められず、うち4例は非セミノーマであった。非セミノーマ患者はPRLピーク値が有意に低かった。精巣がんにおけるPRL反応変化の生物学的意義は未解明である。
pmid-2501399.summary_en: This study assesses prolactin response to thyrotropin-releasing hormone in 15 patients with testicular cancer and 11 healthy controls. Five patients showed no prolactin response, four of whom had nonseminoma. Patients with nonseminoma had significantly lower peak prolactin levels than controls or patients with seminoma. The authors conclude that the altered prolactin response in testicular carcinoma requires further study to determine its biological meaning.

pmid-2503614.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞由来の因子が、ヒトT細胞の応答を抑制する作用とその標的を解析している。因子はIL-2受容体刺激後の増殖段階を阻害し、IL-2やIL-2受容体には結合しない。妊娠や担癌宿主における免疫抑制との関連が考察されている。
pmid-2503614.summary_en: This study characterizes an immunoregulatory factor derived from choriocarcinoma cells that suppresses human T cell responses. The factor blocks T cell proliferation induced by IL-2 without affecting IL-2 production, CD25 expression, IL-2 binding, or IL-2 molecules. Its inhibitory effect acts after IL-2 receptor stimulation, and it also suppresses murine T cell lines. The authors discuss its possible significance during pregnancy and in immunosuppressed tumor-bearing hosts.

pmid-2504249.summary_ja: HIV感染者に生じたリンパ腫とカポジ肉腫以外の稀な悪性腫瘍49例を、主に静注薬物乱用者から集積して報告している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍12例はセミノーマ6例、胎児性癌2例、混合型4例の内訳で示される。治療成績は不良であった。
pmid-2504249.summary_en: This Italian cooperative group report describes 49 HIV-related tumors other than lymphoma and Kaposi sarcoma, mostly in intravenous drug users. Twelve germinal testicular tumors were included, six of which were seminomas, two pure embryonal carcinomas, and four embryonal mixed tumors. Other cases included cervical, lung, and central nervous system tumors and leukemias. Outcomes were poor, with several patients unable to be treated or dying during therapy.

pmid-2504846.summary_ja: 培養絨毛癌細胞株のTNF-αおよびIFN-γに対する感受性を、他の腫瘍細胞株と比較して検討している。絨毛癌細胞株はこれらのリンホカインにほとんど反応せず、MHCクラスI発現も増強されなかった。宿主の免疫攻撃に対する抵抗性を示唆する結果である。
pmid-2504846.summary_en: This study tests the sensitivity of cultured choriocarcinoma cell lines to TNF-alpha and IFN-gamma. Unlike several other tumor cell lines, the choriocarcinoma lines showed little cytostatic or cytotoxic response to these lymphokines. Treatment also failed to increase MHC class I expression on the choriocarcinoma cells. The authors suggest that choriocarcinoma cells have a unique property that confers resistance to host immune attack.

pmid-2508311.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌9例の免疫組織化学染色で、全例の腫瘍細胞の細胞質と核にメタロチオネイン(MT)が検出された。染色性は組織学的増殖パターンと関連していた。MTは腫瘍マーカーとなりうる癌原発性産物であり、金属含有抗癌剤による治療で薬剤耐性が生じる可能性とも関連すると示唆される。
pmid-2508311.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry on nine human testicular embryonal carcinomas showed metallothionein (MT) in the cytoplasm and nucleus of tumor cells in all cases, with immunoreactivity varying according to the histological growth pattern. The authors suggest MT is an oncodevelopmental product that could serve as a tumor marker, and that histology may predict MT expression. This may be relevant to drug resistance during treatment with metal-containing chemotherapeutic agents.

pmid-2511046.summary_ja: 体外受精のための過排卵刺激(クエン酸クロミフェンとhMG)を受けた女性に発生した卵管絨毛癌の症例報告。過排卵刺激が腫瘍発生に関与した可能性を考察している。患者は保存的手術のみで治療され、経過観察期間1.5年で寛解を維持している。クロミフェンとhMG治療後の絨毛癌としては初めての報告とされる。
pmid-2511046.summary_en: A case of choriocarcinoma arising in the fallopian tube is reported in a woman enrolled in an in vitro fertilization program who had received clomiphene citrate and hMG for superovulation. The authors discuss whether superovulation may have contributed to tumor development. The patient was treated with conservative surgery alone and remained in remission 1.5 years later. This is described as the first such report after clomiphene and hMG treatment.

pmid-2513840.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来細胞株(JAR)と正期胎盤を用いて、生物学的応答修飾物質がヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌に与える影響を検討した。レチノイン酸とTNFはJAR細胞のhCG産生と分泌を増加させ、エトポシドも絨毛癌細胞でhCG分泌を増強した。正常と悪性の栄養膜細胞でhCG分泌の調節機構が異なることを示した。
pmid-2513840.summary_en: The effects of interferon-gamma, TNF-alpha, and retinoic acid on hCG secretion were examined in cultured choriocarcinoma cells (JAR) and term placenta. Retinoic acid and TNF increased intracellular and secreted hCG in JAR cells without inhibiting proliferation, while interferon-gamma and TNF reduced hCG secretion from term placenta. Etoposide augmented hCG secretion in choriocarcinoma cells only. The authors conclude that normal and malignant trophoblast regulate hCG secretion by different mechanisms.

pmid-2520787.summary_ja: ヒト妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株GCH-1をヌードマウス体内で繰り返し選択し、肺転移能の高いサブラインGCH-1(m)を樹立した。GCH-1(m)は全例で肺転移を生じ、親株より細胞異型度が高く増殖能は低かった。hCG産生は著しく高く、マウス肺抽出物により増殖が促進された。転移機構への示唆が考察されている。
pmid-2520787.summary_en: The authors established GCH-1(m), a subline of the human gestational choriocarcinoma line GCH-1, by repeated in vivo selection in nude mice. GCH-1(m) produced pulmonary metastases in all recipient mice, whereas the parent line did so only occasionally. The subline showed greater cellular atypia, reduced growth capacity, and markedly higher hCG production. Its growth was enhanced by pulmonary extract from nude mice, and the authors discuss implications for metastatic mechanisms.

pmid-2521380.summary_ja: 生殖年齢の女性9例に対し、片側または両側の類皮嚢腫を腹腔鏡下に摘除した。12〜42か月のフォローアップで即時・長期の合併症は認められなかった。4例で骨盤内癒着の評価のため再腹腔鏡検査が行われ、1例に軽度の卵巣周囲癒着が見られた。
pmid-2521380.summary_en: Nine reproductive-age women with unilateral or bilateral dermoid cysts underwent laparoscopic removal. Over follow-up of 12 to 42 months, no immediate or long-term complications occurred. Four patients underwent repeat laparoscopy to evaluate possible pelvic adhesions; one had mild periovarian adhesions, while the pelvis appeared normal in the other three.

pmid-2529944.summary_ja: 病期I精巣腫瘍114例をサーベイランスで管理し、26例が再発した。そのうち3例は再発の最初の徴候として腰痛を呈した。3例はいずれも腫瘍マーカー非産生例で、疼痛は画像異常に最大4か月先行していた。病期I患者に腰痛が出現した場合は再発リスクが高いと考え、診断の遅れを避けるべきである。
pmid-2529944.summary_en: In 114 patients with stage 1 testicular tumours managed by surveillance, 26 relapsed. Three of these presented with lumbar pain as the first sign of relapse. All three were tumour marker non-producers, and the pain preceded radiological abnormality by up to four months. The authors conclude that stage 1 patients with lumbar pain should be considered at high risk of relapse to avoid diagnostic delay.

pmid-2535759.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群を合併した膀胱後部の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。前立腺癌と疑われたが、生検で胎児性癌と診断され、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は10,700 ng/mlと著明に上昇していた。化学療法で腫瘍とAFPは改善し、精巣摘除術を含む切除と術後化学療法の後も再発は認められなかった。
pmid-2535759.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with Klinefelter's syndrome who had an extragonadal germ cell tumor of the retrovesical region. The presentation was hematuria, and the initial impression was prostate cancer. Needle biopsy showed embryonal carcinoma, and serum AFP was markedly elevated at 10,700 ng/ml. Combined cytotoxic chemotherapy produced an excellent response, with AFP normalization and tumor shrinkage. Surgery with orchiectomy and resection found mostly necrotic tissue with residual viable embryonal carcinoma and no testicular or nodal involvement. Postoperative chemotherapy was given, and the patient remained recurrence-free.

pmid-2536126.summary_ja: DNAフローサイトメトリーにより、乳児型卵黄嚢腫瘍、セミノーマ、非セミノーマの倍数性を比較した研究である。成人の精巣GCTはほぼ全例で異数性を示し、鑑別診断に有用である。著者らは、成人腫瘍はセミノーマ段階を経て、ほぼ四倍体の上皮内癌細胞から進展するという仮説を提唱している。
pmid-2536126.summary_en: This DNA flow cytometry study compares ploidy across testicular germ cell tumor subtypes, including infantile yolk sac tumors, seminomas, and nonseminomas. The DNA index was highest in infantile yolk sac tumors, intermediate in seminomas, and lowest in nonseminomas, and the components of combined tumors differed significantly. Adult testicular GCTs were nearly uniformly aneuploid, which aids differential diagnosis from non-germ cell testicular tumors and separates metastases from primary extragonadal tumors. The authors propose that adult tumors progress through a seminoma stage from a near-tetraploid carcinoma in situ cell.

pmid-2536289.summary_ja: 混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後に、16歳患者で生じたびまん性胸腺過形成を報告した。免疫組織化学的解析では、リンパ球と上皮細胞の分布や抗原発現は正常で、特定の細胞集団の選択的増殖は認められなかった。化学療法後の胸腺腫大は単純なリバウンド現象と結論された。胚細胞腫瘍の治療後の縦隔変化を評価する際に参考となる。
pmid-2536289.summary_en: This report describes diffuse thymic hyperplasia in a 16-year-old patient with a mixed testicular germ cell tumor, appearing after chemotherapy. Immunohistologic analysis of the enlarged thymus showed normal distribution and antigen expression of lymphocytes and epithelial cells, with no selective proliferation of any lymphocytic or nonlymphocytic subpopulation. The authors conclude that thymic enlargement after chemotherapy represents a simple rebound phenomenon. The finding is relevant to clinicians evaluating mediastinal changes in patients treated for germ cell tumors.

pmid-2537616.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍53例を対象に、原発腫瘍の形態学的特徴と転移・再発の関連を検討した。血管侵襲、高いT病期、絨毛癌の存在が不良な予後因子であった。これらの特徴を有する臨床病期I例では再発率が高く、監視療法は適切でない可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-2537616.summary_en: This study of 53 patients with testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumors examined whether morphological features of the primary tumor predict metastatic disease or relapse. Vascular invasion, high T stage, and the presence of choriocarcinoma were identified as poor prognostic features. The authors conclude that surveillance may be inappropriate for clinical stage I NSGCT with these features because of a high relapse rate. The findings help guide selection of patients for surveillance versus adjuvant therapy.

pmid-2537701.summary_ja: 腹腔内転移性精巣がん50例のフォローアップにおいて、CTとリンパ管造影後X線撮影を比較した。CTは残存病変を21例で検出したのに対し、リンパ管造影では7例であった。再発検出でも、CTは8例すべてを捉えたが、リンパ管造影は4例にとどまった。著者らは、治療反応のモニタリングと再発検出の両面でCTが優れると結論づけている。
pmid-2537701.summary_en: This study compared computed tomography (CT) with post-lymphangiogram radiography in the follow-up of 50 patients with intra-abdominal metastatic testicular cancer. CT detected residual disease in 21 patients, whereas lymphangiography identified disease in only seven. For relapse detection, CT identified all eight recurrences, while lymphangiography detected four. The authors conclude that CT is superior to lymphangiography for both monitoring treatment response and detecting relapse.

pmid-2538525.summary_ja: 1978年から1984年の7年間に神奈川県で登録された妊娠性絨毛性疾患2,135例を解析した研究である。出生1,000対あたりの発生率は胞状奇胎3.22、侵入奇胎1.20、絨毛癌0.07などであった。発生率は年次によらず安定しており、他の日本の16県とはいくつかの病型で差があった。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌は30〜34歳と45〜49歳に二峰性の年齢分布を示した。
pmid-2538525.summary_en: This population-based analysis registered 2,135 trophoblastic disease cases in Kanagawa Prefecture over seven years (1978-1984). Incidence per 1,000 live births was 3.22 for hydatidiform mole, 1.67 for partial mole, 1.20 for invasive mole, 0.07 for choriocarcinoma, and 0.20 for persistent trophoblastic disease. Incidence was stable across years and differed from 16 other Japanese prefectures in several subtypes. Age distributions were also analyzed, showing peaks for invasive mole and choriocarcinoma at 30-34 and 45-49 years.

pmid-2538933.summary_ja: 正常妊娠40例、子宮外妊娠18例、不全流産36例、妊娠性絨毛性疾患24例で血清hCGを放射免疫測定法（RIA）と免疫放射定量法（IRMA）で比較した研究である。前3群では両法の結果は同等であったが、妊娠性絨毛性疾患ではRIAの値が一貫して高かった。絨毛癌や胞状奇胎の経過観察には遊離β-hCGを検出する測定法が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-2538933.summary_en: This study compared radioimmunoassay (RIA) and immunoradiometric assay (IRMA) for serum hCG in 40 normal pregnancies, 18 ectopic pregnancies, 36 incomplete abortions, and 24 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease. Results were equivalent in the first three groups, but RIA gave consistently higher values in gestational trophoblastic disease, likely reflecting free beta-subunit. The authors conclude that monitoring choriocarcinoma and hydatidiform mole requires an assay detecting free beta-hCG.

pmid-2539317.summary_ja: 卵巣の充実性奇形腫20例と悪性混合ミュラー管腫瘍（MMT）15例を臨床・組織・免疫組織化学的に比較した研究です。両者は鑑別が難しい一方、予後が異なります。奇形腫は若年に多く、銀親和性細胞やGFAP陽性組織を特徴とし、MMTは高齢に多く肉腫様成分を持つことが示されました。正確な鑑別診断の指標となる知見です。
pmid-2539317.summary_en: This comparative study examines 20 solid ovarian teratomas and 15 malignant mixed Müllerian tumors (MMTs) of the ovary, which can be difficult to distinguish histologically but carry different prognoses. Clinical features, histomorphology, and immunocytochemical profiles were compared. Teratomas occurred in younger patients and showed argyrophil cells, neuropeptide reactivity and GFAP-positive tissue, whereas MMTs occurred in older patients with sarcomatous elements and lacked these features, supporting accurate differential diagnosis.

pmid-2539322.summary_ja: 絨毛癌7例、非定型絨毛癌2例、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍1例の超微細構造を比較した研究です。典型的絨毛癌では細胞性・合胞体性栄養膜細胞が見られ、非定型例では中間型トロホブラストが主体でした。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は核周囲フィラメントを持つ中間型トロホブラストから成り、細胞性栄養膜細胞を欠きました。全腫瘍でhCGと胎盤性ラクトゲンに陽性を示し、機能的な類似性が示されました。
pmid-2539322.summary_en: This ultrastructural study compares ten trophoblastic tumors: seven classical choriocarcinomas, two atypical choriocarcinomas and one placental-site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT). Classical choriocarcinomas showed cytotrophoblasts and syncytiotrophoblasts, while atypical tumors were dominated by intermediate trophoblasts. PSTT contained intermediate trophoblasts with paranuclear filaments absent from choriocarcinoma and no cytotrophoblasts. All tumors showed hCG and placental lactogen immunoreactivity, indicating functional homology despite ultrastructural differences.

pmid-2539327.summary_ja: 精巣がん259例と2組の対照を用いた症例対照研究です。思春期年齢、肥満、飲酒、性行動などとリスクとの一貫した関連は認められませんでした。背の高い男性ではセミノーマが多く、症例の妊孕性低下は主に停留精巣の頻度の高さによるものでした。停留精巣のない男性では、不妊と精巣がんリスクの明確な関連は示されませんでした。
pmid-2539327.summary_en: This 1989 case-control study of 259 testis cancer cases and two control groups examined whether hormonal status, sexual behaviour and fertility relate to risk and histology. No consistent association was found with age at puberty, shaving, obesity, alcohol, fat intake or sexual behaviour. Tall men showed an excess of seminomas. Cases had lower fertility, largely explained by more frequent cryptorchidism; among non-cryptorchid men, infertility was not clearly linked to risk.

pmid-2539568.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍28例（純粋型および混合型）のレクチン結合パターンを組織化学的に検討しました。すべての腫瘍型でレクチン結合が認められました。胎児性癌では結合が分化度と相関し、胎児性癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍・奇形腫に典型的な偏極染色はセミノーマでは認められず、鑑別診断に役立つ可能性があります。コンカナバリンAは細胞性と合胞体性の栄養膜細胞分化を区別できました。
pmid-2539568.summary_en: This histochemical study tested lectin binding patterns in 28 human testicular germ cell tumors, both pure and mixed. All tumor types bound lectins. Seminomas showed evenly distributed binding, while embryonal carcinoma binding correlated with differentiation. A polarized staining pattern typical of embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor and teratoma was absent in seminomas, which may aid differential diagnosis. Concanavalin A distinguished cytotrophoblastic from syncytiotrophoblastic differentiation.

pmid-2539571.summary_ja: 1980〜1987年に西サモアで実施された分娩ベースの調査です。全分娩を対象に、胞状奇胎32例が確認され、絨毛癌はありませんでした。発生率は1000分娩あたり0.90（約1:1109）と推定され、患者の平均年齢は31歳でした。著者らは、この集団では絨毛性疾患の地理的な偏りは重要ではないと結論づけ、発生率推定における方法論の影響も論じています。
pmid-2539571.summary_en: A delivery-based survey in Western Samoa, 1980–1987, identified 32 hydatidiform moles and no choriocarcinomas among all hospital and home deliveries. The estimated incidence was 0.90 per 1000 deliveries (about 1 in 1109), with a mean maternal age of 31 years. The authors conclude that trophoblastic disease is not geographically significant in this population and discuss how methodology affects incidence estimates.

pmid-2539649.summary_ja: シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、エトポシドで治癒しなかった難治性胚細胞腫瘍に対する、イホスファミド含有の救援療法の経験です。VeIPまたはVIPを投与された57例のうち20例が無病状態となり、そのうち15例は18〜53か月再発がありませんでした。大量に前治療を受けた患者でも治癒の可能性があり、初回治療での役割も研究中と報告されています。
pmid-2539649.summary_en: This report describes the Indiana University experience with ifosfamide-containing salvage regimens in patients with refractory germ cell tumors not cured by cisplatin, vinblastine and etoposide. Among 57 patients given VeIP or VIP, 20 became disease-free, 15 of whom remained free of recurrence for 18–53 months. The authors conclude that ifosfamide combination chemotherapy has curative potential in heavily pretreated patients and that its role in initial therapy is under study.

pmid-2540129.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに大量出血を合併した2症例の報告です。1例目は十二指腸・胃転移があり、化学療法の前に手術を行って止血し、術後化学療法後15か月生存しました。2例目は肝・肺転移があり、積極的化学療法開始3日後に出血し、手術と蘇生の努力にもかかわらず術後まもなく死亡しました。まれですが生命を脅かす合併症であることが強調されています。
pmid-2540129.summary_en: Two patients with metastatic testicular carcinoma complicated by massive bleeding are reported. One, with duodenal and gastric metastases, underwent surgery before chemotherapy to control bleeding and was alive 15 months after postoperative chemotherapy. The other, with liver and lung metastases, began aggressive chemotherapy and bled three days later; despite surgery and resuscitation, the patient died shortly afterward. The authors highlight this rare but life-threatening complication.

pmid-2540984.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の既往がある21例の対側精巣を生検し、胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変である上皮内癌を1例認めました。残存精巣に20 Gyの局所照射を行い、明らかな副作用はなく、6か月後の対照生検では上皮内癌は認められませんでした。治療後9か月でテストステロン値は正常範囲を保ったものの、LH・FSHは上昇していました。放射線療法と精巣摘除術の比較評価には長期観察が必要とされています。
pmid-2540984.summary_en: This study examined contralateral testes from 21 patients with prior testicular tumors. One carcinoma in situ, the precursor of germ cell tumor, was found and treated with local irradiation of 20 Gy. No clinical side effects occurred, and a control biopsy six months later showed no carcinoma in situ. Leydig cells were normal, and plasma testosterone remained normal nine months after therapy, although LH and FSH levels were increased. The authors conclude that long-term observation is needed to determine the value of radiotherapy compared with orchiectomy for managing contralateral carcinoma in situ.

pmid-2541091.summary_ja: 36歳女性の成熟奇形腫の壁内に生じた原発性卵巣粘液性カルチノイド腫瘍の症例です。組織学的に杯細胞を含む腺管が認められ、CEA・クロモグラニン・膵ポリペプチドが陽性でした。腫瘍は卵巣に限局していたため右卵管卵巣摘出術のみで治療され、3年後も良好な経過です。若年女性では片側卵管卵巣摘出術と慎重なフォローアップが妥当と考察されています。
pmid-2541091.summary_en: A 36-year-old woman had a primary mucinous carcinoid tumor of the ovary arising within the wall of a mature teratoma. Microscopy showed goblet cell-containing tubules and glands, and immunostaining was positive for carcinoembryonic antigen, chromogranin, and pancreatic polypeptide. Mucinous carcinoids are usually considered more aggressive than other carcinoids, but this tumor was confined to the ovary. The patient underwent right salpingo-oophorectomy and remained well three years later. The authors suggest that unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy with careful follow-up is adequate for young women with ovary-confined tumors.

pmid-2541099.summary_ja: 1980年以降ハンガリーで治療された精巣腫瘍242例の成績を解析した報告です。正確な病期診断と、外科・放射線療法・化学療法を組み合わせた治療指向型の管理により予後が改善したとされています。死亡率はセミノーマ群7.5%、非セミノーマ性・混合細胞型群26.5%でした。集約的な治療体制は合併症の増加を伴うものの、死亡率の低減に寄与すると結論づけています。
pmid-2541099.summary_en: This Hungarian report analyzes outcomes of 242 testicular tumor patients treated since 1980 at a central regional center. Improved staging and therapy-oriented management combining surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy were associated with better pathologic prospects. Mortality was 7.5% for pure seminoma and 26.5% for nonseminomatous and mixed-cell groups. The authors conclude that these advances may further reduce mortality and complication rates, although morbidity has increased with more intensive treatment. The paper highlights how centralized organization supports reliable staging and consistent treatment across a larger geographic area.

pmid-2542141.summary_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍細胞株および神経芽腫細胞株について、N-myc増幅とNSE産生を検討しました。神経芽腫株、卵黄嚢腫瘍株、悪性奇形腫株の3株で両者が併存していました。しかし卵黄嚢腫瘍株と奇形腫株は継代により次第に消失し、奇形腫株では神経由来細胞とともに消失しました。胚細胞腫瘍細胞株における神経様形質の不安定性が示されています。
pmid-2542141.summary_en: The authors examined N-myc gene amplification by Southern hybridization, alongside neuron-specific enolase production, in gynecological malignant cell lines and a neuroblastoma line. Three lines, a neuroblastoma line, an endodermal sinus tumor line, and a malignant teratoma line, showed both features together. However, these traits gradually disappeared with serial passage of the endodermal sinus tumor and teratoma lines. In the teratoma line, the traits were lost along with cells of nervous origin. Nine other cell lines showed neither N-myc amplification nor NSE production. The study highlights the instability of neural-associated features in germ cell tumor cell lines.

pmid-2542142.summary_ja: Smith-Lemli-Opitz症候群を有する若年女性に生じた卵巣悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の初めての症例報告です。本症候群はコレステロール生合成の遺伝性疾患であり、稀な卵巣悪性腫瘍との関連を示しています。抄録のため治療や転帰の詳細は示されていません。先天性症候群を伴う胚細胞腫瘍の報告として意義があります。
pmid-2542142.summary_en: The authors report the first known case of a malignant germ cell tumor of the ovary in a young woman with Smith-Lemli-Opitz syndrome. This genetic disorder of cholesterol biosynthesis is linked here to a rare ovarian malignancy, specifically a malignant mixed germ cell tumor. Because the abstract is brief, clinical details such as treatment, staging, and outcome are not provided. The report adds to the limited literature on germ cell tumors occurring in patients with congenital syndromes and may prompt consideration of this association in future cases.

pmid-2543111.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の転移例65例で、化学療法後の救済リンパ節郭清の結果を後方視的に検討しました。残存組織の性状が最も重要な予後因子で、線維化・壊死のみの症例は91%が無病生存しました。腫瘍マーカーやCTでは残存組織の性状を正確に予測できず、化学療法後の手術の意義を支持しています。
pmid-2543111.summary_en: A retrospective study of 65 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors who underwent salvage lymphadenectomy after polychemotherapy. Histology showed scarring in 35%, differentiated teratoma in 39%, and residual cancer in 26%. Neither tumor markers nor CT reliably predicted residual histology. Patients with only fibrous or necrotic tissue had excellent outcomes (91% alive without disease), while persistent cancer was associated with 47% survival. The authors support postchemotherapy surgery in all responders.

pmid-2543215.summary_ja: 米国ワシントン州の症例対照研究で、精巣の胚細胞腫瘍男性323例と対照658例を比較しました。ゆったりした下着や温熱環境は有意な関連を示さず、精索静脈瘤でも相対危険度1.8で、有意差はありませんでした。間欠的な陰嚢温度上昇が病因である根拠は乏しいと結論されました。
pmid-2543215.summary_en: A population-based case-control study in western Washington compared 323 men with testicular germ cell tumors to 658 controls. Exposures included underwear type, heat-resistant clothing, hot tub or sauna use, long underwear, and varicocele. No association was found with tight underwear or occupational heat exposure. Long underwear use showed a 50% increased risk that was not statistically significant. Varicocele yielded a relative risk of 1.8 with a confidence interval including 1. Findings provide little support for intermittent scrotal heating as an etiologic factor, though continuous heating from varicocele warrants further study.

pmid-2543310.summary_ja: 国立台湾大学病院で1965〜1986年に治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者を対象に、予後因子を解析しました。死亡率に基づく独自のスコアリングシステムを作成し、それに従って治療した51例の転帰と各レジメンの毒性を報告しています。リスク分類に基づく個別化治療の有用性を示しています。
pmid-2543310.summary_en: This report from National Taiwan University Hospital evaluates management of gestational trophoblastic tumor. Sixty-five patients treated with chemotherapy between 1965 and 1979 were analyzed for prognostic factors, leading to a scoring system suited to local conditions. The system was then applied to 51 patients treated from 1980 to 1986, and outcomes and toxicities of different regimens were reported. The study highlights individualized, risk-stratified therapy in gestational trophoblastic tumor.

pmid-2543312.summary_ja: 15年間の経験から、多剤化学療法を行っても約15%の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者が完全寛解に至らないことを指摘しています。持続例の早期予測、複数の腫瘍マーカーによる分類、新規薬剤、薬剤耐性の克服、手術・放射線・免疫調節薬を組み合わせた集学的治療などの改善点を挙げています。
pmid-2543312.summary_en: The authors summarize 15 years of experience with gestational trophoblastic tumor, noting that about 15% of patients fail to achieve complete remission despite multiagent chemotherapy. They identify needed improvements: prediction of persistent disease before and after molar evacuation, a clinicobiochemical classification using multiple tumor markers, new chemotherapeutic agents, strategies to overcome drug resistance, multimodality treatment including surgery, irradiation, and immune modifiers, and consolidation of remission. The abstract is brief and presents a forward-looking agenda rather than detailed data.

pmid-2543314.summary_ja: ネパールのカトマンズ市内2病院で収集された、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の初めての臨床データです。母子病院では1986〜1987年に胞状奇胎68例（妊娠1000件あたり2.84）、教育病院では1985〜1988年に26例（妊娠1000件あたり7.07）が確認されました。ネパールの発生率は予想より高く、アジア諸国と同程度と報告されています。
pmid-2543314.summary_en: This study provides the first data on trophoblastic disease in Nepal, collected from two Kathmandu hospitals. At a maternity hospital in 1986 to 1987, 68 molar pregnancies were identified, an incidence of 2.84 per 1000 pregnancies. At a teaching hospital from 1985 to 1988, 26 cases were recorded, with an incidence of 7.07 per 1000 pregnancies. The authors conclude that the disease rate in Nepal appears higher than expected and similar to other Asian countries at sea level.

pmid-2543315.summary_ja: 1979〜1986年の日本の全国登録データから、胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の発生動向を報告しています。絨毛癌の発生率は低下し、40歳以上、転移性奇胎、侵入奇胎が高リスクとされました。手術と化学療法の併用は5年生存率80%で、単独療法より良好でした。転移のない絨毛癌の5年生存率は100%、転移性絨毛癌は59.2%でした。
pmid-2543315.summary_en: This review summarizes Japanese population-based trophoblastic disease registry data from 1979 to 1986. The incidence of choriocarcinoma declined from 0.31 to 0.13 over the period. Risk factors for choriocarcinoma included age over 40, metastatic mole, and invasive mole. Five-year survival was 100% for nonmetastatic choriocarcinoma and 59.2% for metastatic disease. Combined surgery and chemotherapy yielded 80% five-year survival, higher than chemotherapy alone (71.4%) or surgery alone (67.7%).

pmid-2545021.summary_ja: 父親がセミノーマ、息子が胎児性癌を発症した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の親子例を報告する。親子での精巣腫瘍の報告は文献上18例目である。息子でより悪性度の高い腫瘍がより若年で発生する傾向が、本例によって確認されたと著者らは述べている。
pmid-2545021.summary_en: This case report describes a father and son with testicular germ cell tumors: the father had a seminoma and the son an embryonal carcinoma. The authors note this is the 18th reported father-son pair with testicular tumors in the literature. They state the report confirms a trend toward more malignant tumors occurring at younger ages in sons.

pmid-2545068.summary_ja: 培養内皮細胞においてトロンボモジュリン(TM)は長期継代やIL-1処理により減少することを示した。さらに絨毛性疾患の手術検体を検討し、絨毛癌および胞状奇胎の腫瘍性合胞体栄養膜細胞にTMが発現することを見出した。一方、確立された絨毛癌細胞株3種ではTMは発現していなかった。
pmid-2545068.summary_en: The authors examined thrombomodulin (TM) expression in cultured endothelial cells, showing decreases with prolonged subculture and IL-1 treatment. They also assessed TM distribution in surgical specimens of chorionic diseases, finding TM on neoplastic syncytiotrophoblast of choriocarcinoma and hydatidiform mole, as well as on angiosarcoma. Three established choriocarcinoma cell lines lacked TM expression. The work spans endothelial biology and gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-2545331.summary_ja: 片側精巣摘除後のセミノーマ39例と非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍58例で、精子数・性腺刺激ホルモン・アンドロゲンを検討した。精子数減少はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇、停留精巣の既往、セミノーマ組織型と関連した。約42%は凍結保存に適した精子を有しており、精巣摘除後の生殖機能評価の重要性が示された。
pmid-2545331.summary_en: This study examined sperm counts, gonadotropins, and androgens in 39 seminoma and 58 nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients after unilateral orchiectomy. More than half had subnormal total sperm counts, which correlated with elevated AFP, a history of cryptorchidism, and seminomatous histology. FSH was elevated in a third of patients, while androgens were mostly normal. About 42% had sperm quality adequate for cryopreservation, supporting reproductive assessment after orchiectomy.

pmid-2545635.summary_ja: 精巣のセミノーマでN-mycが高発現し、RB mRNAが減少していることを示した。小細胞肺癌細胞株でも同様の変化が報告されており、本研究で確認された。正常成人精巣ではL-mycのmRNAが少量検出された。N-mycの活性化とRB発現低下の類似性は、腫瘍間で共通の発がん機構が関与する可能性を示唆する。
pmid-2545635.summary_en: The authors show that N-myc is highly expressed and RB mRNA is decreased in a testicular seminoma, with a pattern similar to that reported in small-cell lung cancer cell lines. L-myc transcripts were detectable in normal adult testis. The shared pattern of N-myc activation with RB loss suggests a common oncogenic mechanism across these tumor types.

pmid-2545794.summary_ja: 精巣・性腺外・卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍258例中、治療前にCEAが上昇していたのは3%のみであった。シスプラチン併用化学療法中または後に、CEAの持続的上昇が7%で見られた。CEA上昇は予後不良とは関連せず、著者らは胚細胞腫瘍の管理にCEA測定は有用でないと結論している。
pmid-2545794.summary_en: Among 258 assessable patients with testicular, extragonadal, or ovarian GCT, only 3% had elevated CEA before treatment. Persistently raised CEA occurred in 7% during or after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic disease. Raised CEA was not linked to adverse prognosis. Elevated CEA was more common after excision of mature teratoma, but often persisted despite apparent complete resection. The authors conclude CEA measurement does not help manage germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-2545983.summary_ja: 頭蓋外の頭頸部に原発した胚細胞悪性腫瘍の小児4例を報告した。内訳は卵黄嚢腫瘍2例、腎芽腫成分と神経芽腫成分を伴う悪性奇形腫各1例である。3例は死亡、1例は無病生存した。著者らは、奇形腫性腫瘍には技術的に可能な場合の完全切除が適応であり、悪性成分は化学療法と放射線療法に感受性があると結論づけている。
pmid-2545983.summary_en: The authors report four children with primary extracranial head and neck germ cell malignancies: two yolk sac tumors (endodermal sinus tumor), one malignant teratoma with nephroblastoma components, and one malignant teratoma with neuroblastoma components. Three patients received combination chemotherapy and two received irradiation; three died of progressive disease. The authors conclude that complete resection is indicated for teratomatous tumors when feasible, and that malignant components are sensitive to chemotherapy and irradiation.

pmid-2546839.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞を用い、リポキシゲナーゼ代謝産物がhCG分泌に与える影響を検討した基礎研究。15-HETEは基礎分泌を約3倍に増加させ、EGFによる分泌促進も増強した。アラキドン酸経路がhCG分泌制御に関与し、EGF作用の律速因子となりうることが示唆された。
pmid-2546839.summary_en: Examines how lipoxygenase products affect hCG secretion by cultured human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells. 15-HETE increased basal hCG secretion about threefold and potentiated EGF-induced secretion, while 5-HETE, 12-HETE and LTA4 had no significant effect. TPA-stimulated secretion was unaffected. The findings implicate the arachidonic acid pathway in hCG regulation and suggest lipoxygenase products can rate-limit EGF action.

pmid-2547514.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の各組織型、前癌段階の異型胚細胞、関連細胞株を対象に、アルカリホスファターゼ(ALP)の4種のアイソザイムを等電点電気泳動で解析した研究。セミノーマで発現が最大となり、前癌段階から既に過剰発現していた。染色体1番と2番の倍数性との関連も考察されている。
pmid-2547514.summary_en: Detected the four human alkaline phosphatase isozymes by isoelectric focusing in various testicular germ cell tumors, their precancerous atypical germ cells, and three related cell lines. Seminoma showed maximal expression, with both placental and germ cell ALP forms present. Overexpression already occurred in precancerous tissue, and the authors discuss links to polyploidy of chromosomes 1 and 2 and coordinated activation of tissue-specific ALP genes.

pmid-2549132.summary_ja: 久留米大学病院で18年間に治療した卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍112例の臨床病理学的研究。5年生存率は組織型により異なり、ディスジャーミノーマで76.7%と最も良好であった。ディスジャーミノーマを除き病期が予後因子となることを示した。卵黄嚢腫瘍や未熟奇形腫では化学療法後の組織成熟が見られた。
pmid-2549132.summary_en: Reviews 112 patients treated over 18 years at Kurume University Hospital for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, including yolk sac tumors, dysgerminomas, immature teratomas, mixed forms, choriocarcinomas and dermoid cysts with malignant transformation. Five-year survival varied by histology, from 76.7% for dysgerminoma to 20.0% for mixed forms. Stage remained prognostic except in dysgerminoma. Histologic maturation after chemotherapy in yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma suggests possible links between prognosis and histogenesis.

pmid-2550238.summary_ja: 本論文は家族性精巣がんの4家系を報告し、セミノーマを発症した兄弟2人のHLAタイピングを行った。兄弟は完全なHLAハプロタイプを共有していた。既報8家系と文献上の119家系の検討でも期待以上のハプロタイプ共有が見られ、胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝的素因を支持する結果とされている。
pmid-2550238.summary_en: This 1989 study reports four new familial clusters of testicular cancer and HLA typing of one pair of brothers with seminoma, who shared a complete HLA haplotype. Combining these with eight previously reported familial clusters and a literature review of 119 families, the authors found more haplotype sharing than expected. They interpret this as supporting a genetic influence, possibly anticipation, in germ cell tumors.

pmid-2550400.summary_ja: 1957年から1988年に当施設で治療された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍11例を報告する。内訳はセミノーマ4例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍3例、胎児性癌2例、奇形癌2例。セミノーマは減量手術と術後照射で良好な局所制御が得られた。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は生存率が有意に低く、文献的考察も行われている。
pmid-2550400.summary_en: This report describes eleven cases of primary malignant mediastinal germ cell tumor treated at the Peter MacCallum Cancer Institute between 1957 and 1988. Four were seminomas, three mixed germ cell tumors, two embryonal carcinomas and two teratocarcinomas. Seminoma patients fared best with surgical debulking and postoperative irradiation, achieving local control. Non-seminomatous tumors had significantly poorer survival, and the authors review the literature on this anterior mediastinal disease.

pmid-2550950.summary_ja: 1981年から1988年に、第1・第2選択療法に抵抗性または再発した進行精巣がん49例を対象に、エトポシド、イホスファミド、±ドキソルビシンの第3選択化学療法の効果を評価した。完全奏効2例、部分奏効10例で奏効率は24.48%であった。主な有害事象は白血球減少で、腎機能障害は一過性かつ軽度であった。
pmid-2550950.summary_en: This study evaluates a third-line combination of etoposide (Vepesid), ifosfamide (Holoxan), with or without doxorubicin (Adriblastin), plus mesna (Uromitexan), in 49 evaluable patients with advanced testicular cancer refractory to or relapsing after first- and second-line therapy, treated 1981 to 1988. Two achieved complete response and ten partial response, a 24.48% response rate. Leukopenia was the most severe toxicity, and renal toxicity was transient and mild.

pmid-2551494.summary_ja: 精巣原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍14例を短期組織培養後に細胞遺伝学的に解析した。モード染色体数は53〜113で、フローサイトメトリーによるDNA量と一致した。14例中12例でi(12p)が少なくとも1コピー認められ、2例では欠如していた。特定の染色体の過剰・欠失が見られ、セミノーマとの違いも一部確認された。
pmid-2551494.summary_en: This cytogenetic study analyzed 14 primary testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors after short-term tissue culture. Modal chromosome numbers ranged from 53 to 113, consistent with flow cytometric DNA content. At least one copy of i(12p) was present in 12 of 14 tumors, and two lacked this marker. Some chromosomes were overrepresented and others underrepresented, with some differences noted compared with seminomas.

pmid-2551691.summary_ja: キール小児腫瘍登録に基づき、生後6か月以下の腹部・後腹膜・仙尾部腫瘍226例を解析した。神経芽腫が最多で、次いで胚細胞腫瘍76例（未熟奇形腫37例、成熟奇形腫32例）であった。悪性胚細胞腫瘍の成分は年長児に比べて少なく、多くは仙尾部に発生していた。年齢による発生部位・組織型・予後の違いが示されている。
pmid-2551691.summary_en: This Kiel Paediatric Tumour Registry report analyzed 226 abdominal, retroperitoneal, and sacrococcygeal tumours in infants aged 6 months or younger. Neuroblastomas were most common, followed by 76 germ cell tumours, including 37 immature and 32 mature teratomas. Malignant germ cell components were far rarer than in older children, and most germ cell tumours were sacrococcygeal. The authors highlight age-related differences in location, histology, and favourable prognosis.

pmid-2552741.summary_ja: 1966〜1986年にスウェーデンのKarolinska病院で治療した妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍58例の20年間の経験を報告。メトトレキサートを中心とした化学療法で全体の寛解率は96.5%。高リスク群や後期再発例も含め、多くは化学療法で救済された。手術は選択的症例や化学療法不応例に限定された。
pmid-2552741.summary_en: This Swedish single-institution review covers 58 GTN patients treated at Karolinska Hospital from 1966 to 1986, roughly half of national cases. Most developed malignancy after molar pregnancy, and 25 had metastatic disease, six classified as high-risk. Methotrexate-folinic acid was the first-line regimen from 1978, with CHAMOMA or EMA/CA as second-line options; surgery was reserved for elective or failed-chemotherapy cases. Overall remission was 96.5% with at least two years of follow-up, and five patients relapsed late.

pmid-2554633.summary_ja: 精巣悪性腫瘍に対する傍大動脈リンパ節への放射線療法後に筋萎縮を来した3例の報告。神経生理学的検査で腰神経叢や末梢神経の病変は否定され、前角細胞病変を示す所見もなかった。感覚障害はないものの、体性感覚誘発電位の潜時延長と振幅低下がみられ、放射線による馬尾神経根障害が示唆された。
pmid-2554633.summary_en: Three patients developed muscle atrophy after para-aortal radiotherapy for malignant testicular tumor. Neurophysiological testing excluded lumbar plexus and peripheral nerve lesions, and EMG showed no giant motor unit potentials, arguing against anterior horn cell disease. Although sensory deficits were absent, lumbar dermatomal SSEPs and peripheral nerve SSEPs showed prolonged latencies and reduced amplitudes. The findings suggest radiation-induced injury to the caudal nerve roots as a late complication.

pmid-2554701.summary_ja: 右精巣摘除および後腹膜リンパ節郭清の5年後に、左精巣に腫瘍を生じた36歳男性の症例報告。左精巣摘除の病理はセミノーマと胎児性癌の混在であった。CTおよびガリウムシンチグラフィーで転移は認めず、PVB化学療法を施行した。過去の両側性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の報告をまとめ、年齢分布や発症間隔、組織型について考察している。
pmid-2554701.summary_en: A 36-year-old man with bilateral testicular germ cell tumor is described. Five years earlier he had undergone right orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for embryonal carcinoma. In 1988 a left testicular mass prompted left orchiectomy, which showed seminoma with embryonal carcinoma. CT and gallium scintigraphy showed no metastasis, and he received PVB chemotherapy. The authors review previous bilateral cases and discuss age distribution, interval between tumors, and histology.

pmid-2555732.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で多発性の大きな脳転移をきたした症例の報告。PVB化学療法は血液脳関門の通過が悪く、脳転移の予後は不良とされる。本例は外科的減量切除、PVB化学療法、全脳照射により治癒した。大きな脳転移に対する外科的減量の役割を論じ、全身療法との併用の有用性を示唆している。
pmid-2555732.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who developed multiple large brain metastases. Because PVB chemotherapy (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin) penetrates the blood-brain barrier poorly, brain involvement carries a poor prognosis. The patient was treated with surgical debulking, PVB chemotherapy, and whole-brain radiation therapy, and was cured. The authors review the limited role of surgery in brain metastases from testicular germ cell tumors and argue that debulking of large lesions can be beneficial when combined with systemic therapy.

pmid-2556485.summary_ja: 1977〜1988年に静岡県で実施された妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の登録・フォローアップ制度の成績報告。胞状奇胎1,925例、侵入奇胎68例、絨毛癌48例などが登録され、制度は早期発見・治療に寄与した。絨毛癌の先行妊娠は胞状奇胎後から正期産後へ変化しており、制度未登録の正期産後絨毛癌への注意を促している。
pmid-2556485.summary_en: This Japanese registry study reviews gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) registered in Shizuoka Prefecture from 1977 to 1988 under a formal follow-up system. Among 1,925 hydatidiform moles, 68 invasive moles, 70 persistent trophoblastic disease cases, and 48 choriocarcinomas were recorded, with a 97.4% registration rate. Hydatidiform mole registrations declined, and choriocarcinoma registrations fell significantly. Notably, the antecedent pregnancy for choriocarcinoma shifted from molar to term gestation, suggesting that term-pregnancy-associated choriocarcinoma needs greater attention beyond the current registry.

pmid-2556586.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍24例の腫瘍検体を解析し、12番染色体短腕のアイソクロモソームi(12p)の有無を検討した。i(12p)は16例の20検体に認められ、絨毛癌を含むすべての原発部位・組織型で見られた。12pの追加コピーが3本以上あると治療失敗の可能性が有意に高かった。i(12p)は初期に生じる異常と考えられ、診断・予後マーカーとしての有用性が示唆される。
pmid-2556586.summary_en: This study examined isochromosome 12p, i(12p), in tumor specimens from 24 males with germ cell tumors spanning all primary sites and histologies. i(12p) was detected in 20 specimens from 16 patients, including a choriocarcinoma. Seven specimens had a normal 46,XY karyotype, and one failed cytogenetic analysis. Having three or more additional copies of 12p was significantly associated with treatment failure. The authors suggest i(12p) arises as an early event in tumor development, making it a useful diagnostic marker and a potential prognostic indicator in male germ cell tumors.

pmid-2556605.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌細胞株JHTK-1を用い、分化誘導による新たな治療法の可能性を検討したin vitro研究。1 mMのジブチリルcAMPは48時間以内に形態変化、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌の15倍以上の増加、50%超の増殖抑制をもたらした。テオフィリン、酪酸ナトリウム、ビタミンC、ビンブラスチン、アクチノマイシンDも分化誘導物質として同定された。化学物質による分化誘導療法の概念を提唱している。
pmid-2556605.summary_en: This in vitro study examined whether the testicular choriocarcinoma cell line JHTK-1 can be induced to differentiate, as a basis for a differentiation-induction approach to testicular germ cell tumor therapy. Dibutyryl cAMP (DBcAMP) at 1 mM produced morphological changes within 48 hours, increased hCG secretion more than 15-fold, and inhibited proliferation by over 50%, in a dose-dependent manner. Several other agents, including theophylline, sodium butyrate, vitamin C, vinblastine, and actinomycin D, also increased hCG secretion. The authors propose that chemical inducers may support a differentiation-induction therapy for testicular choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2556829.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんの化学療法後に切除された残存組織を軟寒天で培養し、クローン原性増殖を評価した後方視的研究。12検体中10検体でコロニー形成が見られ、がん組織ではそれ以外より有意に多かった（p=0.019）。良性組織の患者は追跡期間中無病で、がん患者のうち3名は死亡した。組織学的所見を補完する予測因子となりうると結論している。
pmid-2556829.summary_en: This study evaluated whether colony-forming assays on residual tissue resected after chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell cancer could predict biological behavior. Eleven patients had 12 assays of resected tissue cultured in soft agar. Colony formation occurred in 10 of 12 assays, and was significantly greater in tissue containing cancer than in benign tissue (p = 0.019). Patients with benign tissue remained disease-free over three to six years of follow-up, whereas three patients with cancer died. The authors conclude that clonogenic growth may complement histology in predicting disease behavior.

pmid-2557596.summary_ja: 27歳男性に生じた縦隔原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。CT下穿刺吸引細胞診の材料を光顕と電顕で検討し、光顕ではセミノーマのみが同定された。電顕と標本の再検討により絨毛癌と奇形腫の成分が確認され、手術・剖検組織でも裏付けられた。混合組織型の診断には超微細構造の細胞学的検討が有用で、予後と治療の決定に重要であると結論している。
pmid-2557596.summary_en: This report describes a 27-year-old man with a mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor containing seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma components. Material obtained by CT-guided fine needle aspiration was examined by light and electron microscopy. Light microscopy identified only seminoma, whereas electron microscopy, reexamination of slides, and later surgical and autopsy histology revealed choriocarcinoma and teratoma elements. The authors emphasize that ultrastructural cytology was needed to recognize the mixed histology, which is critical for prognosis and therapy.

pmid-2557695.summary_ja: 未治療の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者12例（セミノーマ5例、非セミノーマ7例）と健常男性14例で、GnRH負荷に対する性腺刺激ホルモン応答を比較した。基礎ホルモン値は対照と差がなかったが、患者では下垂体反応が低下し、非セミノーマではFSH応答が欠如していた。治療前から視床下部-下垂体-性腺系の機能異常が存在すると結論され、妊孕性への影響の検討も必要とされた。
pmid-2557695.summary_en: This study assessed the hypothalamic-hypophyseal-gonadal axis in 12 untreated men with testicular germ cell tumors (5 seminomas, 7 non-seminomas) and 14 healthy controls using a 100-microgram GnRH bolus. Basal testosterone, estradiol, and prolactin did not differ from controls. Gonadotropin peaks were lower in patients, and non-seminoma patients lacked an FSH response and had lower FSH and LH peaks than controls. The authors conclude that this endocrine alteration, particularly in non-seminomas, is present before therapy and suggest further study of its effect on fertility.

pmid-2558693.summary_ja: 1972～1983年にフィンランドで診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍422例を解析した。罹患率は過去より上昇し、3年生存率は病期I～IIBで大きく改善した一方、進行病期は依然不良であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法が予後改善に大きく寄与した。臨床的病期分類の精度は向上したと示唆されている。
pmid-2558693.summary_en: This nationwide Finnish study analyzed 422 patients with testicular germ cell cancer diagnosed in 1972 to 1983. Incidence rose compared with previous decades, and three-year survival improved markedly, reaching nearly 100% for seminoma and over 90% for non-seminoma in stages I to IIB, while advanced-stage survival remained poor. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy contributed substantially to improved prognosis in both histologies. The authors also suggest that clinical staging accuracy improved, based on relapse rates in stage I patients staged surgically versus clinically.

pmid-2558941.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera-2およびNTera-2において、TGF-βの産生と受容体発現の調節を解析した。レチノイン酸による神経外胚葉系への分化に伴い、TGF-β1とβ2のmRNAと活性が増加し、増殖は低下した。ヒト株はIII型受容体を介してTGF-β1に高親和性で結合し、レチノイン酸処理によりこの結合はほぼ失われた。マウス株との違いが考察された。
pmid-2558941.summary_en: This study examined transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-beta) signaling in two human embryonal carcinoma cell lines, Tera-2 clone 13 and NTera-2 clone D1. Retinoic acid induced neuroectodermal differentiation with reduced proliferation, accompanied by increased TGF-beta1 and TGF-beta2 mRNA and activity. Unlike murine EC cells, these human lines bound TGF-beta1 with high affinity through type III receptors, and retinoic acid nearly abolished this binding. The authors discuss similarities and differences between human and murine EC cell regulation of growth and differentiation.

pmid-2559069.summary_ja: 絨毛外栄養膜細胞のマーカーとして、PP19、SP1、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を免疫組織化学的に比較した研究である。対象には子宮外妊娠、子宮内妊娠、侵入胞状奇胎、原発性および転移性の妊娠性絨毛癌を含む。PP19は絨毛外合胞体性栄養膜細胞と間質性細胞様の栄養膜細胞に陽性であった。抄録は途中で打ち切られており、絨毛性疾患での所見は一部のみ確認できる。
pmid-2559069.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared placental protein 19 (PP19), pregnancy-specific beta1-glycoprotein (SP1), and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) as markers of extravillous trophoblast. Specimens included tubal and intrauterine pregnancies, late pregnancies with placental abnormalities, invasive complete moles, and primary and metastatic gestational choriocarcinomas. PP19 was expressed in extravillous syncytiotrophoblast and interstitial cytotrophoblast-like cells, while hCG and SP1 were limited to certain populations. The source abstract is truncated, so trophoblastic disease findings are only partly available.

pmid-2559868.summary_ja: ヒト奇形腫由来細胞株GCT 27から多能性の胎児性癌幹細胞クローンGCT 27 X-1を単離し、非多能性クローンと比較した。多能性クローンはフィーダー細胞層に依存し、除去すると内胚葉系や神経系へ分化した。ヌードマウスでは卵黄嚢癌やAFP・hCG産生細胞を含む奇形癌を形成した。卵黄嚢癌細胞株の培養上清がフィーダー依存性を部分的に代替し、傍分泌制御の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2559868.summary_en: The authors isolated a multipotent human embryonal carcinoma stem cell clone, GCT 27 X-1, from the human teratoma cell line GCT 27 and compared it with a nullipotent clone, GCT 27 C-1. Both shared similar surface, cytostructural, and extracellular matrix marker profiles and chromosome features. Multipotent cells required feeder layers and differentiated into extraembryonic endoderm and neuronal types when feeders were removed. Xenografts formed teratocarcinomas with diverse lineages, including yolk sac carcinoma and AFP- and hCG-producing cells. Yolk sac carcinoma supernatant partly replaced the feeder requirement, suggesting paracrine regulation.

pmid-2560279.summary_ja: 精巣がん151例（非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍86例、純粋セミノーマ65例）のHLA抗原（A、B、C、DR）を解析した研究である。術前の血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が高値を示した症例は、セミノーマ群24例、非セミノーマ群50例であった。DR-5はセミノーマ群で、B-13は非セミノーマ群で増加しており、hCG陽性セミノーマはHLA分布においてNSGCTよりもセミノーマ様であった。HLA抗原が組織型に関連する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2560279.summary_en: This study typed 151 patients with testicular cancer (86 non-seminomatous germ cell tumors and 65 pure seminomas) for HLA-A, B, C and DR antigens. Pre-operative serum hCG was elevated in 24 seminoma and 50 NSGCT patients. DR-5 was increased in pure seminoma, while B-13 was increased in NSGCT. hCG-positive seminomas resembled seminomatous tumors rather than NSGCT in HLA distribution, suggesting that histocompatibility antigens may be related to testicular tumor histology.

pmid-2560369.summary_ja: 胎盤、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の組織におけるレクチン結合性を光学顕微鏡で検討した研究である。Con-AとWGAの結合は正常胎盤に比べ増加し、悪性転化よりも栄養膜細胞の増殖を反映していた。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌の多くではPNA結合が乏しく、一部の悪性栄養膜細胞で末端シアル酸が欠失している可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2560369.summary_en: This light-microscopic study examined lectin binding (Con-A, WGA, PNA) in normal placenta and gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole and choriocarcinoma. Con-A and WGA binding increased in all trophoblastic lesions compared with normal placenta, reflecting trophoblast proliferation rather than malignant transformation. PNA binding was minimal or absent in invasive mole and most choriocarcinomas, suggesting loss of terminal sialic acid in some malignant trophoblasts, which may serve as a diagnostic or biological marker.

pmid-2560376.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者9例で、夫のHLAアロタイプに対するリンパ球細胞傷害を抑制する血清中物質を検討した研究である。絨毛癌3/3例、侵入奇胎3/4例、胞状奇胎1/2例で阻害物質が検出され、その力価は腫瘍の増殖とともに変化する様子がみられた。この物質は腫瘍に対する免疫応答を反映し、栄養膜腫瘍細胞に対する拒絶反応が起こらない理由を説明する可能性がある。
pmid-2560376.summary_en: Nine patients with gestational trophoblastic disease were tested for a serum substance that inhibits lymphocytotoxicity against their husbands' HLA allotypes. The inhibitory substance was found in all three choriocarcinoma patients, three of four invasive mole patients, and one of two hydatidiform mole patients, with titers appearing to follow tumor growth. The authors suggest the substance may reflect the immune response to trophoblastic tumor and may explain the absence of graft rejection against tumor cells.

pmid-2560719.summary_ja: 良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)の内部に生じた膠芽腫の症例報告である。神経成分の悪性化は稀で、先行報告は1例のみとされている。GFAP免疫組織化学染色により神経由来が裏付けられた。補助療法を行わない保存的手術にもかかわらず、3年以上無症状で生存している。
pmid-2560719.summary_en: This case report describes glioblastoma multiforme arising within a benign cystic ovarian teratoma (dermoid cyst). Neural malignancy within a teratoma is rare, with the authors noting only one prior report. Glial origin was confirmed by GFAP immunohistochemistry. Despite very conservative surgery without adjuvant therapy, the patient remained alive and symptom-free for more than three years, illustrating rare malignant transformation of a teratoma with a favorable outcome.

pmid-2561098.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で白金併用化学療法後にCTで残存腫瘤を認めた42例の残存腫瘤切除を検討した。残存悪性腫瘍は21%、分化奇形腫は33%、線維化・壊死は36%であった。組織所見は再発を予測しなかった。中央値36か月で86%が無病であり、不完全切除では再発傾向があったが有意差はなかった。
pmid-2561098.summary_en: This study reviewed 42 patients who underwent resection of residual masses detected by CT after platinum-based chemotherapy for advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, despite negative tumor markers. Specimens showed residual malignancy in 21%, differentiated teratoma in 33%, and fibrosis or necrosis in 36%. Histology did not predict relapse. With a median follow-up of 36 months, 86% remained disease-free, and incomplete excision showed a non-significant trend toward relapse.

pmid-2562098.summary_ja: 精巣の混合型胎児性癌から3種のヒト胎児性癌細胞株（NCR-G2、G3、G4）を新たに樹立した研究である。G3とG4は体細胞への分化能を示し、G3はレチノイン酸処理で最も顕著な抗原変化を示した。G3ではヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、ケラチンおよび細胞外基質が誘導可能であり、最も多能性の高いヒト胎児性癌細胞の一つと考えられ、胚細胞腫瘍の分化機構研究に有用である。
pmid-2562098.summary_en: Three human embryonal carcinoma cell lines (NCR-G2, G3, G4) were newly established from testicular mixed embryonal carcinomas. G3 and G4 showed somatic differentiation capacity, and G3 showed the most pronounced antigenic changes after retinoic acid treatment. The authors describe immature EC-specific surface antigens defined with mouse monoclonal antibodies, and inducible hCG, cytokeratin and extracellular matrix components in G3 cells. G3 was considered one of the most pluripotent human EC lines, offering a model for germ cell tumor differentiation.

pmid-2562115.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫の患者で、診断から11か月後に急性非リンパ球性白血病を発症した症例の連続的な細胞遺伝学的解析を報告する。治療前後の腫瘍組織と2回の白血病骨髄検体に共通してi(12p)が認められ、一部の腫瘍クローンと全白血病クローンに21番染色体トリソミーが出現した。白血病は悪性胚細胞クローンに由来することが示され、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と白血病の関連を遺伝学的に裏付けた。
pmid-2562115.summary_en: This case report presents serial cytogenetic analyses of a patient with a mediastinal yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma who developed acute nonlymphocytic leukemia 11 months after diagnosis. Pre- and post-treatment tumor biopsies and two leukemic marrow samples shared an i(12p) abnormality, and trisomy 21 appeared in one tumor clone and all leukemic clones. These findings establish a common origin and indicate that the leukemia arose from the malignant germ cell clone, providing genetic evidence for an association between mediastinal germ cell tumors and leukemia.

pmid-2564001.summary_ja: セミノーマの組織切片に複数のレクチンを反応させ、臨床パラメータとの相関を検討した研究である。コンカナバリンAとWGAは全例を染色した。停留精巣由来のセミノーマではダイズ凝集素陽性例が多く、腹腔内の位置が糖鎖発現に影響する可能性が示された。一方、予後、病期、転移との相関は認められなかった。
pmid-2564001.summary_en: This study applied a panel of lectins to histological sections of seminomas and compared staining patterns with clinical parameters. Concanavalin A and wheat germ agglutinin stained all tumors, while horse gram and peanut agglutinin did not stain tumor cells. Lectins from castor bean, soy bean, and gorse showed heterogeneous patterns, indicating variation within the tumor cell population. Seminomas arising from undescended testes more often stained with soy bean agglutinin, suggesting that intra-abdominal location may alter glycoconjugate expression. No correlation was found with prognosis, stage, or metastasis.

pmid-2564340.summary_ja: 多能性を持つ胎児性癌細胞の分化誘導を、レチノイン酸を中心に概説した総説である。分化に伴う遺伝子発現の変化が原因か結果かを検討している。分化した細胞と異なり、胎児性癌細胞がウイルスゲノムの発現を受け付けにくい理由も考察された。抑制因子配列の消失や中和が、これらの変化の基盤と提案されている。
pmid-2564340.summary_en: This review examines how embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, which are pluripotent and resemble germ cells and embryonic stem cells, can be triggered to differentiate, with emphasis on retinoic acid. It summarizes changes in gene expression during EC differentiation and asks whether these changes cause or result from the differentiation event. The authors also consider why EC cells, unlike their differentiated derivatives, resist expression of many infecting viral genomes. They propose that loss or neutralization of strong repressor elements underlies many of the observed changes in gene expression.

pmid-2565826.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍の捻転を臨床病理学的に検討した1989年の報告である。妊娠中の発生率は非妊娠例より高く、疼痛が主症状であった。腫瘍の大半は良性嚢胞性奇形腫で、悪性は8.7%に留まった。若年女性の卵巣腫瘍では捻転が緊急手術の対象となりうることを示している。
pmid-2565826.summary_en: This clinicopathological study reviewed ovarian tumor torsion, which occurred mainly in women of reproductive age and was more frequent during pregnancy (22.7%) than in non-pregnant women (6.1%). Pain was the main symptom, and an abdominal mass was palpable in 79.4% of cases. Torsion involved the right ovary more often, and half of the cases were gangrenous at laparotomy. Most lesions were benign cystic teratomas, while only 8.7% were malignant. The findings highlight torsion as a surgical emergency in young women with ovarian masses.

pmid-2567209.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌MH-15を担がんさせたマウスで、SSEA-1抗体とメトトレキサートの複合体の抗腫瘍効果を検討した前臨床研究である。15 mg/kg投与で有意な抗腫瘍効果が得られ、全身毒性は目立たなかった。対照薬や遊離メトトレキサートでは効果が認められなかった。IgMが薬剤担体として有効である可能性を示した。
pmid-2567209.summary_en: This preclinical study conjugated methotrexate to an IgM monoclonal antibody against stage-specific embryonic antigen-1 (SSEA-1) and tested it in mice bearing MH-15 teratocarcinoma. Conjugates with about 65 mol MTX per mol antibody retained full antigen-binding capacity. At 15 mg/kg of drug, the immunoconjugate produced significant antitumor activity without marked systemic toxicity, whereas control conjugates and free methotrexate had no significant effect. The authors conclude that IgM can serve as an effective drug carrier and that antigens accessible in tumors, even if present on normal tissue, can be suitable targets for chemoimmunotherapy.

pmid-2568087.summary_ja: ニューヨーク州北部で1977〜1980年に精巣がん患者250例と、年齢・近隣をマッチさせた対照者を比較した症例対照研究である。精巣の加熱曝露、肥料・フェノール・煙霧などへの職業的曝露、精巣外傷、停留精巣や低精子数などの精巣関連異常がリスク上昇と関連していた。多変量解析でも、これらのいくつかの因子が統計学的に有意であった。
pmid-2568087.summary_en: This case-control study compared 250 testicular cancer patients in upstate New York (1977-1980) with age- and neighborhood-matched controls. Risk was increased by testicular heat exposure, occupational exposure to fertilizers, phenols, fumes or smoke, and testicular trauma.
